`broker/broker_core.c`:

```c
#include "broker_core.h"

#include <limits.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <string.h>

static int is_ascii_ws(unsigned char c) {
    return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n';
}

static int is_alpha(unsigned char c) {
    return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z');
}

static int is_alnum_underscore(unsigned char c) {
    return is_alpha(c) || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_';
}

static int hex_val(unsigned char c) {
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return (int)(c - '0');
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') return (int)(c - 'a' + 10);
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') return (int)(c - 'A' + 10);
    return -1;
}

static size_t fmt_append_u64(char *dst, size_t pos, size_t max, uint64_t v) {
    char tmp[24];
    size_t n = 0;
    do {
        tmp[n++] = (char)('0' + (v % 10u));
        v /= 10u;
    } while (v != 0 && n < sizeof(tmp));
    while (n > 0 && pos < max) {
        dst[pos++] = tmp[--n];
    }
    return pos;
}

static void set_err(char *errbuf, size_t errcap, const char *fmt, ...) {
    if (!errbuf || errcap == 0 || !fmt) {
        return;
    }
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    size_t pos = 0;
    size_t max = errcap - 1;
    for (const char *p = fmt; *p != '\0' && pos < max; p++) {
        if (*p != '%') {
            errbuf[pos++] = *p;
            continue;
        }
        p++;
        if (*p == '\0') {
            break;
        }
        if (*p == '%') {
            errbuf[pos++] = '%';
        } else if (*p == 's') {
            const char *s = va_arg(ap, const char *);
            if (!s) s = "(null)";
            while (*s != '\0' && pos < max) {
                errbuf[pos++] = *s++;
            }
        } else if (*p == 'd') {
            int iv = va_arg(ap, int);
            uint64_t uv;
            if (iv < 0) {
                errbuf[pos++] = '-';
                uv = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)iv);
            } else {
                uv = (uint64_t)iv;
            }
            pos = fmt_append_u64(errbuf, pos, max, uv);
        } else if (*p == 'z' && *(p + 1) == 'u') {
            p++;
            size_t zv = va_arg(ap, size_t);
            pos = fmt_append_u64(errbuf, pos, max, (uint64_t)zv);
        } else {
            errbuf[pos++] = '%';
            if (pos < max) errbuf[pos++] = *p;
        }
    }
    va_end(ap);
    errbuf[pos] = '\0';
}

int broker_check_self_context(const char *raw, size_t len) {
    if (!raw) {
        return -1;
    }
    while (len > 0 && (raw[len - 1] == '\0' || is_ascii_ws((unsigned char)raw[len - 1]))) {
        len--;
    }
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off < len && is_ascii_ws((unsigned char)raw[off])) {
        off++;
    }
    size_t want = strlen(BROKER_SELINUX_CTX);
    if (len - off != want) {
        return -1;
    }
    return memcmp(raw + off, BROKER_SELINUX_CTX, want) == 0 ? 0 : -1;
}

int broker_authorize_peer(int peer_uid, const char *sec_ctx, size_t sec_len, int allowed_user0_uid) {
    if (allowed_user0_uid < BROKER_MIN_APP_ID || allowed_user0_uid >= BROKER_ANDROID_USER_WIDTH) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (peer_uid != allowed_user0_uid || peer_uid < BROKER_MIN_APP_ID || peer_uid >= BROKER_ANDROID_USER_WIDTH) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (!sec_ctx || sec_len == 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    size_t n = sec_len;
    if (n > 511) {
        n = 511;
    }
    /* Kernel SO_PEERSEC strings may carry trailing NUL padding. */
    while (n > 0 && (sec_ctx[n - 1] == '\0' || is_ascii_ws((unsigned char)sec_ctx[n - 1]))) {
        n--;
    }
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off < n && is_ascii_ws((unsigned char)sec_ctx[off])) {
        off++;
    }
    if (n <= off) {
        return -1;
    }

    char buf[512];
    size_t blen = n - off;
    memcpy(buf, sec_ctx + off, blen);
    buf[blen] = '\0';

    /* Reject any embedded NUL or isolated_app substring. */
    if (strlen(buf) != blen) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (strstr(buf, "isolated_app") != NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    /* Require SELinux context "u:r:untrusted_app*..." */
    char *c1 = strchr(buf, ':');
    if (!c1 || (size_t)(c1 - buf) != 1 || buf[0] != 'u') {
        return -1;
    }
    char *p2 = c1 + 1;
    char *c2 = strchr(p2, ':');
    if (!c2 || (size_t)(c2 - p2) != 1 || p2[0] != 'r') {
        return -1;
    }
    char *dom = c2 + 1;
    const char *prefix = "untrusted_app";
    size_t plen = strlen(prefix);
    return strncmp(dom, prefix, plen) == 0 ? 0 : -1;
}

typedef struct json_cursor {
    const char *buf;
    size_t len;
    size_t pos;
    int depth;
} json_cursor_t;

static void jskip_ws(json_cursor_t *c) {
    while (c->pos < c->len && is_ascii_ws((unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos])) {
        c->pos++;
    }
}

static size_t append_utf8(char *out, size_t cap, size_t idx, uint32_t cp, int *has_nul) {
    if (cp == 0) {
        *has_nul = 1;
        return idx;
    }
    if (cp <= 0x7Fu) {
        if (idx < cap) out[idx] = (char)cp;
        return idx + 1;
    }
    if (cp <= 0x7FFu) {
        if (idx + 1 < cap) {
            out[idx] = (char)(0xC0u | (cp >> 6));
            out[idx + 1] = (char)(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu));
        }
        return idx + 2;
    }
    if (cp <= 0xFFFFu) {
        if (idx + 2 < cap) {
            out[idx] = (char)(0xE0u | (cp >> 12));
            out[idx + 1] = (char)(0x80u | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3Fu));
            out[idx + 2] = (char)(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu));
        }
        return idx + 3;
    }
    if (idx + 3 < cap) {
        out[idx] = (char)(0xF0u | (cp >> 18));
        out[idx + 1] = (char)(0x80u | ((cp >> 12) & 0x3Fu));
        out[idx + 2] = (char)(0x80u | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3Fu));
        out[idx + 3] = (char)(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu));
    }
    return idx + 4;
}

static int jparse_hex4(json_cursor_t *c, uint32_t *out) {
    if (c->pos + 4 > c->len) {
        return -1;
    }
    uint32_t v = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        int d = hex_val((unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos + (size_t)i]);
        if (d < 0) {
            return -1;
        }
        v = (v << 4) | (uint32_t)d;
    }
    c->pos += 4;
    *out = v;
    return 0;
}

/*
 * Parses a JSON string token into out (if out != NULL and fits in cap - 1).
 * Sets *out_len to decoded byte length and *out_has_nul if '\u0000' was decoded.
 * Returns 0 on valid JSON string, -1 on syntax/control error.
 */
static int jparse_string(json_cursor_t *c, char *out, size_t cap, size_t *out_len, int *out_has_nul) {
    jskip_ws(c);
    if (c->pos >= c->len || c->buf[c->pos] != '"') {
        return -1;
    }
    c->pos++;
    size_t dlen = 0;
    int nul = 0;
    while (c->pos < c->len) {
        unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos++];
        if (ch == '"') {
            if (out && cap > 0) {
                size_t term = dlen < cap - 1 ? dlen : cap - 1;
                out[term] = '\0';
            }
            if (out_len) *out_len = dlen;
            if (out_has_nul) *out_has_nul = nul;
            return 0;
        }
        if (ch < 0x20u) {
            return -1;
        }
        if (ch != '\\') {
            if (out && dlen + 1 < cap) {
                out[dlen] = (char)ch;
            }
            dlen++;
            continue;
        }
        if (c->pos >= c->len) {
            return -1;
        }
        unsigned char esc = (unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos++];
        unsigned char mapped = 0;
        switch (esc) {
            case '"': mapped = '"'; break;
            case '\\': mapped = '\\'; break;
            case '/': mapped = '/'; break;
            case 'b': mapped = '\b'; break;
            case 'f': mapped = '\f'; break;
            case 'n': mapped = '\n'; break;
            case 'r': mapped = '\r'; break;
            case 't': mapped = '\t'; break;
            case 'u': {
                uint32_t cp = 0;
                if (jparse_hex4(c, &cp) != 0) {
                    return -1;
                }
                if (cp >= 0xD800u && cp <= 0xDBFFu) {
                    if (c->pos + 2 <= c->len && c->buf[c->pos] == '\\' && c->buf[c->pos + 1] == 'u') {
                        c->pos += 2;
                        uint32_t low = 0;
                        if (jparse_hex4(c, &low) != 0 || low < 0xDC00u || low > 0xDFFFu) {
                            return -1;
                        }
                        cp = 0x10000u + (((cp - 0xD800u) << 10) | (low - 0xDC00u));
                    } else {
                        cp = 0xFFFDu;
                    }
                } else if (cp >= 0xDC00u && cp <= 0xDFFFu) {
                    cp = 0xFFFDu;
                }
                dlen = append_utf8(out, cap > 0 ? cap - 1 : 0, dlen, cp, &nul);
                continue;
            }
            default:
                return -1;
        }
        if (out && dlen + 1 < cap) {
            out[dlen] = (char)mapped;
        }
        dlen++;
    }
    return -1;
}

static int jconsume_char(json_cursor_t *c, char ch) {
    jskip_ws(c);
    if (c->pos >= c->len || c->buf[c->pos] != ch) {
        return -1;
    }
    c->pos++;
    return 0;
}

static int jconsume_null(json_cursor_t *c) {
    jskip_ws(c);
    if (c->pos + 4 <= c->len && memcmp(c->buf + c->pos, "null", 4) == 0) {
        c->pos += 4;
        return 0;
    }
    return -1;
}

static int jparse_int_strict(json_cursor_t *c, int *out_val) {
    jskip_ws(c);
    if (c->pos >= c->len) {
        return -1;
    }
    size_t start = c->pos;
    int neg = 0;
    if (c->buf[c->pos] == '-') {
        neg = 1;
        c->pos++;
        if (c->pos >= c->len) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
    if (c->buf[c->pos] == '0') {
        c->pos++;
        if (c->pos < c->len && (unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos] >= '0' && (unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos] <= '9') {
            return -1; /* Leading zeros are invalid JSON. */
        }
    } else if ((unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos] >= '1' && (unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos] <= '9') {
        while (c->pos < c->len && (unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos] >= '0' && (unsigned char)c->buf[c->pos] <= '9') {
            c->pos++;
        }
    } else {
        return -1;
    }
    if (c->pos < c->len && (c->buf[c->pos] == '.' || c->buf[c->pos] == 'e' || c->buf[c->pos] == 'E')) {
        return -1;
    }
    long long acc = 0;
    size_t i = neg ? start + 1 : start;
    for (; i < c->pos; i++) {
        acc = acc * 10 + (c->buf[i] - '0');
        if (acc > INT_MAX) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
    *out_val = neg ? (int)(-acc) : (int)acc;
    return 0;
}

int broker_parse_auth_json(const char *raw, size_t len, int *out_uid) {
    if (!raw || !out_uid || len == 0 || len > BROKER_MAX_AUTH_FILE_BYTES) {
        return -1;
    }
    json_cursor_t c = {raw, len, 0, 0};
    if (jconsume_char(&c, '{') != 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    jskip_ws(&c);
    int seen_uid = 0;
    int uid_val = 0;
    if (c.pos < c.len && c.buf[c.pos] == '}') {
        c.pos++;
    } else {
        for (;;) {
            char key[64];
            size_t klen = 0;
            int knul = 0;
            if (jparse_string(&c, key, sizeof(key), &klen, &knul) != 0 || knul) {
                return -1;
            }
            if (klen != strlen("allowed_user0_uid") || strcmp(key, "allowed_user0_uid") != 0) {
                return -1;
            }
            if (seen_uid) {
                return -1;
            }
            seen_uid = 1;
            if (jconsume_char(&c, ':') != 0) {
                return -1;
            }
            if (jparse_int_strict(&c, &uid_val) != 0 || uid_val < 0) {
                return -1;
            }
            jskip_ws(&c);
            if (c.pos < c.len && c.buf[c.pos] == ',') {
                c.pos++;
                continue;
            }
            if (jconsume_char(&c, '}') == 0) {
                break;
            }
            return -1;
        }
    }
    jskip_ws(&c);
    if (c.pos != c.len || !seen_uid) {
        return -1;
    }
    *out_uid = uid_val;
    return 0;
}

static int valid_package_name(const char *pkg, size_t len) {
    if (!pkg || len < 3 || len > BROKER_MAX_PKG_BYTES) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (!is_alpha((unsigned char)pkg[0])) {
        return 0;
    }
    int dots = 0;
    size_t seg_len = 1;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < len; i++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)pkg[i];
        if (c == '.') {
            if (seg_len == 0) {
                return 0;
            }
            dots++;
            seg_len = 0;
        } else if (is_alnum_underscore(c)) {
            seg_len++;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return dots >= 1 && seg_len > 0;
}

static int valid_component_class(const char *cls, size_t len) {
    if (!cls || len == 0 || len > BROKER_MAX_ACTIVITY_BYTES) {
        return 0;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)cls[i];
        if (!(is_alnum_underscore(c) || c == '.' || c == '$')) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (c == '.' && i + 1 < len && cls[i + 1] == '.') {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int is_safe_apk_path(const char *p, size_t len) {
    if (!p || len == 0 || len > BROKER_MAX_APK_PATH_BYTES) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (len < 4 || memcmp(p + len - 4, ".apk", 4) != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    const char *tmp_pfx = "/data/local/tmp/";
    const char *stg_pfx = "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/staging/";
    size_t tmp_len = strlen(tmp_pfx);
    size_t stg_len = strlen(stg_pfx);
    int in_tmp = (len > tmp_len && memcmp(p, tmp_pfx, tmp_len) == 0);
    int in_stg = (len > stg_len && memcmp(p, stg_pfx, stg_len) == 0);
    if (!in_tmp && !in_stg) {
        return 0;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)p[i];
        if (c <= 0x20u || c == ';' || c == '&' || c == '|' || c == '$' ||
            c == '`' || c == '\'' || c == '"' || c == '\\') {
            return 0;
        }
        if (c == '.' && i + 1 < len && p[i + 1] == '.') {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

typedef enum op_kind {
    OP_INVALID = 0,
    OP_GET_STATUS,
    OP_IMPORT_EXISTING,
    OP_INSTALL_APK,
    OP_START_VPN,
    OP_PAUSE_VPN,
    OP_RELOAD_CONFIG,
    OP_SYNC_HIDE_APPS,
    OP_RUN_PROBE,
    OP_LAUNCH_APP,
    OP_STOP_APP,
    OP_REMOVE_APP
} op_kind_t;

static op_kind_t parse_op(const char *s, size_t len) {
    struct op_entry {
        const char *name;
        op_kind_t kind;
    };
    static const struct op_entry table[] = {
        {"GET_STATUS", OP_GET_STATUS},
        {"IMPORT_EXISTING", OP_IMPORT_EXISTING},
        {"INSTALL_APK", OP_INSTALL_APK},
        {"START_VPN", OP_START_VPN},
        {"PAUSE_VPN", OP_PAUSE_VPN},
        {"RELOAD_CONFIG", OP_RELOAD_CONFIG},
        {"SYNC_HIDE_APPS", OP_SYNC_HIDE_APPS},
        {"RUN_PROBE", OP_RUN_PROBE},
        {"LAUNCH_APP", OP_LAUNCH_APP},
        {"STOP_APP", OP_STOP_APP},
        {"REMOVE_APP", OP_REMOVE_APP},
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(table) / sizeof(table[0]); i++) {
        if (strlen(table[i].name) == len && memcmp(s, table[i].name, len) == 0) {
            return table[i].kind;
        }
    }
    return OP_INVALID;
}

static int parse_config_obj(json_cursor_t *c, char *errbuf, size_t errcap) {
    jskip_ws(c);
    if (jconsume_null(c) == 0) {
        return 1; /* config was explicit null */
    }
    if (jconsume_char(c, '{') != 0) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: expected config object");
        return -1;
    }
    if (++c->depth > 16) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: nesting too deep");
        return -1;
    }
    jskip_ws(c);
    int seen_quic = 0;
    int seen_log = 0;
    if (c->pos < c->len && c->buf[c->pos] == '}') {
        c->pos++;
        c->depth--;
        return 0;
    }
    for (;;) {
        char kbuf[64];
        size_t klen = 0;
        int knul = 0;
        if (jparse_string(c, kbuf, sizeof(kbuf), &klen, &knul) != 0 || knul || klen >= sizeof(kbuf)) {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: bad config key");
            return -1;
        }
        if (jconsume_char(c, ':') != 0) {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: expected ':' in config");
            return -1;
        }
        if (strcmp(kbuf, "quic_udp443_mode") == 0) {
            if (seen_quic) {
                set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate config key");
                return -1;
            }
            seen_quic = 1;
            char val[32];
            size_t vlen = 0;
            int vnul = 0;
            if (jconsume_null(c) != 0) {
                if (jparse_string(c, val, sizeof(val), &vlen, &vnul) != 0 || vnul || vlen >= sizeof(val)) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid quic_udp443_mode");
                    return -1;
                }
                if (vlen > 0 && strcmp(val, "reject") != 0 && strcmp(val, "allow") != 0) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid quic_udp443_mode \"%s\"", val);
                    return -1;
                }
            }
        } else if (strcmp(kbuf, "log_level") == 0) {
            if (seen_log) {
                set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate config key");
                return -1;
            }
            seen_log = 1;
            char val[32];
            size_t vlen = 0;
            int vnul = 0;
            if (jconsume_null(c) != 0) {
                if (jparse_string(c, val, sizeof(val), &vlen, &vnul) != 0 || vnul || vlen >= sizeof(val)) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid log_level");
                    return -1;
                }
                if (vlen > 0 &&
                    strcmp(val, "silent") != 0 &&
                    strcmp(val, "error") != 0 &&
                    strcmp(val, "warning") != 0 &&
                    strcmp(val, "info") != 0 &&
                    strcmp(val, "debug") != 0) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid log_level \"%s\"", val);
                    return -1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: unknown field \"%s\"", kbuf);
            return -1;
        }
        jskip_ws(c);
        if (c->pos < c->len && c->buf[c->pos] == ',') {
            c->pos++;
            continue;
        }
        if (jconsume_char(c, '}') == 0) {
            break;
        }
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: malformed config object");
        return -1;
    }
    c->depth--;
    return 0;
}

int broker_validate_rpc_request(
    const char *line,
    size_t len,
    broker_req_info_t *out,
    char *errbuf,
    size_t errcap) {
    if (!line || !out) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "empty request");
        return -1;
    }
    if (len > BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "line exceeds %d bytes", BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES);
        return -1;
    }

    size_t start = 0;
    size_t end = len;
    while (start < end && is_ascii_ws((unsigned char)line[start])) {
        start++;
    }
    while (end > start && is_ascii_ws((unsigned char)line[end - 1])) {
        end--;
    }
    size_t tlen = end - start;
    if (tlen == 0) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "empty request");
        return -1;
    }
    if (tlen + 1 > BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "request exceeds %d bytes", BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES);
        return -1;
    }

    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    out->trimmed_off = start;
    out->trimmed_len = tlen;

    json_cursor_t c = {line + start, tlen, 0, 0};
    if (jconsume_char(&c, '{') != 0) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: expected object");
        return -1;
    }
    c.depth = 1;
    jskip_ws(&c);

    int seen_id = 0, seen_op = 0, seen_pkg = 0, seen_act = 0, seen_apks = 0, seen_cfg = 0;
    char id_buf[BROKER_MAX_ID_BYTES + 2];
    size_t id_len = 0;
    op_kind_t op_kind = OP_INVALID;
    char pkg_buf[BROKER_MAX_PKG_BYTES + 2];
    size_t pkg_len = 0;
    char act_buf[BROKER_MAX_ACTIVITY_BYTES + 2];
    size_t act_len = 0;
    int apk_count = 0;
    int has_bad_apk = 0;
    char bad_apk_buf[64];
    int has_non_null_config = 0;

    if (c.pos < c.len && c.buf[c.pos] == '}') {
        c.pos++;
    } else {
        for (;;) {
            char key[32];
            size_t klen = 0;
            int knul = 0;
            if (jparse_string(&c, key, sizeof(key), &klen, &knul) != 0 || knul || klen >= sizeof(key)) {
                set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: bad field name");
                return -1;
            }
            if (jconsume_char(&c, ':') != 0) {
                set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: expected ':'");
                return -1;
            }

            if (strcmp(key, "id") == 0) {
                if (seen_id) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate id");
                    return -1;
                }
                seen_id = 1;
                int has_nul = 0;
                if (jconsume_null(&c) == 0) {
                    id_len = 0;
                } else {
                    if (jparse_string(&c, id_buf, sizeof(id_buf), &id_len, &has_nul) != 0 || has_nul) {
                        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid request id");
                        return -1;
                    }
                    if (id_len == 0 || id_len > BROKER_MAX_ID_BYTES) {
                        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid request id");
                        return -1;
                    }
                    for (size_t i = 0; i < id_len; i++) {
                        if (id_buf[i] == '\r' || id_buf[i] == '\n' || id_buf[i] == '\t') {
                            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid request id");
                            return -1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if (strcmp(key, "op") == 0) {
                if (seen_op) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate op");
                    return -1;
                }
                seen_op = 1;
                char op_buf[32];
                size_t op_len = 0;
                int has_nul = 0;
                if (jconsume_null(&c) != 0) {
                    if (jparse_string(&c, op_buf, sizeof(op_buf), &op_len, &has_nul) != 0 || has_nul || op_len >= sizeof(op_buf)) {
                        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "unsupported op");
                        return -1;
                    }
                    op_kind = parse_op(op_buf, op_len);
                }
            } else if (strcmp(key, "pkg") == 0) {
                if (seen_pkg) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate pkg");
                    return -1;
                }
                seen_pkg = 1;
                int has_nul = 0;
                if (jconsume_null(&c) == 0) {
                    pkg_len = 0;
                } else if (jparse_string(&c, pkg_buf, sizeof(pkg_buf), &pkg_len, &has_nul) != 0 || has_nul || pkg_len > BROKER_MAX_PKG_BYTES) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid package name");
                    return -1;
                }
            } else if (strcmp(key, "activity") == 0) {
                if (seen_act) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate activity");
                    return -1;
                }
                seen_act = 1;
                int has_nul = 0;
                if (jconsume_null(&c) == 0) {
                    act_len = 0;
                } else if (jparse_string(&c, act_buf, sizeof(act_buf), &act_len, &has_nul) != 0 || has_nul || act_len > BROKER_MAX_ACTIVITY_BYTES) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid activity class");
                    return -1;
                }
            } else if (strcmp(key, "apk_paths") == 0) {
                if (seen_apks) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate apk_paths");
                    return -1;
                }
                seen_apks = 1;
                jskip_ws(&c);
                if (jconsume_null(&c) != 0) {
                    if (jconsume_char(&c, '[') != 0) {
                        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: expected apk_paths array");
                        return -1;
                    }
                    if (++c.depth > 16) {
                        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: nesting too deep");
                        return -1;
                    }
                    jskip_ws(&c);
                    if (c.pos < c.len && c.buf[c.pos] == ']') {
                        c.pos++;
                    } else {
                        for (;;) {
                            char apath[BROKER_MAX_APK_PATH_BYTES + 2];
                            size_t alen = 0;
                            int anul = 0;
                            if (jparse_string(&c, apath, sizeof(apath), &alen, &anul) != 0) {
                                set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid apk_paths item");
                                return -1;
                            }
                            apk_count++;
                            if (!has_bad_apk && (anul || !is_safe_apk_path(apath, alen))) {
                                has_bad_apk = 1;
                                size_t copy_n = alen < sizeof(bad_apk_buf) - 1 ? alen : sizeof(bad_apk_buf) - 1;
                                memcpy(bad_apk_buf, apath, copy_n);
                                bad_apk_buf[copy_n] = '\0';
                            }
                            jskip_ws(&c);
                            if (c.pos < c.len && c.buf[c.pos] == ',') {
                                c.pos++;
                                continue;
                            }
                            if (jconsume_char(&c, ']') == 0) {
                                break;
                            }
                            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: malformed apk_paths");
                            return -1;
                        }
                    }
                    c.depth--;
                }
            } else if (strcmp(key, "config") == 0) {
                if (seen_cfg) {
                    set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: duplicate config");
                    return -1;
                }
                seen_cfg = 1;
                int rc = parse_config_obj(&c, errbuf, errcap);
                if (rc < 0) {
                    return -1;
                }
                if (rc == 0) {
                    has_non_null_config = 1;
                }
            } else {
                set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: unknown field \"%s\"", key);
                return -1;
            }

            jskip_ws(&c);
            if (c.pos < c.len && c.buf[c.pos] == ',') {
                c.pos++;
                continue;
            }
            if (jconsume_char(&c, '}') == 0) {
                break;
            }
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid json: malformed object");
            return -1;
        }
    }

    jskip_ws(&c);
    if (c.pos != c.len) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "trailing data after json object");
        return -1;
    }

    if (id_len == 0) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid request id");
        return -1;
    }
    if (op_kind == OP_INVALID) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "unsupported op");
        return -1;
    }
    if (op_kind == OP_IMPORT_EXISTING || op_kind == OP_LAUNCH_APP ||
        op_kind == OP_STOP_APP || op_kind == OP_REMOVE_APP) {
        if (!valid_package_name(pkg_buf, pkg_len)) {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid package name");
            return -1;
        }
    } else if (pkg_len > 0 && !valid_package_name(pkg_buf, pkg_len)) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid package name");
        return -1;
    }

    if (act_len > 0) {
        if (op_kind != OP_LAUNCH_APP) {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "activity field only allowed on LAUNCH_APP");
            return -1;
        }
        if (!valid_component_class(act_buf, act_len)) {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "invalid activity class");
            return -1;
        }
    }

    if (op_kind == OP_INSTALL_APK) {
        if (apk_count == 0 || apk_count > BROKER_MAX_APK_PATHS) {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "INSTALL_APK requires 1..32 apk_paths");
            return -1;
        }
        if (has_bad_apk) {
            set_err(errbuf, errcap, "unsafe apk_path %s", bad_apk_buf);
            return -1;
        }
    } else if (apk_count > 0) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "apk_paths only allowed on INSTALL_APK");
        return -1;
    }

    if (has_non_null_config && op_kind != OP_RELOAD_CONFIG) {
        set_err(errbuf, errcap, "config field only allowed on RELOAD_CONFIG");
        return -1;
    }

    memcpy(out->id, id_buf, id_len);
    out->id[id_len] = '\0';
    out->is_install_apk = (op_kind == OP_INSTALL_APK) ? 1 : 0;
    return 0;
}

static size_t append_json_escaped(char *out, size_t cap, size_t pos, const char *s) {
    if (!s) {
        return pos;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; s[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)s[i];
        char rep[7];
        size_t rlen = 0;
        if (c == '"') {
            rep[0] = '\\'; rep[1] = '"'; rlen = 2;
        } else if (c == '\\') {
            rep[0] = '\\'; rep[1] = '\\'; rlen = 2;
        } else if (c == '\b') {
            rep[0] = '\\'; rep[1] = 'b'; rlen = 2;
        } else if (c == '\f') {
            rep[0] = '\\'; rep[1] = 'f'; rlen = 2;
        } else if (c == '\n') {
            rep[0] = '\\'; rep[1] = 'n'; rlen = 2;
        } else if (c == '\r') {
            rep[0] = '\\'; rep[1] = 'r'; rlen = 2;
        } else if (c == '\t') {
            rep[0] = '\\'; rep[1] = 't'; rlen = 2;
        } else if (c < 0x20u) {
            static const char k_hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
            rep[0] = '\\';
            rep[1] = 'u';
            rep[2] = '0';
            rep[3] = '0';
            rep[4] = k_hex[(c >> 4) & 0xFu];
            rep[5] = k_hex[c & 0xFu];
            rlen = 6;
        } else {
            rep[0] = (char)c; rlen = 1;
        }
        if (pos + rlen > cap) {
            break;
        }
        memcpy(out + pos, rep, rlen);
        pos += rlen;
    }
    return pos;
}

size_t broker_format_error_json(const char *id, const char *msg, char *out, size_t outcap) {
    static const char k_fallback[] = "{\"id\":\"\",\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"internal\",\"data\":{}}\n";
    if (!out || outcap < sizeof(k_fallback)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* Reserve room for closing trailer `","data":{}}\n\0` (15 bytes). */
    const size_t safe_cap = outcap - 15;
    size_t pos = 0;
    const char *p1 = "{\"id\":\"";
    size_t l1 = strlen(p1);
    if (pos + l1 <= safe_cap) {
        memcpy(out + pos, p1, l1);
        pos += l1;
    }
    pos = append_json_escaped(out, safe_cap, pos, id ? id : "");

    const char *p2 = "\",\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"";
    size_t l2 = strlen(p2);
    if (pos + l2 <= safe_cap) {
        memcpy(out + pos, p2, l2);
        pos += l2;
    }
    pos = append_json_escaped(out, safe_cap, pos, msg ? msg : "error");

    const char *p3 = "\",\"data\":{}}\n";
    size_t l3 = strlen(p3);
    if (pos + l3 + 1 <= outcap) {
        memcpy(out + pos, p3, l3);
        pos += l3;
        out[pos] = '\0';
        return pos;
    }

    memcpy(out, k_fallback, sizeof(k_fallback));
    return sizeof(k_fallback) - 1;
}
```

```h
#ifndef KERNBOX_BROKER_CORE_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES   8192
#define BROKER_MAX_RPC_RESP_BYTES   65536
#define BROKER_MAX_AUTH_FILE_BYTES  1024
#define BROKER_MAX_ID_BYTES         128
#define BROKER_MAX_PKG_BYTES        255
#define BROKER_MAX_ACTIVITY_BYTES   255
#define BROKER_MAX_APK_PATHS        32
#define BROKER_MAX_APK_PATH_BYTES   512

#define BROKER_MIN_APP_ID           10000
#define BROKER_ANDROID_USER_WIDTH   100000

#define BROKER_SELINUX_CTX          "u:r:sandbox_broker:s0"
#define BROKER_SOCK_DIR             "/dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl"
#define BROKER_SOCK_PATH            "/dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock"
#define BROKER_PRIV_DIR             "/dev/socket/sandbox_priv"
#define BROKER_GUARD_SOCK_PATH      "/dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock"
#define BROKER_AUTH_PATH            "/dev/socket/sandbox_priv/broker_auth.json"
#define BROKER_PROC_ATTR_CURRENT    "/proc/self/attr/current"

typedef struct broker_req_info {
    char id[BROKER_MAX_ID_BYTES + 1];
    size_t trimmed_off;
    size_t trimmed_len;
    int is_install_apk;
} broker_req_info_t;

/*
 * Verifies /proc/self/attr/current content matches u:r:sandbox_broker:s0
 * after stripping trailing NUL bytes and ASCII whitespace.
 * Returns 0 on match, -1 on mismatch.
 */
int broker_check_self_context(const char *raw, size_t len);

/*
 * Strictly parses broker_auth.json (`{"allowed_user0_uid":<int>}`).
 * Rejects unknown keys, duplicate keys, non-integer values, and trailing data.
 * Returns 0 on success and stores UID in *out_uid, -1 on error.
 */
int broker_parse_auth_json(const char *raw, size_t len, int *out_uid);

/*
 * Validates SO_PEERCRED UID + SO_PEERSEC context against allowed_user0_uid.
 * Allows u:r:untrusted_app* in User 0 only; rejects isolated_app and work UIDs.
 * Returns 0 if authorized, -1 otherwise.
 */
int broker_authorize_peer(int peer_uid, const char *sec_ctx, size_t sec_len, int allowed_user0_uid);

/*
 * Enforces the frozen max-8192B newline-JSON RPC schema, op whitelist,
 * package/activity/apk_paths regex/path safety, and config override values.
 * Returns 0 on success (populating out), or -1 on error (writing errbuf).
 */
int broker_validate_rpc_request(
    const char *line,
    size_t len,
    broker_req_info_t *out,
    char *errbuf,
    size_t errcap);

/*
 * Formats `{"id":"...","ok":false,"error":"...","data":{}}\n` into out.
 * Always writes valid JSON terminated by '\n' + '\0' when outcap >= 64.
 * Returns number of payload bytes (excluding terminating NUL).
 */
size_t broker_format_error_json(const char *id, const char *msg, char *out, size_t outcap);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* KERNBOX_BROKER_CORE_H */
```

`broker/build.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Builds the pure-C11 static zero-GC ARM64 sandbox_broker binary + ELF hygiene check."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO_ROOT = ROOT.parent
IS_WIN = os.name == "nt"


def exe_name(base: str, win_ext: str = ".exe") -> str:
    return f"{base}{win_ext}" if IS_WIN else base


def resolve_toolchain(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
    sdk_str = args.sdk or os.environ.get("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT") or os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME") or ""
    ndk_str = (
        args.ndk
        or os.environ.get("ANDROID_NDK_HOME")
        or os.environ.get("ANDROID_NDK_ROOT")
        or os.environ.get("ANDROID_NDK")
        or ""
    )
    if not ndk_str and sdk_str:
        ndk_root = pathlib.Path(sdk_str) / "ndk"
        if ndk_root.is_dir():
            hits = sorted(ndk_root.iterdir(), reverse=True)
            if hits:
                ndk_str = str(hits[0])
    if not ndk_str:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing Android NDK: pass --ndk, --sdk, or set ANDROID_NDK_HOME")
    ndk = pathlib.Path(ndk_str)

    prebuilt_bins = sorted((ndk / "toolchains" / "llvm" / "prebuilt").glob("*/bin"))
    if not prebuilt_bins:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"LLVM toolchain bin dir not found under {ndk}")
    ndk_bin = prebuilt_bins[0]

    clang = ndk_bin / exe_name("clang")
    if not clang.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"clang not found at {clang}")
    llvm_readelf = ndk_bin / exe_name("llvm-readelf")
    if not llvm_readelf.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"llvm-readelf not found at {llvm_readelf}")

    return {
        "clang": clang,
        "llvm_readelf": llvm_readelf,
        "target": f"aarch64-linux-android{int(args.min_sdk)}",
    }


def verify_static_elf(tc: dict, out_bin: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    ph = subprocess.run(
        [str(tc["llvm_readelf"]), "-l", str(out_bin)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    if re.search(r"^\s*INTERP\b", ph.stdout, re.MULTILINE):
        raise AssertionError(f"{out_bin} must be 100% static (unexpected PT_INTERP)")

    dyn = subprocess.run(
        [str(tc["llvm_readelf"]), "-d", str(out_bin)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    if "TEXTREL" in dyn.stdout:
        raise AssertionError(f"{out_bin} contains forbidden TEXTREL")
    needed = re.findall(r"Shared library:\s*\[([^\]]+)\]", dyn.stdout)
    if needed:
        raise AssertionError(f"{out_bin} has unexpected DT_NEEDED entries: {needed}")


def build_broker(args: argparse.Namespace) -> pathlib.Path:
    tc = resolve_toolchain(args)
    out_bin = pathlib.Path(args.out) if args.out else (REPO_ROOT / "dist" / "sandbox_broker")
    out_bin.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    cmd = [
        str(tc["clang"]),
        f"--target={tc['target']}",
        "-static",
        "-std=c11",
        "-Oz",
        "-flto",
        "-fmerge-all-constants",
        "-Wall",
        "-Wextra",
        "-Werror",
        "-ffunction-sections",
        "-fdata-sections",
        "-fno-unwind-tables",
        "-fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables",
        "-I",
        str(ROOT),
        str(ROOT / "broker_core.c"),
        str(ROOT / "main.c"),
        "-o",
        str(out_bin),
        "-Wl,--gc-sections,-s,--icf=all,-z,max-page-size=16384",
    ]
    print("+", " ".join(cmd))
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    verify_static_elf(tc, out_bin)

    raw = out_bin.read_bytes()
    sha = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().lower()
    print(f"BUILT_STATIC_BROKER={out_bin} size={len(raw)} sha256={sha}")
    return out_bin


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build static C11 ARM64 sandbox_broker")
    p.add_argument("--out", help="Output binary path")
    p.add_argument("--min-sdk", type=int, default=31, help="NDK API level (default: 31)")
    p.add_argument("--sdk", default="", help="Android SDK path")
    p.add_argument("--ndk", default="", help="Android NDK path")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    build_broker(args)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`broker/main.c`:

```c
#define _GNU_SOURCE

#include "broker_core.h"

#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/epoll.h>
#include <sys/signalfd.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define BROKER_STR_HELPER(x) #x
#define BROKER_STR(x) BROKER_STR_HELPER(x)
#define BROKER_LINE_TOO_LONG_MSG "line exceeds " BROKER_STR(BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES) " bytes"

static void log_stderr(const char *msg) {
    if (!msg) return;
    size_t len = strlen(msg);
    if (len > 0) {
        ssize_t w = write(STDERR_FILENO, msg, len);
        (void)w;
    }
    ssize_t nl = write(STDERR_FILENO, "\n", 1);
    (void)nl;
}

#define MAX_CONNS 8
#define MAX_EPOLL_EVENTS 16

typedef enum conn_state {
    ST_FREE = 0,
    ST_READ_CLIENT,
    ST_CONNECT_GUARD,
    ST_WRITE_GUARD,
    ST_READ_GUARD,
    ST_WRITE_CLIENT
} conn_state_t;

typedef struct conn_slot {
    int client_fd;
    int guard_fd;
    int client_in_epoll;
    conn_state_t state;
    uint64_t deadline_ms;
    size_t req_len;
    size_t req_sent;
    size_t resp_len;
    size_t resp_sent;
    int is_install_apk;
    char req_id[BROKER_MAX_ID_BYTES + 1];
    char req_buf[BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES + 2];
    char resp_buf[BROKER_MAX_RPC_RESP_BYTES + 2];
} conn_slot_t;

static conn_slot_t g_slots[MAX_CONNS];
static int g_epfd = -1;

static uint64_t monotonic_ms(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000ULL + (uint64_t)(ts.tv_nsec / 1000000L);
}

static int read_small_nofollow(const char *path, char *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_len, int require_root) {
    int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    struct stat st;
    if (fstat(fd, &st) != 0 || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }
    if (require_root && st.st_uid != 0) {
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }
    if (st.st_size < 0 || (size_t)st.st_size >= cap) {
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }
    size_t total = 0;
    while (total < cap - 1) {
        ssize_t n = read(fd, buf + total, (cap - 1) - total);
        if (n < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            close(fd);
            return -1;
        }
        if (n == 0) {
            break;
        }
        total += (size_t)n;
    }
    close(fd);
    buf[total] = '\0';
    if (out_len) {
        *out_len = total;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int read_proc_attr(const char *path, char *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_len) {
    int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    size_t total = 0;
    while (total < cap - 1) {
        ssize_t n = read(fd, buf + total, (cap - 1) - total);
        if (n < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            close(fd);
            return -1;
        }
        if (n == 0) {
            break;
        }
        total += (size_t)n;
    }
    close(fd);
    buf[total] = '\0';
    if (out_len) {
        *out_len = total;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int epoll_add(int fd, uint32_t events, uint32_t tag) {
    struct epoll_event ev;
    memset(&ev, 0, sizeof(ev));
    ev.events = events;
    ev.data.u64 = tag;
    return epoll_ctl(g_epfd, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, fd, &ev);
}

static int epoll_mod(int fd, uint32_t events, uint32_t tag) {
    struct epoll_event ev;
    memset(&ev, 0, sizeof(ev));
    ev.events = events;
    ev.data.u64 = tag;
    return epoll_ctl(g_epfd, EPOLL_CTL_MOD, fd, &ev);
}

/* Tag encoding: low 16 bits = slot index (or 0xffff for listener, 0xfffe for signalfd),
 * bit 16 = 0 for client_fd, 1 for guard_fd. */
#define TAG_LISTENER 0xFFFFU
#define TAG_SIGNALFD 0xFFFEU
#define MAKE_TAG(slot_idx, is_guard) ((uint32_t)(slot_idx) | ((uint32_t)(is_guard) << 16))
#define TAG_IS_GUARD(tag) (((tag) >> 16) & 1U)
#define TAG_SLOT(tag) ((tag) & 0xFFFFU)

static int set_client_epoll(conn_slot_t *s, size_t slot_idx, uint32_t events) {
    if (s->client_fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    uint32_t tag = MAKE_TAG(slot_idx, 0);
    if (events == 0) {
        if (s->client_in_epoll) {
            (void)epoll_ctl(g_epfd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, s->client_fd, NULL);
            s->client_in_epoll = 0;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    if (s->client_in_epoll) {
        return epoll_mod(s->client_fd, events, tag);
    }
    if (epoll_add(s->client_fd, events, tag) != 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    s->client_in_epoll = 1;
    return 0;
}

static void close_slot(conn_slot_t *s) {
    if (s->guard_fd >= 0) {
        epoll_ctl(g_epfd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, s->guard_fd, NULL);
        close(s->guard_fd);
        s->guard_fd = -1;
    }
    if (s->client_fd >= 0) {
        if (s->client_in_epoll) {
            epoll_ctl(g_epfd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, s->client_fd, NULL);
            s->client_in_epoll = 0;
        }
        close(s->client_fd);
        s->client_fd = -1;
    }
    s->state = ST_FREE;
    s->deadline_ms = 0;
    s->req_len = 0;
    s->req_sent = 0;
    s->resp_len = 0;
    s->resp_sent = 0;
    s->is_install_apk = 0;
    s->req_id[0] = '\0';
}

static void queue_error_reply(conn_slot_t *s, size_t slot_idx, const char *err_msg, uint64_t now_ms) {
    if (s->guard_fd >= 0) {
        epoll_ctl(g_epfd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, s->guard_fd, NULL);
        close(s->guard_fd);
        s->guard_fd = -1;
    }
    s->resp_len = broker_format_error_json(s->req_id, err_msg, s->resp_buf, sizeof(s->resp_buf));
    s->resp_sent = 0;
    if (s->resp_len == 0) {
        close_slot(s);
        return;
    }
    s->state = ST_WRITE_CLIENT;
    s->deadline_ms = now_ms + 5000ULL;
    if (set_client_epoll(s, slot_idx, EPOLLOUT) != 0) {
        close_slot(s);
    }
}

static int authorize_accepted_client(int cfd) {
    struct ucred cred;
    socklen_t clen = sizeof(cred);
    if (getsockopt(cfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_PEERCRED, &cred, &clen) != 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    char sec_buf[256];
    socklen_t slen = sizeof(sec_buf) - 1;
    if (getsockopt(cfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_PEERSEC, sec_buf, &slen) != 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (slen >= sizeof(sec_buf)) {
        slen = sizeof(sec_buf) - 1;
    }
    sec_buf[slen] = '\0';

    char auth_buf[BROKER_MAX_AUTH_FILE_BYTES + 1];
    size_t auth_len = 0;
    if (read_small_nofollow(BROKER_AUTH_PATH, auth_buf, sizeof(auth_buf), &auth_len, 1) != 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    int allowed_uid = 0;
    if (broker_parse_auth_json(auth_buf, auth_len, &allowed_uid) != 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return broker_authorize_peer((int)cred.uid, sec_buf, (size_t)slen, allowed_uid);
}

static void handle_accept(int listen_fd, uint64_t now_ms) {
    for (;;) {
        int cfd = accept4(listen_fd, NULL, NULL, SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC);
        if (cfd < 0) {
            if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
                return;
            }
            if (errno == EINTR) {
                continue;
            }
            return;
        }

        int free_idx = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNS; i++) {
            if (g_slots[i].state == ST_FREE) {
                free_idx = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (free_idx < 0 || authorize_accepted_client(cfd) != 0) {
            close(cfd);
            continue;
        }

        conn_slot_t *s = &g_slots[free_idx];
        s->client_fd = cfd;
        s->guard_fd = -1;
        s->client_in_epoll = 0;
        s->state = ST_READ_CLIENT;
        s->deadline_ms = now_ms + 36000ULL;
        s->req_len = 0;
        s->req_sent = 0;
        s->resp_len = 0;
        s->resp_sent = 0;
        s->is_install_apk = 0;
        s->req_id[0] = '\0';

        if (set_client_epoll(s, (size_t)free_idx, EPOLLIN) != 0) {
            close_slot(s);
        }
    }
}

static void start_guard_forward(conn_slot_t *s, size_t slot_idx, uint64_t now_ms) {
    int gfd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
    if (gfd < 0) {
        queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard unavailable", now_ms);
        return;
    }

    struct sockaddr_un addr;
    memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
    addr.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
    size_t plen = strlen(BROKER_GUARD_SOCK_PATH);
    if (plen >= sizeof(addr.sun_path)) {
        close(gfd);
        queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard unavailable", now_ms);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(addr.sun_path, BROKER_GUARD_SOCK_PATH, plen + 1);

    int rc = connect(gfd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr));
    if (rc == 0) {
        s->guard_fd = gfd;
        s->state = ST_WRITE_GUARD;
        s->req_sent = 0;
        s->deadline_ms = now_ms + (s->is_install_apk ? 125000ULL : 33000ULL);
        if (epoll_add(gfd, EPOLLOUT, MAKE_TAG(slot_idx, 1)) != 0) {
            close(gfd);
            s->guard_fd = -1;
            queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard unavailable", now_ms);
            return;
        }
        /* Remove client_fd from epoll while waiting on guard to prevent level-triggered EPOLLHUP spin. */
        (void)set_client_epoll(s, slot_idx, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (errno == EINPROGRESS) {
        s->guard_fd = gfd;
        s->state = ST_CONNECT_GUARD;
        s->deadline_ms = now_ms + 3000ULL;
        if (epoll_add(gfd, EPOLLOUT, MAKE_TAG(slot_idx, 1)) != 0) {
            close(gfd);
            s->guard_fd = -1;
            queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard unavailable", now_ms);
            return;
        }
        (void)set_client_epoll(s, slot_idx, 0);
        return;
    }
    close(gfd);
    queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard unavailable", now_ms);
}

static void handle_client_read(conn_slot_t *s, size_t slot_idx, uint64_t now_ms) {
    for (;;) {
        if (s->req_len > BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES) {
            queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, BROKER_LINE_TOO_LONG_MSG, now_ms);
            return;
        }
        size_t avail = (BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES + 1) - s->req_len;
        ssize_t n = read(s->client_fd, s->req_buf + s->req_len, avail);
        if (n < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) return;
            close_slot(s);
            return;
        }
        if (n == 0) {
            if (s->req_len == 0) {
                queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "EOF", now_ms);
                return;
            }
            break; /* EOF with partial line */
        }
        size_t old_len = s->req_len;
        s->req_len += (size_t)n;
        char *nl = (char *)memchr(s->req_buf + old_len, '\n', (size_t)n);
        if (nl != NULL) {
            size_t line_len = (size_t)(nl - s->req_buf) + 1;
            s->req_len = line_len;
            break;
        }
        if (s->req_len > BROKER_MAX_RPC_LINE_BYTES) {
            queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, BROKER_LINE_TOO_LONG_MSG, now_ms);
            return;
        }
    }

    broker_req_info_t info;
    char errbuf[192];
    if (broker_validate_rpc_request(s->req_buf, s->req_len, &info, errbuf, sizeof(errbuf)) != 0) {
        queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, errbuf, now_ms);
        return;
    }

    if (info.trimmed_off > 0) {
        memmove(s->req_buf, s->req_buf + info.trimmed_off, info.trimmed_len);
    }
    s->req_buf[info.trimmed_len] = '\n';
    s->req_len = info.trimmed_len + 1;
    s->req_sent = 0;
    s->is_install_apk = info.is_install_apk;
    memcpy(s->req_id, info.id, sizeof(s->req_id));

    start_guard_forward(s, slot_idx, now_ms);
}

static void handle_guard_event(conn_slot_t *s, size_t slot_idx, uint32_t events, uint64_t now_ms) {
    if (s->state == ST_CONNECT_GUARD) {
        if (events & (EPOLLERR | EPOLLHUP)) {
            queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard unavailable", now_ms);
            return;
        }
        int soerr = 0;
        socklen_t slen = sizeof(soerr);
        if (getsockopt(s->guard_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, &soerr, &slen) != 0 || soerr != 0) {
            queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard unavailable", now_ms);
            return;
        }
        s->state = ST_WRITE_GUARD;
        s->req_sent = 0;
        s->deadline_ms = now_ms + (s->is_install_apk ? 125000ULL : 33000ULL);
    }

    if (s->state == ST_WRITE_GUARD) {
        while (s->req_sent < s->req_len) {
            ssize_t w = send(s->guard_fd, s->req_buf + s->req_sent, s->req_len - s->req_sent, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
            if (w < 0) {
                if (errno == EINTR) continue;
                if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) return;
                queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard write failed", now_ms);
                return;
            }
            s->req_sent += (size_t)w;
        }
        s->state = ST_READ_GUARD;
        s->resp_len = 0;
        if (epoll_mod(s->guard_fd, EPOLLIN, MAKE_TAG(slot_idx, 1)) != 0) {
            queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard read failed", now_ms);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (s->state == ST_READ_GUARD) {
        int line_done = 0;
        for (;;) {
            if (s->resp_len > BROKER_MAX_RPC_RESP_BYTES) {
                queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard read failed", now_ms);
                return;
            }
            size_t avail = (BROKER_MAX_RPC_RESP_BYTES + 1) - s->resp_len;
            ssize_t n = read(s->guard_fd, s->resp_buf + s->resp_len, avail);
            if (n < 0) {
                if (errno == EINTR) continue;
                if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) break;
                queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard read failed", now_ms);
                return;
            }
            if (n == 0) {
                if (s->resp_len == 0) {
                    queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard read failed", now_ms);
                    return;
                }
                line_done = 1;
                break;
            }
            size_t old_len = s->resp_len;
            s->resp_len += (size_t)n;
            char *nl = (char *)memchr(s->resp_buf + old_len, '\n', (size_t)n);
            if (nl != NULL) {
                s->resp_len = (size_t)(nl - s->resp_buf) + 1;
                line_done = 1;
                break;
            }
            if (s->resp_len > BROKER_MAX_RPC_RESP_BYTES) {
                queue_error_reply(s, slot_idx, "guard read failed", now_ms);
                return;
            }
        }
        if (!line_done) {
            return;
        }

        size_t off = 0;
        size_t end = s->resp_len;
        while (off < end && (s->resp_buf[off] == ' ' || s->resp_buf[off] == '\t' ||
                             s->resp_buf[off] == '\r' || s->resp_buf[off] == '\n')) {
            off++;
        }
        while (end > off && (s->resp_buf[end - 1] == ' ' || s->resp_buf[end - 1] == '\t' ||
                             s->resp_buf[end - 1] == '\r' || s->resp_buf[end - 1] == '\n')) {
            end--;
        }
        size_t clean_len = end - off;
        if (clean_len > BROKER_MAX_RPC_RESP_BYTES - 1) {
            clean_len = BROKER_MAX_RPC_RESP_BYTES - 1;
        }
        if (off > 0 && clean_len > 0) {
            memmove(s->resp_buf, s->resp_buf + off, clean_len);
        }
        s->resp_buf[clean_len] = '\n';
        s->resp_len = clean_len + 1;
        s->resp_sent = 0;

        epoll_ctl(g_epfd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, s->guard_fd, NULL);
        close(s->guard_fd);
        s->guard_fd = -1;

        s->state = ST_WRITE_CLIENT;
        s->deadline_ms = now_ms + 5000ULL;
        if (set_client_epoll(s, slot_idx, EPOLLOUT) != 0) {
            close_slot(s);
        }
    }
}

static void handle_client_write(conn_slot_t *s) {
    while (s->resp_sent < s->resp_len) {
        ssize_t w = send(s->client_fd, s->resp_buf + s->resp_sent, s->resp_len - s->resp_sent, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
        if (w < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) return;
            close_slot(s);
            return;
        }
        s->resp_sent += (size_t)w;
    }
    close_slot(s);
}

int main(void) {
    signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
    signal(SIGHUP, SIG_IGN);

    char attr_buf[256];
    size_t attr_len = 0;
    if (read_proc_attr(BROKER_PROC_ATTR_CURRENT, attr_buf, sizeof(attr_buf), &attr_len) != 0 ||
        broker_check_self_context(attr_buf, attr_len) != 0) {
        log_stderr("unexpected SELinux context (want " BROKER_SELINUX_CTX ")");
        return 1;
    }

    sigset_t mask;
    sigemptyset(&mask);
    sigaddset(&mask, SIGTERM);
    sigaddset(&mask, SIGINT);
    if (sigprocmask(SIG_BLOCK, &mask, NULL) != 0) {
        log_stderr("sigprocmask failed");
        return 1;
    }
    int sig_fd = signalfd(-1, &mask, SFD_NONBLOCK | SFD_CLOEXEC);
    if (sig_fd < 0) {
        log_stderr("signalfd failed");
        return 1;
    }

    unlink(BROKER_SOCK_PATH);
    mode_t old_mask = umask(0000);
    int listen_fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
    if (listen_fd < 0) {
        umask(old_mask);
        log_stderr("socket failed");
        close(sig_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    struct sockaddr_un laddr;
    memset(&laddr, 0, sizeof(laddr));
    laddr.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
    memcpy(laddr.sun_path, BROKER_SOCK_PATH, strlen(BROKER_SOCK_PATH) + 1);
    if (bind(listen_fd, (struct sockaddr *)&laddr, sizeof(laddr)) != 0 ||
        listen(listen_fd, 16) != 0) {
        umask(old_mask);
        log_stderr("bind/listen failed");
        close(listen_fd);
        unlink(BROKER_SOCK_PATH);
        close(sig_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    umask(old_mask);
    if (chmod(BROKER_SOCK_PATH, 0666) != 0) {
        log_stderr("chmod ctrl.sock failed");
        close(listen_fd);
        unlink(BROKER_SOCK_PATH);
        close(sig_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    g_epfd = epoll_create1(EPOLL_CLOEXEC);
    if (g_epfd < 0) {
        log_stderr("epoll_create1 failed");
        close(listen_fd);
        unlink(BROKER_SOCK_PATH);
        close(sig_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNS; i++) {
        g_slots[i].client_fd = -1;
        g_slots[i].guard_fd = -1;
        g_slots[i].state = ST_FREE;
    }
    if (epoll_add(listen_fd, EPOLLIN, TAG_LISTENER) != 0 ||
        epoll_add(sig_fd, EPOLLIN, TAG_SIGNALFD) != 0) {
        log_stderr("epoll_add failed");
        close(g_epfd);
        close(listen_fd);
        unlink(BROKER_SOCK_PATH);
        close(sig_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    int running = 1;
    struct epoll_event events[MAX_EPOLL_EVENTS];
    while (running) {
        uint64_t now_ms = monotonic_ms();
        int timeout_ms = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNS; i++) {
            if (g_slots[i].state == ST_FREE) continue;
            int rem = (g_slots[i].deadline_ms > now_ms)
                ? (int)(g_slots[i].deadline_ms - now_ms)
                : 0;
            if (timeout_ms < 0 || rem < timeout_ms) {
                timeout_ms = rem;
            }
        }

        int nev = epoll_wait(g_epfd, events, MAX_EPOLL_EVENTS, timeout_ms);
        if (nev < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            break;
        }
        now_ms = monotonic_ms();

        for (int i = 0; i < nev; i++) {
            uint32_t tag = (uint32_t)events[i].data.u64;
            uint32_t ev = events[i].events;

            if (tag == TAG_SIGNALFD) {
                struct signalfd_siginfo si;
                while (read(sig_fd, &si, sizeof(si)) > 0) {
                }
                running = 0;
                break;
            }
            if (tag == TAG_LISTENER) {
                handle_accept(listen_fd, now_ms);
                continue;
            }
            size_t slot_idx = TAG_SLOT(tag);
            if (slot_idx >= MAX_CONNS) continue;
            conn_slot_t *s = &g_slots[slot_idx];
            if (s->state == ST_FREE) continue;

            if (TAG_IS_GUARD(tag)) {
                handle_guard_event(s, slot_idx, ev, now_ms);
            } else {
                if (s->state == ST_READ_CLIENT) {
                    if (ev & (EPOLLIN | EPOLLHUP | EPOLLERR)) {
                        handle_client_read(s, slot_idx, now_ms);
                    }
                } else if (s->state == ST_WRITE_CLIENT) {
                    if (ev & (EPOLLOUT | EPOLLERR | EPOLLHUP)) {
                        handle_client_write(s);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        now_ms = monotonic_ms();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNS; i++) {
            conn_slot_t *s = &g_slots[i];
            if (s->state != ST_FREE && now_ms >= s->deadline_ms) {
                close_slot(s);
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNS; i++) {
        close_slot(&g_slots[i]);
    }
    close(g_epfd);
    close(listen_fd);
    unlink(BROKER_SOCK_PATH);
    close(sig_fd);
    return 0;
}
```

`broker/tests/broker_test.c`:

```c
#include "../broker_core.h"

#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static void test_check_self_context(void) {
    assert(broker_check_self_context("u:r:ksu:s0\0", 11) != 0);
    assert(broker_check_self_context("", 0) != 0);
    assert(broker_check_self_context("u:r:sandbox_broker:s0\n", 22) == 0);
    assert(broker_check_self_context("u:r:sandbox_broker:s0\0\0", 23) == 0);
}

static void test_parse_auth_json(void) {
    int uid = 0;
    assert(broker_parse_auth_json("{\"allowed_user0_uid\":10376}\n", 28, &uid) == 0);
    assert(uid == 10376);

    assert(broker_parse_auth_json("{\"allowed_user0_uid\": 0}", 24, &uid) == 0);
    assert(uid == 0);

    assert(broker_parse_auth_json("{\"allowed_user0_uid\":10376,\"extra\":1}", 37, &uid) != 0);
    assert(broker_parse_auth_json("{\"allowed_user0_uid\":10376,\"allowed_user0_uid\":1}", 49, &uid) != 0);
    assert(broker_parse_auth_json("{\"allowed_user0_uid\":-1}", 24, &uid) != 0);
    assert(broker_parse_auth_json("{\"allowed_user0_uid\":10376} trailing", 36, &uid) != 0);
    assert(broker_parse_auth_json("{}", 2, &uid) != 0);
}

static void test_authorize_peer_matrix(void) {
    const int allow = 10376;
    const char *v1 = "u:r:untrusted_app:s0:c120,c256,c512,c768";
    const char *v2 = "u:r:untrusted_app_32:s0:c120,c256,c512,c768\0";
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(allow, v1, strlen(v1), allow) == 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(allow, v2, strlen(v1) + 4, allow) == 0);

    const char *iso = "u:r:isolated_app:s0:c120,c256";
    const char *iso_all = "u:r:isolated_app_all:s0";
    const char *u10_ctx = "u:r:untrusted_app:s0:c10";
    const char *plat = "u:r:platform_app:s0";
    const char *sh = "u:r:shell:s0";
    const char *ok = "u:r:untrusted_app:s0";

    assert(broker_authorize_peer(allow, iso, strlen(iso), allow) != 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(allow, iso_all, strlen(iso_all), allow) != 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(1010376, u10_ctx, strlen(u10_ctx), allow) != 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(10377, ok, strlen(ok), allow) != 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(0, ok, strlen(ok), allow) != 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(allow, plat, strlen(plat), allow) != 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(allow, sh, strlen(sh), allow) != 0);
    assert(broker_authorize_peer(allow, ok, strlen(ok), 0) != 0);
}

static void test_validate_rpc_request(void) {
    broker_req_info_t info;
    char err[256];

    const char *r1 = "  {\"id\":\"r-1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\"}\r\n";
    assert(broker_validate_rpc_request(r1, strlen(r1), &info, err, sizeof(err)) == 0);
    assert(strcmp(info.id, "r-1") == 0);
    assert(info.is_install_apk == 0);
    assert(info.trimmed_off == 2);

    const char *r_inst = "{\"id\":\"inst-1\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[\"/data/local/tmp/base.apk\",\"/data/adb/sandbox_guard/staging/s.apk\"]}";
    assert(broker_validate_rpc_request(r_inst, strlen(r_inst), &info, err, sizeof(err)) == 0);
    assert(strcmp(info.id, "inst-1") == 0);
    assert(info.is_install_apk == 1);

    const char *r_launch = "{\"id\":\"l-1\",\"op\":\"LAUNCH_APP\",\"pkg\":\"com.example.app\",\"activity\":\".MainActivity\"}";
    assert(broker_validate_rpc_request(r_launch, strlen(r_launch), &info, err, sizeof(err)) == 0);

    const char *r_cfg = "{\"id\":\"c-1\",\"op\":\"RELOAD_CONFIG\",\"config\":{\"quic_udp443_mode\":\"allow\",\"log_level\":\"info\"}}";
    assert(broker_validate_rpc_request(r_cfg, strlen(r_cfg), &info, err, sizeof(err)) == 0);

    const char *bad_cases[] = {
        "",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"SHELL_EXEC\"}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"IMPORT_EXISTING\",\"pkg\":\"com.foo;id\"}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"IMPORT_EXISTING\"}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\",\"extra\":1}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\",\"id\":\"2\"}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\",\"activity\":\".Main\"}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\",\"apk_paths\":[\"/data/local/tmp/a.apk\"]}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\",\"config\":{\"quic_udp443_mode\":\"allow\"}}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[\"/sdcard/a.apk\"]}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[\"/data/local/tmp/../a.apk\"]}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[\"/data/local/tmp/a;b.apk\"]}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[]}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"RELOAD_CONFIG\",\"config\":{\"quic_udp443_mode\":\"bypass\"}}",
        "{\"id\":\"1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\"} trailing",
        "{\"id\":\"1\\u0000\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\"}",
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(bad_cases) / sizeof(bad_cases[0]); i++) {
        assert(broker_validate_rpc_request(bad_cases[i], strlen(bad_cases[i]), &info, err, sizeof(err)) != 0);
    }

    /* Exact 8192 bytes without newline would become 8193 with '\n' forwarded -> must be rejected. */
    char exact8192[8193];
    const char *pfx = "{\"id\":\"big\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\",\"pkg\":\"com.a.";
    size_t plen = strlen(pfx);
    memcpy(exact8192, pfx, plen);
    memset(exact8192 + plen, 'a', 8192 - plen - 2);
    exact8192[8190] = '"';
    exact8192[8191] = '}';
    exact8192[8192] = '\0';
    assert(broker_validate_rpc_request(exact8192, 8192, &info, err, sizeof(err)) != 0);

    /* Reject >32 APK paths. */
    char thirty3[2048];
    size_t pos = 0;
    pos += (size_t)snprintf(thirty3 + pos, sizeof(thirty3) - pos, "{\"id\":\"many\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[");
    for (int i = 0; i < 33; i++) {
        pos += (size_t)snprintf(thirty3 + pos, sizeof(thirty3) - pos, "%s\"/data/local/tmp/s%d.apk\"", i ? "," : "", i);
    }
    pos += (size_t)snprintf(thirty3 + pos, sizeof(thirty3) - pos, "]}");
    assert(broker_validate_rpc_request(thirty3, pos, &info, err, sizeof(err)) != 0);
}

static void test_format_error_json(void) {
    char out[256];
    size_t n = broker_format_error_json("id\"1", "bad\\line\nctrl", out, sizeof(out));
    assert(n > 0);
    assert(out[n - 1] == '\n');
    assert(strcmp(out, "{\"id\":\"id\\\"1\",\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"bad\\\\line\\nctrl\",\"data\":{}}\n") == 0);
}

int main(void) {
    test_check_self_context();
    test_parse_auth_json();
    test_authorize_peer_matrix();
    test_validate_rpc_request();
    test_format_error_json();
    printf("NATIVE_BROKER_C11_TESTS_PASSED\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`controller/build-controller.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Builds the minimalist pure-Java KernBox Controller APK (dist/KernBox.apk)."""

import argparse
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from zipfile import ZIP_DEFLATED, ZipFile, ZipInfo

SOURCE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO_ROOT = SOURCE.parent
IS_WIN = os.name == "nt"
FIXED_DATE = (2026, 11, 25, 0, 0, 0)


def fixed_zipinfo(arcname: str) -> ZipInfo:
    zi = ZipInfo(filename=arcname, date_time=FIXED_DATE)
    zi.compress_type = ZIP_DEFLATED
    return zi


def exe_name(base: str, win_ext: str = ".exe") -> str:
    return f"{base}{win_ext}" if IS_WIN else base


def resolve_toolchain(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
    jdk_str = args.jdk or os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME") or ""
    if not jdk_str:
        javac_on_path = shutil.which("javac")
        if javac_on_path:
            jdk_str = str(pathlib.Path(javac_on_path).resolve().parent.parent)
    if not jdk_str:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing JDK: pass --jdk or set JAVA_HOME")
    jdk = pathlib.Path(jdk_str)
    jdk_bin = jdk / "bin"

    sdk_str = args.sdk or os.environ.get("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT") or os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME") or ""
    if not sdk_str:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing Android SDK: pass --sdk or set ANDROID_SDK_ROOT / ANDROID_HOME")
    sdk = pathlib.Path(sdk_str)

    platform = sdk / "platforms" / "android-35" / "android.jar"
    if not platform.is_file():
        hits = sorted((sdk / "platforms").glob("android-*/android.jar"), reverse=True)
        if not hits:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No android.jar found under {sdk / 'platforms'}")
        platform = hits[0]

    tools_dir = sdk / "build-tools" / "35.0.0"
    if not tools_dir.is_dir():
        bt_dirs = sorted((sdk / "build-tools").iterdir(), reverse=True)
        if not bt_dirs:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No build-tools found under {sdk / 'build-tools'}")
        tools_dir = bt_dirs[0]

    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["JAVA_HOME"] = str(jdk)
    env["PATH"] = str(jdk_bin) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")

    return {
        "java": jdk_bin / exe_name("java"),
        "javac": jdk_bin / exe_name("javac"),
        "keytool": jdk_bin / exe_name("keytool"),
        "platform": platform,
        "d8": tools_dir / exe_name("d8", ".bat"),
        "d8_jar": tools_dir / "lib" / "d8.jar",
        "aapt": tools_dir / exe_name("aapt"),
        "aapt2": tools_dir / exe_name("aapt2"),
        "zipalign": tools_dir / exe_name("zipalign"),
        "apksigner": tools_dir / exe_name("apksigner", ".bat"),
        "apksigner_jar": tools_dir / "lib" / "apksigner.jar",
        "env": env,
    }


def run_cmd(tc: dict, *arguments):
    str_args = [str(v) for v in arguments]
    if IS_WIN and str_args[0].lower().endswith(".bat"):
        str_args = ["cmd", "/c", *str_args]
    subprocess.run(str_args, env=tc["env"], check=True)


def stage_resources(res_dir: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    static_res = SOURCE / "res"
    if static_res.is_dir():
        shutil.copytree(static_res, res_dir, dirs_exist_ok=True)

    icons_root = REPO_ROOT / "assets" / "android"
    drawable_dir = res_dir / "drawable-nodpi"
    drawable_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(icons_root / "ic_launcher_adaptive_432.png", drawable_dir / "ic_launcher_foreground.png")

    for density in ("mdpi", "hdpi", "xhdpi", "xxhdpi", "xxxhdpi"):
        src_png = icons_root / f"mipmap-{density}" / "ic_launcher.png"
        dst_dir = res_dir / f"mipmap-{density}"
        dst_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(src_png, dst_dir / "ic_launcher.png")
        shutil.copyfile(src_png, dst_dir / "ic_launcher_round.png")

    anydpi_dir = res_dir / "mipmap-anydpi-v26"
    anydpi_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    adaptive_xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
        '<adaptive-icon xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">\n'
        '    <background android:drawable="@color/ic_launcher_background" />\n'
        '    <foreground android:drawable="@drawable/ic_launcher_foreground" />\n'
        "</adaptive-icon>\n"
    )
    (anydpi_dir / "ic_launcher.xml").write_text(adaptive_xml, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    (anydpi_dir / "ic_launcher_round.xml").write_text(adaptive_xml, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

    values_dir = res_dir / "values"
    values_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (values_dir / "icon_colors.xml").write_text(
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
        "<resources>\n"
        '    <color name="ic_launcher_background">#F2EEE2</color>\n'
        "</resources>\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="\n",
    )


def build_apk(args: argparse.Namespace) -> pathlib.Path:
    tc = resolve_toolchain(args)
    output = pathlib.Path(args.out) if args.out else (REPO_ROOT / "dist" / "KernBox.apk")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    java_sources = sorted((SOURCE / "java").rglob("*.java"))
    if not java_sources:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No .java sources found under {SOURCE / 'java'}")

    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="kernbox-controller-") as tmp:
        staging = pathlib.Path(tmp)
        key = pathlib.Path(args.keystore) if args.keystore else (staging / "ephemeral-debug.p12")
        alias = args.alias
        storepass = args.storepass
        if not args.keystore:
            run_cmd(
                tc,
                tc["keytool"],
                "-genkeypair",
                "-alias",
                alias,
                "-keystore",
                key,
                "-storetype",
                "PKCS12",
                "-storepass",
                storepass,
                "-dname",
                "CN=KernBox Controller",
                "-keyalg",
                "RSA",
                "-keysize",
                "2048",
                "-validity",
                "365",
            )

        res_dir = staging / "res"
        stage_resources(res_dir)
        compiled_res = staging / "compiled-res.zip"
        run_cmd(tc, tc["aapt2"], "compile", "--dir", res_dir, "-o", compiled_res)

        gen_java = staging / "gen"
        gen_java.mkdir()
        unsigned = staging / "unsigned.apk"
        run_cmd(
            tc,
            tc["aapt2"],
            "link",
            "-o",
            unsigned,
            "-I",
            tc["platform"],
            "--manifest",
            SOURCE / "AndroidManifest.xml",
            "--java",
            gen_java,
            "--min-sdk-version",
            "26",
            "--target-sdk-version",
            "35",
            "--auto-add-overlay",
            compiled_res,
        )

        generated_r = sorted(gen_java.rglob("*.java"))
        classes = staging / "classes"
        classes.mkdir()
        run_cmd(
            tc,
            tc["javac"],
            "--release",
            "8",
            "-encoding",
            "UTF-8",
            "-Xlint:all,-options",
            "-Werror",
            "-classpath",
            tc["platform"],
            "-d",
            classes,
            *java_sources,
            *generated_r,
        )

        jar = staging / "classes.jar"
        with ZipFile(jar, "w") as archive:
            for compiled in sorted(classes.rglob("*.class"), key=lambda p: p.relative_to(classes).as_posix()):
                archive.writestr(fixed_zipinfo(compiled.relative_to(classes).as_posix()), compiled.read_bytes())

        if IS_WIN and tc["d8_jar"].is_file():
            run_cmd(tc, tc["java"], "-cp", tc["d8_jar"], "com.android.tools.r8.D8", "--min-api", "26", "--release", "--lib", tc["platform"], "--output", staging, jar)
        else:
            run_cmd(tc, tc["d8"], "--min-api", "26", "--release", "--lib", tc["platform"], "--output", staging, jar)
        with ZipFile(unsigned, "a") as archive:
            archive.writestr(fixed_zipinfo("classes.dex"), (staging / "classes.dex").read_bytes())

        aligned = staging / "aligned.apk"
        run_cmd(tc, tc["zipalign"], "-f", "4", unsigned, aligned)
        ks_pass_arg = f"env:{args.storepass_env}" if args.storepass_env else f"pass:{storepass}"
        signer_prefix = [tc["java"], "-jar", tc["apksigner_jar"]] if (IS_WIN and tc["apksigner_jar"].is_file()) else [tc["apksigner"]]
        run_cmd(
            tc,
            *signer_prefix,
            "sign",
            "--ks",
            key,
            "--ks-key-alias",
            alias,
            "--ks-pass",
            ks_pass_arg,
            "--out",
            output,
            aligned,
        )

    verify_cmd = (
        [str(tc["java"]), "-jar", str(tc["apksigner_jar"])]
        if (IS_WIN and tc["apksigner_jar"].is_file())
        else [str(tc["apksigner"])]
    )
    verify_cmd.extend(["verify", "--print-certs", str(output)])
    verify_res = subprocess.run(verify_cmd, env=tc["env"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    sys.stdout.write(verify_res.stdout)
    for line in verify_res.stdout.splitlines():
        if "SHA-256 digest:" in line:
            digest = line.split("SHA-256 digest:", 1)[1].strip().lower()
            print(f"CERT_SHA256={digest}")
            break
    run_cmd(tc, tc["aapt"], "dump", "badging", output)
    print(f"BUILT_APK={output} SIZE={output.stat().st_size}")
    return output


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build KernBox.apk companion controller")
    p.add_argument("--out", help="Output APK path (default: dist/KernBox.apk)")
    p.add_argument("--keystore", help="Optional PKCS12/JKS release keystore path")
    p.add_argument("--alias", default="kernbox-controller", help="Keystore key alias")
    p.add_argument("--storepass", default="android", help="Keystore password")
    p.add_argument("--storepass-env", default="", help="Env var name holding keystore password (passed via env:VAR)")
    p.add_argument("--jdk", help="JDK home path (overrides JAVA_HOME)")
    p.add_argument("--sdk", help="Android SDK path (overrides ANDROID_SDK_ROOT)")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    build_apk(args)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```java
public final class AddAppSheet extends FrameLayout {

        void onApkInstalled(String path);
        void onToast(String message, boolean error);
        void onDismissed();
    }

    private static final class AppItem {
        final String pkg;
        final String label;
        final Drawable icon;
        boolean imported;

        AppItem(String pkg, String label, Drawable icon) {
            this.pkg = pkg;
            this.label = label;
            this.icon = icon;
        }
    }

    private final Strings strings;
    private final BrokerClient broker;
    private final ExecutorService executor;
    private final Handler mainHandler;
    private final HostCallback callback;
```
