```java
        reloadAppsBtn.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_popup_sync);
        reloadAppsBtn.setColorFilter(ThemePalette.inkSecondary(context));
        reloadAppsBtn.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_INSIDE);
        reloadAppsBtn.setContentDescription(strings.a11yReloadApps());
        reloadAppsBtn.setPadding(ThemePalette.dp(context, 10f), ThemePalette.dp(context, 10f),
                ThemePalette.dp(context, 10f), ThemePalette.dp(context, 10f));
        reloadAppsBtn.setBackground(ThemePalette.circleRippleDrawable(
                context, ThemePalette.surfaceCard(context), ThemePalette.surfacePressed(context), ThemePalette.borderHairline(context)));
        Motion.attachPressScale(reloadAppsBtn);
        reloadAppsBtn.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                if (!loadingApps) {
                    Motion.spinOnce(reloadAppsBtn);
                    loadDeviceAppsAsync();
                }
            }
        });
        searchRow.addView(reloadAppsBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ThemePalette.dp(context, 42f), ThemePalette.dp(context, 42f)));
        devicePane.addView(searchRow, searchLp);

        appsScroll = new ScrollView(context);
        appsScroll.setVerticalScrollBarEnabled(false);
        appsListContainer = new LinearLayout(context);
        appsListContainer.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        appsScroll.addView(appsListContainer, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        int listMaxHeight = computeListMaxHeight(context);
        devicePane.addView(appsScroll, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, listMaxHeight));

        emptyMsgView = new TextView(context);
        emptyMsgView.setTextColor(ThemePalette.inkMuted(context));
        emptyMsgView.setTextSize(13f);
        emptyMsgView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        emptyMsgView.setPadding(0, ThemePalette.dp(context, 28f), 0, ThemePalette.dp(context, 28f));
        emptyMsgView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        appsListContainer.addView(emptyMsgView);

        sheetContainer.addView(devicePane);

        apkPane = new LinearLayout(context);
        apkPane.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        apkPane.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        TextView apkDesc = new TextView(context);
        apkDesc.setText(strings.apkPathLabel());
        apkDesc.setTextColor(ThemePalette.inkSecondary(context));
        apkDesc.setTextSize(13f);
        apkDesc.setLineSpacing(0f, 1.25f);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams descLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        descLp.bottomMargin = ThemePalette.dp(context, 10f);
        apkPane.addView(apkDesc, descLp);

        apkPathInput = new EditText(context);
        apkPathInput.setHint(strings.apkPathHint());
        apkPathInput.setHintTextColor(ThemePalette.inkMuted(context));
        apkPathInput.setTextColor(ThemePalette.inkPrimary(context));
        apkPathInput.setTextSize(13f);
        apkPathInput.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE);
        apkPathInput.setInputType(InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT
                | InputType.TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_MULTI_LINE
                | InputType.TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_NO_SUGGESTIONS);
        apkPathInput.setMinLines(2);
        apkPathInput.setMaxLines(4);
        apkPathInput.setGravity(Gravity.TOP | Gravity.START);
        apkPathInput.setBackground(ThemePalette.cardDrawable(
                context, ThemePalette.surfaceCard(context), ThemePalette.borderHairline(context), 12f));
        apkPathInput.setPadding(sPad, ThemePalette.dp(context, 11f), sPad, ThemePalette.dp(context, 11f));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams inputLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        inputLp.bottomMargin = ThemePalette.dp(context, 14f);
        apkPane.addView(apkPathInput, inputLp);

        installApkBtn = new TextView(context);
        installApkBtn.setText(strings.btnInstallApk());
        installApkBtn.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        installApkBtn.setTextSize(14.5f);
        installApkBtn.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.BOLD));
        installApkBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        installApkBtn.setBackground(ThemePalette.pillRippleDrawable(
                context, ThemePalette.accentCopper(context), ThemePalette.accentCopperPressed(context), Color.TRANSPARENT, 14f));
        Motion.attachPressScale(installApkBtn);
        installApkBtn.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                handleApkInstall();
            }
        });
        apkPane.addView(installApkBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ThemePalette.dp(context, 46f)));

        sheetContainer.addView(apkPane);
        switchTab(true);
    }

    private TextView buildTabButton(Context context, String label) {
        TextView tv = new TextView(context);
        tv.setText(label);
        tv.setTextSize(13f);
        tv.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        tv.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.BOLD));
        tv.setPadding(0, ThemePalette.dp(context, 8f), 0, ThemePalette.dp(context, 8f));
        return tv;
    }

    private void switchTab(boolean deviceTab) {
        Context ctx = getContext();
        tabDeviceBtn.setBackground(deviceTab
                ? ThemePalette.cardDrawable(ctx, ThemePalette.surfaceCard(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx), 10f)
                : null);
        tabDeviceBtn.setTextColor(deviceTab ? ThemePalette.inkPrimary(ctx) : ThemePalette.inkSecondary(ctx));
        tabApkBtn.setBackground(!deviceTab
                ? ThemePalette.cardDrawable(ctx, ThemePalette.surfaceCard(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx), 10f)
                : null);
        tabApkBtn.setTextColor(!deviceTab ? ThemePalette.inkPrimary(ctx) : ThemePalette.inkSecondary(ctx));
        devicePane.setVisibility(deviceTab ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        apkPane.setVisibility(deviceTab ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
    }

    private static int computeListMaxHeight(Context ctx) {
        return Math.max(ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 160f),
                Math.round(ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels * 0.40f));
    }

    private void applyFilterChipStyle(Context ctx) {
        filterNotAddedChip.setTextColor(onlyNotAdded ? ThemePalette.accentCopper(ctx) : ThemePalette.inkSecondary(ctx));
        filterNotAddedChip.setBackground(ThemePalette.pillRippleDrawable(
                ctx,
                onlyNotAdded ? ThemePalette.accentCopperSoft(ctx) : ThemePalette.surfaceCard(ctx),
                ThemePalette.surfacePressed(ctx),
                ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx),
                12f));
    }

    public void setBottomInset(int bottomPx) {
        int hPad = ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 20f);
        sheetContainer.setPadding(hPad, ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 12f), hPad,
                ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 22f) + Math.max(0, bottomPx));
        refreshMaxHeight();
    }

    public void refreshMaxHeight() {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = (LinearLayout.LayoutParams) appsScroll.getLayoutParams();
        if (lp != null) {
            lp.height = computeListMaxHeight(getContext());
            appsScroll.setLayoutParams(lp);
        }
    }

    public boolean isOpen() {
        return open;
    }

    public void show(List<String> alreadyImported) {
        refreshMaxHeight();
        importedPackages.clear();
        if (alreadyImported != null) {
            importedPackages.addAll(alreadyImported);
        }
        for (AppItem item : allDeviceApps) {
            item.imported = importedPackages.contains(item.pkg);
        }

        open = true;
        setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        backdrop.animate().cancel();
        backdrop.setAlpha(0f);
        backdrop.animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(220L).start();

        float startY = ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 340f);
        sheetContainer.animate().cancel();
        sheetContainer.setTranslationY(startY);
        sheetContainer.animate()
                .translationY(0f)
                .setDuration(260L)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(2.2f))
                .start();

        if (allDeviceApps.isEmpty() && !loadingApps) {
            loadDeviceAppsAsync();
        } else {
            renderFilteredApps();
        }
    }

    public void dismiss() {
        if (!open) {
            return;
        }
        open = false;
        backdrop.animate().cancel();
        backdrop.animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(180L).start();
        sheetContainer.animate().cancel();
        sheetContainer.animate()
                .translationY(ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 360f))
                .setDuration(200L)
                .setInterpolator(new AccelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .setListener(new AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                    @Override
                    public void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation) {
                        sheetContainer.animate().setListener(null);
                        if (!open) {
                            setVisibility(View.GONE);
                            callback.onDismissed();
                        }
                    }
                })
                .start();
    }

    private void loadDeviceAppsAsync() {
        loadingApps = true;
        final int seq = ++loadSeq;
        final Set<String> importedSnapshot = new HashSet<String>(importedPackages);
        renderFilteredApps();
        final Context appCtx = getContext().getApplicationContext();
        executor.execute(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                final List<AppItem> loaded = new ArrayList<AppItem>();
                try {
                    PackageManager pm = appCtx.getPackageManager();
                    Intent mainIntent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN, null);
                    mainIntent.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
                    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
                    List<ResolveInfo> resolved = pm.queryIntentActivities(mainIntent, PackageManager.MATCH_ALL);
                    if (resolved == null) {
                        resolved = Collections.emptyList();
                    }
                    Set<String> seen = new HashSet<String>();
                    for (ResolveInfo ri : resolved) {
                        if (ri == null || ri.activityInfo == null || ri.activityInfo.packageName == null) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        String pkg = ri.activityInfo.packageName;
                        if ("com.sandbox.controller".equals(pkg)
                                || "com.sandbox.verify".equals(pkg)
                                || !seen.add(pkg)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        String label = pkg;
                        Drawable icon = null;
                        try {
                            CharSequence labelCs = ri.loadLabel(pm);
                            String s = labelCs != null ? labelCs.toString().trim() : pkg;
                            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                                label = s;
                            }
                            icon = ri.loadIcon(pm);
                        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
                        }
                        AppItem item = new AppItem(pkg, label, icon);
                        item.imported = importedSnapshot.contains(pkg);
                        loaded.add(item);
                    }
                    Collections.sort(loaded, new Comparator<AppItem>() {
                        @Override
                        public int compare(AppItem a, AppItem b) {
                            return a.label.compareToIgnoreCase(b.label);
                        }
                    });
                } finally {
                    mainHandler.post(new Runnable() {
                        @Override
                        public void run() {
                            if (seq != loadSeq) {
                                return;
                            }
                            loadingApps = false;
                            allDeviceApps.clear();
                            allDeviceApps.addAll(loaded);
                            renderFilteredApps();
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderFilteredApps() {
        appsListContainer.removeAllViews();
        if (loadingApps) {
            emptyMsgView.setText(strings.scanningApps());
            emptyMsgView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            appsListContainer.addView(emptyMsgView);
            return;
        }
        String q = searchInput.getText().toString().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        Context ctx = getContext();
        int shown = 0;
        for (final AppItem item : allDeviceApps) {
            if (onlyNotAdded && item.imported) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!q.isEmpty()
                    && !item.label.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q)
                    && !item.pkg.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q)) {
                continue;
            }
            View row = buildAppRow(ctx, item);
            appsListContainer.addView(row);
            shown++;
        }
        if (shown == 0) {
            emptyMsgView.setText(strings.noMatches());
            emptyMsgView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            appsListContainer.addView(emptyMsgView);
        }
    }

    private View buildAppRow(final Context ctx, final AppItem item) {
        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        row.setBackground(ThemePalette.cardDrawable(
                ctx, ThemePalette.surfaceCard(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx), 14f));
        int hPad = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 12f);
        int vPad = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 10f);
        row.setPadding(hPad, vPad, hPad, vPad);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams rowLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        rowLp.bottomMargin = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 8f);
        row.setLayoutParams(rowLp);

        ImageView iconView = new ImageView(ctx);
        iconView.setImageDrawable(item.icon);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams iconLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 38f), ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 38f));
        iconLp.setMarginEnd(ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 12f));
        row.addView(iconView, iconLp);

        LinearLayout textCol = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        textCol.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        TextView nameTv = new TextView(ctx);
        nameTv.setText(item.label);
        nameTv.setTextColor(ThemePalette.inkPrimary(ctx));
        nameTv.setTextSize(14f);
        nameTv.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.BOLD));
        nameTv.setMaxLines(1);
        nameTv.setEllipsize(TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
        textCol.addView(nameTv);

        TextView pkgTv = new TextView(ctx);
        pkgTv.setText(item.pkg);
        pkgTv.setTextColor(ThemePalette.inkMuted(ctx));
        pkgTv.setTextSize(11.5f);
        pkgTv.setMaxLines(1);
        pkgTv.setEllipsize(TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
        textCol.addView(pkgTv);
        row.addView(textCol, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));

        final TextView actionBtn = new TextView(ctx);
        actionBtn.setTextSize(12.5f);
        actionBtn.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.BOLD));
        actionBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        actionBtn.setPadding(ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 12f), ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 6f),
                ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 12f), ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 6f));
        applyActionState(ctx, actionBtn, item.imported);
        Motion.attachPressScale(actionBtn);
        actionBtn.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                if (item.imported || !importingPkgs.add(item.pkg)) {
                    return;
                }
                actionBtn.setEnabled(false);
                actionBtn.setAlpha(0.55f);
                executor.execute(new Runnable() {
                    @Override
                    public void run() {
                        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse r;
                        try {
                            r = broker.importExistingApp(item.pkg);
                        } catch (Throwable t) {
                            r = BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse.error("", String.valueOf(t.getMessage()), false);
                        }
                        final BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse resp = r;
                        mainHandler.post(new Runnable() {
                            @Override
                            public void run() {
                                importingPkgs.remove(item.pkg);
                                actionBtn.setEnabled(true);
                                actionBtn.setAlpha(1f);
                                if (resp.ok) {
                                    item.imported = true;
                                    importedPackages.add(item.pkg);
                                    applyActionState(ctx, actionBtn, true);
                                    Motion.animatePulse(actionBtn);
                                    callback.onAppImported(item.pkg, item.label);
                                } else {
                                    callback.onToast(strings.failPrefix() + resp.error, true);
                                }
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        });
        row.addView(actionBtn);
        return row;
    }

    private void applyActionState(Context ctx, TextView btn, boolean imported) {
        if (imported) {
            btn.setText("✓ " + strings.btnAdded());
            btn.setTextColor(ThemePalette.accentSage(ctx));
            btn.setBackground(ThemePalette.cardDrawable(
                    ctx, ThemePalette.accentSageSoft(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx), 18f));
        } else {
            btn.setText("+ " + strings.btnImport());
            btn.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
            btn.setBackground(ThemePalette.pillRippleDrawable(
                    ctx, ThemePalette.accentCopper(ctx), ThemePalette.accentCopperPressed(ctx), Color.TRANSPARENT, 18f));
        }
    }

    private void handleApkInstall() {
        final String raw = apkPathInput.getText().toString().trim();
        final List<String> paths = BrokerProtocol.parseApkPathList(raw);
        if (paths.isEmpty()) {
            Motion.animatePulse(apkPathInput);
            callback.onToast(strings.invalidApkPath(), true);
            return;
        }
        installApkBtn.setEnabled(false);
        installApkBtn.setText(strings.btnSyncing());
        executor.execute(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse r;
                try {
                    r = broker.installApks(paths);
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    r = BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse.error("", String.valueOf(t.getMessage()), false);
                }
                final BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse resp = r;
                mainHandler.post(new Runnable() {
                    @Override
                    public void run() {
                        installApkBtn.setEnabled(true);
                        installApkBtn.setText(strings.btnInstallApk());
                        if (resp.ok) {
                            apkPathInput.setText("");
                            callback.onApkInstalled(paths.get(0));
                            dismiss();
                        } else {
                            callback.onToast(strings.failPrefix() + resp.error, true);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }
}

```

`controller/java/com/sandbox/controller/AppActionSheet.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.controller;

import android.animation.Animator;
import android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter;
import android.content.ClipData;
import android.content.ClipboardManager;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.AccelerateInterpolator;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
import android.widget.FrameLayout;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;

/**
 * Animated contextual bottom sheet opened on long-press of a workspace app tile:
 * Launch, Force Stop (STOP_APP), Copy Package, or Remove (REMOVE_APP with 2nd-tap confirm).
 */
public final class AppActionSheet extends FrameLayout {

    public interface Callback {
        void onActionSuccess(BrokerProtocol.StatusSnapshot snapshot, String toastMessage);
        void onActionError(String errorMessage);
        void onCopyToast(String message);
        void onSheetDismissed();
    }

    private final Strings strings;
    private final BrokerClient broker;
    private final ExecutorService executor;
    private final Handler mainHandler;
    private final Callback callback;

    private final View backdrop;
    private final LinearLayout sheetContainer;
    private final ImageView appIconView;
    private final TextView appMonoView;
    private final TextView appLabelView;
    private final TextView appPkgView;
    private final TextView launchBtn;
    private final TextView stopBtn;
    private final TextView copyBtn;
    private final TextView removeBtn;

    private String currentPkg = "";
    private String currentLabel = "";
    private boolean open = false;
    private boolean removeArmed = false;
    private boolean working = false;
    private int opSeq = 0;

    public AppActionSheet(
            Context ctx,
            Strings strings,
            BrokerClient broker,
            ExecutorService executor,
            Handler mainHandler,
            Callback callback) {
        super(ctx);
        this.strings = strings;
        this.broker = broker;
        this.executor = executor;
        this.mainHandler = mainHandler;
        this.callback = callback;

        setVisibility(View.GONE);
        setClickable(true);

        backdrop = new View(ctx);
        backdrop.setBackgroundColor(ThemePalette.backdropDim(ctx));
        backdrop.setAlpha(0f);
        backdrop.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                dismiss();
            }
        });
        addView(backdrop, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));

        sheetContainer = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        sheetContainer.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        sheetContainer.setBackground(ThemePalette.topSheetDrawable(
                ctx, ThemePalette.bgPaper(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx), 24f));
        sheetContainer.setClickable(true);
        int hPad = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 20f);
        sheetContainer.setPadding(hPad, ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 12f), hPad, ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 24f));
        sheetContainer.setElevation(ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 18f));
        addView(sheetContainer, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, Gravity.BOTTOM));

        View handle = new View(ctx);
        handle.setBackground(ThemePalette.cardDrawable(
                ctx, ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx), Color.TRANSPARENT, 3f));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams handleLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 40f), ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 4f));
        handleLp.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL;
        handleLp.bottomMargin = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 16f);
        sheetContainer.addView(handle, handleLp);

        // App identity header
        LinearLayout idRow = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        idRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        idRow.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams idLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        idLp.bottomMargin = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 16f);

        FrameLayout iconBox = new FrameLayout(ctx);
        int iconPx = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 44f);
        appIconView = new ImageView(ctx);
        iconBox.addView(appIconView, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(iconPx, iconPx));
        appMonoView = new TextView(ctx);
        appMonoView.setTextSize(17f);
        appMonoView.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.BOLD));
        appMonoView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        appMonoView.setTextColor(ThemePalette.accentCopper(ctx));
        appMonoView.setBackground(ThemePalette.circleRippleDrawable(
                ctx, ThemePalette.accentCopperSoft(ctx), ThemePalette.surfacePressed(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx)));
        iconBox.addView(appMonoView, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(iconPx, iconPx));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams boxLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(iconPx, iconPx);
        boxLp.setMarginEnd(ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 12f));
        idRow.addView(iconBox, boxLp);

        LinearLayout metaCol = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        metaCol.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        appLabelView = new TextView(ctx);
        appLabelView.setTextColor(ThemePalette.inkPrimary(ctx));
        appLabelView.setTextSize(17f);
        appLabelView.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.BOLD));
        appLabelView.setMaxLines(1);
        appLabelView.setEllipsize(TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
        metaCol.addView(appLabelView);

        appPkgView = new TextView(ctx);
        appPkgView.setTextColor(ThemePalette.inkMuted(ctx));
        appPkgView.setTextSize(12f);
        appPkgView.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE);
        appPkgView.setMaxLines(1);
        appPkgView.setEllipsize(TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
        metaCol.addView(appPkgView);
        idRow.addView(metaCol, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        sheetContainer.addView(idRow, idLp);

        launchBtn = buildActionButton(ctx, strings.actionLaunch(),
                Color.WHITE, ThemePalette.accentCopper(ctx), ThemePalette.accentCopperPressed(ctx), Color.TRANSPARENT);
        stopBtn = buildActionButton(ctx, strings.actionStop(),
                ThemePalette.inkPrimary(ctx), ThemePalette.surfaceCard(ctx), ThemePalette.surfacePressed(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx));
        copyBtn = buildActionButton(ctx, strings.actionCopyPkg(),
                ThemePalette.inkPrimary(ctx), ThemePalette.surfaceCard(ctx), ThemePalette.surfacePressed(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx));
        removeBtn = buildActionButton(ctx, strings.actionRemove(),
                ThemePalette.accentError(ctx), ThemePalette.accentErrorSoft(ctx), ThemePalette.surfacePressed(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx));

        launchBtn.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                runPackageRpc(0);
            }
        });
        stopBtn.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                runPackageRpc(1);
            }
        });
        copyBtn.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                ClipboardManager cm = (ClipboardManager) getContext().getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE);
                if (cm != null) {
                    cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("kernbox-package", currentPkg));
                }
                callback.onCopyToast(strings.copiedPkgToast());
                dismiss();
            }
        });
        removeBtn.setOnClickListener(new OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                if (working) {
                    return;
                }
                if (!removeArmed) {
                    removeArmed = true;
                    removeBtn.setText(strings.actionRemoveConfirm());
                    removeBtn.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                    removeBtn.setBackground(ThemePalette.pillRippleDrawable(
                            getContext(), ThemePalette.accentError(getContext()),
                            ThemePalette.surfacePressed(getContext()), Color.TRANSPARENT, 14f));
                    Motion.animatePulse(removeBtn);
                    return;
                }
                runPackageRpc(2);
            }
        });

        sheetContainer.addView(launchBtn);
        sheetContainer.addView(stopBtn);
        sheetContainer.addView(copyBtn);
        sheetContainer.addView(removeBtn);
    }

    private TextView buildActionButton(
            Context ctx, String text, int fg, int fill, int ripple, int stroke) {
        TextView tv = new TextView(ctx);
        tv.setText(text);
        tv.setTextColor(fg);
        tv.setTextSize(14.5f);
        tv.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.BOLD));
        tv.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        tv.setBackground(ThemePalette.pillRippleDrawable(ctx, fill, ripple, stroke, 14f));
        Motion.attachPressScale(tv);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 46f));
        lp.bottomMargin = ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 10f);
        tv.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return tv;
    }

    public void setBottomInset(int bottomPx) {
        int hPad = ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 20f);
        sheetContainer.setPadding(hPad, ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 12f), hPad,
                ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 24f) + Math.max(0, bottomPx));
    }

    public boolean isOpen() {
        return open;
    }

    public void show(String pkg, String label, Drawable icon) {
        Context ctx = getContext();
        this.currentPkg = pkg;
        this.currentLabel = label;
        this.removeArmed = false;
        this.working = false;
        this.opSeq++;

        appLabelView.setText(label);
        appPkgView.setText(pkg);
        if (icon != null) {
            appIconView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            appMonoView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            appIconView.setImageDrawable(icon);
        } else {
            appIconView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            appMonoView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            appMonoView.setText(label.isEmpty() ? "?" : label.substring(0, 1).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        }

        removeBtn.setText(strings.actionRemove());
        removeBtn.setTextColor(ThemePalette.accentError(ctx));
        removeBtn.setBackground(ThemePalette.pillRippleDrawable(
                ctx, ThemePalette.accentErrorSoft(ctx), ThemePalette.surfacePressed(ctx), ThemePalette.borderHairline(ctx), 14f));
        setButtonsEnabled(true);

        open = true;
        setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        backdrop.animate().cancel();
        backdrop.setAlpha(0f);
        backdrop.animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(200L).start();

        sheetContainer.animate().cancel();
        sheetContainer.setTranslationY(ThemePalette.dp(ctx, 320f));
        sheetContainer.animate()
                .translationY(0f)
                .setDuration(250L)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(2.2f))
                .start();
    }

    public void dismiss() {
        if (!open) {
            return;
        }
        open = false;
        opSeq++;
        backdrop.animate().cancel();
        backdrop.animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(170L).start();
        sheetContainer.animate().cancel();
        sheetContainer.animate()
                .translationY(ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 340f))
                .setDuration(190L)
                .setInterpolator(new AccelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .setListener(new AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                    @Override
                    public void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation) {
                        sheetContainer.animate().setListener(null);
                        if (!open) {
                            setVisibility(View.GONE);
                            callback.onSheetDismissed();
                        }
                    }
                })
                .start();
    }

    private void setButtonsEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        launchBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
        stopBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
        copyBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
        removeBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
        float alpha = enabled ? 1f : 0.55f;
        launchBtn.setAlpha(alpha);
        stopBtn.setAlpha(alpha);
        removeBtn.setAlpha(alpha);
    }

    private void runPackageRpc(final int kind) {
        if (working) {
            return;
        }
        working = true;
        setButtonsEnabled(false);
        final int seq = ++opSeq;
        final String pkg = currentPkg;
        final String label = currentLabel;
        executor.execute(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                final BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse resp;
                final String okMsg;
                try {
                    if (kind == 0) {
                        resp = broker.launchApp(pkg);
                        okMsg = strings.launchingFmt(label);
                    } else if (kind == 1) {
                        resp = broker.stopApp(pkg);
                        okMsg = strings.stoppedFmt(label);
                    } else {
                        resp = broker.removeApp(pkg);
                        okMsg = strings.removedFmt(label);
                    }
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    mainHandler.post(new Runnable() {
                        @Override
                        public void run() {
                            if (seq != opSeq) {
                                return;
                            }
                            working = false;
                            setButtonsEnabled(true);
                            callback.onActionError(strings.failPrefix() + t.getMessage());
                        }
                    });
                    return;
                }
                mainHandler.post(new Runnable() {
                    @Override
                    public void run() {
                        if (seq != opSeq) {
                            return;
                        }
                        working = false;
                        setButtonsEnabled(true);
                        if (resp.ok) {
                            callback.onActionSuccess(resp.snapshot, okMsg);
                            dismiss();
                        } else {
                            callback.onActionError(strings.failPrefix() + resp.error);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }
}
```

`controller/java/com/sandbox/controller/BreathingHaloView.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.controller;

import android.animation.ArgbEvaluator;
import android.animation.ValueAnimator;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.LinearInterpolator;

/**
 * Quiet-luxury Swiss dial ring with smooth state color transitions,
 * soft breathing pulse when active, and subtle rotating arc when syncing.
 */
public final class BreathingHaloView extends View {

    public enum Mode {
        ACTIVE,
        PAUSED,
        OFFLINE,
        BUSY,
        ERROR
    }

    private final Paint dialPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint haloPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint corePaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint arcPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final RectF arcBounds = new RectF();
    private final ArgbEvaluator colorEval = new ArgbEvaluator();

    private Mode mode = Mode.OFFLINE;
    private int currentColor;
    private float breathPhase = 0f;
    private float spinAngle = 0f;
    private boolean hostResumed = true;

    private final ValueAnimator breathAnim;
    private final ValueAnimator spinAnim;
    private ValueAnimator colorAnim;

    public BreathingHaloView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        float density = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        currentColor = ThemePalette.accentStone(context);

        dialPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        dialPaint.setStrokeWidth(1.25f * density);
        dialPaint.setColor(ThemePalette.borderHairline(context));

        haloPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        corePaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);

        arcPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        arcPaint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
        arcPaint.setStrokeWidth(2.2f * density);

        breathAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f);
        breathAnim.setDuration(2200L);
        breathAnim.setRepeatMode(ValueAnimator.REVERSE);
        breathAnim.setRepeatCount(ValueAnimator.INFINITE);
        breathAnim.addUpdateListener(new ValueAnimator.AnimatorUpdateListener() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationUpdate(ValueAnimator animation) {
                breathPhase = ((Float) animation.getAnimatedValue()).floatValue();
                invalidate();
            }
        });

        spinAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 360f);
        spinAnim.setDuration(900L);
        spinAnim.setInterpolator(new LinearInterpolator());
        spinAnim.setRepeatCount(ValueAnimator.INFINITE);
        spinAnim.addUpdateListener(new ValueAnimator.AnimatorUpdateListener() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationUpdate(ValueAnimator animation) {
                spinAngle = ((Float) animation.getAnimatedValue()).floatValue();
                invalidate();
            }
        });
    }

    public void setMode(Mode nextMode) {
        if (this.mode == nextMode) {
            return;
        }
        this.mode = nextMode;
        Context ctx = getContext();
        int targetColor;
        switch (nextMode) {
            case ACTIVE:
                targetColor = ThemePalette.accentSage(ctx);
                break;
            case BUSY:
                targetColor = ThemePalette.accentCopper(ctx);
                break;
            case ERROR:
                targetColor = ThemePalette.accentError(ctx);
                break;
            case PAUSED:
            case OFFLINE:
            default:
                targetColor = ThemePalette.accentStone(ctx);
                break;
        }
        animateColorTo(targetColor);
        syncAnimators();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setHostResumed(boolean resumed) {
        this.hostResumed = resumed;
        syncAnimators();
    }

    private void animateColorTo(final int targetColor) {
        if (colorAnim != null) {
            colorAnim.cancel();
        }
        final int startColor = currentColor;
        colorAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f);
        colorAnim.setDuration(280L);
        colorAnim.addUpdateListener(new ValueAnimator.AnimatorUpdateListener() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationUpdate(ValueAnimator animation) {
                float f = ((Float) animation.getAnimatedValue()).floatValue();
                currentColor = ((Integer) colorEval.evaluate(f, startColor, targetColor)).intValue();
                invalidate();
            }
        });
        colorAnim.start();
    }

    private void syncAnimators() {
        if (!hostResumed || !isAttachedToWindow()) {
            breathAnim.cancel();
            spinAnim.cancel();
            return;
        }
        if (mode == Mode.ACTIVE) {
            if (!breathAnim.isStarted()) {
                breathAnim.start();
            }
        } else {
            breathAnim.cancel();
            breathPhase = 0.25f;
        }
        if (mode == Mode.BUSY) {
            if (!spinAnim.isStarted()) {
                spinAnim.start();
            }
        } else {
            spinAnim.cancel();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow() {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();
        syncAnimators();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        breathAnim.cancel();
        spinAnim.cancel();
        if (colorAnim != null) {
            colorAnim.cancel();
        }
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        float w = getWidth();
        float h = getHeight();
        float cx = w * 0.5f;
        float cy = h * 0.5f;
        float maxR = Math.min(w, h) * 0.44f;

        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, maxR, dialPaint);

        float haloScale = mode == Mode.ACTIVE ? (0.58f + 0.26f * breathPhase) : 0.54f;
        int haloAlpha = mode == Mode.ACTIVE ? Math.round(52 - 22 * breathPhase) : 26;
        haloPaint.setColor((currentColor & 0x00FFFFFF) | (haloAlpha << 24));
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, maxR * haloScale, haloPaint);

        corePaint.setColor(currentColor);
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, maxR * 0.28f, corePaint);

        if (mode == Mode.BUSY) {
            arcPaint.setColor(currentColor);
            float r = maxR * 0.88f;
            arcBounds.set(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r);
            canvas.drawArc(arcBounds, spinAngle - 90f, 110f, false, arcPaint);
        }
    }
}
```

`controller/java/com/sandbox/controller/BrokerClient.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.controller;

import android.net.LocalSocket;
import android.net.LocalSocketAddress;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * Unprivileged UDS JSON-line client for /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock.
 */
public final class BrokerClient {

    private static final int DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000;
    private static final int LIFECYCLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 32000;
    private static final int PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 38000;
    private static final int INSTALL_APK_TIMEOUT_MS = 125000;
    private static final int MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 65536;
    private static final AtomicInteger SEQ = new AtomicInteger(1);

    private String nextId() {
        return "kb-" + SEQ.getAndIncrement();
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse getStatus() {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildGetStatus(id), DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse startSandbox() {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildStartVpn(id), LIFECYCLE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse pauseSandbox() {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildPauseVpn(id), LIFECYCLE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse runProbe() {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildRunProbe(id), PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse reloadConfig(String quicUdp443Mode, String logLevel) {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildReloadConfig(id, quicUdp443Mode, logLevel), DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse syncHideApps() {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildSyncHideApps(id), DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse importExistingApp(String pkg) {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildImportExisting(id, pkg), PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse installApk(String apkPath) {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildInstallApk(id, apkPath), INSTALL_APK_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse installApks(List<String> apkPaths) {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildInstallApks(id, apkPaths), INSTALL_APK_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse launchApp(String pkg) {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildLaunchApp(id, pkg), LIFECYCLE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse stopApp(String pkg) {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildStopApp(id, pkg), DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    public BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse removeApp(String pkg) {
        String id = nextId();
        return exchange(id, BrokerProtocol.buildRemoveApp(id, pkg), PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    private BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse exchange(String id, String jsonLine, int timeoutMs) {
        LocalSocket socket = new LocalSocket();
        try {
            socket.connect(new LocalSocketAddress(
                    BrokerProtocol.SOCKET_PATH,
                    LocalSocketAddress.Namespace.FILESYSTEM
            ));
            socket.setSoTimeout(timeoutMs);

            OutputStream out = socket.getOutputStream();
            out.write((jsonLine + "\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            out.flush();

            String line = readBoundedLine(socket.getInputStream());
            if (line == null || line.trim().isEmpty()) {
                return BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse.error(
                        id,
                        "broker closed connection (pin cert SHA-256 in policy.json)",
                        BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.CERT_UNPINNED);
            }
            return BrokerProtocol.parseResponse(line);
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            String msg = ex.getMessage() != null ? ex.getMessage() : "socket unreachable";
            String lower = msg.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (ex instanceof java.net.SocketTimeoutException
                    || lower.contains("timed out")
                    || lower.contains("timeout")
                    || lower.contains("try again")
                    || lower.contains("eagain")) {
                return BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse.error(
                        id, "RPC timeout: " + msg, BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.RPC_TIMEOUT);
            }
            BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason reason = (lower.contains("permission") || lower.contains("eacces"))
                    ? BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.SELINUX_DENIED
                    : BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.DAEMON_DOWN;
            return BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse.error(id, msg, reason);
        } finally {
            try {
                socket.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private static String readBoundedLine(InputStream in) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream buf = new ByteArrayOutputStream(512);
        byte[] chunk = new byte[1024];
        while (true) {
            int n = in.read(chunk);
            if (n < 0) {
                break;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                byte b = chunk[i];
                if (b == '\n') {
                    return new String(buf.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                }
                if (buf.size() >= MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
                    throw new IOException("RPC response exceeds 64 KiB limit");
                }
                buf.write(b);
            }
        }
        return buf.size() == 0 ? null : new String(buf.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }
}
```

`controller/java/com/sandbox/controller/BrokerProtocol.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.controller;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Pure-Java wire protocol matching guard/internal/contracts RPCRequest and RPCResponse.
 * Intentionally free of android.* imports so host JDK unit tests run cleanly.
 */
public final class BrokerProtocol {

    public static final String SOCKET_PATH = "/dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock";

    public static final String OP_GET_STATUS = "GET_STATUS";
    public static final String OP_IMPORT_EXISTING = "IMPORT_EXISTING";
    public static final String OP_INSTALL_APK = "INSTALL_APK";
    public static final String OP_START_VPN = "START_VPN";
    public static final String OP_PAUSE_VPN = "PAUSE_VPN";
    public static final String OP_RUN_PROBE = "RUN_PROBE";
    public static final String OP_LAUNCH_APP = "LAUNCH_APP";
    public static final String OP_STOP_APP = "STOP_APP";
    public static final String OP_REMOVE_APP = "REMOVE_APP";
    public static final String OP_RELOAD_CONFIG = "RELOAD_CONFIG";
    public static final String OP_SYNC_HIDE_APPS = "SYNC_HIDE_APPS";

    private static final int MAX_APK_PATH_LEN = 512;
    private static final int MAX_SPLIT_APKS = 32;

    public enum OfflineReason {
        NONE,
        DAEMON_DOWN,
        CERT_UNPINNED,
        SELINUX_DENIED,
        RPC_TIMEOUT
    }

    private BrokerProtocol() {}

    public static String buildGetStatus(String id) {
        return buildSimpleRequest(id, OP_GET_STATUS);
    }

    public static String buildStartVpn(String id) {
        return buildSimpleRequest(id, OP_START_VPN);
    }

    public static String buildPauseVpn(String id) {
        return buildSimpleRequest(id, OP_PAUSE_VPN);
    }

    public static String buildRunProbe(String id) {
        return buildSimpleRequest(id, OP_RUN_PROBE);
    }

    public static String buildSyncHideApps(String id) {
        return buildSimpleRequest(id, OP_SYNC_HIDE_APPS);
    }

    public static String buildReloadConfig(String id, String quicUdp443Mode, String logLevel) {
        StringBuilder cfg = new StringBuilder();
        if (quicUdp443Mode != null && !quicUdp443Mode.trim().isEmpty()) {
            cfg.append("\"quic_udp443_mode\":").append(quote(quicUdp443Mode.trim()));
        }
        if (logLevel != null && !logLevel.trim().isEmpty()) {
            if (cfg.length() > 0) {
                cfg.append(',');
            }
            cfg.append("\"log_level\":").append(quote(logLevel.trim()));
        }
        return "{\"id\":" + quote(nonEmpty(id, "req"))
                + ",\"op\":" + quote(OP_RELOAD_CONFIG)
                + ",\"config\":{" + cfg.toString() + "}}";
    }

    public static String buildImportExisting(String id, String pkg) {
        return buildPkgRequest(id, OP_IMPORT_EXISTING, pkg);
    }

    public static String buildLaunchApp(String id, String pkg) {
        return buildPkgRequest(id, OP_LAUNCH_APP, pkg);
    }

    public static String buildStopApp(String id, String pkg) {
        return buildPkgRequest(id, OP_STOP_APP, pkg);
    }

    public static String buildRemoveApp(String id, String pkg) {
        return buildPkgRequest(id, OP_REMOVE_APP, pkg);
    }

    public static String buildInstallApk(String id, String apkPath) {
        return buildInstallApks(id, Collections.singletonList(nonNull(apkPath)));
    }

    public static String buildInstallApks(String id, List<String> apkPaths) {
        StringBuilder arr = new StringBuilder("[");
        if (apkPaths != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < apkPaths.size(); i++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    arr.append(',');
                }
                arr.append(quote(nonNull(apkPaths.get(i))));
            }
        }
        arr.append(']');
        return "{\"id\":" + quote(nonEmpty(id, "req"))
                + ",\"op\":" + quote(OP_INSTALL_APK)
                + ",\"apk_paths\":" + arr.toString() + "}";
    }

    public static List<String> parseApkPathList(String rawText) {
        if (rawText == null) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        String[] parts = rawText.split("[\\r\\n,]+");
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (String part : parts) {
            String p = part.trim();
            if (p.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!isAllowedApkPath(p) || out.size() >= MAX_SPLIT_APKS) {
                return Collections.emptyList();
            }
            out.add(p);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static String buildSimpleRequest(String id, String op) {
        return "{\"id\":" + quote(nonEmpty(id, "req")) + ",\"op\":" + quote(op) + "}";
    }

    private static String buildPkgRequest(String id, String op, String pkg) {
        return "{\"id\":" + quote(nonEmpty(id, "req"))
                + ",\"op\":" + quote(op)
                + ",\"pkg\":" + quote(nonNull(pkg)) + "}";
    }

    public static boolean isAllowedApkPath(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) {
            return false;
        }
        String p = rawPath.trim();
        if (p.isEmpty() || p.length() > MAX_APK_PATH_LEN || !p.endsWith(".apk") || p.contains("..")) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean inTmp = p.startsWith("/data/local/tmp/");
        boolean inStaging = p.startsWith("/data/adb/sandbox_guard/staging/");
        if (!inTmp && !inStaging) {
            return false;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < p.length(); i++) {
            char c = p.charAt(i);
            if (c <= 0x20 || c == ';' || c == '&' || c == '|' || c == '$'
                    || c == '`' || c == '\'' || c == '"' || c == '\\') {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static RpcResponse parseResponse(String rawJson) {
        if (rawJson == null || rawJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return RpcResponse.error("", "empty response", true);
        }
        try {
            Object parsed = new JsonParser(rawJson).parseRoot();
            if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {
                return RpcResponse.error("", "response is not a JSON object", false);
            }
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> root = (Map<String, Object>) parsed;
            String id = asString(root.get("id"), "");
            boolean ok = asBoolean(root.get("ok"), false);
            String err = asString(root.get("error"), "");
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> data = root.get("data") instanceof Map
                    ? (Map<String, Object>) root.get("data")
                    : Collections.<String, Object>emptyMap();
            StatusSnapshot snapshot = parseSnapshot(data);
            if (!ok && !snapshot.policyLoaded && ("guard unavailable".equals(err)
                    || "guard write failed".equals(err) || "guard read failed".equals(err))) {
                return new RpcResponse(id, false, true, OfflineReason.DAEMON_DOWN, err, snapshot);
            }
            return new RpcResponse(id, ok, false, OfflineReason.NONE, err, snapshot);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return RpcResponse.error("", "malformed JSON: " + ex.getMessage(), false);
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static StatusSnapshot parseSnapshot(Map<String, Object> data) {
        if (data == null || data.isEmpty()) {
            return StatusSnapshot.empty();
        }
        String version = asString(data.get("version"), "");
        String variant = extractVariant(data.get("variant"));
        String state = asString(data.get("state"), "UNKNOWN");
        String mode = asString(data.get("mode"), "");
        String activePreset = asString(data.get("active_preset"), "neutral");
        boolean paused = asBoolean(data.get("paused"), true);
        boolean policyLoaded = asBoolean(data.get("policy_loaded"), false);
        boolean openGate = asBoolean(data.get("sbw_open"), false);
        boolean sbwRawArmed = asBoolean(data.get("sbw_raw_armed"), false);
        boolean frozen = asBoolean(data.get("frozen"), false);
        boolean hotFrozen = asBoolean(data.get("hot_frozen"), false);
        boolean tproxyReady = asBoolean(data.get("tproxy_ready"), false);
        boolean zygiskDisabled = asBoolean(data.get("zygisk_disabled"), false);
        boolean privateDnsWarning = asBoolean(data.get("private_dns_warning"), false);
        boolean probeApkInstalled = asBoolean(data.get("probe_apk_installed"), false);
        boolean instrumentOk = asBoolean(data.get("instrument_ok"), false);
        boolean hasProbeData = data.containsKey("probe_apk_installed") || data.containsKey("instrument_ok");
        int userId = asInt(data.get("user_id"), 10);
        int runningProcs = asInt(data.get("u10_running_procs"), 0);
        int hibernatedCount = asInt(data.get("hibernated_count"), 0);
        int stuckWorkSockets = asInt(data.get("stuck_work_sockets"), 0);
        int crossPool12c6Hits = asInt(data.get("cross_pool_12c6_hits"), 0);
        int tproxyPort = asInt(data.get("tproxy_port"), 1537);
        int stealthBootTries = asInt(data.get("stealth_boot_tries"), 0);
        String privateDnsMode = asString(data.get("private_dns_mode"), "");
        int scorecardPassed = 0;
        int scorecardFailed = 0;
        int scorecardWarn = 0;
        int scorecardTotal = 0;
        if (data.get("probe_result") instanceof Map) {
            Map<String, Object> pr = (Map<String, Object>) data.get("probe_result");
            if (pr.get("real_device_scorecard") instanceof Map) {
                Map<String, Object> sc = (Map<String, Object>) pr.get("real_device_scorecard");
                scorecardPassed = asInt(sc.get("passed"), 0);
                scorecardFailed = asInt(sc.get("failed"), 0);
                scorecardWarn = sc.containsKey("warnings") ? asInt(sc.get("warnings"), 0) : asInt(sc.get("warn"), 0);
                scorecardTotal = asInt(sc.get("total"), scorecardPassed + scorecardFailed + scorecardWarn);
            }
        }
        String lastError = asString(data.get("last_error"), "");
        String bootAlert = asString(data.get("boot_alert"), "");
        String quicUdp443Mode = "";
        String exitIp = "";
        boolean vpnRunning = openGate;
        if (data.get("vpn_status") instanceof Map) {
            Map<String, Object> vpn = (Map<String, Object>) data.get("vpn_status");
            exitIp = asString(vpn.get("exit_ip"), "");
            vpnRunning = asBoolean(vpn.get("running"), openGate);
            quicUdp443Mode = asString(vpn.get("quic_udp443_mode"), "");
        }
        if (quicUdp443Mode.isEmpty() && data.get("pending_config") instanceof Map) {
            Map<String, Object> pc = (Map<String, Object>) data.get("pending_config");
            quicUdp443Mode = asString(pc.get("quic_udp443_mode"), "");
        }
        long exemptionGen = 0L;
        if (data.get("exemption") instanceof Map) {
            Map<String, Object> exMap = (Map<String, Object>) data.get("exemption");
            exemptionGen = asLong(exMap.get("generation"), 0L);
        }
        long ackAppliedGen = 0L;
        if (data.get("sandbox_ack") instanceof Map) {
            Map<String, Object> ackMap = (Map<String, Object>) data.get("sandbox_ack");
            ackAppliedGen = asLong(ackMap.get("applied_generation"), 0L);
        }
        List<String> apps = new ArrayList<String>();
        if (data.get("sandbox_apps") instanceof List) {
            for (Object item : (List<Object>) data.get("sandbox_apps")) {
                if (item instanceof String) {
                    String s = ((String) item).trim();
                    if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                        apps.add(s);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return new StatusSnapshot(
                version,
                variant,
                state,
                mode,
                activePreset,
                paused,
                policyLoaded,
                openGate,
                sbwRawArmed,
                frozen,
                hotFrozen,
                tproxyReady,
                zygiskDisabled,
                privateDnsWarning,
                probeApkInstalled,
                instrumentOk,
                hasProbeData,
                vpnRunning,
                userId,
                runningProcs,
                hibernatedCount,
                stuckWorkSockets,
                crossPool12c6Hits,
                tproxyPort,
                stealthBootTries,
                privateDnsMode,
                scorecardPassed,
                scorecardFailed,
                scorecardWarn,
                scorecardTotal,
                exitIp,
                lastError,
                bootAlert,
                quicUdp443Mode,
                exemptionGen,
                ackAppliedGen,
                Collections.unmodifiableList(apps)
        );
    }

    private static String nonNull(String s) {
        return s == null ? "" : s;
    }

    private static String nonEmpty(String s, String fallback) {
        return (s == null || s.trim().isEmpty()) ? fallback : s;
    }

    private static String asString(Object v, String fallback) {
        return v instanceof String ? (String) v : fallback;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static String extractVariant(Object raw) {
        if (raw instanceof String) {
            return (String) raw;
        }
        if (raw instanceof Map) {
            Map<String, Object> m = (Map<String, Object>) raw;
            String oem = asString(m.get("oem"), "").trim();
            String kernel = asString(m.get("kernel"), "").trim();
            if (!oem.isEmpty() && !kernel.isEmpty()) {
                return oem + "-" + kernel;
            }
            if (!oem.isEmpty()) {
                return oem;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static boolean asBoolean(Object v, boolean fallback) {
        return v instanceof Boolean ? ((Boolean) v).booleanValue() : fallback;
    }

    private static int asInt(Object v, int fallback) {
        return v instanceof Number ? ((Number) v).intValue() : fallback;
    }

    private static long asLong(Object v, long fallback) {
        return v instanceof Number ? ((Number) v).longValue() : fallback;
    }

    static String quote(String s) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(s.length() + 8);
        sb.append('"');
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            switch (c) {
                case '"':
                    sb.append("\\\"");
                    break;
                case '\\':
                    sb.append("\\\\");
                    break;
                case '\b':
                    sb.append("\\b");
                    break;
                case '\f':
                    sb.append("\\f");
                    break;
                case '\n':
                    sb.append("\\n");
                    break;
                case '\r':
                    sb.append("\\r");
                    break;
                case '\t':
                    sb.append("\\t");
                    break;
                default:
                    if (c < 0x20) {
                        sb.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
                    } else {
                        sb.append(c);
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }
        sb.append('"');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static final class RpcResponse {
        public final String id;
        public final boolean ok;
        public final boolean offline;
        public final OfflineReason offlineReason;
        public final String error;
        public final StatusSnapshot snapshot;

        public RpcResponse(String id, boolean ok, boolean offline, String error, StatusSnapshot snapshot) {
            this(id, ok, offline, offline ? OfflineReason.DAEMON_DOWN : OfflineReason.NONE, error, snapshot);
        }

        public RpcResponse(String id, boolean ok, boolean offline, OfflineReason offlineReason, String error, StatusSnapshot snapshot) {
            this.id = id;
            this.ok = ok;
            this.offline = offline;
            this.offlineReason = offlineReason == null ? OfflineReason.NONE : offlineReason;
            this.error = error == null ? "" : error;
            this.snapshot = snapshot == null ? StatusSnapshot.empty() : snapshot;
        }

        public static RpcResponse error(String id, String error, boolean offline) {
            return new RpcResponse(id, false, offline, offline ? OfflineReason.DAEMON_DOWN : OfflineReason.NONE, error, StatusSnapshot.empty());
        }

        public static RpcResponse error(String id, String error, OfflineReason reason) {
            boolean off = reason != null && reason != OfflineReason.NONE && reason != OfflineReason.RPC_TIMEOUT;
            return new RpcResponse(id, false, off, reason, error, StatusSnapshot.empty());
        }
    }

        public StatusSnapshot withPreservedProbeFrom(StatusSnapshot prev) {
            if (this.hasProbeData || prev == null || !prev.hasProbeData) {
                return this;

            return new StatusSnapshot(
                    version, variant, state, mode, activePreset, paused, policyLoaded, sbwOpen, sbwRawArmed,
                    frozen, hotFrozen, tproxyReady, zygiskDisabled, privateDnsWarning,

                    userId, runningProcs, hibernatedCount, stuckWorkSockets, crossPool12c6Hits,

        public boolean isGateHealthyOpen() {
            return !paused && sbwOpen;
        }

        public boolean hasStartupOrHealthAlert() {
            return !policyLoaded
                    || !bootAlert.trim().isEmpty()
                    || zygiskDisabled
                    || (!paused && !sbwOpen)
                    || ("tproxy".equalsIgnoreCase(mode) && !tproxyReady)
                    || crossPool12c6Hits > 0
                    || stuckWorkSockets > 0
                    || !lastError.trim().isEmpty();
        }

        public String buildAlertSummary(Strings s) {
            List<String> items = new ArrayList<String>();
            if (!policyLoaded) {
                items.add(s.alertNotPinned());
            }
            if (!bootAlert.trim().isEmpty()) {
                items.add(bootAlert.trim());
            } else if (zygiskDisabled) {
                items.add(s.alertZygiskDisabled());
            }
            if ("tproxy".equalsIgnoreCase(mode) && !tproxyReady) {
                int port = tproxyPort > 0 ? tproxyPort : 1537;
                items.add(s.alertTProxyNotReady(port));
            }
            if (!paused && !sbwOpen) {
                items.add(s.alertGateNotOpen(state));
            }
            if (crossPool12c6Hits > 0) {
                items.add(s.alertCrossPool(crossPool12c6Hits));
            }
            if (stuckWorkSockets > 0) {
                items.add(s.alertStuckSockets(stuckWorkSockets));
            }
            String errTrim = lastError.trim();
            if (!errTrim.isEmpty() && !bootAlert.contains(errTrim)) {
                items.add(errTrim);
            }
            if (items.isEmpty()) {
                return "";
            }
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    sb.append('\n');
                }
                sb.append("• ").append(items.get(i));
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }

    private static final class JsonParser {
        private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 32;
        private final String src;
        private int pos;
        private int depth;

        JsonParser(String src) {
            this.src = src;
        }

        Object parseRoot() {
            Object val = parseValue();
            skipWs();
            if (pos != src.length()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("trailing content at " + pos);
            }
            return val;
        }

        Object parseValue() {
            skipWs();
            if (pos >= src.length()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("unexpected end of input");
            }
            char c = src.charAt(pos);
            switch (c) {
                case '{':
                    return parseObject();
                case '[':
                    return parseArray();
                case '"':
                    return parseString();
                case 't':
                    expectLiteral("true");
                    return Boolean.TRUE;
                case 'f':
                    expectLiteral("false");
                    return Boolean.FALSE;
                case 'n':
                    expectLiteral("null");
                    return null;
                default:
                    if (c == '-' || (c >= '0' && c <= '9')) {
                        return parseNumber();
                    }
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("unexpected token '" + c + "' at " + pos);
            }
        }

        private Map<String, Object> parseObject() {
            if (++depth > MAX_DEPTH) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("nesting too deep");
            }
            try {
                Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
                pos++;
                skipWs();
                if (peek('}')) {
                    pos++;
                    return map;
                }
                while (true) {
                    skipWs();
                    if (!peek('"')) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("expected object key at " + pos);
                    }
                    String key = parseString();
                    skipWs();
                    expectChar(':');
                    Object val = parseValue();
                    map.put(key, val);
                    skipWs();
                    if (peek(',')) {
                        pos++;
                    } else if (peek('}')) {
                        pos++;
                        return map;
                    } else {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("expected ',' or '}' at " + pos);
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                depth--;
            }
        }

        private List<Object> parseArray() {
            if (++depth > MAX_DEPTH) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("nesting too deep");
            }
            try {
                List<Object> list = new ArrayList<Object>();
                pos++;
                skipWs();
                if (peek(']')) {
                    pos++;
                    return list;
                }
                while (true) {
                    list.add(parseValue());
                    skipWs();
                    if (peek(',')) {
                        pos++;
                    } else if (peek(']')) {
                        pos++;
                        return list;
                    } else {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("expected ',' or ']' at " + pos);
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                depth--;
            }
        }

        private String parseString() {
            expectChar('"');
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            while (pos < src.length()) {
                char c = src.charAt(pos++);
                if (c == '"') {
                    return sb.toString();
                }
                if (c == '\\') {
                    if (pos >= src.length()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("unterminated escape");
                    }
                    char esc = src.charAt(pos++);
                    switch (esc) {
                        case '"':
                        case '\\':
                        case '/':
                            sb.append(esc);
                            break;
                        case 'b':
                            sb.append('\b');
                            break;
                        case 'f':
                            sb.append('\f');
                            break;
                        case 'n':
                            sb.append('\n');
                            break;
                        case 'r':
                            sb.append('\r');
                            break;
                        case 't':
                            sb.append('\t');
                            break;
                        case 'u':
                            if (pos + 4 > src.length()) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad unicode escape");
                            }
                            int code = Integer.parseInt(src.substring(pos, pos + 4), 16);
                            sb.append((char) code);
                            pos += 4;
                            break;
                        default:
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid escape \\" + esc);
                    }
                } else {
                    sb.append(c);
                }
            }
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unterminated string");
        }

        private Number parseNumber() {
            int start = pos;
            if (peek('-')) {
                pos++;
            }
            while (pos < src.length() && src.charAt(pos) >= '0' && src.charAt(pos) <= '9') {
                pos++;
            }
            boolean isFloat = false;
            if (pos < src.length() && src.charAt(pos) == '.') {
                isFloat = true;
                pos++;
                while (pos < src.length() && src.charAt(pos) >= '0' && src.charAt(pos) <= '9') {
                    pos++;
                }
            }
            if (pos < src.length() && (src.charAt(pos) == 'e' || src.charAt(pos) == 'E')) {
                isFloat = true;
                pos++;
                if (pos < src.length() && (src.charAt(pos) == '+' || src.charAt(pos) == '-')) {
                    pos++;
                }
                while (pos < src.length() && src.charAt(pos) >= '0' && src.charAt(pos) <= '9') {
                    pos++;
                }
            }
            String token = src.substring(start, pos);
            try {
                return isFloat ? (Number) Double.valueOf(token) : (Number) Long.valueOf(token);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad number " + token);
            }
        }

        private void skipWs() {
            while (pos < src.length()) {
                char c = src.charAt(pos);
                if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n') {
                    pos++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        private boolean peek(char expected) {
            return pos < src.length() && src.charAt(pos) == expected;
        }

        private void expectChar(char expected) {
            if (pos >= src.length() || src.charAt(pos) != expected) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("expected '" + expected + "' at " + pos);
            }
            pos++;
        }

        private void expectLiteral(String lit) {
            if (!src.startsWith(lit, pos)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("expected " + lit + " at " + pos);
            }
            pos += lit.length();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.sandbox.controller;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.PackageInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.Signature;
import android.content.pm.SigningInfo;
import android.os.Build;

import java.security.MessageDigest;

/**
 * Computes this controller APK's lowercase SHA-256 signing certificate digest
 * so users can bind caller_cert_sha256 in /data/adb/sandbox_guard/policy.json.
 */
public final class CertUtil {

    private CertUtil() {}

    public static String getSigningCertSha256(Context ctx) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = ctx.getPackageManager();
            String pkg = ctx.getPackageName();
            Signature[] sigs = extractSignatures(pm, pkg);
            if (sigs == null || sigs.length == 0 || sigs[0] == null) {
                return "";
            }
            byte[] digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(sigs[0].toByteArray());
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(digest.length * 2);
            for (byte b : digest) {
                sb.append(Character.forDigit((b >>> 4) & 0xF, 16));
                sb.append(Character.forDigit(b & 0xF, 16));
            }
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private static Signature[] extractSignatures(PackageManager pm, String pkg) throws PackageManager.NameNotFoundException {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 28) {
            PackageInfo info = pm.getPackageInfo(pkg, PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES);
            SigningInfo si = info.signingInfo;
            if (si == null) {
                return null;
            }
            return si.getApkContentsSigners();
        }
        PackageInfo legacy = pm.getPackageInfo(pkg, PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES);
        return legacy.signatures;
    }

    public static String shortDigest(String hex) {
        if (hex == null || hex.length() < 16) {
            return hex == null ? "" : hex;
        }
        return hex.substring(0, 8) + "…" + hex.substring(hex.length() - 8);
    }
}
```

```java
    private TextView buildSecondaryButton(Context ctx, String label) {
        TextView tv = new TextView(ctx);

    public void setBottomInset(int bottomPx) {
        int hPad = ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 20f);
        sheetContainer.setPadding(hPad, ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 12f), hPad,
                ThemePalette.dp(getContext(), 24f) + Math.max(0, bottomPx));
```
