`controller/java/com/sandbox/controller/ThemePalette.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.controller;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.RippleDrawable;
import android.util.TypedValue;

/**
 * Quiet-luxury Swiss Industrial Monograph palette (Light Ivory & Dark Charcoal Obsidian)
 * aligned with the KernBox cube & brushed-copper ring identity.
 */
public final class ThemePalette {

    // Light palette defaults (also retained as constants for custom views)
    public static final int BG_PAPER = 0xFFF6F3EC;
    public static final int SURFACE_CARD = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    public static final int SURFACE_SUBTLE = 0xFFEDE8DC;
    public static final int SURFACE_PRESSED = 0xFFE3DDD0;
    public static final int BORDER_HAIRLINE = 0xFFE2DDD1;
    public static final int BACKDROP_DIM = 0x661C2026;

    public static final int INK_PRIMARY = 0xFF1C2026;
    public static final int INK_SECONDARY = 0xFF6B6F76;
    public static final int INK_MUTED = 0xFF6E6B63;

    public static final int ACCENT_COPPER = 0xFFB8704F;
    public static final int ACCENT_COPPER_PRESSED = 0xFF9E5D3F;
    public static final int ACCENT_COPPER_SOFT = 0xFFF2E5DE;

    public static final int ACCENT_SAGE = 0xFF2F7A58;
    public static final int ACCENT_SAGE_SOFT = 0xFFE5F0EA;
    public static final int ACCENT_STONE = 0xFF8C887E;
    public static final int ACCENT_ERROR = 0xFFB34A3C;
    public static final int ACCENT_ERROR_SOFT = 0xFFF7E7E5;

    // Dark warm-obsidian palette
    private static final int DARK_BG_PAPER = 0xFF16181C;
    private static final int DARK_SURFACE_CARD = 0xFF202329;
    private static final int DARK_SURFACE_SUBTLE = 0xFF2A2E36;
    private static final int DARK_SURFACE_PRESSED = 0xFF343944;
    private static final int DARK_BORDER_HAIRLINE = 0xFF323741;
    private static final int DARK_BACKDROP_DIM = 0x880B0C0E;

    private static final int DARK_INK_PRIMARY = 0xFFF2EEE6;
    private static final int DARK_INK_SECONDARY = 0xFFB0ACA3;
    private static final int DARK_INK_MUTED = 0xFF9E9A91;

    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_COPPER = 0xFFC97F5D;
    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_COPPER_PRESSED = 0xFFAF6A4A;
    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_COPPER_SOFT = 0xFF342721;

    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_SAGE = 0xFF4AA37A;
    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_SAGE_SOFT = 0xFF1D3128;
    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_STONE = 0xFF949087;
    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_ERROR = 0xFFD46A5C;
    private static final int DARK_ACCENT_ERROR_SOFT = 0xFF362220;

    private ThemePalette() {}

    public static boolean isDark(Context ctx) {
        int night = ctx.getResources().getConfiguration().uiMode & Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK;
        return night == Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES;
    }

    public static int bgPaper(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_BG_PAPER : BG_PAPER; }
    public static int surfaceCard(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_SURFACE_CARD : SURFACE_CARD; }
    public static int surfaceSubtle(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_SURFACE_SUBTLE : SURFACE_SUBTLE; }
    public static int surfacePressed(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_SURFACE_PRESSED : SURFACE_PRESSED; }
    public static int borderHairline(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_BORDER_HAIRLINE : BORDER_HAIRLINE; }
    public static int backdropDim(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_BACKDROP_DIM : BACKDROP_DIM; }

    public static int inkPrimary(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_INK_PRIMARY : INK_PRIMARY; }
    public static int inkSecondary(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_INK_SECONDARY : INK_SECONDARY; }
    public static int inkMuted(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_INK_MUTED : INK_MUTED; }

    public static int accentCopper(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_COPPER : ACCENT_COPPER; }
    public static int accentCopperPressed(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_COPPER_PRESSED : ACCENT_COPPER_PRESSED; }
    public static int accentCopperSoft(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_COPPER_SOFT : ACCENT_COPPER_SOFT; }
    public static int accentSage(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_SAGE : ACCENT_SAGE; }
    public static int accentSageSoft(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_SAGE_SOFT : ACCENT_SAGE_SOFT; }
    public static int accentStone(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_STONE : ACCENT_STONE; }
    public static int accentError(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_ERROR : ACCENT_ERROR; }
    public static int accentErrorSoft(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_ACCENT_ERROR_SOFT : ACCENT_ERROR_SOFT; }
    public static int toastSurface(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_INK_PRIMARY : INK_PRIMARY; }
    public static int toastInk(Context ctx) { return isDark(ctx) ? DARK_BG_PAPER : Color.WHITE; }

    public static int dp(Context ctx, float value) {
        return Math.round(TypedValue.applyDimension(
                TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, value, ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics()
        ));
    }

    public static Drawable cardDrawable(Context ctx, int fillColor, int strokeColor, float radiusDp) {
        GradientDrawable gd = new GradientDrawable();
        gd.setShape(GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE);
        gd.setColor(fillColor);
        gd.setCornerRadius(dp(ctx, radiusDp));
        if (strokeColor != Color.TRANSPARENT) {
            gd.setStroke(Math.max(1, dp(ctx, 1f)), strokeColor);
        }
        return gd;
    }

    public static Drawable topSheetDrawable(Context ctx, int fillColor, int strokeColor, float topRadiusDp) {
        int r = dp(ctx, topRadiusDp);
        GradientDrawable gd = new GradientDrawable();
        gd.setShape(GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE);
        gd.setColor(fillColor);
        gd.setCornerRadii(new float[]{r, r, r, r, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f});
        gd.setStroke(Math.max(1, dp(ctx, 1f)), strokeColor);
        return gd;
    }

    public static Drawable pillRippleDrawable(
            Context ctx, int fillColor, int rippleColor, int strokeColor, float radiusDp) {
        GradientDrawable content = new GradientDrawable();
        content.setShape(GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE);
        content.setColor(fillColor);
        content.setCornerRadius(dp(ctx, radiusDp));
        if (strokeColor != Color.TRANSPARENT) {
            content.setStroke(Math.max(1, dp(ctx, 1f)), strokeColor);
        }
        GradientDrawable mask = new GradientDrawable();
        mask.setShape(GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE);
        mask.setColor(Color.WHITE);
        mask.setCornerRadius(dp(ctx, radiusDp));
        return new RippleDrawable(ColorStateList.valueOf(rippleColor), content, mask);
    }

    public static Drawable circleRippleDrawable(Context ctx, int fillColor, int rippleColor, int strokeColor) {
        GradientDrawable content = new GradientDrawable();
        content.setShape(GradientDrawable.OVAL);
        content.setColor(fillColor);
        if (strokeColor != Color.TRANSPARENT) {
            content.setStroke(Math.max(1, dp(ctx, 1f)), strokeColor);
        }
        GradientDrawable mask = new GradientDrawable();
        mask.setShape(GradientDrawable.OVAL);
        mask.setColor(Color.WHITE);
        return new RippleDrawable(ColorStateList.valueOf(rippleColor), content, mask);
    }
}

`controller/tests/BrokerProtocolHostTest.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.controller;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class BrokerProtocolHostTest {

    private static void assertTrue(boolean cond, String msg) {
        if (!cond) {
            throw new AssertionError(msg);
        }
    }

    private static void assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual, String msg) {
        if (expected == null ? actual != null : !expected.equals(actual)) {
            throw new AssertionError(msg + ": expected=" + expected + " actual=" + actual);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        testBuilders();
        testApkPathValidationAndSplitList();
        testParseStatusSnapshotAndPreservation();
        testParseErrorOfflineAndJsonHardening();
        testBilingualStrings();
        System.out.println("BROKER_PROTOCOL_HOST_TESTS_PASSED");
    }

    private static void testBuilders() {
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r1\",\"op\":\"GET_STATUS\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildGetStatus("r1"), "GET_STATUS");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r2\",\"op\":\"START_VPN\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildStartVpn("r2"), "START_VPN");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r3\",\"op\":\"PAUSE_VPN\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildPauseVpn("r3"), "PAUSE_VPN");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r3b\",\"op\":\"RUN_PROBE\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildRunProbe("r3b"), "RUN_PROBE");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r3c\",\"op\":\"SYNC_HIDE_APPS\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildSyncHideApps("r3c"), "SYNC_HIDE_APPS");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r3d\",\"op\":\"RELOAD_CONFIG\",\"config\":{\"quic_udp443_mode\":\"reject\",\"log_level\":\"warn\"}}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildReloadConfig("r3d", "reject", "warn"), "RELOAD_CONFIG");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r4\",\"op\":\"IMPORT_EXISTING\",\"pkg\":\"org.mozilla.firefox\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildImportExisting("r4", "org.mozilla.firefox"), "IMPORT_EXISTING");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r5\",\"op\":\"LAUNCH_APP\",\"pkg\":\"com.android.vending\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildLaunchApp("r5", "com.android.vending"), "LAUNCH_APP");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r5b\",\"op\":\"STOP_APP\",\"pkg\":\"com.discord\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildStopApp("r5b", "com.discord"), "STOP_APP");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r5c\",\"op\":\"REMOVE_APP\",\"pkg\":\"com.discord\"}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildRemoveApp("r5c", "com.discord"), "REMOVE_APP");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r6\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[\"/data/local/tmp/a\\\"b.apk\"]}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildInstallApk("r6", "/data/local/tmp/a\"b.apk"), "INSTALL_APK escaping");
        assertEquals("{\"id\":\"r6b\",\"op\":\"INSTALL_APK\",\"apk_paths\":[\"/data/local/tmp/base.apk\",\"/data/local/tmp/arm64.apk\"]}",
                BrokerProtocol.buildInstallApks("r6b", Arrays.asList("/data/local/tmp/base.apk", "/data/local/tmp/arm64.apk")),
                "INSTALL_APK split bundle");
    }

    private static void testApkPathValidationAndSplitList() {
        assertTrue(BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath("/data/local/tmp/app.apk"), "tmp apk");
        assertTrue(BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath("  /data/adb/sandbox_guard/staging/base.apk  "), "staging apk");
        assertTrue(!BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath("/sdcard/Download/app.apk"), "reject sdcard");
        assertTrue(!BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath("/data/local/tmp/../etc.apk"), "reject dotdot");
        assertTrue(!BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath("/data/local/tmp/app.zip"), "reject non-apk");
        assertTrue(!BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath("/data/local/tmp/app;rm.apk"), "reject shell metachar");
        assertTrue(!BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath("/data/local/tmp/with space.apk"), "reject space");
        assertTrue(!BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath(null), "reject null");

        StringBuilder longPath = new StringBuilder("/data/local/tmp/");
        for (int i = 0; i < 510; i++) {
            longPath.append('a');
        }
        longPath.append(".apk");
        assertTrue(!BrokerProtocol.isAllowedApkPath(longPath.toString()), "reject >512 chars path");

        List<String> splits = BrokerProtocol.parseApkPathList(
                "/data/local/tmp/base.apk\n/data/adb/sandbox_guard/staging/config.arm64_v8a.apk, ");
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("/data/local/tmp/base.apk", "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/staging/config.arm64_v8a.apk"),
                splits, "split apk list parsing");
        assertTrue(BrokerProtocol.parseApkPathList("/data/local/tmp/base.apk\n/sdcard/bad.apk").isEmpty(),
                "invalid item rejects whole split list");

        StringBuilder thirtyThree = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 33; i++) {
            thirtyThree.append("/data/local/tmp/s").append(i).append(".apk\n");
        }
        assertTrue(BrokerProtocol.parseApkPathList(thirtyThree.toString()).isEmpty(),
                "must reject >32 split apk entries");
    }

    private static void testParseStatusSnapshotAndPreservation() {
        String sample = "{\"id\":\"kb-1\",\"ok\":true,\"error\":\"\",\"data\":{"
                + "\"version\":\"1.2.0\","
                + "\"variant\":\"hyperos-k510-ksu\","
                + "\"state\":\"OPEN\","
                + "\"mode\":\"tproxy\","
                + "\"tproxy_port\":1537,"
                + "\"active_preset\":\"jp-docomo\","
                + "\"paused\":false,"
                + "\"policy_loaded\":true,"
                + "\"sbw_open\":true,"
                + "\"sbw_raw_armed\":false,"
                + "\"frozen\":false,"
                + "\"hot_frozen\":true,"
                + "\"tproxy_ready\":true,"
                + "\"zygisk_disabled\":false,"
                + "\"stealth_boot_tries\":1,"
                + "\"private_dns_mode\":\"off\","
                + "\"private_dns_warning\":true,"
                + "\"probe_apk_installed\":true,"
                + "\"instrument_ok\":true,"
                + "\"probe_result\":{\"real_device_scorecard\":{\"passed\":11,\"warn\":1,\"failed\":0,\"total\":12}},"
                + "\"user_id\":10,"
                + "\"u10_running_procs\":3,"
                + "\"hibernated_count\":2,"
                + "\"stuck_work_sockets\":1,"
                + "\"cross_pool_12c6_hits\":2,"
                + "\"exemption\":{\"generation\":226},"
                + "\"sandbox_ack\":{\"applied_generation\":226},"
                + "\"boot_alert\":\"Zygisk disabled test\","
                + "\"last_error\":\"\","
                + "\"vpn_status\":{\"running\":true,\"exit_ip\":\"198.51.100.2\",\"quic_udp443_mode\":\"allow\"},"
                + "\"sandbox_apps\":[\"com.android.chrome\",\"com.example.\\u0061pp\"]"
                + "}}";

        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse resp = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse(sample);
        assertTrue(resp.ok, "ok=true");
        assertTrue(!resp.offline, "offline=false");
        assertEquals(BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.NONE, resp.offlineReason, "offlineReason=NONE");
        assertEquals("kb-1", resp.id, "id");
        assertEquals("hyperos-k510-ksu", resp.snapshot.variant, "variant");
        assertEquals("tproxy", resp.snapshot.mode, "mode");
        assertEquals(1537, resp.snapshot.tproxyPort, "tproxy_port");
        assertEquals("jp-docomo", resp.snapshot.activePreset, "active_preset");
        assertEquals("off", resp.snapshot.privateDnsMode, "private_dns_mode");
        assertTrue(resp.snapshot.hasProbeData, "hasProbeData=true");
        assertTrue(resp.snapshot.probeApkInstalled, "probe_apk_installed=true");
        assertTrue(resp.snapshot.instrumentOk, "instrument_ok=true");
        assertEquals(11, resp.snapshot.scorecardPassed, "scorecardPassed");
        assertEquals(1, resp.snapshot.scorecardWarn, "scorecardWarn");
        assertEquals(12, resp.snapshot.scorecardTotal, "scorecardTotal");
        assertEquals("198.51.100.2", resp.snapshot.exitIp, "exit_ip");
        assertEquals(2, resp.snapshot.crossPool12c6Hits, "crossPool12c6Hits");
        assertEquals("Zygisk disabled test", resp.snapshot.bootAlert, "bootAlert");
        assertEquals("allow", resp.snapshot.quicUdp443Mode, "quicUdp443Mode");
        assertEquals(226L, resp.snapshot.exemptionGen, "exemptionGen");
        assertEquals(226L, resp.snapshot.ackAppliedGen, "ackAppliedGen");
        assertTrue(resp.snapshot.isGateHealthyOpen(), "isGateHealthyOpen=true");
        assertTrue(resp.snapshot.hasStartupOrHealthAlert(), "hasStartupOrHealthAlert checks stuck sockets / cross pool / bootAlert");
        String summary = resp.snapshot.buildAlertSummary(new Strings(true));
        assertTrue(summary.contains("Zygisk disabled test") && summary.contains("198.18"), "alert summary includes bootAlert and crossPool");
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("com.android.chrome", "com.example.app"),
                resp.snapshot.sandboxApps, "sandbox_apps");

        // Regular GET_STATUS omits probe fields; withPreservedProbeFrom must preserve prior RUN_PROBE scorecard
        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse statusNoProbe = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse(
                "{\"id\":\"kb-1b\",\"ok\":true,\"data\":{\"policy_loaded\":true,\"state\":\"OPEN\",\"sandbox_apps\":[\"com.android.chrome\"]}}");
        assertTrue(!statusNoProbe.snapshot.hasProbeData, "regular GET_STATUS lacks probe data");
        BrokerProtocol.StatusSnapshot merged = statusNoProbe.snapshot.withPreservedProbeFrom(resp.snapshot);
        assertTrue(merged.hasProbeData && merged.probeApkInstalled && merged.instrumentOk,
                "withPreservedProbeFrom retains live probe results");
        assertEquals(12, merged.scorecardTotal, "withPreservedProbeFrom retains scorecardTotal");

        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse scWarnings = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse(
                "{\"id\":\"kb-1c\",\"ok\":true,\"data\":{\"probe_apk_installed\":true,\"instrument_ok\":true,"
                + "\"variant\":{\"oem\":\"hyperos\",\"kernel\":\"k510\",\"transport\":\"tproxy\"},"
                + "\"probe_result\":{\"real_device_scorecard\":{\"passed\":10,\"warnings\":2,\"failed\":0}}}}");
        assertEquals("hyperos-k510", scWarnings.snapshot.variant, "variant object parsed");
        assertEquals(2, scWarnings.snapshot.scorecardWarn, "scorecard 'warnings' alias parsed");
        assertEquals(12, scWarnings.snapshot.scorecardTotal, "scorecard computed total=12");

        String redacted = merged.toRedactedDiagnosticJson();
        assertTrue(!redacted.contains("198.51.100.2"), "redacted report omits exit_ip");
        assertTrue(!redacted.contains("com.android.chrome"), "redacted report omits app package names");
        assertTrue(redacted.contains("\"sandbox_apps_count\": 1"), "redacted report keeps app count");
    }

    private static void testParseErrorOfflineAndJsonHardening() {
        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse err = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse(
                "{\"id\":\"kb-2\",\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"policy not pinned\",\"data\":{\"sandbox_apps\":[]}}");
        assertTrue(!err.ok, "ok=false");
        assertTrue(!err.offline, "offline=false");
        assertEquals("policy not pinned", err.error, "error string");
        assertEquals(Collections.<String>emptyList(), err.snapshot.sandboxApps, "empty sandbox_apps");

        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse empty = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse("   ");
        assertTrue(!empty.ok && empty.offline, "blank input is offline");

        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse badJson = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse("{not json");
        assertTrue(!badJson.ok && !badJson.offline, "malformed JSON flagged cleanly");
        assertTrue(badJson.error.startsWith("malformed JSON"), "malformed JSON message");

        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse trailing = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse("{\"ok\":true} garbage");
        assertTrue(!trailing.ok && trailing.error.contains("trailing"), "trailing tokens rejected");

        StringBuilder deep = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            deep.append('[');
        }
        deep.append('1');
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            deep.append(']');
        }
        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse deepResp = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse(deep.toString());
        assertTrue(!deepResp.ok && deepResp.error.contains("nesting"), "excessive nesting depth rejected");

        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse timeoutResp = BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse.error(
                "kb-t1", "RPC timeout: SocketTimeoutException", BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.RPC_TIMEOUT);
        assertTrue(!timeoutResp.ok && !timeoutResp.offline, "RPC_TIMEOUT must NOT wipe UI as offline");
        assertEquals(BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.RPC_TIMEOUT, timeoutResp.offlineReason, "offlineReason=RPC_TIMEOUT");

        BrokerProtocol.RpcResponse guardDown = BrokerProtocol.parseResponse(
                "{\"id\":\"kb-g1\",\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"guard unavailable\",\"data\":{}}");
        assertTrue(!guardDown.ok && guardDown.offline, "guard unavailable with empty data must mark offline=true");
        assertEquals(BrokerProtocol.OfflineReason.DAEMON_DOWN, guardDown.offlineReason, "offlineReason=DAEMON_DOWN");
    }

    private static void testBilingualStrings() {
        Strings zh = new Strings(true);
        Strings en = new Strings(false);
        assertTrue(!zh.offlineCertUnpinnedHint().isEmpty() && !en.offlineCertUnpinnedHint().isEmpty(), "cert hint");
        assertTrue(!zh.offlineSelinuxHint().isEmpty() && !en.offlineSelinuxHint().isEmpty(), "selinux hint");
        assertTrue(!zh.diagCopyReport().isEmpty() && !en.diagCopyReport().isEmpty(), "diag copy report");
        assertTrue(!zh.diagScorecardFmt(11, 12, 1, 0).isEmpty() && !en.diagScorecardFmt(11, 12, 1, 0).isEmpty(), "scorecard fmt");
        assertTrue(!zh.freezeDeep().isEmpty() && !en.freezeDeep().isEmpty(), "freezeDeep");
        assertTrue(!zh.a11yRefresh().isEmpty() && !en.a11yClose().isEmpty(), "a11y descriptions");
        assertTrue(!zh.alertBannerTitle().isEmpty() && !en.alertBannerTitle().isEmpty(), "alertBannerTitle");
        assertTrue(!zh.alertRpcTimeout().isEmpty() && !en.alertRpcTimeout().isEmpty(), "alertRpcTimeout");
        assertTrue(!zh.qsTimeout().isEmpty() && !en.qsTimeout().isEmpty(), "qsTimeout");
        assertTrue(!zh.diagLabelBootAlert().isEmpty() && !en.diagLabelCrossPool().isEmpty(), "diag alert labels");
    }
}

`docs/FAQ.md`:

```md
# KernBox 常见问题排查 (FAQ)

---

### 1. KernBox 和普通双开 App / 传统全局 VPN 有什么本质区别？

- **普通双开 / 虚拟容器**：运行在应用层 Hook 或同用户目录隔离下，无法阻止恶意/高权限检测，也无法防止启动、休眠或切节点时的系统直连漏流。
- **传统 Android `VpnService`**：会在系统网络能力中暴露 `TRANSPORT_VPN` 标志，许多强风控应用会直接识别并降权或拒服。
- **KernBox**：直接在 Linux 内核 **Netfilter (`iptables-restore --noflush`)** 与 **Android 原生 Work Profile（如 User 10）** 边界实施 Fail-Closed 流量隔离，默认采用无 `TRANSPORT_VPN` 特征的 **TProxy 透明代理**；配合 **Zygisk Native PLT + Binder 动态代理**、**cgroup 热冻结** 与 **6 套可切换区域预设**，让隔离空间兼顾洁净度与低功耗。

---

### 2. 如何创建工作资料（Work Profile）并绑定 `KernBox.apk` 控制端？

1. 若设备尚无工作资料用户（常见 UID 起始 `user_id = 10`），可通过设备支持的 Work Profile 管理工具（如 Shelter、Insular 或设备策略控制器）预先创建好 Work Profile。
2. 安装发布包里的 [`KernBox.apk`](../controller/) 到主空间（User 0）。未绑定前直接打开 `KernBox.apk`，顶部的 **Offline Cert Helper** 会自动展示本包签名 **SHA-256 指纹** 与一键复制 `policy.json` 片段（或用 `apksigner verify --print-certs KernBox.apk` 读取），写入 `/data/adb/sandbox_guard/policy.json` 的 `caller_cert_sha256`（见 [`docs/TPROXY_INTEGRATION.md`](TPROXY_INTEGRATION.md)）。
3. 绑定完成后，主空间打开 **KernBox** 即可一键启停沙盒、点击 `+` 从主空间热导入应用或安装 APK，并支持在 Root 管理器模块列表通过 Action 按钮（`action.sh`）快速切换暂停/恢复、卸载时通过 `uninstall.sh` 自动还原休眠应用与清理防火墙规则。

---

### 故障排查决策树

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Q["遇到无法上网 / 控制端离线 / 体检告警"] --> A{"KernBox 首页显示离线?"}
    A -- "控制端提示 Guard Offline" --> A1["检查 Root 管理器模块是否启用并重启<br/>执行 sandbox_guard ctl status / service.sh"]
    A -- "提示 Cert SHA-256 Unpinned" --> A2["在 KernBox 离线卡片一键复制 policy.json<br/>补全 caller_cert_sha256 后 ctl reload-policy"]
    A -- "提示 SELinux Denied" --> A3["检查 dmesg avc 拒绝与 sandbox_broker_exec 标签<br/>确认刷新匹配 Root 管理器的专版 ZIP"]
    A -- "守护在线但 State!=Open" --> B{"ctl status 为 AckWait / Blocked?"}
    B -- "是" --> B1["核对外部代理核 TProxy 端口(1537) 与 sandbox_ack.v1.json generation"]
    B -- "Open 但工作区 App 仍异常" --> C{"Run Probe / KernBoxVerify 体检有 warn?"}
    C -- "zygisk_disabled=true" --> C1["触发了 2 次开机熔断，检查 ZygiskNext/ReZygisk 并执行 ctl stealth-toggle on"]
    C -- "keymint_rot / adb / accessibility" --> C2["按 FAQ #4 配合 TrickyStore/PIF，验收完关闭 USB 调试与无障碍并卸载 Verify APK"]
```

---

### 3. 为什么默认是 `neutral` 预设？什么时候切换区域预设？

- **安全最小化默认值**：开源版刚刷入时默认使用 `presets/neutral.json`，**不会主动覆写语言、时区与运营商**，避免预设地区与你真实代理出口不一致导致风控矛盾。
- **切换时机**：确认你的本地 TProxy 出口国家后，再从 `presets/` 挑出匹配的预设（如 `jp-docomo`、`us-tmobile`、`uk-ee`、`sg-singtel`、`de-telekom`）执行一次 `ctl preset-apply`。
- **稳态原则**：**一个沙盒长期绑定一个固定区域**，不要高频跨区来回切换 `preset-apply`，也优先使用热冻结暂停而不是反复清数据重装。

---

### 4. `KernBoxVerify.apk` 的 12 项体检出现 `warn` 怎么办？为什么测完要卸载？

1. **`keymint_rot_locked` 为 `warn`**：说明手机 Bootloader 处于解锁状态，硬件密钥认证链需搭配 KernelSU umount、TrickyStore 与 PlayIntegrityFix 模块处理（属于 TEE 伴侣层职责，KernBox 负责系统/内核网络与 Binder 边界）。
2. **`accessibility_risk_clean` 为 `warn`**：关闭非必要系统无障碍服务即可通过 `appAccessRiskVerdict` 洁净检查。
3. **`usb_debugging_off` 为 `warn`**：这是故意设计的真机验收提醒——全部检查确认通过后，**关闭「开发者选项 → USB 调试」并拔掉数据线**再投入日常使用。
4. **为什么验收完必须卸载探针**：`KernBoxVerify.apk` 仅用于验收期主动探测隔离与进程卫生，日常保留自签名测试包会成为不必要的已安装应用指纹，验收完成后请执行 `adb uninstall --user <work_user> com.sandbox.verify`。

---

### 5. 万一刷入后卡开机或遇到异常怎么安全恢复？

- **自动熔断保护（无需手动抢救）**：模块自带 **Two-Strike Bootloop Kill-Switch**。若连续 2 次重启未到达 `sys.boot_completed=1`，`post-fs-data.sh` 会在 Zygote fork 前自动写入 `zygisk_disabled` 并将 `stealth.json` 置为 `"enabled": false`，保底让你正常进入系统。
- **手动临时关闭隐身或回滚模块**：完整恢复与回滚命令见 [`agent-prompts/UPGRADE_AND_ROLLBACK.md`](../agent-prompts/UPGRADE_AND_ROLLBACK.md) 与 [`agent-prompts/DIAGNOSE.md`](../agent-prompts/DIAGNOSE.md)。

---

### 6. 发布页面有 30 个 ZIP，我怎么知道手机该用哪一个？

**不要人工瞎猜。** 把手机连上电脑运行只读探测脚本文档与选包器即可 100% 精准命中：

- Windows：`.\tools\probe_device.ps1 -Out .\dist\device_profile.json`
- macOS / Linux：`sh ./tools/probe_device.sh --out ./dist/device_profile.json`
- 自动选包：`python ./tools/select_variant.py --profile ./dist/device_profile.json --json`

所有变体明细与编译期裁剪标志见 [`VARIANT_MATRIX.md`](../VARIANT_MATRIX.md)。

```

`docs/FAQ_EN.md`:

```md
# KernBox Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

---

### 1. How does KernBox differ from app cloners or a traditional VPN?

- **App cloners / virtual containers**: Run with user-space hooks inside the same UID/data namespace, making them vulnerable to higher-privilege detection and unable to stop direct clearnet leaks during startup, doze, or proxy switches.
- **Traditional Android `VpnService`**: Exposes `TRANSPORT_VPN` and `tun0` capabilities inside `ConnectivityManager`, which strict risk-scoring apps check directly.
- **KernBox**: Enforces **Fail-Closed Netfilter (`iptables-restore --noflush`)** at the native **Android Work Profile (`user_id = 10`)** boundary over a VPN-free **TProxy** transparent path, paired with **Two-Layer Zygisk PLT + Binder Proxy** stealth, **cgroup hot-freeze**, and **6 switchable region presets**.

---

### 2. How do I provision a Work Profile and bind `KernBox.apk`?

1. If your phone does not have a Work Profile yet (commonly `user_id = 10`), create one using Shelter, Insular, or your DPC manager.
2. Install [`KernBox.apk`](../controller/) in User 0. Before pinning, open `KernBox.apk` and use its **Offline Cert Helper** card to copy its live **SHA-256 signing digest** or ready-to-paste **`policy.json` snippet** (or inspect with `apksigner verify --print-certs KernBox.apk`) into `/data/adb/sandbox_guard/policy.json` (`caller_cert_sha256`; see [`docs/TPROXY_INTEGRATION_EN.md`](TPROXY_INTEGRATION_EN.md)).
3. Once pinned, `KernBox.apk` gives one-tap Start/Pause, `+` User 0 import / split-APK install, long-press Stop / Copy Pkg / Remove, and in-app `RUN_PROBE` diagnostics. You can also toggle pause/resume from your Root Manager's module Action button (`action.sh`), and module removal runs `uninstall.sh` to restore hibernated apps and clean up `SBW_*` netfilter rules.

---

### Troubleshooting Decision Tree

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Q["Blocked network / Offline banner / Verify warning"] --> A{"What does KernBox home show?"}
    A -- "Guard Offline" --> A1["Confirm module enabled in Root Manager &amp; rebooted<br/>Run sandbox_guard ctl status / service.sh"]
    A -- "Cert SHA-256 Unpinned" --> A2["Tap Copy policy.json in Offline Cert Helper<br/>Pin caller_cert_sha256 then ctl reload-policy"]
    A -- "SELinux Denied" --> A3["Inspect dmesg avc denials &amp; sandbox_broker_exec label<br/>Flash the exact ZIP matching your Root Manager"]
    A -- "Daemon Online but State != Open" --> B{"Is ctl status AckWait or Blocked?"}
    B -- "Yes" --> B1["Verify external proxy TProxy port 1537 &amp; sandbox_ack.v1.json generation"]
    B -- "Open but Work App misbehaves" --> C{"Any warn in Run Probe / KernBoxVerify?"}
    C -- "zygisk_disabled=true" --> C1["2-strike bootloop protection tripped; verify ZygiskNext/ReZygisk &amp; ctl stealth-toggle on"]
    C -- "keymint_rot / adb / accessibility" --> C2["Check FAQ #4: TrickyStore/PIF, turn off USB Debugging &amp; Accessibility, uninstall Verify APK"]
```

---

### 3. Why is `neutral` the default preset, and when should I apply a regional preset?

- **Safe minimal default**: Fresh installs start in `presets/neutral.json` (`spoof_carrier = false`, `spoof_timezone = false`, `spoof_locale = false`, `spoof_device_region = false`, `spoof_bluetooth = false`) so your device identity is never mismatched against an unconfigured proxy exit.
- **When to switch**: Once your external TProxy exit country is verified, run `ctl preset-apply` once with the matching preset under `presets/` (`jp-docomo`, `us-tmobile`, `uk-ee`, `sg-singtel`, `de-telekom`).
- **Stability rule**: Pin **one long-lived region preset per sandbox**; avoid rapidly flipping countries back and forth, and prefer hot-freeze over repeated data wipes.

---

### 4. How do I handle `warn` items in `KernBoxVerify.apk` (and why uninstall it afterwards)?

1. **`keymint_rot_locked` = `warn`**: The bootloader is unlocked; hardware `RootOfTrust` leaf/chain attestation requires pairing with KernelSU umount + TrickyStore + PlayIntegrityFix.
2. **`accessibility_risk_clean` = `warn`**: Disable non-essential Accessibility Services before running sensitive apps (`appAccessRiskVerdict`).
3. **`usb_debugging_off` = `warn`**: Expected reminder during ADB setup — once verification passes, **disable Developer Options → USB Debugging** and unplug the cable before daily use.
4. **Why uninstall `KernBoxVerify.apk`**: Keeping a self-signed instrumentation APK installed inside the sandbox is an unnecessary fingerprint surface. Run `adb uninstall --user <work_user> com.sandbox.verify` immediately after verification.

---

### 5. What if a boot issue or anomaly occurs after flashing?

- **Automatic Bootloop Kill-Switch**: After 2 consecutive boots that fail to reach `sys.boot_completed = 1`, `post-fs-data.sh` writes `zygisk_disabled` and sets `"enabled": false` in `stealth.json` before Zygote forks.
- **Manual recovery & rollback**: See [`agent-prompts/UPGRADE_AND_ROLLBACK_EN.md`](../agent-prompts/UPGRADE_AND_ROLLBACK_EN.md) and [`agent-prompts/DIAGNOSE_EN.md`](../agent-prompts/DIAGNOSE_EN.md).

---

### 6. Which of the 30 release ZIPs should I flash?

Do not guess manually. Connect ADB and run the read-only prober + deterministic selector:

- Windows: `.\tools\probe_device.ps1 -Out .\dist\device_profile.json`
- macOS / Linux: `sh ./tools/probe_device.sh --out ./dist/device_profile.json`
- Select variant: `python ./tools/select_variant.py --profile ./dist/device_profile.json --json`

See [`VARIANT_MATRIX.md`](../VARIANT_MATRIX.md) for the complete 30-variant build table.

```

`docs/TPROXY_INTEGRATION.md`:

```md
# TProxy 外部代理核对接指南

KernBox 默认开源构建（`!transport_vpn`）采用 **Netfilter TProxy 透明代理路径**：不走 Android `VpnService`，不在工作资料内留下 `TRANSPORT_VPN` / `tun0` 特征，且在启动窗口、锁屏状态与代理升级期间通过 `SBW_RAW_OUTPUT` 实现 **Fail-Closed 阻断防漏流**。

本指南说明外部代理核心（例如 Mihomo / Sing-box 等支持 Linux `TPROXY` 入站的本地核心）如何与 `sandbox_guard` 完成握手。

---

## 1. 数据面路径与内核默认参数

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    App["工作区 App<br/>UID = user_id * 100000 .. +99999"] -->|"SBW_TPROXY_OUT (mangle)"| Mark["打标 fwmark 0x1a<br/>ip rule pref 2025 -> table 2027"]
    Mark -->|"SBW_TPROXY_PRE (PREROUTING)"| Port["本机 TPROXY 入站<br/>127.0.0.1:1537 (sandbox-tproxy)"]
    Port -->|"外部代理核出站"| Out["代理出口 (与 presets/ 区域一致)"]
```

- **默认监听端口**：`1537`（`policy.tproxy_port`，允许范围 `1024..65535`）
- **默认 fwmark**：`0x1a`（`policy.tproxy_mark`，不可为 `0`、`> 0xffff`、`0x14` 或 `0x19`）
- **策略路由表与优先级**：`table 2027`、`pref 2025`
- **默认入站标识**：`sandbox-tproxy`（`policy.proxy_inbound_name`，用于在清理连接时精准关闭工作区入站流）
- **IPv6 约束**：当前版本强制 `ipv6_enabled: false`，`sandbox_guard` 会在 `ip6tables` 侧阻断工作区 IPv6 直连防止泄漏。

---

## 2. 根目录锚定配置 `/data/adb/sandbox_guard/policy.json`

`policy.json` 必须为 **root 属主且仅 `0600` 权限**。先用 `apksigner verify --print-certs KernBox.apk` 读取控制端签名 SHA-256 摘要，再写入配置（以下路径均可按需通过可选项覆盖，绝不写死单一上游目录）：

```json
{
  "user_id": 10,
  "serial": 1,
  "caller_package": "com.sandbox.controller",
  "caller_cert_sha256": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
  "mode": "tproxy",
  "ipv6_enabled": false,
  "tproxy_port": 1537,
  "tproxy_mark": 26,
  "proxy_base_dir": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy",
  "proxy_ctl_script": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/proxy.sh",
  "proxy_config_path": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/config.json",
  "proxy_ack_path": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/sandbox_ack.v1.json",
  "proxy_core_pid_path": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/core.pid",
  "proxy_inbound_name": "sandbox-tproxy",
  "proxy_core_process": "mihomo"
}
```

> **提示**：如工作区尚未导入或需要通过设备测试验证真实网络出口，请先确认主机上的代理配置正常连通（切勿将真实机场订阅或私有 IP 写入任何代码库文件）。

---

## 3. 状态握手契约（`exemption.v1.json` ⇄ `sandbox_ack.v1.json`）

1. **Daemon 写出豁免目标** (`/data/adb/sandbox_guard/exemption.v1.json`)：
   当进入 `StateAckWait` 或打开流量时，守护进程原子写出当前 `generation`、`boot_id`、`user_id`、`uid_start` / `uid_end`、`mode: "tproxy"`、`tproxy_port` 与 `tproxy_mark`。
2. **代理核就绪回执** (`sandbox_ack.v1.json`)：
   代理核启动并开始监听 `tproxy_port` 后，向 `proxy_ack_path`（默认 `/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/sandbox_ack.v1.json`）原子写入当前生效的 `generation` 与 `boot_id`：

```json
{
  "contract_version": 1,
  "applied_generation": 1,
  "boot_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "core_pid": 4321
}
```

仅当 `sandbox_ack.v1.json` 的 `contract_version == 1`、`boot_id` 与 `/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id` 一致且 `applied_generation` 匹配当前代数，同时 TProxy 端口就绪后，`sandbox_guard` 才会切入 `StateOpen` 并解除 `SBW_RAW_OUTPUT` 丢包保护。

---

## 4. 代理核无漏流热升级流程（Upgrade Fence）

日常更新外部代理核二进制或配置时，务必使用升级围栏防止升级瞬间工作区流量直连：

```bash
# 1. 升起升级围栏（默认 TTL 90 秒，上限 300 秒；期间重新闭锁 SBW_RAW_OUTPUT 防漏流）
adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl upgrade-begin 90"

# 2. 重启 / 替换外部代理核（例如通过你的 proxy.sh 重启）

# 3. 写入新 generation ack 后解除围栏（或等待新 ack 自动闭合）
adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl upgrade-end"
```

---

## 5. 上线自检命令

```bash
# 1. 查看 Daemon 与 TProxy 就绪状态
adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl status"

# 2. 检查工作区 mangle 链路与 ip6tables 阻断是否已挂稳
adb shell su -c "iptables -t mangle -S | grep SBW_"
adb shell su -c "ip rule show | grep 2025"
```

接着在工作资料中安装一次 `KernBoxVerify.apk` 跑完 12 项体检并卸载清理（详见 [`agent-prompts/INSTALL_CN.md`](../agent-prompts/INSTALL_CN.md)）。

```

`docs/TPROXY_INTEGRATION_EN.md`:

```md
# TProxy External Proxy Core Integration Guide

Default OSS KernBox builds (`!transport_vpn`) route sandbox Work Profile traffic through **Netfilter TProxy**: zero `VpnService`, zero `TRANSPORT_VPN` / `tun0` footprint inside the sandbox, and **Fail-Closed blocking** (`SBW_RAW_OUTPUT`) across boot, lock-screen, and proxy upgrades.

This guide documents the filesystem & Netfilter contract between an external TProxy core (such as Mihomo / Sing-box) and `sandbox_guard`.

---

## 1. Data-Plane Path & Default Kernel Parameters

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    App["Work Profile App<br/>UID = user_id * 100000 .. +99999"] -->|"SBW_TPROXY_OUT (mangle)"| Mark["Mark fwmark 0x1a<br/>ip rule pref 2025 -> table 2027"]
    Mark -->|"SBW_TPROXY_PRE (PREROUTING)"| Port["Local TPROXY Listener<br/>127.0.0.1:1537 (sandbox-tproxy)"]
    Port -->|"Proxy Core Outbound"| Out["Exit Node (Aligned w/ presets/)"]
```

- **Default TProxy port**: `1537` (`policy.tproxy_port`, valid range `1024..65535`)
- **Default fwmark**: `0x1a` (`policy.tproxy_mark`, non-zero `<= 0xffff`, must not equal `0x14` or `0x19`)
- **Routing table & preference**: `table 2027`, `pref 2025`
- **Default inbound token**: `sandbox-tproxy` (`policy.proxy_inbound_name`, used when flushing only sandbox connections on proxy restarts)
- **IPv6 constraint**: `ipv6_enabled` is forced `false`; `ip6tables` blocks sandbox IPv6 egress to prevent dual-stack leaks.

---

## 2. Root-Pinned Config: `/data/adb/sandbox_guard/policy.json`

`policy.json` must be **root-owned with `0600` permissions**. Obtain your `KernBox.apk` SHA-256 signing digest from the controller's **Offline Cert Helper** (or `apksigner verify --print-certs KernBox.apk`) and write `policy.json` (or generate via `sandbox_guard ctl bootstrap-pin`):

```json
{
  "user_id": 10,
  "serial": 1,
  "caller_package": "com.sandbox.controller",
  "caller_cert_sha256": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
  "mode": "tproxy",
  "ipv6_enabled": false,
  "tproxy_port": 1537,
  "tproxy_mark": 26,
  "proxy_base_dir": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy",
  "proxy_ctl_script": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/proxy.sh",
  "proxy_config_path": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/config.json",
  "proxy_ack_path": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/sandbox_ack.v1.json",
  "proxy_core_pid_path": "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/core.pid",
  "proxy_inbound_name": "sandbox-tproxy",
  "proxy_core_process": "mihomo"
}
```

> All `proxy_*` fields are optional overrides so KernBox never hardcodes a single proxy layout. Never commit real subscription URLs or private IPs into any repository file.

---

## 3. Handshake Contract (`exemption.v1.json` ⇄ `sandbox_ack.v1.json`)

1. **Daemon writes exemption target** (`/data/adb/sandbox_guard/exemption.v1.json`):
   Before opening traffic (`StateAckWait` / `StateOpen`), `sandbox_guard` atomically writes the active `generation`, `boot_id`, `user_id`, UID range, `tproxy_port`, and `tproxy_mark`.
2. **Proxy core writes readiness ack** (`sandbox_ack.v1.json`):
   Once the external proxy core is listening on `127.0.0.1:<tproxy_port>` (loopback or wildcard, owned by root/core UID), atomically write `proxy_ack_path` (default `/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/sandbox_ack.v1.json`):

```json
{
  "contract_version": 1,
  "applied_generation": 1,
  "boot_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "core_pid": 4321
}
```

`sandbox_guard` transitions to `StateOpen` (disarming `SBW_RAW_OUTPUT`) ONLY when `contract_version == 1`, `boot_id` matches `/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id`, `applied_generation` matches the current exemption, and the local TProxy listener probe succeeds.

---

## 4. Zero-Leak Hot Upgrade Fence

When upgrading the external proxy core binary or config, raise the upgrade fence first so sandbox traffic never leaks:

```bash
# 1. Raise upgrade fence (default TTL 90s, max 300s; re-arms SBW_RAW_OUTPUT)
adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl upgrade-begin 90"

# 2. Restart / replace your external proxy core (e.g. via proxy.sh)

# 3. Clear fence once the new generation ack is in place
adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl upgrade-end"
```

---

## 5. Verification Commands

```bash
adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl status"
adb shell su -c "iptables -t mangle -S | grep SBW_"
adb shell su -c "ip rule show | grep 2025"
```

Finish by running `KernBoxVerify.apk` once inside the Work Profile and uninstalling it immediately afterwards (see [`agent-prompts/INSTALL_EN.md`](../agent-prompts/INSTALL_EN.md)).

package main

import (
	"bytes"

func TestCheckSelfContext(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	attr := filepath.Join(dir, "current")

	if err := os.WriteFile(attr, []byte("u:r:ksu:s0\x00"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := CheckSelfContext(attr, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted non-broker context u:r:ksu:s0")
	}
	if _, err := CheckSelfContext(attr, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("allowTest failed: %v", err)
	}

	if err := os.WriteFile(attr, []byte(contracts.SELinuxBrokerCtx+"\n"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, err := CheckSelfContext(attr, false); err != nil || got != contracts.SELinuxBrokerCtx {
		t.Fatalf("rejected valid broker context: got=%q err=%v", got, err)
	}
}

func TestAuthorizePeerMatrix(t *testing.T) {
	const allowedUID = 10376
	valid := []sysio.PeerCredentials{
		{PID: 100, UID: allowedUID, GID: allowedUID, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app:s0:c120,c256,c512,c768"},
		{PID: 101, UID: allowedUID, GID: allowedUID, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app_32:s0:c120,c256,c512,c768\x00"},
	}
	for _, c := range valid {
		if err := AuthorizePeer(c, allowedUID); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("valid peer %+v rejected: %v", c, err)
		}
	}

	invalid := []struct {
		name  string
		creds sysio.PeerCredentials
		allow int
	}{
		{"isolated_app", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: allowedUID, Context: "u:r:isolated_app:s0:c120,c256"}, allowedUID},
		{"isolated_app_compute", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: allowedUID, Context: "u:r:isolated_app_all:s0"}, allowedUID},
		{"work_uid_1010376", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: 1010376, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app:s0:c10"}, allowedUID},
		{"wrong_user0_uid", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: 10377, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app:s0"}, allowedUID},
		{"root_uid_0", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: 0, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app:s0"}, allowedUID},
		{"platform_app_domain", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: allowedUID, Context: "u:r:platform_app:s0"}, allowedUID},
		{"shell_domain", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: allowedUID, Context: "u:r:shell:s0"}, allowedUID},
		{"revoked_allowed_uid_0", sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: allowedUID, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app:s0"}, 0},
	}
	for _, tc := range invalid {
		if err := AuthorizePeer(tc.creds, tc.allow); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("case %s should have been rejected", tc.name)
		}
	}
}

func TestBrokerForwardingAndRejection(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	authPath := filepath.Join(dir, "broker_auth.json")
	guardSock := filepath.Join(dir, "guard.sock")
	clientSock := filepath.Join(dir, "ctrl.sock")

	if err := os.WriteFile(authPath, []byte(`{"allowed_user0_uid":10376}`), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Start mock guard.sock
	gln, err := net.Listen("unix", guardSock)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer gln.Close()
	go func() {
		for {
			c, err := gln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			line, err := rpc.ReadLineBounded(c, contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes)
			if err == nil {
				req, perr := rpc.ParseAndValidateRequest(line)
				if perr == nil {
					_ = json.NewEncoder(c).Encode(contracts.RPCResponse{
						ID:   req.ID,
						OK:   true,
						Data: map[string]any{"op": req.Op},
					})
					_ = c.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(200 * time.Millisecond))
					var eof [1]byte
					_, _ = c.Read(eof[:])
				}
			}
			_ = c.Close()
		}
	}()

	var credMu sync.Mutex
	var currentCreds sysio.PeerCredentials
	var credErr error
	setCreds := func(creds sysio.PeerCredentials, cerr error) {
		credMu.Lock()
		currentCreds = creds
		credErr = cerr
		credMu.Unlock()
	}
	cfg := BrokerConfig{
		ClientSockPath: clientSock,
		GuardSockPath:  guardSock,
		AuthFilePath:   authPath,
		AllowTestCtx:   true,
		GetPeerCreds: func(conn net.Conn) (sysio.PeerCredentials, error) {
			credMu.Lock()
			defer credMu.Unlock()
			return currentCreds, credErr
		},
	}
	_, stop, err := ServeBroker(cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer stop()

	call := func(line string, writeBeforeRead bool) contracts.RPCResponse {
		c, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", clientSock, 2*time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer c.Close()
		if writeBeforeRead {
			_, _ = c.Write([]byte(line))
		}
		raw, err := rpc.ReadLineBounded(c, contracts.MaxRPCRespBytes)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("call(%d bytes) read failed: %v", len(line), err)
		}
		var resp contracts.RPCResponse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), &resp); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return resp
	}

	// 1. Authorized User 0 untrusted_app -> forwarded cleanly
	setCreds(sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: 10376, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app_32:s0:c120,c256"}, nil)
	r1 := call(`{"id":"1","op":"GET_STATUS"}`+"\n", true)
	if !r1.OK || r1.ID != "1" {
		t.Fatalf("authorized RPC failed: %+v", r1)
	}

	expectSilentClose := func(label string) {
		t.Helper()
		c, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", clientSock, 2*time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer c.Close()
		_ = c.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		var buf [16]byte
		n, rerr := c.Read(buf[:])
		if n != 0 || !errors.Is(rerr, io.EOF) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: expected silent EOF close, got n=%d data=%q err=%v", label, n, string(buf[:n]), rerr)
		}
	}

	// 2. isolated_app dropped silently (no oracle banner leaked)
	setCreds(sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: 10376, Context: "u:r:isolated_app:s0:c120"}, nil)
	expectSilentClose("isolated_app")

	// 3. SO_PEERCRED error dropped silently
	setCreds(sysio.PeerCredentials{}, errors.New("bad cred"))
	expectSilentClose("cred_err")
	setCreds(sysio.PeerCredentials{}, nil)

	// 3b. Work user (User 10) dropped silently
	setCreds(sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: 1010376, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app:s0:c10"}, nil)
	expectSilentClose("work_user_u10")

	// 4. Oversized >8192B rejected before forwarding
	setCreds(sysio.PeerCredentials{UID: 10376, Context: "u:r:untrusted_app:s0"}, nil)
	big := `{"id":"4","op":"GET_STATUS","pkg":"` + strings.Repeat("a", contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes) + `"}` + "\n"
	r4 := call(big, true)
	if r4.OK || !strings.Contains(r4.Error, "8192") {
		t.Fatalf("oversized request not rejected: %+v", r4)
	}
}

`guard/cmd/broker/main.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/debug"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/rpc"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/sysio"
)

type PeerCheckFunc func(conn net.Conn) (sysio.PeerCredentials, error)

type BrokerConfig struct {
	ClientSockPath string
	GuardSockPath  string
	AuthFilePath   string
	AttrPath       string
	AllowTestCtx   bool
	GetPeerCreds   PeerCheckFunc
}

func DefaultBrokerConfig() BrokerConfig {
	return BrokerConfig{
		ClientSockPath: contracts.BrokerSockPath,
		GuardSockPath:  contracts.GuardSockPath,
		AuthFilePath:   contracts.BrokerAuthPath,
		AttrPath:       contracts.ProcSelfAttrCurrent,
		AllowTestCtx:   false,
		GetPeerCreds:   sysio.GetUnixPeerCreds,
	}
}

// CheckSelfContext reads /proc/self/attr/current and enforces u:r:sandbox_broker:s0
// unless allowTest is explicitly enabled outside production.
func CheckSelfContext(attrPath string, allowTest bool) (string, error) {
	if allowTest {
		return "test-context", nil
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(attrPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", attrPath, err)
	}
	ctx := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimRight(string(data), "\x00"))
	if ctx != contracts.SELinuxBrokerCtx {
		return ctx, fmt.Errorf("unexpected SELinux context %q, want %q", ctx, contracts.SELinuxBrokerCtx)
	}
	return ctx, nil
}

// AuthorizePeer enforces SO_PEERCRED (uid == allowed_user0_uid && uid < 100000)
// and SO_PEERSEC (u:r:untrusted_app*, rejecting isolated_app).
func AuthorizePeer(creds sysio.PeerCredentials, allowedUser0UID int) error {
	if !contracts.ValidUser0AppUID(allowedUser0UID) {
		return errors.New("no valid allowed_user0_uid configured")
	}
	if creds.UID != allowedUser0UID || creds.UID < contracts.MinAppID || creds.UID >= contracts.AndroidUserWidth {
		return fmt.Errorf("unauthorized peer uid %d (want %d)", creds.UID, allowedUser0UID)
	}
	ctx := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimRight(creds.Context, "\x00"))
	parts := strings.Split(ctx, ":")
	if len(parts) < 3 || parts[0] != "u" || parts[1] != "r" {
		return fmt.Errorf("malformed peer SELinux context %q", ctx)
	}
	domain := parts[2]
	if strings.Contains(ctx, "isolated_app") || !strings.HasPrefix(domain, "untrusted_app") {
		return fmt.Errorf("rejected peer SELinux context %q", ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func ReadBrokerAuth(path string) (contracts.BrokerAuth, error) {
	data, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(path, 1024)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.BrokerAuth{}, err
	}
	var auth contracts.BrokerAuth
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(bytes.TrimSpace(data)))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(&auth); err != nil {
		return contracts.BrokerAuth{}, err
	}
	return auth, nil
}

func ServeBroker(cfg BrokerConfig) (net.Listener, func(), error) {
	if _, err := CheckSelfContext(cfg.AttrPath, cfg.AllowTestCtx); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if cfg.GetPeerCreds == nil {
		cfg.GetPeerCreds = sysio.GetUnixPeerCreds
	}

	_ = os.Remove(cfg.ClientSockPath)
	oldMask := sysio.SetUmask(0000)
	ln, err := net.Listen("unix", cfg.ClientSockPath)
	sysio.SetUmask(oldMask)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(cfg.ClientSockPath, 0666); err != nil {
		_ = ln.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(cfg.ClientSockPath)
		return nil, nil, err
	}

	stop := func() {
		_ = ln.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(cfg.ClientSockPath)
	}
	sem := make(chan struct{}, 8)
	go func() {
		for {
			conn, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			select {
			case sem <- struct{}{}:
				go func(c net.Conn) {
					defer func() { <-sem }()
					handleBrokerConn(c, cfg)
				}(conn)
			default:
				_ = conn.Close()
			}
		}
	}()
	return ln, stop, nil
}

func handleBrokerConn(conn net.Conn, cfg BrokerConfig) {
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(36 * time.Second))

	creds, err := cfg.GetPeerCreds(conn)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	auth, err := ReadBrokerAuth(cfg.AuthFilePath)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	if err := AuthorizePeer(creds, auth.AllowedUser0UID); err != nil {
		return
	}

	line, err := rpc.ReadLineBounded(conn, contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes)
	if err != nil {
		writeBrokerErr(conn, "", err.Error())
		return
	}
	req, err := rpc.ParseAndValidateRequest(line)
	if err != nil {
		writeBrokerErr(conn, "", err.Error())
		return
	}

	if req.Op == contracts.OpInstallApk {
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(125 * time.Second))
	}

	payload := append(bytes.TrimSpace(line), '\n')
	if len(payload) > contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes {
		writeBrokerErr(conn, req.ID, fmt.Sprintf("request exceeds %d bytes", contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes))
		return
	}

	upstream, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", cfg.GuardSockPath, 3*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		writeBrokerErr(conn, req.ID, "guard unavailable")
		return
	}
	defer upstream.Close()
	upDeadline := 33 * time.Second
	if req.Op == contracts.OpInstallApk {
		upDeadline = 125 * time.Second
	}
	_ = upstream.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(upDeadline))

	if _, err := upstream.Write(payload); err != nil {
		writeBrokerErr(conn, req.ID, "guard write failed")
		return
	}
	respLine, err := rpc.ReadLineBounded(upstream, contracts.MaxRPCRespBytes)
	if err != nil {
		writeBrokerErr(conn, req.ID, "guard read failed")
		return
	}
	_, _ = conn.Write(append(bytes.TrimSpace(respLine), '\n'))
}

func writeBrokerErr(conn net.Conn, id, msg string) {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(contracts.RPCResponse{
		ID:    id,
		OK:    false,
		Error: msg,
		Data:  map[string]any{},
	})
	_, _ = conn.Write(append(b, '\n'))
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1)
	debug.SetGCPercent(25)
	debug.SetMemoryLimit(3 << 20)
	cfg := DefaultBrokerConfig()

	_, stop, err := ServeBroker(cfg)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer stop()

	sigs := make(chan os.Signal, 2)
	signal.Notify(sigs, syscall.SIGTERM, syscall.SIGINT)
	signal.Ignore(syscall.SIGHUP)
	<-sigs
}

`guard/cmd/guard/main.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/debug"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/buildinfo"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/daemon"
)

func usage() int {
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: sandbox_guard <supervise | ctl <boot|reload-policy|upgrade-begin [ttl]|upgrade-end|bootstrap-pin|status|perf-status|perf-trace|pause-hot|variant-info|preset-apply|sync-hide|sync-policies|set-app-locale|prune-bloat|restore-bloat|flush-sandbox-conns|install-apk|stealth-status|stealth-toggle|start-sandbox|pause-sandbox|block> | version>")
	return 2
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1)
	debug.SetGCPercent(10)
	debug.SetMemoryLimit(3 << 20)
	os.Exit(run(os.Args[1:]))
}

func run(args []string) int {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		return usage()
	}
	switch args[0] {
	case "version":
		fmt.Println(buildinfo.BuildString())
		return 0
	case "ctl":
		if len(args) < 2 {
			return usage()
		}
		if os.Geteuid() != 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "sandbox_guard requires root")
			return 1
		}
		if err := daemon.RunCtl(args[1:]); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			return 1
		}
		return 0
	case "supervise":
		if os.Geteuid() != 0 {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "sandbox_guard requires root")
			return 1
		}
		d, err := daemon.NewDaemon()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			return 1
		}
		return d.Supervise()
	default:
		return usage()
	}
}

`guard/internal/android/android_test.go`:

```go
package android

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

type fakeRunner struct {
	outputs map[string]string
}

func (f fakeRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	key := name + " " + strings.Join(args, " ")
	if out, ok := f.outputs[key]; ok {
		return out, nil
	}
	return "", errors.New("unmocked cmd: " + key)
}

func TestDiscoverManagedProfileRejects999(t *testing.T) {
	// Android 13+ `cmd user list -v` output with a managed profile and clone user 999
	r := fakeRunner{outputs: map[string]string{
		"cmd user list -v": `3 users:
0: id=0, name=Owner, type=full.SYSTEM, flags=PRIMARY|ADMIN|FULL|INITIALIZED (running) (current)
1: id=10, name=Work Sandbox, type=profile.MANAGED, flags=INITIALIZED|MANAGED_PROFILE|PROFILE (parentId=0) (running) (profile-owner)
2: id=999, name=XSpace, type=profile.CLONE, flags=INITIALIZED|PROFILE (parentId=0) (running)
`,
		"dumpsys user --user 10": "  UserInfo{10:Work Sandbox:1030} serialNo=1000 isPrimary=false parentId=0\n    Type: android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED\n    Flags: 4144 (INITIALIZED|MANAGED_PROFILE|PROFILE)\n    State: RUNNING_UNLOCKED\n",
	}}
	prof, err := DiscoverManagedProfile(context.Background(), r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if prof.UserID != 10 || prof.Serial != 1000 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected profile: %+v", prof)
	}

	// If only user 999 exists, must fail.
	rOnly999 := fakeRunner{outputs: map[string]string{
		"cmd user list -v": "  2: id=999, name=XSpace, type=profile.CLONE, flags=INITIALIZED|PROFILE (parentId=0) (running)\n",
	}}
	if _, err := DiscoverManagedProfile(context.Background(), rOnly999); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted user 999")
	}

	// Non-zero parentId must also be rejected.
	rWrongParent := fakeRunner{outputs: map[string]string{
		"cmd user list -v": "  1: id=11, name=Nested, type=profile.MANAGED, flags=INITIALIZED|MANAGED_PROFILE|PROFILE (parentId=10) (running)\n",
	}}
	if _, err := DiscoverManagedProfile(context.Background(), rWrongParent); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted non-zero parentId")
	}
}

func TestTryFastSingleUplinkVsDualUplink(t *testing.T) {
	status := &contracts.VPNStatus{
		BootID:        "boot-1",
		Running:       true,
		TunIf:         "tun0",
		VPNNetID:      106,
		UnderlayIf:    "wlan0",
		UnderlayNetID: 100,
	}
	tun := LiveIface{Name: "tun0", Index: 19, Up: true, HasIPv4: true, IPv4CIDRs: []string{"172.19.0.1/30"}}
	wlan := LiveIface{Name: "wlan0", Index: 12, Up: true, HasIPv4: true, IPv4CIDRs: []string{"192.168.1.10/24"}}
	cell := LiveIface{Name: "ccmni2", Index: 8, Up: true, HasIPv4: true, IPv4CIDRs: []string{"10.1.2.3/24"}}

	// Single uplink fast path succeeds without dumpsys.
	sess, multi, ok := TryFastSingleUplinkSession("boot-1", 1010376, status, []LiveIface{tun, wlan})
	if !ok || multi || sess == nil || sess.UplinkIf != "wlan0" || sess.UplinkNetID != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("expected fast single uplink success, got sess=%+v multi=%v ok=%v", sess, multi, ok)
	}

	// Legacy single-uplink helper still reports multi=true when both uplinks exist.
	sess2, multi2, ok2 := TryFastSingleUplinkSession("boot-1", 1010376, status, []LiveIface{tun, wlan, cell})
	if ok2 || !multi2 || sess2 != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected legacy single-uplink helper multi=true, got sess=%+v multi=%v ok=%v", sess2, multi2, ok2)
	}

	// New TryFastStatusSession resolves directly during dual-uplink coexistence without dumpsys.
	sessDualWifi, okDualWifi := TryFastStatusSession("boot-1", 1010376, status, []LiveIface{tun, wlan, cell})
	if !okDualWifi || sessDualWifi == nil || sessDualWifi.UplinkIf != "wlan0" || sessDualWifi.UplinkIndex != 12 || sessDualWifi.UplinkNetID != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("expected dual-uplink fast status resolution for wlan0, got sess=%+v ok=%v", sessDualWifi, okDualWifi)
	}
	cellStatus := *status
	cellStatus.UnderlayIf = "ccmni2"
	cellStatus.UnderlayNetID = 101
	sessDualCell, okDualCell := TryFastStatusSession("boot-1", 1010376, &cellStatus, []LiveIface{tun, wlan, cell})
	if !okDualCell || sessDualCell == nil || sessDualCell.UplinkIf != "ccmni2" || sessDualCell.UplinkIndex != 8 || sessDualCell.UplinkNetID != 101 {
		t.Fatalf("expected dual-uplink fast status resolution for ccmni2, got sess=%+v ok=%v", sessDualCell, okDualCell)
	}

	// Reject loopback, tun-as-underlay, missing interface, or low net_id.
	for _, bad := range []struct {
		ifName string
		netID  int
	}{
		{"lo", 100},
		{"tun0", 100},
		{"wlan99", 100},
		{"wlan0", 99},
	} {
		bs := *status
		bs.UnderlayIf = bad.ifName
		bs.UnderlayNetID = bad.netID
		if s, ok := TryFastStatusSession("boot-1", 1010376, &bs, []LiveIface{tun, wlan, cell}); ok || s != nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected fast status rejection for %+v, got %+v", bad, s)
		}
	}
}

func TestParseWorkNetworks(t *testing.T) {
	const dump = `Current Networks:
  NetworkAgentInfo{network{100}  handle{4294967296}  ni{MOBILE[NR] CONNECTED extra: cmnet}  lp{{InterfaceName: ccmni2 LinkAddresses: [ 10.0.0.1/24 ] }}  nc{[ Transports: CELLULAR ]}}
  NetworkAgentInfo{network{101}  handle{4294967297}  ni{WIFI CONNECTED extra: ssid}  lp{{InterfaceName: wlan0 LinkAddresses: [ 192.168.1.2/24 ] }}  nc{[ Transports: WIFI ]}}
  NetworkAgentInfo{network{106}  handle{4294967298}  ni{VPN CONNECTED extra: }  lp{{InterfaceName: tun0 LinkAddresses: [ 172.19.0.1/30 ] DnsAddresses: [ /172.19.0.2 ] }}  nc{[ Transports: CELLULAR|VPN Uids: <{1000000-1099999}> OwnerUid: 1010376 AdminUids: [1010376] UnderlyingNetworks: [100]]}  factorySerialNumber=-1}
`

	s, err := ParseWorkNetworks(dump, 1010376)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s.VPNNetID != 106 || s.UplinkNetID != 100 || s.UplinkIf != "ccmni2" || s.TunIf != "tun0" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected parsed session: %+v", s)
	}
}

func TestVerifyStaticIdentityAndDPC(t *testing.T) {
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	adminComp := contracts.DefaultAdminComponent
	r := fakeRunner{outputs: map[string]string{
		"cmd user list -v": `3 users:
0: id=0, name=Owner, type=full.SYSTEM, flags=PRIMARY|ADMIN|FULL|INITIALIZED (running) (current)
1: id=10, name=Work Sandbox, type=profile.MANAGED, flags=INITIALIZED|MANAGED_PROFILE|PROFILE (parentId=0) (running) (profile-owner)
2: id=999, name=XSpace, type=profile.CLONE, flags=INITIALIZED|PROFILE (parentId=0) (running)
`,
		"dumpsys user --user 10":                                       "  UserInfo{10:Work Sandbox:1030} serialNo=1000 isPrimary=false parentId=0\n    Type: android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED\n    Flags: 4144 (INITIALIZED|MANAGED_PROFILE|PROFILE)\n    State: RUNNING_UNLOCKED\n",
		"cmd device_policy list-owners":                                "User 10: admin=" + adminComp + ",ProfileOwner\nUser 10: admin=" + adminComp + ",ManagedProfileOwner(parentUserId=0)\n",
		"settings --user 10 get secure always_on_vpn_app":              pkg + "\n",
		"settings --user 10 get secure always_on_vpn_lockdown":         "1\n",
		"settings --user 10 get secure always_on_vpn_lockdown_whitelist": "null\n",
		"dumpsys vpn_management":                                       "  0: null\n  10: " + pkg + "\n",
		"cmd package list packages --user 10 -U " + pkg:                "package:" + pkg + " uid:1010376\n",
	}}
	pol := contracts.Policy{
		UserID:           10,
		Serial:           1000,
		CallerPackage:    pkg,
		CallerCertSHA256: strings.Repeat("a", 64),
	}
	id, err := VerifyStaticIdentity(context.Background(), r, pol)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("VerifyStaticIdentity failed: %v", err)
	}
	if id.UserID != 10 || id.Serial != 1000 || id.ClientUID != 1010376 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected VerifiedIdentity: %+v", id)
	}
	// Reject user 0 and OEM excluded clone users
	for _, badUser := range append([]int{0}, oem.Current().ExcludedCloneUsers...) {
		badPol := pol
		badPol.UserID = badUser
		if _, err := VerifyStaticIdentity(context.Background(), r, badPol); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted forbidden user %d", badUser)
		}
	}
}

type fakeCgroupFS struct {
	files map[string][]byte
}

func (f *fakeCgroupFS) ReadFile(p string) ([]byte, error) {
	if b, ok := f.files[p]; ok {
		return b, nil
	}
	return nil, errors.New("not found")
}

func (f *fakeCgroupFS) WriteFile(p string, b []byte) error {
	f.files[p] = append([]byte(nil), b...)
	return nil
}

func TestMilletCgroupV2FreezeAndUnfreeze(t *testing.T) {
	fs := &fakeCgroupFS{files: map[string][]byte{
		"/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_1010376/pid_6206/cgroup.freeze": []byte("1\n"),
		"/sys/fs/cgroup/frozen/cgroup.procs":                []byte("123\n6206\n"),
		"/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer/cgroup.procs":               []byte("must_never_read"),
	}}
	st := InspectCgroupV2Freeze(fs, 1010376, 6206)
	if !st.Frozen || st.FreezePath != "/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_1010376/pid_6206/cgroup.freeze" {
		t.Fatalf("failed to detect cgroup v2 freeze: %+v", st)
	}
	st.InFrozenGroup = true
	if err := UnfreezeCgroupV2(fs, 1010376, 6206, st); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(fs.files["/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_1010376/pid_6206/cgroup.freeze"]) != "0" {
		t.Fatal("failed to write 0 to cgroup.freeze")
	}
	if string(fs.files["/sys/fs/cgroup/unfrozen/cgroup.procs"]) != "6206" {
		t.Fatal("failed to move pid to unfrozen/cgroup.procs")
	}
}

func TestIdentityEdgeCasesAndUplinkRegex(t *testing.T) {
	// serialNo at end of line and parentId=0 still match WorkUserMatches
	dumpEOL := "  UserInfo{10:Work Sandbox:1030} parentId=0 serialNo=1000\n"
	if !WorkUserMatches(dumpEOL, 10, 1000) {
		t.Fatal("expected WorkUserMatches to accept serialNo at end of line")
	}
	// Trailing metadata column in device_policy list-owners
	ownersExtra := "User 10: admin=" + contracts.DefaultAdminComponent + ",ProfileOwner extra=1\n"
	if !WorkDPCMatches(ownersExtra, 10, contracts.DefaultAdminComponent) {
		t.Fatal("expected WorkDPCMatches to tolerate trailing columns")
	}
	// Android 14+ (lockdown) suffix in dumpsys vpn_management
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	r := fakeRunner{outputs: map[string]string{
		"cmd user list -v":                                               "0: id=0, name=Owner, type=full.SYSTEM (running)\n1: id=10, name=Work, type=profile.MANAGED, (parentId=0) (running)\n",
		"dumpsys user --user 10":                                         "  UserInfo{10:Work:1030} serialNo=1000 isPrimary=false parentId=0\n    Type: android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED\n    Flags: 4144\n    State: RUNNING_UNLOCKED\n",
		"cmd device_policy list-owners":                                  "User 10: admin=" + contracts.DefaultAdminComponent + ",ProfileOwner\n",
		"settings --user 10 get secure always_on_vpn_app":                pkg + "\n",
		"settings --user 10 get secure always_on_vpn_lockdown":           "1\n",
		"settings --user 10 get secure always_on_vpn_lockdown_whitelist": "null\n",
		"dumpsys vpn_management":                                         "  10: " + pkg + " (lockdown)\n",
		"cmd package list packages --user 10 -U " + pkg:                  "package:" + pkg + " uid:1010376\n",
	}}
	if _, err := VerifyStaticIdentity(context.Background(), r, contracts.Policy{
		UserID: 10, Serial: 1000, CallerPackage: pkg, CallerCertSHA256: strings.Repeat("a", 64),
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("VerifyStaticIdentity failed on (lockdown) vpn_management line: %v", err)
	}
	for _, ifName := range []string{"v4-ccmni0", "v4-seth_lte0", "v4-wlan0", "rmnet_mhi0", "rmnet_usb0", "wwan0", "ncm0", "usb0"} {
		if !contracts.UplinkIfRegex.MatchString(ifName) {
			t.Fatalf("expected UplinkIfRegex to match %q", ifName)
		}
	}
}

`guard/internal/android/bloat.go`:

```go
package android

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/sysio"
)

// baseProtectedSandboxPackages must NEVER be disabled inside sandbox profiles so keyboard input,
// Play/GMS, Gemini, file picking/uploads, web OAuth login, and DPM profile control keep working cleanly.
var baseProtectedSandboxPackages = map[string]bool{
	contracts.DefaultWorkPackage:                true,
	contracts.VerifyProbePackage:                true,
	contracts.ManagedProvisioningPkg:            true,
	"com.android.vending":                       true,
	"com.google.android.gms":                    true,
	"com.google.android.gsf":                    true,
	"com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox":   true,
	"com.google.android.apps.bard":              true,
	"com.google.android.apps.subscriptions.red": true,
	"com.android.chrome":                        true,
	"com.google.android.webview":                true,
	"com.android.webview":                       true,
	"com.android.permissioncontroller":          true,
	"com.google.android.permissioncontroller":   true,
	"com.android.packageinstaller":              true,
	"com.google.android.packageinstaller":       true,
	"com.google.android.ext.services":           true,
	"com.android.ext.services":                  true,
	"com.android.remoteprovisioner":             true,
	"com.lbe.security.miui":                     true,
	"com.miui.securitycore":                     true,
	"com.android.providers.media.module":        true,
	"com.android.providers.media":               true,
	"com.android.documentsui":                   true,
	"com.google.android.documentsui":            true,
	"com.android.providers.downloads":           true,
	"com.android.externalstorage":               true,
	"com.android.keychain":                      true,
	"com.android.certinstaller":                 true,
	"com.android.settings":                      true,
	"com.android.systemui":                      true,
	"com.android.phone":                         true,
	"com.android.bluetooth":                     true,
	"com.google.android.inputmethod.latin":      true,
}

func protectedPackageSet(extraProtected ...string) map[string]bool {
	out := make(map[string]bool, len(baseProtectedSandboxPackages)+len(oem.Current().ExtraProtectedPackages)+len(extraProtected))
	for k, v := range baseProtectedSandboxPackages {
		out[k] = v
	}
	for _, pkg := range oem.Current().ExtraProtectedPackages {
		if contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			out[pkg] = true
		}
	}
	for _, pkg := range extraProtected {
		if contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			out[pkg] = true
		}
	}
	return out
}

type PrunedState struct {
	UserID    int      `json:"user_id"`
	Packages  []string `json:"packages"`
	UpdatedAt string   `json:"updated_at"`
}

type BloatActionResult struct {
	UserID   int      `json:"user_id"`
	Packages []string `json:"packages"`
	Skipped  []string `json:"skipped,omitempty"`
	Mode     string   `json:"mode"`
}

func parseIMEPkgs(output string) map[string]bool {
	out := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, raw := range strings.Split(output, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
		if line == "" {
			continue
		}
		pkg, _, _ := strings.Cut(line, "/")
		pkg = strings.TrimSpace(pkg)
		if contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			out[pkg] = true
		}
	}
	return out
}

func readPrunedState(path string) PrunedState {
	if b, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(path, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes); err == nil {
		var st PrunedState
		if json.Unmarshal(b, &st) == nil {
			return st
		}
	}
	return PrunedState{}
}

func writePrunedState(path string, st PrunedState) error {
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(st, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return sysio.WriteAtomic(path, append(b, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0})
}

// PruneSandboxBloat disables compile-time OEM bloat packages strictly inside sandbox User userID
// using direct argv calls (zero sh -c), while protecting critical Google/system/IME/controller packages.
func PruneSandboxBloat(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, statePath string, extraProtected ...string) (BloatActionResult, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return BloatActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to prune bloat on forbidden user %d", userID)
	}
	if statePath == "" {
		statePath = contracts.PrunedPkgsPath
	}
	candidatesList := oem.Current().BloatCandidates
	if len(candidatesList) == 0 {
		return BloatActionResult{
			UserID:   userID,
			Packages: nil,
			Skipped:  nil,
			Mode:     "prune",
		}, nil
	}

	u := strconv.Itoa(userID)
	enabledOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "pm", "list", "packages", "-e", "--user", u)
	if err != nil {
		return BloatActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("pm list enabled packages: %w", err)
	}
	enabledSet := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, pkg := range parsePackageList(enabledOut) {
		enabledSet[pkg] = true
	}

	imeOut, _ := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ime", "list", "-s", "--user", u)
	imeProtected := parseIMEPkgs(imeOut)
	protected := protectedPackageSet(extraProtected...)

	var candidates []string
	var skipped []string
	for _, pkg := range candidatesList {
		if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			continue
		}
		if protected[pkg] || imeProtected[pkg] {
			skipped = append(skipped, pkg)
			continue
		}
		if !enabledSet[pkg] {
			continue
		}
		candidates = append(candidates, pkg)
	}

	var mu sync.Mutex
	var disabledNow []string
	runPackagePool(ctx, candidates, sandboxWorkerPoolSize, func(pkg string) {
		if _, err := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "pm", "disable-user", "--user", u, pkg); err == nil {
			mu.Lock()
			disabledNow = append(disabledNow, pkg)
			mu.Unlock()
		}
		_, _ = r.Run(ctx, 2*time.Second, "", "am", "force-stop", "--user", u, pkg)
	})
	sort.Strings(disabledNow)

	prev := readPrunedState(statePath)
	merged := mergeSortedUnique(prev.Packages, disabledNow)
	sort.Strings(merged)
	_ = writePrunedState(statePath, PrunedState{
		UserID:    userID,
		Packages:  merged,
		UpdatedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
	})

	return BloatActionResult{
		UserID:   userID,
		Packages: disabledNow,
		Skipped:  skipped,
		Mode:     "prune",
	}, nil
}

// RestoreSandboxBloat re-enables every package previously disabled inside User userID in statePath.
func RestoreSandboxBloat(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, statePath string) (BloatActionResult, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return BloatActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to restore bloat on forbidden user %d", userID)
	}
	if statePath == "" {
		statePath = contracts.PrunedPkgsPath
	}
	st := readPrunedState(statePath)
	targets := st.Packages
	if len(targets) == 0 {
		targets = oem.Current().BloatCandidates
	}

	u := strconv.Itoa(userID)
	wasRecorded := len(st.Packages) > 0
	var reEnabled, failedPkgs []string
	for _, pkg := range targets {
		if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			continue
		}
		if _, err := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "pm", "enable", "--user", u, pkg); err == nil {
			reEnabled = append(reEnabled, pkg)
		} else if wasRecorded {
			failedPkgs = append(failedPkgs, pkg)
		}
	}
	var persistPkgs []string
	if len(failedPkgs) > 0 {
		persistPkgs = failedPkgs
	}
	_ = writePrunedState(statePath, PrunedState{
		UserID:    userID,
		Packages:  persistPkgs,
		UpdatedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
	})
	res := BloatActionResult{
		UserID:   userID,
		Packages: reEnabled,
		Mode:     "restore",
	}
	if wasRecorded && len(failedPkgs) > 0 && len(reEnabled) == 0 {
		return res, fmt.Errorf("failed to re-enable pruned packages: %s", strings.Join(failedPkgs, ","))
	}
	return res, nil
}

`guard/internal/android/bloat_test.go`:

```go
package android

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

func TestPruneAndRestoreSandboxBloatSafetyAndIMEGuard(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	statePath := filepath.Join(dir, "pruned_pkgs.json")

	if _, err := PruneSandboxBloat(context.Background(), &sandboxRecRunner{}, 0, statePath); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("must reject User 0")
	}
	for _, ex := range oem.Current().ExcludedCloneUsers {
		if _, err := PruneSandboxBloat(context.Background(), &sandboxRecRunner{}, ex, statePath); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("must reject excluded clone user %d", ex)
		}
	}

	candidates := oem.Current().BloatCandidates
	if len(candidates) == 0 {
		r := &sandboxRecRunner{}
		res, err := PruneSandboxBloat(context.Background(), r, 10, statePath, "com.custom.controller")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(res.Packages) != 0 || len(r.calls) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("expected no bloat pruning calls on OEM %s, got res=%+v calls=%v", oem.Current().Name, res, r.calls)
		}
		return
	}

	var sample []string
	for _, c := range candidates {
		sample = append(sample, c)
		if len(sample) == 3 {
			break
		}
	}
	var pkgLines []string
	for _, p := range sample {
		pkgLines = append(pkgLines, "package:"+p)
	}
	pkgLines = append(pkgLines,
		"package:com.google.android.apps.bard",
		"package:com.android.vending",
		"package:com.android.chrome",
		"package:com.custom.ime",
		"package:"+contracts.DefaultWorkPackage,
		"package:com.custom.controller",
	)

	r := &sandboxRecRunner{
		out: map[string]string{
			"pm list packages -e --user 10": strings.Join(pkgLines, "\n") + "\n",
			"ime list -s --user 10":         "com.custom.ime/com.custom.IME\n",
		},
	}

	res, err := PruneSandboxBloat(context.Background(), r, 10, statePath, "com.custom.controller")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(res.Packages) != len(sample) {
		t.Fatalf("expected %d enabled bloat packages pruned on OEM %s, got %v", len(sample), oem.Current().Name, res.Packages)
	}
	joined := strings.Join(r.calls, "\n")
	if strings.Contains(joined, "sh -c") {
		t.Fatalf("must not invoke sh -c:\n%s", joined)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{
		"pm disable-user --user 10 com.google.android.apps.bard",
		"pm disable-user --user 10 com.android.vending",
		"pm disable-user --user 10 com.android.chrome",
		"pm disable-user --user 10 " + contracts.DefaultWorkPackage,
		"pm disable-user --user 10 com.custom.controller",
		"pm disable-user --user 10 com.custom.ime",
	} {
		if strings.Contains(joined, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("protected package %s leaked into calls:\n%s", forbidden, joined)
		}
	}
	for _, wantPkg := range sample {
		if !strings.Contains(joined, "pm disable-user --user 10 "+wantPkg) {
			t.Fatalf("missing expected bloat disable call for %s:\n%s", wantPkg, joined)
		}
	}

	raw, err := os.ReadFile(statePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var saved PrunedState
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &saved); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if saved.UserID != 10 || len(saved.Packages) != len(sample) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected persisted pruned state: %+v", saved)
	}

	r.calls = nil
	restored, err := RestoreSandboxBloat(context.Background(), r, 10, statePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	restJoined := strings.Join(r.calls, "\n")
	if len(restored.Packages) != len(sample) || !strings.Contains(restJoined, "pm enable --user 10 "+sample[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected restore calls: %+v\n%s", restored, restJoined)
	}
	rawAfter, _ := os.ReadFile(statePath)
	var after PrunedState
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rawAfter, &after)
	if len(after.Packages) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected pruned list cleared after restore, got %+v", after.Packages)
	}
}

// HideSyncResult summarizes launcher hide-app synchronization (populated on OEMs with
// launcher hide support such as HyperOS/MIUI; Skipped=true elsewhere).
type HideSyncResult struct {
	UserID       int    `json:"user_id"`
	Serial       int    `json:"serial"`
	WorkCount    int    `json:"work_activities"`
	TotalHidden  int    `json:"total_hidden"`
	Inserted     int    `json:"inserted"`
	UpdatedStore bool   `json:"updated_store"`
	Skipped      bool   `json:"skipped,omitempty"`
	Warning      string `json:"warning,omitempty"`
}
