`guard/internal/android/hideapps_hyperos.go`:

```go
//go:build oem_hyperos

package android

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

// HideAppBean matches MIUI/HyperOS Home com.miui.home.launcher.hideapp.HideAppBean JSON.
type HideAppBean struct {
	ActivityName string `json:"activityName"`
	MHashCode    int32  `json:"mHashCode"`
	PackageName  string `json:"packageName"`
	SerialNumber string `json:"serialNumber"`
}

type LauncherActivity struct {
	PackageName  string
	ActivityName string
}

var resolveComponentRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`\b([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(?:\.[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)+)/([a-zA-Z0-9_.$]+)\b`)

// JavaStringHash replicates java.lang.String.hashCode() over UTF-16 code units.
func JavaStringHash(s string) int32 {
	var h int32
	for _, u := range utf16.Encode([]rune(s)) {
		h = 31*h + int32(u)
	}
	return h
}

// JavaObjectsHash replicates java.util.Objects.hash(Object...).
func JavaObjectsHash(parts ...string) int32 {
	h := int32(1)
	for _, p := range parts {
		h = 31*h + JavaStringHash(p)
	}
	return h
}

// BuildHideAppBean constructs one MIUI/HyperOS HideAppBean JSON object.
func BuildHideAppBean(pkg, activity, serial string) HideAppBean {
	return HideAppBean{
		ActivityName: activity,
		MHashCode:    JavaObjectsHash(pkg, activity, serial),
		PackageName:  pkg,
		SerialNumber: serial,
	}
}

// ParseQueryActivities parses `cmd package query-activities --user <u> -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER`.
func ParseQueryActivities(output string) []LauncherActivity {
	seen := make(map[string]LauncherActivity)
	var inActivityInfo, inAppInfo bool
	var curPkg, curName string

	flush := func() {
		if curPkg != "" && curName != "" {
			if strings.HasPrefix(curName, ".") {
				curName = curPkg + curName
			}
			if contracts.ValidPackageName(curPkg) {
				key := curPkg + "/" + curName
				seen[key] = LauncherActivity{PackageName: curPkg, ActivityName: curName}
			}
		}
		curPkg, curName = "", ""
	}

	for _, raw := range strings.Split(output, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Activity #") || line == "" {
			flush()
			inActivityInfo = false
			inAppInfo = false
			continue
		}
		if line == "ActivityInfo:" {
			inActivityInfo = true
			inAppInfo = false
			continue
		}
		if line == "ApplicationInfo:" {
			inActivityInfo = false
			inAppInfo = true
			continue
		}
		if inAppInfo {
			continue
		}
		if inActivityInfo {
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "name=") {
				curName = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "name="))
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(line, "packageName=") {
				curPkg = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "packageName="))
			}
			continue
		}
		if m := resolveComponentRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(m) == 3 {
			pkg, act := m[1], m[2]
			if strings.HasPrefix(act, ".") {
				act = pkg + act
			}
			if contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
				seen[pkg+"/"+act] = LauncherActivity{PackageName: pkg, ActivityName: act}
			}
		}
	}
	flush()

	out := make([]LauncherActivity, 0, len(seen))
	for _, item := range seen {
		out = append(out, item)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
		if out[i].PackageName != out[j].PackageName {
			return out[i].PackageName < out[j].PackageName
		}
		return out[i].ActivityName < out[j].ActivityName
	})
	return out
}

// MergeHideAppList preserves all non-work-serial entries (e.g. User 0 serialNumber="0")
// and merges the exact set of work launcher activities for workSerial.
func MergeHideAppList(existing []HideAppBean, workActivities []LauncherActivity, workSerial string) (merged []HideAppBean, missing []LauncherActivity, staleCount int) {
	existingWork := make(map[string]HideAppBean)
	for _, entry := range existing {
		if entry.SerialNumber == workSerial {
			existingWork[entry.PackageName+"/"+entry.ActivityName] = entry
		} else {
			merged = append(merged, entry)
		}
	}

	desiredKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(workActivities))
	for _, act := range workActivities {
		key := act.PackageName + "/" + act.ActivityName
		desiredKeys[key] = struct{}{}
		if prev, ok := existingWork[key]; ok {
			merged = append(merged, prev)
		} else {
			missing = append(missing, act)
			merged = append(merged, BuildHideAppBean(act.PackageName, act.ActivityName, workSerial))
		}
	}
	for key := range existingWork {
		if _, ok := desiredKeys[key]; !ok {
			staleCount++
		}
	}
	return merged, missing, staleCount
}

func ParseHideAppListJSON(raw string) ([]HideAppBean, error) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	var beans []HideAppBean
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &beans); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return beans, nil
}

// SyncHideApps queries User <u> launcher activities and updates HyperOS/MIUI Home HideAppProvider +
// Settings.Secure.miui_home_hide_app_list while preserving User 0 entries.
func SyncHideApps(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID, serial int) (HideSyncResult, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) || serial <= 0 {
		return HideSyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d / serial %d", userID, serial)
	}
	prof := oem.Current()
	secureKey := prof.HideSecureListKey
	if secureKey == "" {
		secureKey = "miui_home_hide_app_list"
	}
	providerURI := prof.HideProviderURI
	if providerURI == "" {
		providerURI = "content://com.miui.home.app.hide"
	}

	u := strconv.Itoa(userID)
	serialStr := strconv.Itoa(serial)

	actOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 8*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "query-activities",
		"--user", u, "-a", "android.intent.action.MAIN", "-c", "android.intent.category.LAUNCHER")
	if err != nil {
		return HideSyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("query-activities: %w", err)
	}
	workActs := ParseQueryActivities(actOut)

	existingRaw, getErr := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "settings", "--user", "0", "get", "secure", secureKey)
	if getErr != nil {
		return HideSyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("read secure %s: %w", secureKey, getErr)
	}
	existing, parseErr := ParseHideAppListJSON(existingRaw)
	if parseErr != nil {
		return HideSyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("parse secure %s (refusing to overwrite): %w", secureKey, parseErr)
	}

	merged, missing, stale := MergeHideAppList(existing, workActs, serialStr)
	res := HideSyncResult{
		UserID:      userID,
		Serial:      serial,
		WorkCount:   len(workActs),
		TotalHidden: len(merged),
	}
	if len(missing) == 0 && stale == 0 {
		return res, nil
	}

	// Prefer HideAppProvider live insert so com.miui.home receives ACTION_PACKAGE_CHANGED without kill.
	var warnMsgs []string
	for _, act := range missing {
		_, cerr := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "content", "insert", "--user", "0",
			"--uri", providerURI,
			"--bind", "packageName:s:"+act.PackageName,
			"--bind", "activityName:s:"+act.ActivityName,
			"--bind", "serialNumber:s:"+serialStr)
		if cerr != nil {
			warnMsgs = append(warnMsgs, cerr.Error())
		} else {
			res.Inserted++
		}
	}

	// Re-read Settings.Secure and ensure exact merged JSON if stale entries exist or insert missed anything.
	afterRaw, _ := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "settings", "--user", "0", "get", "secure", secureKey)
	afterBeans, afterErr := ParseHideAppListJSON(afterRaw)
	needPut := stale > 0 || afterErr != nil
	if !needPut {
		_, stillMissing, stillStale := MergeHideAppList(afterBeans, workActs, serialStr)
		if len(stillMissing) > 0 || stillStale > 0 {
			needPut = true
		}
	}
	if needPut {
		payload, err := json.Marshal(merged)
		if err != nil {
			return res, err
		}
		if _, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "settings", "--user", "0", "put", "secure", secureKey, string(payload)); err != nil {
			return res, fmt.Errorf("settings put %s: %w", secureKey, err)
		}
		res.UpdatedStore = true
	}
	if len(warnMsgs) > 0 {
		res.Warning = strings.Join(warnMsgs[:min(len(warnMsgs), 3)], "; ")
	}
	return res, nil
}
```

```go
package android

func TestHideAppBeanJSONAndQueryParser(t *testing.T) {
	const queryOut = `Activity #0:
  priority=0x0 preferredOrder=0x0 match=0x108000 specificIndex=-1 isDefault=false
  ActivityInfo:
    name=com.google.android.apps.chrome.Main
    packageName=com.android.chrome
    enabled=true exported=true
    ApplicationInfo:
      name=com.google.android.apps.chrome.ChromeApplication
      packageName=com.android.chrome
Activity #1:
  ActivityInfo:
    name=.AssetBrowserActivity
    packageName=com.android.vending
    ApplicationInfo:
      name=com.google.android.finsky.application.FinskyApplicationImpl
      packageName=com.android.vending
`

	acts := ParseQueryActivities(queryOut)
	if len(acts) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 launcher activities, got %+v", acts)
	}
	if acts[0].PackageName != "com.android.chrome" || acts[1].ActivityName != "com.android.vending.AssetBrowserActivity" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected parsed activities: %+v", acts)
	}

	existing := []HideAppBean{
		BuildHideAppBean("com.user0.secret", "com.user0.secret.Main", "0"),

	}
	merged, missing, stale := MergeHideAppList(existing, acts, "1000")

	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(merged)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := string(raw)
	if !strings.Contains(s, `"serialNumber":"0"`) || !strings.Contains(s, `"serialNumber":"1000"`) || strings.Contains(s, "com.old.removed") {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected HideAppBean JSON: %s", s)
	}
```

```go
func SyncHideApps(_ context.Context, _ Runner, userID, serial int) (HideSyncResult, error) {
```

`guard/internal/android/identity.go`:

```go
package android

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/netfilter"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

type Runner interface {
	Run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin string, name string, args ...string) (string, error)
}

// ReaderRunner is an optional Runner extension supporting streaming stdin from an io.Reader
// (used e.g. to feed APK file descriptors directly to `pm install-write -S <sz> <sid> <split> -`).
type ReaderRunner interface {
	RunWithStdinReader(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin io.Reader, name string, args ...string) (string, error)
}

var (
	ErrWorkVPNMissing = errors.New("no active Android VPN record for the sandbox controller package")

	networkRecord         = regexp.MustCompile(`^NetworkAgentInfo\{network\{([0-9]+)\}`)
	networkInterface      = regexp.MustCompile(`\bInterfaceName:\s*([a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)(?:\s|,|\})`)
	networkOwner          = regexp.MustCompile(`\bOwnerUid:\s*([0-9]+)\b`)
	networkUnderlying     = regexp.MustCompile(`\bunderlying\{\[([0-9]+)\]\}`)
	networkUnderlyingCaps = regexp.MustCompile(`\bUnderlyingNetworks:\s*\[([0-9]+)\]`)
	userListIDRegex       = regexp.MustCompile(`(?:^|\s)id=([0-9]+),`)
	userInfoIDRegex       = regexp.MustCompile(`UserInfo\{([0-9]+):[^}]*\}`)
	userSerialRegex       = regexp.MustCompile(`\bserialNo=([0-9]+)\b`)
	userTypeRegex         = regexp.MustCompile(`\btype=([^,\s]+)`)
	userParentRegex       = regexp.MustCompile(`\bparentId=([0-9]+)\b`)
)

const (
	userFlagDisabled  = 0x40
	userFlagQuietMode = 0x80
)

type DiscoveredProfile struct {
	UserID int
	Serial int
}

// DiscoverManagedProfile scans `cmd user list -v` and `dumpsys user` to find the single
// active Android MANAGED profile with parentId=0, strictly rejecting user 999 / CLONE.
func DiscoverManagedProfile(ctx context.Context, r Runner) (DiscoveredProfile, error) {
	listOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "cmd", "user", "list", "-v")
	if err != nil {
		return DiscoveredProfile{}, fmt.Errorf("cmd user list -v: %w", err)
	}
	var candidateIDs []int
	for _, row := range strings.Split(listOut, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(row)
		var idStr string
		if m := userListIDRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(m) == 2 {
			idStr = m[1]
		} else if m := userInfoIDRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(m) == 2 {
			idStr = m[1]
		} else {
			continue
		}
		uid, err := strconv.Atoi(idStr)
		if err != nil || oem.IsForbiddenUser(uid) {
			continue
		}
		typMatch := userTypeRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line)
		if len(typMatch) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		typ := typMatch[1]
		if typ != "profile.MANAGED" && typ != "android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED" {
			continue
		}
		parentMatch := userParentRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line)
		if len(parentMatch) == 2 && parentMatch[1] != "0" {
			continue
		}
		candidateIDs = append(candidateIDs, uid)
	}
	if len(candidateIDs) == 0 {
		return DiscoveredProfile{}, errors.New("no Android managed profile (parentId=0) found")
	}
	if len(candidateIDs) > 1 {
		return DiscoveredProfile{}, fmt.Errorf("ambiguous managed profiles found: %v", candidateIDs)
	}
	uid := candidateIDs[0]
	// Obtain serialNo from `dumpsys user --user <u>` and verify parentId=0 on its UserInfo line.
	dump, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "dumpsys", "user", "--user", strconv.Itoa(uid))
	if err != nil {
		return DiscoveredProfile{}, fmt.Errorf("dumpsys user --user %d: %w", uid, err)
	}
	serial, err := parseUserSerialFromDump(dump, uid)
	if err != nil || !WorkUserMatches(dump, uid, serial) {
		return DiscoveredProfile{}, fmt.Errorf("dumpsys user failed parentId=0/serialNo check for user %d: %v", uid, err)
	}
	return DiscoveredProfile{UserID: uid, Serial: serial}, nil
}

func parseUserSerialFromDump(dump string, user int) (int, error) {
	prefix := fmt.Sprintf("UserInfo{%d:", user)
	for _, row := range strings.Split(dump, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(row)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, prefix) {
			continue
		}
		m := userSerialRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line)
		if len(m) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		serial, err := strconv.Atoi(m[1])
		if err != nil || serial <= 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid serialNo in %q", line)
		}
		return serial, nil
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("UserInfo{%d:...} serialNo not found in dumpsys user", user)
}

// DiscoverUser0Package resolves User 0 UID and base.apk path for the configured controller package.
func DiscoverUser0Package(ctx context.Context, r Runner, pkg string) (uid int, apkPath string, err error) {
	listOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "list", "packages", "--user", "0", "-U", pkg)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, "", err
	}
	uid, err = ParsePackageUIDLine(listOut, pkg)
	if err != nil || !contracts.ValidUser0AppUID(uid) {
		return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid User 0 UID %d for %s: %v", uid, pkg, err)
	}
	pathOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "path", "--user", "0", pkg)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, "", err
	}
	apkPath, err = ParsePackageAPKPath(pathOut)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, "", err
	}
	return uid, apkPath, nil
}

func ParsePackageUIDLine(output, pkg string) (int, error) {
	prefix := "package:" + pkg + " uid:"
	for _, row := range strings.Split(output, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(row)
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, prefix) {
			rest := strings.TrimPrefix(line, prefix)
			fields := strings.Fields(rest)
			if len(fields) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			// Handle comma-separated multiple UIDs if present by picking exact integer.
			uidStr := strings.Split(fields[0], ",")[0]
			return strconv.Atoi(uidStr)
		}
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("package %s UID not found", pkg)
}

func ParsePackageAPKPath(output string) (string, error) {
	var fallback string
	for _, row := range strings.Split(output, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(row)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "package:") {
			continue
		}
		p := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "package:")
		if strings.Contains(p, "..") || !strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(p, "/base.apk") {
			return p, nil
		}
		if fallback == "" && strings.HasSuffix(p, ".apk") {
			fallback = p
		}
	}
	if fallback != "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}
	return "", errors.New("no APK path found")
}

func WorkUserMatches(dump string, user, serial int) bool {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(user) || serial <= 0 {
		return false
	}
	prefix := fmt.Sprintf("UserInfo{%d:", user)
	for _, line := range strings.Split(dump, "\n") {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
		padded := trimmed + " "
		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, prefix) &&
			strings.Contains(padded, fmt.Sprintf(" serialNo=%d ", serial)) &&
			strings.Contains(padded, " parentId=0 ") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func WorkUserAllowsRun(dump string, user, serial int) bool {
	if !WorkUserMatches(dump, user, serial) {
		return false
	}
	prefix := "UserInfo{" + strconv.Itoa(user) + ":"
	selected := false
	managed, enabled, unlocked := false, false, false
	for _, row := range strings.Split(dump, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(row)
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "UserInfo{") {
			if selected {
				break
			}
			if !strings.HasPrefix(line, prefix) {
				continue
			}
			selected = true
			if strings.Contains(line, "<removing>") || strings.Contains(line, "<partial>") || strings.Contains(line, "<pre-created>") {
				return false
			}
		}
		if !selected {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case line == "Type: android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED":
			managed = true
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "Flags: "):
			fields := strings.Fields(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "Flags: "))
			if len(fields) > 0 {
				flags, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[0], 0, 32)
				enabled = err == nil && flags&(userFlagDisabled|userFlagQuietMode) == 0
			}
		case line == "State: RUNNING_UNLOCKED":
			unlocked = true
		}
	}
	return managed && enabled && unlocked
}

func WorkDPCMatches(owners string, user int, adminComp ...string) bool {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(user) {
		return false
	}
	wantAdmin := contracts.DefaultAdminComponent
	if len(adminComp) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(adminComp[0]) != "" {
		wantAdmin = strings.TrimSpace(adminComp[0])
	}
	matched := false
	prefix := strconv.Itoa(user) + ":"
	for _, row := range strings.Split(owners, "\n") {
		fields := strings.Fields(row)
		if len(fields) < 3 || fields[0] != "User" || fields[1] != prefix {
			continue
		}
		flags := strings.Split(fields[2], ",")
		if flags[0] != "admin="+wantAdmin {
			return false
		}
		for _, flag := range flags[1:] {
			switch {
			case flag == "ProfileOwner", flag == "ManagedProfileOwner(parentUserId=0)":
				matched = true
			case flag == "DeviceOwner", strings.HasPrefix(flag, "ManagedProfileOwner("):
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return matched
}

func WorkPackageCanRun(dump string, user int) bool {
	prefix := "User " + strconv.Itoa(user) + ": "
	for _, row := range strings.Split(dump, "\n") {
		fields, ok := strings.CutPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(row), prefix)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		state := make(map[string]string)
		for _, field := range strings.Fields(fields) {
			if key, value, ok := strings.Cut(field, "="); ok {
				state[key] = value
			}
		}
		return state["installed"] == "true" && state["hidden"] == "false" &&
			state["suspended"] == "false" && state["stopped"] == "false" &&
			(state["enabled"] == "0" || state["enabled"] == "1")
	}
	return false
}

func VerifyWorkLockdown(ctx context.Context, r Runner, user int, callerPkg ...string) error {
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	if len(callerPkg) > 0 && contracts.ValidPackageName(callerPkg[0]) {
		pkg = callerPkg[0]
	}
	u := strconv.Itoa(user)
	for key, expected := range map[string]string{
		"always_on_vpn_app":      pkg,
		"always_on_vpn_lockdown": "1",
	} {
		val, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "settings", "--user", u, "get", "secure", key)
		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(val) != expected {
			return fmt.Errorf("always-on lockdown check failed on %s=%q", key, strings.TrimSpace(val))
		}
	}
	wl, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "settings", "--user", u, "get", "secure", "always_on_vpn_lockdown_whitelist")
	if v := strings.TrimSpace(wl); err != nil || (v != "" && v != "null") {
		return fmt.Errorf("always-on lockdown has bypass whitelist %q", v)
	}
	return nil
}

func WorkClientUID(ctx context.Context, r Runner, user int, callerPkg ...string) (int, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(user) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid user %d", user)
	}
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	if len(callerPkg) > 0 && contracts.ValidPackageName(callerPkg[0]) {
		pkg = callerPkg[0]
	}
	u := strconv.Itoa(user)
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "list", "packages", "--user", u, "-U", pkg)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	uid, err := ParsePackageUIDLine(out, pkg)
	if err != nil || !contracts.ValidClientUID(user, uid) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid work client UID %d for user %d", uid, user)
	}
	return uid, nil
}

// VerifiedIdentity caches boot-static profile/DPC/AlwaysOnVpn verification.
type VerifiedIdentity struct {
	UserID    int
	Serial    int
	ClientUID int
}

// VerifyStaticIdentity verifies managed profile, parentId=0, serial, RUNNING_UNLOCKED,
// DPM ProfileOwner, AlwaysOnVpn lockdown, vpn_management ownership, and work client UID.
func VerifyStaticIdentity(ctx context.Context, r Runner, policy contracts.Policy) (VerifiedIdentity, error) {
	if err := policy.NormalizeAndValidate(); err != nil {
		return VerifiedIdentity{}, err
	}
	callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
	adminComp := policy.EffectiveAdminComponent()
	u := strconv.Itoa(policy.UserID)

	usersOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "cmd", "user", "list", "-v")
	if err != nil {
		return VerifiedIdentity{}, err
	}
	managed := false
	for _, entry := range strings.Split(usersOut, "\n") {
		m := userListIDRegex.FindStringSubmatch(strings.TrimSpace(entry))
		idMatch := len(m) == 2 && m[1] == u
		if idMatch &&
			(strings.Contains(entry, "type=profile.MANAGED,") || strings.Contains(entry, "type=android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED,")) &&
			strings.Contains(entry, "(running)") {
			managed = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !managed {
		return VerifiedIdentity{}, fmt.Errorf("user %d is not a running managed profile", policy.UserID)
	}

	userDump, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "dumpsys", "user", "--user", u)
	if err != nil || !WorkUserAllowsRun(userDump, policy.UserID, policy.Serial) {
		return VerifiedIdentity{}, fmt.Errorf("user %d failed serial/parentId=0/RUNNING_UNLOCKED check", policy.UserID)
	}

	ownersOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "cmd", "device_policy", "list-owners")
	if err != nil || !WorkDPCMatches(ownersOut, policy.UserID, adminComp) {
		return VerifiedIdentity{}, errors.New("device_policy owner check failed")
	}

	if !policy.IsTProxy() {
		if err := VerifyWorkLockdown(ctx, r, policy.UserID, callerPkg); err != nil {
			return VerifiedIdentity{}, err
		}

		vpnOwners, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "dumpsys", "vpn_management")
		if err != nil {
			return VerifiedIdentity{}, err
		}
		vpnBound := false
		wantLine := u + ": " + callerPkg
		for _, line := range strings.Split(vpnOwners, "\n") {
			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
			if trimmed == wantLine || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, wantLine+" ") {
				vpnBound = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !vpnBound {
			return VerifiedIdentity{}, fmt.Errorf("vpn_management does not bind work profile VPN to %s", callerPkg)
		}
	}

	clientUID, err := WorkClientUID(ctx, r, policy.UserID, callerPkg)
	if err != nil && policy.IsTProxy() {
		if adminPkg := policy.EffectiveAdminPackage(); adminPkg != "" && adminPkg != callerPkg {
			if adminUID, aerr := WorkClientUID(ctx, r, policy.UserID, adminPkg); aerr == nil {
				clientUID = adminUID
				err = nil
			}
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return VerifiedIdentity{}, err
	}
	return VerifiedIdentity{UserID: policy.UserID, Serial: policy.Serial, ClientUID: clientUID}, nil
}

func regexMatch(pattern *regexp.Regexp, line string) string {
	groups := pattern.FindStringSubmatch(line)
	if len(groups) != 2 {
		return ""
	}
	return groups[1]
}

// ParseWorkNetworks extracts the unique Android VPN session and its dedicated physical underlay
// from `dumpsys connectivity` output.
func ParseWorkNetworks(dump string, uid int) (*netfilter.ActiveSession, error) {
	type observedNet struct {
		iface     string
		vpn       bool
		connected bool
	}
	nets := make(map[int]observedNet)
	var work *netfilter.ActiveSession
	started := false
	for _, row := range strings.Split(dump, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(row)
		if line == "Current Networks:" {
			started = true
			continue
		}
		if !started {
			continue
		}
		if len(row) > 0 && row[0] != ' ' && row[0] != '\t' {
			break
		}
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(regexMatch(networkRecord, line))
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		linkStart := strings.Index(line, " lp{")
		capsStart := strings.Index(line, " nc{")
		if linkStart < 0 || capsStart <= linkStart {
			continue
		}
		if _, dup := nets[id]; dup {
			return nil, errors.New("duplicate netId in connectivity output")
		}
		header, link, caps := line[:linkStart], line[linkStart:capsStart], line[capsStart:]
		iface := regexMatch(networkInterface, link)
		isVPN := strings.Contains(header, " ni{VPN ") || strings.Contains(header, " ni{VPN[")
		connected := strings.Contains(header, " CONNECTED")
		nets[id] = observedNet{iface: iface, vpn: isVPN, connected: connected}
		if !isVPN || !connected || regexMatch(networkOwner, caps) != strconv.Itoa(uid) {
			continue
		}
		if work != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("multiple active VPN records for work package")
		}
		under := regexMatch(networkUnderlying, header)
		if under == "" {
			under = regexMatch(networkUnderlyingCaps, caps)
		}
		underID, err := strconv.Atoi(under)
		if err != nil || !contracts.TunIfRegex.MatchString(iface) {
			return nil, errors.New("work VPN requires one explicit underlying network and TUN")
		}
		work = &netfilter.ActiveSession{
			ClientUID:   uid,
			VPNNetID:    id,
			TunIf:       iface,
			UplinkNetID: underID,
		}
	}
	if work == nil {
		for _, network := range nets {
			if network.connected && !network.vpn && contracts.UplinkIfRegex.MatchString(network.iface) {
				return nil, ErrWorkVPNMissing
			}
		}
		return nil, errors.New("no recognized Android physical network")
	}
	under, ok := nets[work.UplinkNetID]
	if !ok || !under.connected || under.vpn || !contracts.UplinkIfRegex.MatchString(under.iface) {
		return nil, errors.New("work VPN underlying network is not a recognized physical interface")
	}
	work.UplinkIf = under.iface
	return work, nil
}

// LiveIface represents a local OS interface snapshot for zero-dumpsys single-uplink fast path.
type LiveIface struct {
	Name       string
	Index      int
	Up         bool
	HasIPv4    bool
	HasGateway bool
	IPv4CIDRs  []string
}

func inspectNetInterface(ifc net.Interface) (LiveIface, bool) {
	if ifc.Flags&net.FlagUp == 0 || ifc.Flags&net.FlagLoopback != 0 {
		return LiveIface{}, false
	}
	addrs, err := ifc.Addrs()
	if err != nil {
		return LiveIface{}, false
	}
	li := LiveIface{Name: ifc.Name, Index: ifc.Index, Up: true}
	for _, a := range addrs {
		ipNet, ok := a.(*net.IPNet)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		v4 := ipNet.IP.To4()
		if v4 == nil || v4.IsLoopback() || v4.IsLinkLocalUnicast() {
			continue
		}
		li.HasIPv4 = true
		li.IPv4CIDRs = append(li.IPv4CIDRs, ipNet.String())
	}
	if li.Index <= 0 {
		li.Index = InterfaceIndex(ifc.Name)
	}
	return li, true
}

// ReadLiveIfaces reads local network interfaces without spawning any subprocesses.
func ReadLiveIfaces() ([]LiveIface, error) {
	ifaces, err := net.Interfaces()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []LiveIface
	for _, ifc := range ifaces {
		if !contracts.TunIfRegex.MatchString(ifc.Name) && !contracts.UplinkIfRegex.MatchString(ifc.Name) {
			continue
		}
		if li, ok := inspectNetInterface(ifc); ok {
			out = append(out, li)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func InterfaceIndex(name string) int {
	val, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("/sys/class/net", name, "ifindex"))
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	var idx int
	_, _ = fmt.Sscan(strings.TrimSpace(string(val)), &idx)
	return idx
}

func hasTunGatewayCIDR(ifc LiveIface) bool {
	for _, cidr := range ifc.IPv4CIDRs {
		if strings.HasPrefix(cidr, contracts.TunGateway4+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// VerifyLiveIfaceUpIPv4 checks a single named interface via net.InterfaceByName without external processes.
func VerifyLiveIfaceUpIPv4(name string, requireTunGW bool) (LiveIface, bool) {
	if name == "" || name == "lo" {
		return LiveIface{}, false
	}
	ifc, err := net.InterfaceByName(name)
	if err != nil || ifc == nil {
		return LiveIface{}, false
	}
	li, ok := inspectNetInterface(*ifc)
	if !ok || !li.HasIPv4 || li.Index <= 0 {
		return LiveIface{}, false
	}
	if requireTunGW && !hasTunGatewayCIDR(li) {
		return LiveIface{}, false
	}
	return li, true
}

func validFastStatus(bootID string, status *contracts.VPNStatus) bool {
	if status == nil || !status.Running || bootID == "" || status.BootID != bootID {
		return false
	}
	if !contracts.TunIfRegex.MatchString(status.TunIf) {
		return false
	}
	if status.UnderlayIf == "" || status.UnderlayIf == status.TunIf || status.UnderlayIf == "lo" ||
		!contracts.UplinkIfRegex.MatchString(status.UnderlayIf) {
		return false
	}
	if status.VPNNetID < 100 || status.VPNNetID > contracts.NetIDMask ||
		status.UnderlayNetID < 100 || status.UnderlayNetID > contracts.NetIDMask ||
		status.VPNNetID == status.UnderlayNetID {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// TryFastStatusSession resolves an ActiveSession in <15ms from verified vpn_status.json
// and live interfaces, including multi-uplink states where wlan0 and cellular coexist.
func TryFastStatusSession(bootID string, clientUID int, status *contracts.VPNStatus, ifaces []LiveIface) (*netfilter.ActiveSession, bool) {
	if !validFastStatus(bootID, status) {
		return nil, false
	}
	var tunIface, uplinkIface *LiveIface
	for i := range ifaces {
		ifc := &ifaces[i]
		if !ifc.Up || !ifc.HasIPv4 || ifc.Index <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		if ifc.Name == status.TunIf && hasTunGatewayCIDR(*ifc) {
			tunIface = ifc
		} else if ifc.Name == status.UnderlayIf {
			uplinkIface = ifc
		}
	}
	if tunIface == nil || uplinkIface == nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	sess := &netfilter.ActiveSession{
		ClientUID:   clientUID,
		VPNNetID:    status.VPNNetID,
		TunIf:       tunIface.Name,
		TunIfindex:  tunIface.Index,
		UplinkNetID: status.UnderlayNetID,
		UplinkIf:    uplinkIface.Name,
		UplinkIndex: uplinkIface.Index,
	}
	if err := sess.Validate(clientUID / contracts.AndroidUserWidth); err != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	return sess, true
}

// ResolveFastStatusSession checks status.TunIf and status.UnderlayIf via net.InterfaceByName
// (zero external dumpsys processes) when vpn_status.json identifies an active physical underlay.
func ResolveFastStatusSession(bootID string, clientUID int, status *contracts.VPNStatus) (*netfilter.ActiveSession, bool) {
	if !validFastStatus(bootID, status) {
		return nil, false
	}
	tun, ok1 := VerifyLiveIfaceUpIPv4(status.TunIf, true)
	if !ok1 {
		return nil, false
	}
	uplink, ok2 := VerifyLiveIfaceUpIPv4(status.UnderlayIf, false)
	if !ok2 {
		return nil, false
	}
	return TryFastStatusSession(bootID, clientUID, status, []LiveIface{tun, uplink})
}

// TryFastSingleUplinkSession resolves an ActiveSession in <15ms with 0 dumpsys calls when
// exactly one physical uplink is active and vpn_status.json matches the current boot & interfaces.
// Returns (session, multiUplink, ok). When multiUplink is true or ok is false, caller uses dumpsys connectivity.
func TryFastSingleUplinkSession(bootID string, clientUID int, status *contracts.VPNStatus, ifaces []LiveIface) (*netfilter.ActiveSession, bool, bool) {
	var tuns []LiveIface
	var uplinks []LiveIface
	for _, ifc := range ifaces {
		if !ifc.Up || !ifc.HasIPv4 || ifc.Index <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case contracts.TunIfRegex.MatchString(ifc.Name):
			if hasTunGatewayCIDR(ifc) {
				tuns = append(tuns, ifc)
			}
		case contracts.UplinkIfRegex.MatchString(ifc.Name):
			uplinks = append(uplinks, ifc)
		}
	}
	if len(uplinks) > 1 {
		return nil, true, false
	}
	if len(uplinks) != 1 || len(tuns) != 1 {
		return nil, false, false
	}
	sess, ok := TryFastStatusSession(bootID, clientUID, status, ifaces)
	return sess, false, ok
}

// DiscoverSessionFromConnectivity performs bounded dumpsys connectivity + TUN IP + route checks.
func DiscoverSessionFromConnectivity(ctx context.Context, r Runner, id VerifiedIdentity, verifyRoutes bool, endpoints ...string) (*netfilter.ActiveSession, error) {
	endpointV4 := ""
	if len(endpoints) > 0 {
		endpointV4 = strings.TrimSpace(endpoints[0])
	}
	portalDNS4 := contracts.PortalDNS4
	if len(endpoints) > 1 && strings.TrimSpace(endpoints[1]) != "" {
		portalDNS4 = strings.TrimSpace(endpoints[1])
	}

	state, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "dumpsys", "connectivity")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("dumpsys connectivity: %w", err)
	}
	sess, err := ParseWorkNetworks(state, id.ClientUID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sess.TunIfindex = InterfaceIndex(sess.TunIf)
	sess.UplinkIndex = InterfaceIndex(sess.UplinkIf)
	if err := sess.Validate(id.UserID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	linkOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "addr", "show", "dev", sess.TunIf)
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(linkOut, "inet "+contracts.TunGateway4+"/30 ") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("TUN %s missing %s/30", sess.TunIf, contracts.TunGateway4)
	}

	if verifyRoutes {
		innerUID := id.UserID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + contracts.MinAppID
		if innerUID == id.ClientUID {
			innerUID++
		}
		if err := CheckWorkRoute(ctx, r, contracts.FakeIPProbe, innerUID, sess.UplinkNetID, sess.TunIf); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("work UID route (%s): %w", contracts.FakeIPProbe, err)
		}
		if endpointV4 != "" {
			outerMark := sess.UplinkNetID | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit | contracts.ExplicitNetworkBit
			if err := CheckWorkRoute(ctx, r, endpointV4, sess.ClientUID, outerMark, sess.UplinkIf); err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("outer route: %w", err)
			}
		}
		dnsMark := sess.VPNNetID | contracts.ExplicitNetworkBit | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit | contracts.SystemPermission
		if err := CheckWorkRoute(ctx, r, portalDNS4, 1051, dnsMark, sess.TunIf); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("delegated DNS route: %w", err)
		}
	}
	return sess, nil
}

func CheckWorkRoute(ctx context.Context, r Runner, address string, uid, mark int, iface string) error {
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "route", "get", address, "mark", fmt.Sprintf("0x%x", mark), "uid", strconv.Itoa(uid))
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(" "+strings.TrimSpace(out)+" ", " dev "+iface+" ") {
		return fmt.Errorf("route to %s did not resolve to %s", address, iface)
	}
	return nil
}
```

`guard/internal/android/millet.go`:

```go
package android

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
)

type CgroupFS interface {
	ReadFile(path string) ([]byte, error)
	WriteFile(path string, data []byte) error
}

type osCgroupFS struct{}

func (osCgroupFS) ReadFile(path string) ([]byte, error) { return os.ReadFile(path) }
func (osCgroupFS) WriteFile(path string, data []byte) error {
	return os.WriteFile(path, data, 0644)
}

type FreezeState struct {
	Frozen        bool
	FreezePath    string
	InFrozenGroup bool
	Evidence      string
}

// InspectCgroupV2Freeze checks Kernel 5.10 MIUI Millet cgroup v2 paths ONLY
// (/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_<uid>/pid_<pid>/cgroup.freeze, /proc/<pid>/cgroup -> cgroup.freeze,
// and /sys/fs/cgroup/frozen/cgroup.procs). NEVER touches legacy /sys/fs/cgroup/freezer.
func InspectCgroupV2Freeze(fs CgroupFS, clientUID, pid int) FreezeState {
	if fs == nil {
		fs = osCgroupFS{}
	}
	if pid <= 0 || clientUID <= 0 {
		return FreezeState{}
	}
	pidStr := strconv.Itoa(pid)
	parentPath := fmt.Sprintf("/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_%d/cgroup.freeze", clientUID)
	if pdata, perr := fs.ReadFile(parentPath); perr == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(pdata)) == "1" {
		return FreezeState{
			Frozen:     true,
			FreezePath: parentPath,
			Evidence:   parentPath + "=1",
		}
	}
	directPath := fmt.Sprintf("/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_%d/pid_%d/cgroup.freeze", clientUID, pid)
	if data, err := fs.ReadFile(directPath); err == nil {
		if strings.TrimSpace(string(data)) == "1" {
			return FreezeState{
				Frozen:     true,
				FreezePath: directPath,
				Evidence:   directPath + "=1",
			}
		}
	}
	eventsPath := fmt.Sprintf("/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_%d/pid_%d/cgroup.events", clientUID, pid)
	if ev, err := fs.ReadFile(eventsPath); err == nil && strings.Contains(string(ev), "frozen 1") {
		freezeTarget := directPath
		if _, rerr := fs.ReadFile(freezeTarget); rerr != nil {
			freezeTarget = parentPath
		}
		return FreezeState{
			Frozen:     true,
			FreezePath: freezeTarget,
			Evidence:   eventsPath + ":frozen 1",
		}
	}

	if cgData, err := fs.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/proc/%d/cgroup", pid)); err == nil {
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(cgData), "\n") {
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "0::") {
				rel := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "0::"))
				if rel != "" && !strings.Contains(rel, "..") {
					p := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("/sys/fs/cgroup", rel, "cgroup.freeze"))
					if d, err := fs.ReadFile(p); err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(d)) == "1" {
						return FreezeState{
							Frozen:     true,
							FreezePath: p,
							Evidence:   p + "=1",
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if frozenProcs, err := fs.ReadFile("/sys/fs/cgroup/frozen/cgroup.procs"); err == nil {
		for _, row := range strings.Split(string(frozenProcs), "\n") {
			if strings.TrimSpace(row) == pidStr {
				return FreezeState{
					Frozen:        true,
					InFrozenGroup: true,
					Evidence:      "/sys/fs/cgroup/frozen/cgroup.procs contains " + pidStr,
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return FreezeState{}
}

// UnfreezeCgroupV2 unfreezes a Millet-frozen process via cgroup v2 paths.
func UnfreezeCgroupV2(fs CgroupFS, clientUID, pid int, st FreezeState) error {
	if fs == nil {
		fs = osCgroupFS{}
	}
	var errs []error
	if st.FreezePath != "" {
		if err := fs.WriteFile(st.FreezePath, []byte("0")); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err)
		}
	} else {
		directPath := fmt.Sprintf("/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_%d/pid_%d/cgroup.freeze", clientUID, pid)
		if _, err := fs.ReadFile(directPath); err == nil {
			if err := fs.WriteFile(directPath, []byte("0")); err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, err)
			}
		}
	}
	parentPath := fmt.Sprintf("/sys/fs/cgroup/uid_%d/cgroup.freeze", clientUID)
	if st.FreezePath != parentPath {
		if pdata, err := fs.ReadFile(parentPath); err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(pdata)) == "1" {
			if err := fs.WriteFile(parentPath, []byte("0")); err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, err)
			}
		}
	}
	if st.InFrozenGroup {
		if err := fs.WriteFile("/sys/fs/cgroup/unfrozen/cgroup.procs", []byte(strconv.Itoa(pid))); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err)
		}
	}
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// EnsureWorkPermissions enforces deviceidle whitelist, RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND, and POST_NOTIFICATION allow.
func EnsureWorkPermissions(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, workPkg string) []string {
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(workPkg) {
		workPkg = contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	}
	u := strconv.Itoa(userID)
	var errs []string
	cmds := [][]string{
		{"dumpsys", "deviceidle", "whitelist", "+" + workPkg},
		{"cmd", "appops", "set", "--user", u, workPkg, "RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND", "allow"},
		{"cmd", "appops", "set", "--user", u, workPkg, "POST_NOTIFICATION", "allow"},
	}
	for _, args := range cmds {
		if _, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", args[0], args[1:]...); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err.Error())
		}
	}
	return errs
}

// FindWorkServicePID locates <workPkg>:background (or <workPkg>) running as exact clientUID.
func FindWorkServicePID(clientUID int, workPkg string) (int, bool, error) {
	if clientUID <= 0 {
		return 0, false, nil
	}
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(workPkg) {
		workPkg = contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	}
	svcProc := workPkg + contracts.DefaultServiceProcessSuffix
	procs, err := os.ReadDir("/proc")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, false, err
	}
	for _, proc := range procs {
		pid, err := strconv.Atoi(proc.Name())
		if err != nil || pid <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		base := filepath.Join("/proc", proc.Name())
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(base, "cmdline"))
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		name, _, _ := strings.Cut(string(data), "\x00")
		if name != svcProc && name != workPkg {
			continue
		}
		status, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(base, "status"))
		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return 0, false, err
		}
		if SameWorkProcessUID(string(status), clientUID) {
			return pid, true, nil
		}
	}
	return 0, false, nil
}

func SameWorkProcessUID(status string, uid int) bool {
	want := strconv.Itoa(uid)
	for _, line := range strings.Split(status, "\n") {
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(fields) == 5 && fields[0] == "Uid:" {
			return fields[1] == want && fields[2] == want
		}
	}
	return false
}

// InspectCgroupV1Freeze checks legacy cgroup v1 freezer paths for Linux 4.19 / 5.4 kernels
// when cgroup v2 cgroup.freeze nodes are not present.
func InspectCgroupV1Freeze(fs CgroupFS, clientUID, pid int) FreezeState {
	if fs == nil {
		fs = osCgroupFS{}
	}
	if pid <= 0 || clientUID <= 0 {
		return FreezeState{}
	}
	pidStr := strconv.Itoa(pid)
	for _, uidStatePath := range []string{
		fmt.Sprintf("/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer/uid_%d/freezer.state", clientUID),
		fmt.Sprintf("/dev/freezer/uid_%d/freezer.state", clientUID),
	} {
		if data, err := fs.ReadFile(uidStatePath); err == nil {
			s := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(string(data)))
			if s == "FROZEN" || s == "FREEZING" {
				return FreezeState{
					Frozen:     true,
					FreezePath: uidStatePath,
					Evidence:   uidStatePath + "=" + s,
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, frozenPair := range [][2]string{
		{"/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer/frozen/tasks", "/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer/frozen/freezer.state"},
		{"/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer/frozen/cgroup.procs", "/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer/frozen/freezer.state"},
		{"/dev/freezer/frozen/tasks", "/dev/freezer/frozen/freezer.state"},
		{"/dev/freezer/frozen/cgroup.procs", "/dev/freezer/frozen/freezer.state"},
	} {
		tasksPath := frozenPair[0]
		if procs, err := fs.ReadFile(tasksPath); err == nil {
			for _, row := range strings.Split(string(procs), "\n") {
				if strings.TrimSpace(row) == pidStr {
					// Never record the shared global frozen/freezer.state as FreezePath:
					// thawing a global freezer group would thaw unrelated host processes.
					return FreezeState{
						Frozen:        true,
						FreezePath:    "",
						InFrozenGroup: true,
						Evidence:      tasksPath + " contains " + pidStr,
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return FreezeState{}
}

// UnfreezeCgroupV1 unfreezes a cgroup v1 freezer group / uid state for kernel_compat builds.
func UnfreezeCgroupV1(fs CgroupFS, clientUID, pid int, st FreezeState) error {
	if fs == nil {
		fs = osCgroupFS{}
	}
	var errs []error
	uidFrozenSuffix := fmt.Sprintf("/uid_%d/freezer.state", clientUID)
	if !st.InFrozenGroup && st.FreezePath != "" && strings.HasSuffix(st.FreezePath, uidFrozenSuffix) {
		if err := fs.WriteFile(st.FreezePath, []byte("THAWED")); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err)
		}
	} else if clientUID > 0 {
		for _, uidStatePath := range []string{
			fmt.Sprintf("/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer/uid_%d/freezer.state", clientUID),
			fmt.Sprintf("/dev/freezer/uid_%d/freezer.state", clientUID),
		} {
			if _, err := fs.ReadFile(uidStatePath); err == nil {
				if err := fs.WriteFile(uidStatePath, []byte("THAWED")); err != nil {
					errs = append(errs, err)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if st.InFrozenGroup && pid > 0 {
		pidBytes := []byte(strconv.Itoa(pid))
		rootDir := "/sys/fs/cgroup/freezer"
		if strings.HasPrefix(st.Evidence, "/dev/freezer/") {
			rootDir = "/dev/freezer"
		}
		if err := fs.WriteFile(rootDir+"/cgroup.procs", pidBytes); err != nil {
			if err2 := fs.WriteFile(rootDir+"/tasks", pidBytes); err2 != nil {
				errs = append(errs, err2)
			}
		}
	}
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}
```

`guard/internal/android/proc_kill_compat_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux && kernel_compat

package android

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

func killPIDHard(pid int) error {
	return killPIDHardForUser(pid, -1)
}

func readProcStartTime(pid int) (string, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/proc/%d/stat", pid))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	s := string(b)
	rparen := strings.LastIndexByte(s, ')')
	if rparen < 0 || rparen+2 >= len(s) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("malformed /proc/%d/stat", pid)
	}
	// Field 22 in /proc/<pid>/stat (0-indexed 19 after comm ') ') is starttime.
	fields := strings.Fields(s[rparen+2:])
	if len(fields) <= 19 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("short /proc/%d/stat", pid)
	}
	return fields[19], nil
}

func verifyProcStatusUID(pid, userID int) bool {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return false
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/proc/%d/status", pid))
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	uidMin := userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + contracts.MinAppID
	uidMax := userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + 99999
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Uid:") {
			fields := strings.Fields(line[4:])
			if len(fields) == 0 {
				return false
			}
			uid, uerr := strconv.Atoi(fields[0])
			return uerr == nil && uid >= uidMin && uid <= uidMax
		}
	}
	return false
}

// killPIDHardForUser performs two-phase starttime + UID verification before
// SIGKILL when pidfd_open(2) is unavailable (Linux 4.19 / 5.4 kernels).
func killPIDHardForUser(pid, userID int) error {
	if pid <= 1 || pid == os.Getpid() {
		return nil
	}
	if userID >= 0 {
		if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
			return unix.EPERM
		}
		startBefore, err := readProcStartTime(pid)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !verifyProcStatusUID(pid, userID) {
			return unix.EPERM
		}
		startAfter, err := readProcStartTime(pid)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if startBefore != startAfter {
			return unix.ESRCH
		}
	}
	return unix.Kill(pid, unix.SIGKILL)
}
```

`guard/internal/android/proc_kill_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux && !kernel_compat

package android

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

func killPIDHard(pid int) error {
	return killPIDHardForUser(pid, -1)
}

func killPIDHardForUser(pid, userID int) error {
	if pid <= 1 || pid == os.Getpid() {
		return nil
	}
	if userID >= 0 {
		if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
			return unix.EPERM
		}
		pidfd, err := unix.PidfdOpen(pid, 0)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer func() { _ = unix.Close(pidfd) }()

		b, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/proc/%d/status", pid))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		uidMin := userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + contracts.MinAppID
		uidMax := userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + 99999
		matched := false
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Uid:") {
				fields := strings.Fields(line[4:])
				if len(fields) > 0 {
					if uid, uerr := strconv.Atoi(fields[0]); uerr == nil && uid >= uidMin && uid <= uidMax {
						matched = true
					}
				}
				break
			}
		}
		if !matched {
			return unix.EPERM
		}
		return unix.PidfdSendSignal(pidfd, unix.SIGKILL, nil, 0)
	}
	return unix.Kill(pid, unix.SIGKILL)
}
```

`guard/internal/android/proc_mem.go`:

```go
package android

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

type uidBoostState struct {
	origVal string
	timer   *time.Timer
}

var (
	uidBoostMu sync.Mutex
	uidBoosts  = make(map[int]*uidBoostState)
)

type anonMapRange struct {
	start uintptr
	len   uint64
}

func parseAnonPrivateMaps(mapsPath string, maxRegions int) []anonMapRange {
	if maxRegions <= 0 {
		maxRegions = 128
	}
	f, err := os.Open(mapsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	defer f.Close()

	const maxScanCandidates = 1024
	var ranges []anonMapRange
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	for sc.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(sc.Text())
		if len(fields) < 5 {
			continue
		}
		// Only reclaim anonymous private read-write mappings (rw-p, zero inode, no backing pathname).
		if fields[1] != "rw-p" || fields[4] != "0" {
			continue
		}
		if len(fields) >= 6 {
			path := fields[5]
			if path != "[anon:libc_malloc]" && !strings.HasPrefix(path, "[anon:scudo") && !strings.HasPrefix(path, "[anon:dalvik-") {
				continue
			}
		}
		dash := strings.IndexByte(fields[0], '-')
		if dash <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		start, err1 := strconv.ParseUint(fields[0][:dash], 16, 64)
		end, err2 := strconv.ParseUint(fields[0][dash+1:], 16, 64)
		if err1 != nil || err2 != nil || end <= start {
			continue
		}
		size := end - start
		if size < 64*1024 {
			continue
		}
		ranges = append(ranges, anonMapRange{
			start: uintptr(start),
			len:   size,
		})
		if len(ranges) >= maxScanCandidates {
			break
		}
	}
	if len(ranges) > maxRegions {
		sort.Slice(ranges, func(i, j int) bool {
			return ranges[i].len > ranges[j].len
		})
		ranges = ranges[:maxRegions]
	}
	return ranges
}

// ReadMemoryPSIAvg10 parses `some avg10=X.XX` from /proc/pressure/memory (or path).
func ReadMemoryPSIAvg10(path string) (float64, bool) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
		path = "/proc/pressure/memory"
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, false
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "some ") {
			continue
		}
		for _, tok := range strings.Fields(line)[1:] {
			if strings.HasPrefix(tok, "avg10=") {
				v, perr := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimPrefix(tok, "avg10="), 64)
				if perr == nil {
					return v, true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}

// BoostUIDLaunch applies a bounded transient cpu.uclamp.min boost strictly to sandbox uid_<uid>
// in [MinAppID, 89999] (never User 0 or system UIDs) and asynchronously restores the prior value.
func BoostUIDLaunch(cgroupRoot string, uid int, duration time.Duration) bool {
	if uid < contracts.AndroidUserWidth || oem.IsForbiddenUser(uid/contracts.AndroidUserWidth) {
		return false
	}
	appID := uid % contracts.AndroidUserWidth
	if appID < contracts.MinAppID || appID >= 90000 {
		return false
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(cgroupRoot) == "" {
		cgroupRoot = "/sys/fs/cgroup"
	}
	if duration <= 0 {
		duration = 1500 * time.Millisecond
	}
	if duration > 5*time.Second {
		duration = 5 * time.Second
	}
	uclampFile := filepath.Join(cgroupRoot, fmt.Sprintf("uid_%d", uid), "cpu.uclamp.min")
	uidBoostMu.Lock()
	defer uidBoostMu.Unlock()

	origVal := "0"
	hadPrev := false
	if prev, exists := uidBoosts[uid]; exists {
		hadPrev = true
		origVal = prev.origVal
		if prev.timer != nil {
			prev.timer.Stop()
		}
	} else {
		origBytes, err := os.ReadFile(uclampFile)
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		if s := strings.TrimSpace(string(origBytes)); s != "" {
			origVal = s
		}
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(uclampFile, []byte("50"), 0644); err != nil {
		if hadPrev {
			delete(uidBoosts, uid)
			_ = os.WriteFile(uclampFile, []byte(origVal), 0644)
		}
		return false
	}
	entry := &uidBoostState{origVal: origVal}
	entry.timer = time.AfterFunc(duration, func() {
		uidBoostMu.Lock()
		defer uidBoostMu.Unlock()
		if uidBoosts[uid] == entry {
			delete(uidBoosts, uid)
			_ = os.WriteFile(uclampFile, []byte(origVal), 0644)
		}
	})
	uidBoosts[uid] = entry
	return true
}

// PrewarmSandboxAppFiles resolves installed APK + ART oat/vdex paths from packages.list
// and hints the kernel page cache with FADV_WILLNEED (best-effort, non-blocking).
func PrewarmSandboxAppFiles(packagesListPath, pkg string) {
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(packagesListPath) == "" {
		packagesListPath = contracts.PackagesListPath
	}
	f, err := os.Open(packagesListPath)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	var codePath string
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	for sc.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(sc.Text())
		if len(fields) >= 4 && fields[0] == pkg {
			codePath = fields[3]
			break
		}
	}
	_ = f.Close()
	if codePath == "" || !strings.HasPrefix(codePath, "/data/app/") {
		return
	}
	appDir := codePath
	if strings.HasSuffix(appDir, ".apk") {
		appDir = filepath.Dir(appDir)
	}
	PrewarmFiles([]string{
		filepath.Join(appDir, "base.apk"),
		filepath.Join(appDir, "oat", "arm64", "base.odex"),
		filepath.Join(appDir, "oat", "arm64", "base.vdex"),
	})
}

// PrewarmSandboxAppCodePath queries Android PackageManager for the true /data/app/... code path
// and hints the kernel page cache with FADV_WILLNEED (best-effort, non-blocking).
func PrewarmSandboxAppCodePath(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, pkg string) {
	if r == nil || oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) || !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
		return
	}
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "path", "--user", strconv.Itoa(userID), pkg)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	var codePath string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
		l := strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(l, "package:") {
			continue
		}
		cand := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(l, "package:"))
		if strings.HasPrefix(cand, "/data/app/") {
			codePath = cand
			break
		}
	}
	if codePath == "" {
		return
	}
	appDir := codePath
	if strings.HasSuffix(appDir, ".apk") {
		appDir = filepath.Dir(appDir)
	}
	PrewarmFiles([]string{
		filepath.Join(appDir, "base.apk"),
		filepath.Join(appDir, "oat", "arm64", "base.odex"),
		filepath.Join(appDir, "oat", "arm64", "base.vdex"),
	})
}
```

`guard/internal/android/proc_mem_compat_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux && kernel_compat

package android

import (
	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

// ReclaimProcessMemory is a no-op on Linux < 5.10 kernels without process_madvise(2).
func ReclaimProcessMemory(pid int) error {
	_ = pid
	return nil
}

// ReclaimProcessMemoryForUser validates user ownership and returns nil on Linux < 5.10
// kernels without process_madvise(2) (syscall 440) or pidfd_open(2).
func ReclaimProcessMemoryForUser(pid, userID int) error {
	_ = pid
	if userID >= 0 && oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return unix.EPERM
	}
	return nil
}

// PrewarmFiles advises the kernel page cache with FADV_WILLNEED using O_NOFOLLOW safety.
func PrewarmFiles(paths []string) {
	for _, p := range paths {
		if p == "" {
			continue
		}
		fd, err := unix.Open(p, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_CLOEXEC|unix.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		_ = unix.Fadvise(fd, 0, 0, unix.FADV_WILLNEED)
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/android/proc_mem_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux && !kernel_compat

package android

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

const (
	sysProcessMadvise uintptr = 440
	madvPageout       uintptr = 21
)

type sysIovec struct {
	Base uintptr
	Len  uint64
}

func verifyProcUIDRange(pid, userID int) bool {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return false
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/proc/%d/status", pid))
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	uidMin := userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + contracts.MinAppID
	uidMax := userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + 99999
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Uid:") {
			fields := strings.Fields(line[4:])
			if len(fields) == 0 {
				return false
			}
			uid, uerr := strconv.Atoi(fields[0])
			return uerr == nil && uid >= uidMin && uid <= uidMax
		}
	}
	return false
}

// ReclaimProcessMemory asks the Linux kernel via process_madvise(MADV_PAGEOUT) to pageout frozen
// private anonymous mappings without user-range binding (for legacy callers).
func ReclaimProcessMemory(pid int) error {
	return ReclaimProcessMemoryForUser(pid, -1)
}

// ReclaimProcessMemoryForUser opens pidfd first, validates /proc/<pid>/status Uid belongs
// strictly to sandbox userID (eliminating PID-reuse races), parses the largest anonymous heaps,
// and invokes process_madvise(MADV_PAGEOUT).
func ReclaimProcessMemoryForUser(pid, userID int) error {
	if pid <= 1 || pid == os.Getpid() {
		return nil
	}
	if runtime.GOARCH != "arm64" && runtime.GOARCH != "amd64" {
		return unix.ENOSYS
	}
	pidfd, err := unix.PidfdOpen(pid, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = unix.Close(pidfd) }()

	if userID >= 0 && !verifyProcUIDRange(pid, userID) {
		return unix.EPERM
	}
	ranges := parseAnonPrivateMaps(fmt.Sprintf("/proc/%d/maps", pid), 128)
	if len(ranges) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	iovecs := make([]sysIovec, len(ranges))
	for i, r := range ranges {
		iovecs[i] = sysIovec{Base: r.start, Len: r.len}
	}
	const chunk = 64
	var lastSoftErr error
	for off := 0; off < len(iovecs); off += chunk {
		end := off + chunk
		if end > len(iovecs) {
			end = len(iovecs)
		}
		_, _, errno := unix.Syscall6(
			sysProcessMadvise,
			uintptr(pidfd),
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&iovecs[off])),
			uintptr(end-off),
			madvPageout,
			0,
			0,
		)
		if errno != 0 {
			if errno == unix.EINVAL || errno == unix.ENOMEM || errno == unix.EFAULT {
				lastSoftErr = errno
				continue
			}
			return errno
		}
	}
	return lastSoftErr
}

// PrewarmFiles advises the kernel page cache with FADV_WILLNEED using O_NOFOLLOW safety.
func PrewarmFiles(paths []string) {
	for _, p := range paths {
		if p == "" {
			continue
		}
		fd, err := unix.Open(p, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_CLOEXEC|unix.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		_ = unix.Fadvise(fd, 0, 0, unix.FADV_WILLNEED)
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
	}
}
```

```go
var (
	installSessionIDRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`\[(\d+)\]`)
	coreSandboxApps       = []string{
		"com.android.vending",
		"com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox",
		"com.google.android.apps.bard",
		"com.google.android.apps.subscriptions.red",

type AppPolicySyncResult struct {
	UserID            int      `json:"user_id"`
	Locale            string   `json:"locale"`
	LocaleApps        int      `json:"locale_apps"`
	LocalePreserved   int      `json:"locale_preserved,omitempty"`

// PolicySyncOptions controls Per-App Locale, Bluetooth name, and appops enforcement inside the sandbox user.
type PolicySyncOptions struct {
	CallerPackage       string
	DefaultLocale       string
	PreserveUserLocales bool
	SkipLocale          bool
	LocaleOverrides     map[string]string
	BluetoothDeviceName string

type InstallAPKResult struct {
	UserID    int      `json:"user_id"`
	SessionID string   `json:"session_id"`
	Files     []string `json:"files"`

func parsePackageList(output string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, raw := range strings.Split(output, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "package:") {
			continue
		}
		pkg := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "package:"))
		if idx := strings.IndexAny(pkg, " \t"); idx >= 0 {
			pkg = pkg[:idx]
		}
		if contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			seen[pkg] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
	for pkg := range seen {
		out = append(out, pkg)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

// ListSandboxApps returns sorted third-party package names installed inside the sandbox user,
// excluding any specified internal packages.
func ListSandboxApps(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, excludePkgs ...string) ([]string, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d", userID)
	}
	exclude := make(map[string]struct{}, len(excludePkgs))
	for _, p := range excludePkgs {
		if p != "" {
			exclude[p] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "list", "packages", "-3", "--user", strconv.Itoa(userID))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	raw := parsePackageList(out)
	res := make([]string, 0, len(raw))
	for _, pkg := range raw {
		if _, skip := exclude[pkg]; skip {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, pkg)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// StopSandboxApp force-stops a single package inside the sandbox user,
// refusing protected caller packages.
func StopSandboxApp(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, pkg, callerPkg string) error {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d", userID)
	}
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid package name %q", pkg)
	}
	protectPkg := strings.TrimSpace(callerPkg)
	if protectPkg == "" {
		protectPkg = contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	}
	if pkg == protectPkg || protectedRemovePackages[pkg] || pkg == contracts.ManagedProvisioningPkg {
		return fmt.Errorf("refusing to force-stop protected package %s", pkg)
	}
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "am", "force-stop", "--user", strconv.Itoa(userID), pkg)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("am force-stop %s: %w (%s)", pkg, err, strings.TrimSpace(out))
	}
	return nil
}

var protectedRemovePackages = map[string]bool{
	"android":                 true,
	"com.android.settings":    true,
	"com.android.systemui":    true,
	"com.android.vending":     true,
	"com.google.android.gms":  true,
	"com.google.android.gsf":  true,
	"com.sandbox.controller":  true,
	"com.sandbox.verify":      true,
}

// RemoveSandboxApp uninstalls a user-installed (-3) package solely inside the sandbox user,
// blocking protected system, GMS, and controller packages.
func RemoveSandboxApp(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, pkg, callerPkg string) (string, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d", userID)
	}
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid package name %q", pkg)
	}
	protectPkg := strings.TrimSpace(callerPkg)
	if protectPkg == "" {
		protectPkg = contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	}
	if pkg == protectPkg || protectedRemovePackages[pkg] {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove protected package %s", pkg)
	}
	installed, err := ListSandboxApps(ctx, r, userID, protectPkg, contracts.VerifyProbePackage)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("list sandbox apps: %w", err)
	}
	found := false
	for _, p := range installed {
		if p == pkg {
			found = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !found {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("package %s is not a removable user app in work user %d", pkg, userID)
	}
	out, uerr := r.Run(ctx, 15*time.Second, "", "pm", "uninstall", "--user", strconv.Itoa(userID), pkg)
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
	if uerr != nil {
		return trimmed, fmt.Errorf("pm uninstall %s: %w (%s)", pkg, uerr, trimmed)
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func mergeSortedUnique(groups ...[]string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, g := range groups {
		for _, item := range g {
			if item != "" {
				seen[item] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
	for item := range seen {
		out = append(out, item)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

func computePolicyFingerprint(userID int, pkgs []string, opts PolicySyncOptions) string {
	h := sha256.New()
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(h, "u=%d;loc=%s;pres=%v;", userID, opts.DefaultLocale, opts.PreserveUserLocales)
	for _, p := range pkgs {
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s,", p)
	}
	if len(opts.LocaleOverrides) > 0 {
		keys := make([]string, 0, len(opts.LocaleOverrides))
		for k := range opts.LocaleOverrides {
			keys = append(keys, k)
		}
		sort.Strings(keys)
		for _, k := range keys {
			_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(h, ";ov:%s=%s", k, opts.LocaleOverrides[k])
		}
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))[:16]
}

// HasNonEmptyAppLocale parses `cmd locale get-app-locales <pkg> --user <u>` output.
// Returns true ONLY when output explicitly contains a non-empty locale tag inside brackets like `[zh-CN]`.
func HasNonEmptyAppLocale(output string) bool {
	openIdx := strings.IndexByte(output, '[')
	closeIdx := strings.LastIndexByte(output, ']')
	if openIdx < 0 || closeIdx <= openIdx+1 {
		return false
	}
	inner := strings.TrimSpace(output[openIdx+1 : closeIdx])
	return inner != ""
}

func isExtraLocationUIDPkg(pkg string) bool {
	for _, p := range oem.Current().ExtraLocationDenyPackages {
		if pkg == p {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocaleServiceUnsupported(out string, err error) bool {
	combined := strings.ToLower(out)
	if err != nil {
		combined += " " + strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	}
	return strings.Contains(combined, "unknown command") ||
		strings.Contains(combined, "can't find service: locale") ||
		strings.Contains(combined, "service locale not found")
}

// StopSandboxApps stops third-party and core Google background processes inside the sandbox user
// on pause while excluding the specified packages (such as controller and admin) so zero idle battery/CPU drain occurs.
func StopSandboxApps(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, excludePkgs ...string) (int, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d", userID)
	}
	exclude := make(map[string]bool, len(excludePkgs))
	for _, ep := range excludePkgs {
		if ep != "" {
			exclude[ep] = true
		}
	}
	u := strconv.Itoa(userID)
	out, listErr := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "list", "packages", "-3", "--user", u)
	pkgs := parsePackageList(out)
	targets := mergeSortedUnique(pkgs, coreSandboxApps)

	stopped := 0
	var errs []string
	for _, pkg := range targets {
		if exclude[pkg] || !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			continue
		}
		if err := stopPackagePreserveStopped(ctx, r, u, pkg); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, pkg+": "+err.Error())
		} else {
			stopped++
		}
	}
	if listErr != nil && stopped == 0 {
		return 0, listErr
	}
	if len(errs) > 0 && stopped == 0 {
		return 0, errors.New(strings.Join(errs, "; "))
	}
	return stopped, nil
}

// SyncSandboxAppPolicies enforces Per-App Locale (default ja-JP) and User-N appops isolation.
func SyncSandboxAppPolicies(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, locale string) (AppPolicySyncResult, error) {
	return SyncSandboxAppPoliciesWithOpts(ctx, r, userID, PolicySyncOptions{
		DefaultLocale:       locale,
		PreserveUserLocales: false,
	})
}

// SyncSandboxAppPoliciesWithOpts enforces Per-App Locale and appops location isolation using
// direct argv invocations (zero shell invocation / zero sh -c), while preserving non-empty user locales.
func SyncSandboxAppPoliciesWithOpts(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, opts PolicySyncOptions) (AppPolicySyncResult, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return AppPolicySyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d", userID)
	}
	callerPkg := strings.TrimSpace(opts.CallerPackage)
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(callerPkg) {
		callerPkg = contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	}
	defLoc := strings.TrimSpace(opts.DefaultLocale)
	if defLoc == "" {
		defLoc = "en-US"
	}
	if !contracts.ValidLocaleTag(defLoc) {
		return AppPolicySyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid locale tag %q", defLoc)
	}
	opts.DefaultLocale = defLoc

	u := strconv.Itoa(userID)
	res := AppPolicySyncResult{UserID: userID, Locale: defLoc}

	out, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "list", "packages", "-3", "--user", u)
	if err != nil {
		return res, fmt.Errorf("list sandbox packages: %w (%s)", err, strings.TrimSpace(out))
	}
	userPkgs := parsePackageList(out)

	localeTargets := mergeSortedUnique(userPkgs, coreSandboxApps)
	locTargets := mergeSortedUnique(userPkgs, coreSandboxApps, oem.Current().ExtraLocationDenyPackages)
	res.PackagesHash = computePolicyFingerprint(userID, localeTargets, opts)

	localeSupported := !opts.SkipLocale
	for _, pkg := range localeTargets {
		if !localeSupported {
			break
		}
		if pkg == callerPkg || !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			continue
		}
		targetLoc := defLoc
		if opts.LocaleOverrides != nil {
			if ov, hasOv := opts.LocaleOverrides[pkg]; hasOv {
				ov = strings.TrimSpace(ov)
				if ov == "" {
					res.LocalePreserved++
					continue
				}
				if !contracts.ValidLocaleTag(ov) {
					res.Errors = append(res.Errors, fmt.Sprintf("invalid override locale %q for %s", ov, pkg))
					continue
				}
				targetLoc = ov
			}
		}
		if opts.PreserveUserLocales {
			curOut, gerr := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "cmd", "locale", "get-app-locales", pkg, "--user", u)
			if gerr != nil {
				if isLocaleServiceUnsupported(curOut, gerr) {
					localeSupported = false
					res.LocaleUnsupported = true
					continue
				}
				// Fail safe: never overwrite an existing user locale if current locale cannot be inspected.
				res.Errors = append(res.Errors, "get-locale "+pkg+": "+gerr.Error())
				continue
			}
			if HasNonEmptyAppLocale(curOut) {
				res.LocalePreserved++
				continue
			}
		}
		if setOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "cmd", "locale", "set-app-locales", pkg, "--user", u, "--locales", targetLoc); err != nil {
			if isLocaleServiceUnsupported(setOut, err) {
				localeSupported = false
				res.LocaleUnsupported = true
				continue
			}
			res.Errors = append(res.Errors, "locale "+pkg+": "+err.Error())
		} else {
			res.LocaleApps++
		}
	}

	for _, pkg := range locTargets {
		if pkg == callerPkg || !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
			continue
		}
		pkgOK := true
		for _, op := range locationOps {
			if _, err := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "appops", "set", "--user", u, pkg, op, "ignore"); err != nil {
				pkgOK = false
				res.Errors = append(res.Errors, "appops "+pkg+" "+op+": "+err.Error())
			}
			if pkg == "com.google.android.gms" || isExtraLocationUIDPkg(pkg) {
				if _, err := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "appops", "set", "--user", u, "--uid", pkg, op, "ignore"); err != nil {
					pkgOK = false
					res.Errors = append(res.Errors, "appops-uid "+pkg+" "+op+": "+err.Error())
				}
			}
		}
		if pkgOK {
			res.LocationApps++
		}
	}

	for _, pkg := range userPkgs {
		if pkg == "com.android.chrome" {
			_, _ = r.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "cmd", "role", "add-role-holder", "--user", u, "android.app.role.BROWSER", "com.android.chrome")
			break
		}
	}
	if btName := strings.TrimSpace(opts.BluetoothDeviceName); btName != "" && !strings.ContainsAny(btName, "\r\n\t\x00") {
		if _, err := r.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "settings", "--user", u, "put", "secure", "bluetooth_name", btName); err != nil {
			res.Errors = append(res.Errors, "settings bluetooth_name: "+err.Error())
		}
	}

	if len(res.Errors) > 0 && res.LocaleApps == 0 && res.LocalePreserved == 0 && res.LocationApps == 0 {
		return res, errors.New(strings.Join(res.Errors, "; "))
	}
	return res, nil
}

// SetSandboxAppLocale explicitly applies or clears an Android 13+ Per-App Locale inside the sandbox user.
func SetSandboxAppLocale(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, pkg, locale string, callerPkg ...string) error {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d", userID)
	}
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid package name %q", pkg)
	}
	protectPkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	if len(callerPkg) > 0 && contracts.ValidPackageName(callerPkg[0]) {
		protectPkg = callerPkg[0]
	}
	if pkg == protectPkg || pkg == "com.google.android.gms" {
		return fmt.Errorf("refusing to alter Per-App Locale for protected package %s", pkg)
	}
	loc := strings.TrimSpace(locale)
	if strings.EqualFold(loc, "clear") || strings.EqualFold(loc, "none") {
		loc = ""
	}
	if loc != "" && !contracts.ValidLocaleTag(loc) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid locale tag %q", loc)
	}
	_, err := r.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "cmd", "locale", "set-app-locales", pkg, "--user", strconv.Itoa(userID), "--locales", loc)
	return err
}

func openValidatedAPKForDirs(apk string, allowedDirs []string) (*os.File, int64, error) {
	if apk == "" || !strings.HasSuffix(apk, ".apk") || strings.Contains(apk, "..") ||
		strings.ContainsAny(apk, "\x00\r\n\t;&|$`'\" ") {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("unsafe apk path %q", apk)
	}
	bases := allowedDirs
	if len(bases) == 0 {
		if strings.ContainsRune(apk, '\\') {
			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("unsafe apk path %q", apk)
		}
		bases = []string{"/data/local/tmp", contracts.StagingDir}
	}
	cleanAPK := filepath.Clean(apk)
	f, st, err := openRegularFileNoFollow(cleanAPK)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("open %s: %w", apk, err)
	}
	if st.Size() <= 0 {
		_ = f.Close()
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("%s is empty", apk)
	}
	realParent, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Dir(cleanAPK))
	if err != nil {
		_ = f.Close()
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("resolve parent %s: %w", apk, err)
	}
	matched := false
	for _, d := range bases {
		cleanBase := filepath.Clean(d)
		realBase, berr := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cleanBase)
		if berr != nil {
			realBase = cleanBase
		}
		if realParent == realBase || strings.HasPrefix(realParent, realBase+string(filepath.Separator)) {
			matched = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !matched {
		_ = f.Close()
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("apk path %q outside allowed staging dirs", apk)
	}
	return f, st.Size(), nil
}

// InstallSandboxAPKs stages and commits single or split APKs strictly inside User userID.
func InstallSandboxAPKs(ctx context.Context, r Runner, userID int, apkPaths []string, allowedDirs []string) (InstallAPKResult, error) {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return InstallAPKResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid work user %d", userID)
	}
	if len(apkPaths) == 0 || len(apkPaths) > 32 {
		return InstallAPKResult{}, errors.New("expected 1..32 apk paths")
	}
	files := make([]*os.File, 0, len(apkPaths))
	closeAll := func() {
		for _, f := range files {
			if f != nil {
				_ = f.Close()
			}
		}
	}
	defer closeAll()

	sizes := make([]int64, len(apkPaths))
	for i, p := range apkPaths {
		f, sz, err := openValidatedAPKForDirs(p, allowedDirs)
		if err != nil {
			return InstallAPKResult{}, err
		}
		files = append(files, f)
		sizes[i] = sz
	}

	u := strconv.Itoa(userID)
	createOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 10*time.Second, "", "pm", "install-create", "--user", u, "-r")
	if err != nil {
		return InstallAPKResult{}, fmt.Errorf("pm install-create: %w (%s)", err, strings.TrimSpace(createOut))
	}
	m := installSessionIDRegex.FindStringSubmatch(createOut)
	if len(m) != 2 {
		return InstallAPKResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse install session id from %q", strings.TrimSpace(createOut))
	}
	sid := m[1]

	abandonSession := func() {
		abCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 4*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, _ = r.Run(abCtx, 4*time.Second, "", "pm", "install-abandon", sid)
	}

	rr, canStream := r.(ReaderRunner)
	for i, p := range apkPaths {
		splitName := fmt.Sprintf("split_%d.apk", i)
		sizeStr := strconv.FormatInt(sizes[i], 10)
		var out string
		var werr error
		if canStream {
			out, werr = rr.RunWithStdinReader(ctx, 60*time.Second, files[i], "pm", "install-write",
				"-S", sizeStr, sid, splitName, "-")
		} else {
			out, werr = r.Run(ctx, 60*time.Second, "", "pm", "install-write",
				"-S", sizeStr, sid, splitName, p)
		}
		if werr != nil {
			abandonSession()
			return InstallAPKResult{}, fmt.Errorf("pm install-write %s: %w (%s)", p, werr, strings.TrimSpace(out))
		}
	}

	commitOut, err := r.Run(ctx, 45*time.Second, "", "pm", "install-commit", sid)
	if err != nil {
		abandonSession()
		return InstallAPKResult{}, fmt.Errorf("pm install-commit: %w (%s)", err, strings.TrimSpace(commitOut))
	}
	return InstallAPKResult{
		UserID:    userID,
		SessionID: sid,
		Files:     append([]string(nil), apkPaths...),
		Output:    strings.TrimSpace(commitOut),
	}, nil
}
```

```go
//go:build linux

package android

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

func openRegularFileNoFollow(cleanPath string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
	f, err := os.OpenFile(cleanPath, os.O_RDONLY|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	st, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		_ = f.Close()
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if !st.Mode().IsRegular() {
		_ = f.Close()
		return nil, nil, os.ErrInvalid
	}
	return f, st, nil
}
```

```go
//go:build !linux

package android

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func openRegularFileNoFollow(cleanPath string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
	lst, err := os.Lstat(cleanPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if lst.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !lst.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not a regular file", cleanPath)
	}
	f, err := os.Open(cleanPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	st, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil || !st.Mode().IsRegular() {
		_ = f.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
		return nil, nil, os.ErrInvalid
	}
	return f, st, nil
}
```

```go
package android

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"time"

)

type sandboxRecRunner struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	calls []string
	out   map[string]string
	err   map[string]error
}

func (r *sandboxRecRunner) Run(_ context.Context, _ time.Duration, _ string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	line := name + " " + strings.Join(args, " ")
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.calls = append(r.calls, line)
	r.mu.Unlock()
	if r.err != nil {
		if e, ok := r.err[line]; ok {
			return r.out[line], e
		}
	}
	if r.out != nil {
		if o, ok := r.out[line]; ok {
			return o, nil
		}
	}
	return "", nil
}

func TestSyncSandboxAppPoliciesSetsLocaleAndAppOps(t *testing.T) {

		t.Fatalf("unexpected locale call on work bridge:\n%s", joined)
	}

func TestSyncSandboxAppPoliciesPreservesUserLocalesAndOverrides(t *testing.T) {
	r := &sandboxRecRunner{
		out: map[string]string{
			"cmd package list packages -3 --user 10":                          "package:com.google.android.apps.bard\npackage:com.demo.cleared\npackage:com.demo.new\n",
			"cmd locale get-app-locales com.google.android.apps.bard --user 10": "Locales for com.google.android.apps.bard for user 10 are [zh-CN]\n",
			"cmd locale get-app-locales com.demo.new --user 10":                 "Locales for com.demo.new for user 10 are []\n",
		},
	}

	res, err := SyncSandboxAppPoliciesWithOpts(context.Background(), r, 10, PolicySyncOptions{
		DefaultLocale:       "ja-JP",
		PreserveUserLocales: true,
		LocaleOverrides: map[string]string{
			"com.demo.cleared": "",
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if res.LocalePreserved < 2 || res.LocaleApps < 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected bard + cleared preserved and com.demo.new set, got %+v", res)
	}
	joined := strings.Join(r.calls, "\n")
	if strings.Contains(joined, "cmd locale set-app-locales com.google.android.apps.bard") {
		t.Fatalf("must NEVER overwrite non-empty zh-CN Gemini locale:\n%s", joined)
	}
	if strings.Contains(joined, "cmd locale set-app-locales com.demo.cleared") {
		t.Fatalf("explicit empty override must suppress set-app-locales:\n%s", joined)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(joined, "cmd locale set-app-locales com.demo.new --user 10 --locales ja-JP") {
		t.Fatalf("expected unset com.demo.new to receive ja-JP:\n%s", joined)
	}

	// Error on get-app-locales when PreserveUserLocales=true must fail safe (do NOT overwrite).
	rErr := &sandboxRecRunner{
		out: map[string]string{
			"cmd package list packages -3 --user 10": "package:com.google.android.apps.bard\n",
		},
		err: map[string]error{
			"cmd locale get-app-locales com.google.android.apps.bard --user 10": os.ErrDeadlineExceeded,
		},
	}
	resErr, _ := SyncSandboxAppPoliciesWithOpts(context.Background(), rErr, 10, PolicySyncOptions{
		DefaultLocale:       "ja-JP",
		PreserveUserLocales: true,
	})
	if strings.Contains(strings.Join(rErr.calls, "\n"), "cmd locale set-app-locales com.google.android.apps.bard") {
		t.Fatalf("must NOT overwrite Gemini locale when get-app-locales errors:\n%s", strings.Join(rErr.calls, "\n"))
	}
	if len(resErr.Errors) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected get-app-locales failure recorded in res.Errors")
	}

	if _, err := SyncSandboxAppPoliciesWithOpts(context.Background(), r, 10, PolicySyncOptions{DefaultLocale: "ja-JP;rm -rf /"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("must reject invalid locale tag containing shell chars")
	}
}

func TestInstallSandboxAPKsStagesSplitAndCommits(t *testing.T) {

		t.Fatal(err)
	}

		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	r := &sandboxRecRunner{
		out: map[string]string{
			"pm install-create --user 10 -r": "Success: created install session [4242]\n",
			"pm install-commit 4242":         "Success\n",
		},
	}
```
