```go
// HandleRPC serves the whitelisted RPCs forwarded by sandbox_broker on guard.sock.
func (d *Daemon) HandleRPC(ctx context.Context, req contracts.RPCRequest) contracts.RPCResponse {
	switch req.Op {
	case contracts.OpGetStatus:
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}

	case contracts.OpImportExisting:
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		u := strconv.Itoa(policy.UserID)
		out, err := d.runner.Run(ctx, 15*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "install-existing", "--user", u, req.Pkg)
		if err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{"output": strings.TrimSpace(out)}}
		}
		d.invalidateLaunchCaches()
		hideRes, hideErr := android.SyncHideApps(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, policy.Serial)
		polRes, _ := d.syncPolicies(ctx, policy)
		data := map[string]any{
			"pkg":           req.Pkg,
			"user_id":       policy.UserID,
			"installed":     true,
			"output":        strings.TrimSpace(out),
			"hide_synced":   hideErr == nil,
			"hide_result":   hideRes,
			"policy_result": polRes,
		}
		if hideErr != nil {
			data["hide_warning"] = hideErr.Error()
		}
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: data}

	case contracts.OpInstallApk:
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		res, err := android.InstallSandboxAPKs(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, req.ApkPaths, d.apkStagingDirs)
		if err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		d.invalidateLaunchCaches()
		hideRes, hideErr := android.SyncHideApps(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, policy.Serial)
		polRes, _ := d.syncPolicies(ctx, policy)
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: map[string]any{
			"install":       res,
			"hide_synced":   hideErr == nil,
			"hide_result":   hideRes,
			"policy_result": polRes,
		}}

	case contracts.OpStartVPN:
		loaded, policy, err := d.setDesiredPaused(false, true, false)
		if err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		if policy.IsTProxy() {
			if err := d.startTProxySandbox(ctx, policy); err != nil {
				return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
			}
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
		}
		callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
		_ = android.EnsureWorkPermissions(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, callerPkg)
		if uid, err := android.WorkClientUID(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, callerPkg); err == nil {
			if pid, running, _ := android.FindWorkServicePID(uid, callerPkg); running {
				fs := inspectAnyFreeze(uid, pid)
				if fs.Frozen {
					_ = unfreezeAny(uid, pid, fs)
				}
			}
		}
		if _, err := d.runner.Run(ctx, 5*time.Second, "", "am", "start-foreground-service",
			"--user", strconv.Itoa(policy.UserID),
			"-a", callerPkg+".action.START_VPN",
			"-n", policy.EffectiveServiceComponent()); err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		_ = d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{clearAckBlock: true, invalidateID: true})
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}

	case contracts.OpPauseVPN:
		loaded, policy, err := d.setDesiredPaused(true, false, false)
		if err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		if perr := d.pauseSandboxWork(ctx, loaded, policy); perr != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: perr.Error(), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
		}
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}

	case contracts.OpReloadConfig:
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy, gen, pgen, lastVPN := d.policyLoaded, d.policy, d.lastGen, d.lastPendingGen, d.lastVPNStatus
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
		uid, err := android.WorkClientUID(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, callerPkg)
		if err != nil {
			if policy.IsTProxy() {
				uid = 0
			} else {
				return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
			}
		}
		cfgDir := d.workCfgDir
		if cfgDir == "" {
			cfgDir = contracts.WorkCfgDir
		}
		cfgPath := filepath.Join(cfgDir, fmt.Sprintf("u%d.pending.json", policy.UserID))
		quicMode := "reject"
		if lastVPN != nil && (lastVPN.QUICUDP443Mode == "allow" || lastVPN.QUICUDP443Mode == "reject") {
			quicMode = lastVPN.QUICUDP443Mode
		}
		if existing, err := readPendingConfig(cfgPath); err == nil {
			if existing.Generation > pgen {
				pgen = existing.Generation
			}
			if existing.QuicUDP443Mode == "allow" || existing.QuicUDP443Mode == "reject" {
				quicMode = existing.QuicUDP443Mode
			}
		}
		logLevel := "warning"
		if req.Config != nil {
			if req.Config.QuicUDP443Mode != "" {
				quicMode = req.Config.QuicUDP443Mode
			}
			if req.Config.LogLevel != "" {
				logLevel = req.Config.LogLevel
			}
		}
		if gen > pgen {
			pgen = gen
		}
		nextPendingGen := pgen + 1
		pending := contracts.PendingConfig{
			Version:        1,
			Generation:     nextPendingGen,
			TSMonoNs:       sysio.MonotonicNowNs(),
			MTU:            contracts.SandboxMTU,
			QuicUDP443Mode: quicMode,
			Overrides:      map[string]string{"log_level": logLevel},
		}
		b, err := json.Marshal(pending)
		if err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		if err := sysio.WriteAtomic(cfgPath, append(b, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{
			Perm:    0640,
			UID:     0,
			GID:     uid,
			SELinux: contracts.SELinuxCfgFile,
		}); err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.lastPendingGen = nextPendingGen
		paused := d.paused
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !paused {
			if policy.IsTProxy() {
				_ = d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{})
			} else {
				callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
				_, _ = d.runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "am", "start-foreground-service",
					"--user", strconv.Itoa(policy.UserID),
					"-a", callerPkg+".action.RELOAD_CONFIG",
					"-n", policy.EffectiveServiceComponent())
			}
		}
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: map[string]any{
			"config_path":      cfgPath,
			"generation":       pending.Generation,
			"mtu":              pending.MTU,
			"quic_udp443_mode": pending.QuicUDP443Mode,
		}}

	case contracts.OpSyncHideApps:
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		res, err := android.SyncHideApps(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, policy.Serial)
		if err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: res}

	case contracts.OpRunProbe:
		data, err := d.runOnDemandProbe(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: data}
		}
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: data}

	case contracts.OpLaunchApp:
		tTotal := time.Now()
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.wakeSeq++
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		wasPaused := d.paused
		curState := d.state
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		perf := d.getPerfConfig()
		var thawUs, restoreUs, reconcileUs int64
		fastPath := false

		if wasPaused || curState != StateOpen {
			if _, _, err := d.setDesiredPaused(false, true, false); err != nil {
				return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}}
			}
			if policy.IsTProxy() {
				var err error
				thawUs, restoreUs, reconcileUs, err = d.startTProxySandboxWithPriorityTraced(ctx, policy, req.Pkg)
				if err != nil {
					return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
				}
			} else {
				tRec := time.Now()
				if err := d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{clearAckBlock: true, invalidateID: true}); err != nil {
					return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
				}
				d.mu.Lock()
				opened := d.state == StateOpen
				lastErr := d.lastError
				curSt := d.state
				d.mu.Unlock()
				reconcileUs = time.Since(tRec).Microseconds()
				if !opened {
					msg := strings.TrimSpace(lastErr)
					if msg == "" {
						msg = fmt.Sprintf("sandbox gate did not open (state=%s)", curSt)
					}
					return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: msg, Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
				}
			}
		} else if policy.IsTProxy() {
			fastPath = true
			hibPath := d.resolvedHibernatedPath()
			if st := android.ReadHibernatedState(hibPath); len(st.Packages) > 0 || len(st.FrozenUIDs) > 0 {
				d.cancelMaintenance()
				d.lifecycleMu.Lock()
				var remaining []string
				if !d.isPaused() {
					_ = android.ThawAllUserCgroups(d.cgroupRoot, policy.UserID)
					tThaw := time.Now()
					lifeOpts := android.LifecycleOptions{
						CallerPackage:       policy.EffectiveCallerPackage(),
						AdminPackage:        policy.EffectiveAdminPackage(),
						PackagesListPath:    d.packagesListPath,
						CgroupRoot:          d.cgroupRoot,
						SkipAppOpsForFrozen: perf.SkipAppOpsForFrozen,
						SyncTargetOnly:      perf.SyncTargetOnly,
					}
					_, remaining, _ = android.RestoreHibernatedPriorityEx(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, hibPath, []string{req.Pkg}, lifeOpts)
					thawUs = time.Since(tThaw).Microseconds()
					restoreUs = thawUs
				}
				d.lifecycleMu.Unlock()
				if len(remaining) > 0 && !d.isPaused() {
					d.scheduleMaintenance(policy, true)
				}
			} else if !d.isPaused() {
				d.lifecycleMu.Lock()
				if !d.isPaused() {
					_ = android.ThawAllUserCgroups(d.cgroupRoot, policy.UserID)
				}
				d.lifecycleMu.Unlock()
			}
		} else {
			fastPath = true
		}

		pkgList := contracts.PackagesListPath
		if d.packagesListPath != "" {
			pkgList = d.packagesListPath
		}
		if perf.LaunchBoostMs > 0 && req.Pkg != "" {
			if targetUID := ResolvePackageUIDForUser(pkgList, policy.UserID, req.Pkg); targetUID > 0 {
				_ = android.BoostUIDLaunch(d.cgroupRoot, targetUID, time.Duration(perf.LaunchBoostMs)*time.Millisecond)
			}
		}
		if !fastPath && req.Pkg != "" && d.runner != nil {
			d.mu.Lock()
			shuttingDown := d.shuttingDown
			parentCtx := d.superviseCtx
			if !shuttingDown {
				d.maintWg.Add(1)
			}
			d.mu.Unlock()
			if !shuttingDown {
				if parentCtx == nil {
					parentCtx = context.Background()
				}
				go func(targetPkg string, userID int) {
					defer d.maintWg.Done()
					pctx, pcancel := context.WithTimeout(parentCtx, 8*time.Second)
					defer pcancel()
					android.PrewarmSandboxAppCodePath(pctx, d.runner, userID, targetPkg)
				}(req.Pkg, policy.UserID)
			}
		}

		tLaunch := time.Now()
		var launchErr error
		if req.Activity != "" {
			launchErr = android.LaunchSandboxAppAsRoot(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, req.Pkg, req.Activity)
		} else {
			handledCompanion := false
			if req.Pkg != "" {
				var fallbackErr error
				handledCompanion, fallbackErr = android.LaunchViaCompanionFallbackIfHostStopped(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, req.Pkg)
				if handledCompanion {
					launchErr = fallbackErr
				}
			}
			if !handledCompanion {
				if cachedComp := d.cachedLauncher(req.Pkg); cachedComp != "" {
					launchErr = android.LaunchComponentAsRoot(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, cachedComp)
					if launchErr != nil {
						d.evictCachedLauncher(req.Pkg)
						d.mu.Lock()
						d.userUnlockedBoot = false
						d.mu.Unlock()
						timeout := d.userWakeTimeout
						if timeout <= 0 {
							timeout = 5 * time.Second
						}
						if uerr := android.StartSandboxUserAndWait(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, timeout); uerr == nil {
							d.mu.Lock()
							d.userUnlockedBoot = true
							d.mu.Unlock()
						}
						if resolved, rerr := android.ResolveLauncherComponent(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, req.Pkg); rerr == nil {
							if launchErr = android.LaunchComponentAsRoot(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, resolved); launchErr == nil {
								d.setCachedLauncher(req.Pkg, resolved)
							}
						} else {
							launchErr = rerr
						}
					}
				} else {
					if resolved, rerr := android.ResolveLauncherComponent(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, req.Pkg); rerr == nil {
						if launchErr = android.LaunchComponentAsRoot(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, resolved); launchErr == nil {
							d.setCachedLauncher(req.Pkg, resolved)
						}
					} else {
						launchErr = rerr
					}
				}
			}
		}
		launchUs := time.Since(tLaunch).Microseconds()
		if launchErr != nil {
			d.mu.Lock()
			d.userUnlockedBoot = false
			d.mu.Unlock()
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: launchErr.Error(), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
		}
		d.recordLaunchTrace(LaunchTrace{
			Op:          contracts.OpLaunchApp,
			Pkg:         req.Pkg,
			ThawUs:      thawUs,
			RestoreUs:   restoreUs,
			ReconcileUs: reconcileUs,
			LaunchUs:    launchUs,
			TotalUs:     time.Since(tTotal).Microseconds(),
			FastPath:    fastPath,
			Timestamp:   time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
		})
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}

	case contracts.OpStopApp:
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		if req.Pkg == policy.EffectiveAdminPackage() {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: fmt.Sprintf("refusing to force-stop profile owner package %s", req.Pkg), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
		}
		if err := android.StopSandboxApp(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, req.Pkg, policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()); err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
		}
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}

	case contracts.OpRemoveApp:
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "policy not pinned", Data: map[string]any{}}
		}
		if req.Pkg == policy.EffectiveAdminPackage() {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: fmt.Sprintf("refusing to remove profile owner package %s", req.Pkg), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
		}
		if _, err := android.RemoveSandboxApp(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, req.Pkg, policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()); err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}
		}
		d.invalidateLaunchCaches()
		_, _ = android.SyncHideApps(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, policy.Serial)
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: true, Error: "", Data: d.buildStatusData(ctx)}

	default:
		return contracts.RPCResponse{ID: req.ID, OK: false, Error: "unsupported op", Data: map[string]any{}}
	}
}

func (d *Daemon) HandleCtl(ctx context.Context, cmd string, args []string) (string, error) {
	switch cmd {
	case "upgrade-begin":
		ttl := contracts.DefaultUpgradeTTLSeconds
		if len(args) > 0 {
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(args[0])
			if err != nil || v <= 0 || v > contracts.MaxUpgradeTTLSeconds {
				return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid ttl %q", args[0])
			}
			ttl = v
		}
		fence := contracts.UpgradeFence{
			BootID:      d.bootID,
			Active:      true,
			UntilMonoNs: sysio.MonotonicNowNs() + int64(ttl)*int64(time.Second),
			TTLSeconds:  ttl,
		}
		fencePath := d.upgradeFencePath
		if fencePath == "" {
			fencePath = contracts.UpgradeFencePath
		}
		ackPath := d.sandboxAckPath
		if ackPath == "" {
			d.mu.Lock()
			hasPol, pol := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
			d.mu.Unlock()
			if hasPol {
				ackPath = pol.EffectiveProxyAckPath()
			} else {
				ackPath = contracts.SandboxAckPath
			}
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(fence)
		_ = sysio.WriteAtomic(fencePath, append(b, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0})
		_ = removeIfExist(ackPath)
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.fence = fence
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if err := d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{}); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("upgrading fence active ttl=%ds", ttl), nil

	case "upgrade-end":
		fencePath := d.upgradeFencePath
		if fencePath == "" {
			fencePath = contracts.UpgradeFencePath
		}
		_ = removeIfExist(fencePath)
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.fence = contracts.UpgradeFence{}
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if err := d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{clearAckBlock: true}); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return "upgrading fence cleared", nil

	case "reload-policy":
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("reload-policy: %w", err)
		}
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.policy = p
		d.policyLoaded = true
		d.cachedID = nil
		d.mu.Unlock()
		d.invalidateStatusCaches()
		d.applyPolicyNetfilterLock(p)
		if w := d.getWatchers(); w != nil && d.sandboxAckPath == "" {
			w.EnsureProxyBaseWatch(filepath.Dir(p.EffectiveProxyAckPath()))
		}
		if err := d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{clearAckBlock: true, invalidateID: true, refreshCert: true, syncHide: true}); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return "reloaded", nil

	case "status":
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(d.buildStatusData(ctx), "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return string(b), nil

	case "sync-hide":
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return "", errors.New("policy not pinned")
		}
		res, err := android.SyncHideApps(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, policy.Serial)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(res)
		return string(b), nil

	case "sync-policies":
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return "", errors.New("policy not pinned")
		}
		res, err := d.syncPolicies(ctx, policy)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(res)
		return string(b), nil

	case "perf-status":
		perf := d.getPerfConfig()
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(perf, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return string(b), nil

	case "perf-trace":
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(d.getLaunchTraces(), "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return string(b), nil

	case "prune-bloat":
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return "", errors.New("policy not pinned")
		}
		res, err := android.PruneSandboxBloat(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, d.resolvedPrunedPath(), policy.EffectiveCallerPackage(), policy.EffectiveAdminPackage())
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.bloatPrunedOnce = true
		d.mu.Unlock()
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(res, "", "  ")
		return string(b), nil

	case "restore-bloat":
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return "", errors.New("policy not pinned")
		}
		res, err := android.RestoreSandboxBloat(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, d.resolvedPrunedPath())
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.bloatPrunedOnce = false
		d.mu.Unlock()
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(res, "", "  ")
		return string(b), nil

	case "flush-sandbox-conns":
		perf := d.getPerfConfig()
		d.mu.Lock()
		pol := d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		inbound := d.resolvedInboundName(perf, pol)
		n, err := FlushSandboxConnections(ctx, d.resolvedMainConfigPath(pol), inbound)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"inbound": inbound, "closed": n})
		return string(b), nil

	case "set-app-locale":
		if len(args) != 2 {
			return "", errors.New("usage: set-app-locale <package> <locale|clear>")
		}
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return "", errors.New("policy not pinned")
		}
		pkg, loc := args[0], args[1]
		if err := android.SetSandboxAppLocale(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, pkg, loc, policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		perf := LoadPerfConfig(d.resolvedPerfPath())
		if perf.LocaleOverrides == nil {
			perf.LocaleOverrides = map[string]string{}
		}
		if strings.EqualFold(loc, "clear") || strings.EqualFold(loc, "none") {
			perf.LocaleOverrides[pkg] = ""
		} else {
			perf.LocaleOverrides[pkg] = loc
		}
		_ = WritePerfConfig(d.resolvedPerfPath(), perf)
		d.setPerfConfig(perf)
		b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"user_id": policy.UserID, "package": pkg, "locale": perf.LocaleOverrides[pkg]})
		return string(b), nil

	case "install-apk":
		if len(args) == 0 {
			return "", errors.New("install-apk requires at least 1 apk path")
		}
		for _, p := range args {
			if len(d.apkStagingDirs) == 0 && !rpc.IsSafeAPKPath(p) {
				return "", fmt.Errorf("unsafe apk path %q", p)
			}
		}
		d.mu.Lock()
		loaded, policy := d.policyLoaded, d.policy
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if !loaded {
			return "", errors.New("policy not pinned")
		}
		res, err := android.InstallSandboxAPKs(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, args, d.apkStagingDirs)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		d.invalidateLaunchCaches()
		_, _ = android.SyncHideApps(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, policy.Serial)
		_, _ = d.syncPolicies(ctx, policy)
		b, _ := json.Marshal(res)
		return string(b), nil

	case "stealth-status":
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(d.ReadStealthStatus(), "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return string(b), nil

	case "variant-info":
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(buildinfo.Current(), "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return string(b), nil

	case "preset-apply":
		if len(args) != 1 {
			return "", errors.New("usage: preset-apply <preset.json>")
		}
		cfg, err := d.ApplyPresetFile(ctx, args[0])
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return string(b), nil

	case "stealth-toggle":
		if len(args) != 1 || (args[0] != "on" && args[0] != "off") {
			return "", errors.New("usage: stealth-toggle on|off")
		}
		cfg, err := d.ToggleStealth(args[0] == "on")
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
		return string(b), nil

	case "block", "pause-sandbox", "pause-hot":
		loaded, policy, err := d.setDesiredPaused(true, false, true)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if cmd == "pause-hot" {
			if err := d.pauseSandboxWorkWithExplicitMode(ctx, loaded, policy, false, PauseModeHot); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			return "hot-paused", nil
		}
		if cmd == "pause-sandbox" {
			if err := d.pauseSandboxWork(ctx, loaded, policy); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			return "paused", nil
		}
		if err := d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{clearAckBlock: true}); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return "blocked", nil

	case "start-sandbox":
		loaded, policy, err := d.setDesiredPaused(false, true, false)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if !loaded {
			return "", errors.New("policy not pinned")
		}
		if policy.IsTProxy() {
			if err := d.startTProxySandbox(ctx, policy); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			return "started", nil
		}
		if err := d.requestReconcile(ctx, reconcileReq{clearAckBlock: true, invalidateID: true}); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return "started", nil

	default:
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown ctl command %q", cmd)
	}
}

func (d *Daemon) getPrivateDNSMode(ctx context.Context, forceFresh bool) string {
	if !forceFresh {
		d.mu.Lock()
		fresh := !d.cachedPrivateDNSAt.IsZero() && time.Since(d.cachedPrivateDNSAt) < 15*time.Second
		cached := d.cachedPrivateDNS
		d.mu.Unlock()
		if fresh {
			return cached
		}
	}
	privDNS, err := d.runner.Run(ctx, 2*time.Second, "", "settings", "get", "global", "private_dns_mode")
	privDNS = strings.TrimSpace(privDNS)
	if err == nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
		d.mu.Lock()
		d.cachedPrivateDNS = privDNS
		d.cachedPrivateDNSAt = time.Now()
		d.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return privDNS
}

func (d *Daemon) buildStatusData(ctx context.Context) map[string]any {
	return d.buildStatusDataEx(ctx, false)
}

func (d *Daemon) buildStatusDataEx(ctx context.Context, forceFresh bool) map[string]any {
	d.mu.Lock()
	state := d.state
	paused := d.paused
	loaded := d.policyLoaded
	policy := d.policy
	fence := d.fence
	curEx := d.currentExemption
	sess := d.lastSession
	rawArmed := d.lastRawArmed
	openGate := d.lastOpen
	lastErr := d.lastError
	bootAlert := d.bootAlert
	d.mu.Unlock()

	var vpnStatus *contracts.VPNStatus
	var frozen bool
	var freezeEvidence string
	stuckWork, crossPool := 0, 0

	if loaded {
		callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
		uidStart, uidEnd := policy.UIDRange()
		stuckWork, crossPool = CountStuckWorkSockets(uidStart, uidEnd)
		if !policy.IsTProxy() {
			if cid, err := android.WorkClientUID(ctx, d.runner, policy.UserID, callerPkg); err == nil {
				vpnStatus, _ = d.readWorkVPNStatus(policy.UserID, cid, callerPkg)
				if pid, alive, _ := android.FindWorkServicePID(cid, callerPkg); alive {
					fs := inspectAnyFreeze(cid, pid)
					frozen = fs.Frozen
					freezeEvidence = fs.Evidence
				}
			}
		}
	}

	var privDNS string
	var apps []string
	var appsErr error
	var fetchWg sync.WaitGroup
	fetchWg.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer fetchWg.Done()
		privDNS = d.getPrivateDNSMode(ctx, forceFresh)
	}()
	if loaded {
		fetchWg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer fetchWg.Done()
			apps, appsErr = d.getSandboxAppsForPolicy(ctx, policy, forceFresh)
		}()
	}
	fetchWg.Wait()

	_, _, disabledFlag := d.resolvedStealthPaths()
	_, flagErr := os.Stat(disabledFlag)
	zygiskDisabled := flagErr == nil
	stealthTries := 0
	if raw, err := os.ReadFile(d.resolvedStealthBootTriesPath()); err == nil {
		if n, perr := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))); perr == nil && n >= 0 {
			stealthTries = n
		}
	}

	data := map[string]any{
		"version":              contracts.Version,
		"variant":              buildinfo.Current(),
		"state":                string(state),
		"paused":               paused,
		"boot_id":              d.bootID,
		"policy_loaded":        loaded,
		"user_id":              policy.UserID,
		"serial":               policy.Serial,
		"main_upgrading":       FenceActive(fence, d.bootID, sysio.MonotonicNowNs()),
		"sbw_raw_armed":        rawArmed,
		"sbw_open":             openGate,
		"frozen":               frozen,
		"freeze_evidence":      freezeEvidence,
		"zygisk_disabled":      zygiskDisabled,
		"active_preset":        d.readActivePresetName(),
		"stealth_boot_tries":   stealthTries,
		"private_dns_mode":     privDNS,
		"private_dns_warning":  privDNS == "hostname",
		"stuck_work_sockets":   stuckWork,
		"cross_pool_12c6_hits": crossPool,
		"last_error":           lastErr,
		"boot_alert":           bootAlert,
	}
	if curEx != nil {
		data["exemption"] = curEx
	}
	if ack := d.readCurrentAck(policy); ack != nil {
		data["sandbox_ack"] = ack
	}
	if sess != nil {
		data["session"] = sess
	}
	pendingCfg := d.resolvePendingConfig(loaded, policy, vpnStatus)
	perfCfg := d.getPerfConfig()
	if vpnStatus != nil {
		data["vpn_status"] = vpnStatus
	} else if loaded && policy.IsTProxy() {
		tproxyOK := d.tproxyReady(policy)
		data["mode"] = contracts.ModeTProxy
		data["tproxy_port"] = policy.TProxyPort
		data["tproxy_ready"] = tproxyOK
		quicModeStr := "allow"
		if perfCfg.KernelRejectQuicUDP443 {
			quicModeStr = "reject"
		}
		if qm, ok := pendingCfg["quic_udp443_mode"].(string); ok && qm == "allow" {
			quicModeStr = "allow"
		}
		data["vpn_status"] = map[string]any{
			"running":          openGate,
			"exit_ip":          policy.EndpointV4,
			"mtu":              1500,
			"quic_udp443_mode": quicModeStr,
		}
	}
	data["perf"] = perfCfg
	data["pending_config"] = pendingCfg
	if loaded {
		data["u10_running_procs"] = android.CountRunningUserProcessesWithRoot(d.cgroupRoot, policy.UserID)
		hib := android.ReadHibernatedState(d.resolvedHibernatedPath())
		data["hibernated_count"] = len(hib.Packages)
		data["hot_frozen"] = hib.HotFrozen
		if hib.FrozenUIDs != nil {
			data["frozen_uids"] = hib.FrozenUIDs
		} else {
			data["frozen_uids"] = []int{}
		}
		if appsErr == nil && apps != nil {
			data["sandbox_apps"] = apps
		} else {
			data["sandbox_apps"] = []string{}
		}
	}
	if traces := d.getLaunchTraces(); len(traces) > 0 {
		data["last_launch_trace"] = traces[len(traces)-1]
	}
	return data
}

func (d *Daemon) tproxyReady(policy contracts.Policy) bool {
	if d.probeTProxyReady != nil {
		return d.probeTProxyReady(policy.TProxyPort)
	}
	return android.TProxyReadyProbe(policy.TProxyPort, policy.EffectiveProxyCorePIDPath(), policy.ProxyCoreProcess)
}

func readPendingConfig(path string) (contracts.PendingConfig, error) {
	raw, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFilePerm(path, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes, 0037)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.PendingConfig{}, err
	}
	var cfg contracts.PendingConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cfg); err != nil {
		return contracts.PendingConfig{}, err
	}
	return cfg, nil
}

func (d *Daemon) resolvePendingConfig(loaded bool, policy contracts.Policy, vpnStatus *contracts.VPNStatus) map[string]any {
	mtu := contracts.SandboxMTU
	quicMode := "reject"
	var gen uint64

	if vpnStatus != nil {
		if vpnStatus.MTU > 0 {
			mtu = vpnStatus.MTU
		}
		if vpnStatus.QUICUDP443Mode == "allow" || vpnStatus.QUICUDP443Mode == "reject" {
			quicMode = vpnStatus.QUICUDP443Mode
		}
		if vpnStatus.ConfigGeneration > 0 {
			gen = uint64(vpnStatus.ConfigGeneration)
		}
	}

	if loaded {
		cfgDir := d.workCfgDir
		if cfgDir == "" {
			cfgDir = contracts.WorkCfgDir
		}
		cfgPath := filepath.Join(cfgDir, fmt.Sprintf("u%d.pending.json", policy.UserID))
		if pending, err := readPendingConfig(cfgPath); err == nil {
			if pending.Generation >= gen {
				if pending.MTU > 0 {
					mtu = pending.MTU
				}
				if pending.QuicUDP443Mode == "allow" || pending.QuicUDP443Mode == "reject" {
					quicMode = pending.QuicUDP443Mode
				}
				if pending.Generation > 0 {
					gen = pending.Generation
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return map[string]any{
		"mtu":              mtu,
		"quic_udp443_mode": quicMode,
		"generation":       gen,
	}
}

func ParseInstrumentationResult(output string) (map[string]any, error) {
	hasSuccessCode := false
	var networkJSON string
	for _, raw := range strings.Split(output, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
		if line == "INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1" {
			hasSuccessCode = true
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT: network=") {
			networkJSON = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT: network="))
		} else if networkJSON == "" {
			if idx := strings.Index(line, "network={"); idx >= 0 {
				networkJSON = strings.TrimSpace(line[idx+len("network="):])
			}
		}
	}
	if !hasSuccessCode {
		return nil, errors.New("am instrument did not return INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1")
	}
	if networkJSON == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("am instrument missing INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT network JSON")
	}
	var parsed map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(networkJSON), &parsed); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("am instrument invalid network JSON: %w", err)
	}
	return parsed, nil
}

func (d *Daemon) runOnDemandProbe(ctx context.Context) (map[string]any, error) {
	res := d.buildStatusDataEx(ctx, true)
	d.mu.Lock()
	loaded, policy, sess := d.policyLoaded, d.policy, d.lastSession
	d.mu.Unlock()
	if !loaded {
		return res, errors.New("policy not pinned")
	}
	routeChecks := map[string]any{}
	if sess != nil {
		innerUID := policy.UserID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + contracts.MinAppID
		if innerUID == sess.ClientUID {
			innerUID++
		}
		routeChecks["fakeip_198_19"] = android.CheckWorkRoute(ctx, d.runner, contracts.FakeIPProbe, innerUID, sess.UplinkNetID, sess.TunIf) == nil
		if policy.EndpointV4 != "" {
			outerMark := sess.UplinkNetID | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit | contracts.ExplicitNetworkBit
			routeChecks["outer_endpoint"] = android.CheckWorkRoute(ctx, d.runner, policy.EndpointV4, sess.ClientUID, outerMark, sess.UplinkIf) == nil
		}
		dnsMark := sess.VPNNetID | contracts.ExplicitNetworkBit | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit | contracts.SystemPermission
		routeChecks["portal_dns4"] = android.CheckWorkRoute(ctx, d.runner, policy.PortalDNS4, 1051, dnsMark, sess.TunIf) == nil
	}
	res["route_checks"] = routeChecks

	// If independent probe APK is installed in the sandbox user, run it on demand.
	u := strconv.Itoa(policy.UserID)
	pkgs, err := d.runner.Run(ctx, 3*time.Second, "", "cmd", "package", "list", "packages", "--user", u, contracts.VerifyProbePackage)
	if err == nil && strings.Contains(pkgs, "package:"+contracts.VerifyProbePackage) {
		res["probe_apk_installed"] = true
		out, ierr := d.runner.Run(ctx, 20*time.Second, "", "am", "instrument", "-w", "-r", "--user", u,
			"-e", "compact", "true", contracts.VerifyProbePackage+"/.NetworkProbe")
		if ierr != nil {
			res["instrument_output"] = strings.TrimSpace(out)
			res["instrument_ok"] = false
			return res, fmt.Errorf("am instrument failed: %w", ierr)
		}
		parsed, perr := ParseInstrumentationResult(out)
		if perr != nil {
			res["instrument_output"] = strings.TrimSpace(out)
			res["instrument_ok"] = false
			return res, perr
		}
		res["instrument_ok"] = true
		res["probe_result"] = parsed
	} else {
		res["probe_apk_installed"] = false
	}
	return res, nil
}

// CountStuckWorkSockets scans /proc/net/tcp for SYN_SENT (state 02) sockets owned by [uidStart..uidEnd]
// targeting sandbox Fake-IP 198.19.x.x (little-endian ....13C6:) or cross-pool 198.18.x.x (....12C6:).
func CountStuckWorkSockets(uidStart, uidEnd int) (work13C6 int, cross12C6 int) {
	f, err := os.Open(contracts.ProcNetTCP)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0
	}
	defer f.Close()
	return CountStuckSocketsFromReader(bufio.NewScanner(f), uidStart, uidEnd)
}

func CountStuckSocketsFromReader(sc *bufio.Scanner, uidStart, uidEnd int) (work13C6 int, cross12C6 int) {
	sc.Scan() // header
	for sc.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(sc.Text())
		if len(fields) < 8 {
			continue
		}
		if fields[3] != "02" {
			continue
		}
		uid, err := strconv.Atoi(fields[7])
		if err != nil || uid < uidStart || uid > uidEnd {
			continue
		}
		addr := strings.ToUpper(fields[2])
		ipHex, _, ok := strings.Cut(addr, ":")
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case strings.HasSuffix(ipHex, "13C6"):
			work13C6++
		case strings.HasSuffix(ipHex, "12C6"):
			cross12C6++
		}
	}
	return work13C6, cross12C6
}

func ensureDevDirs() {
	dirs := []struct {
		path string
		perm os.FileMode
		ctx  string
	}{
		{contracts.BrokerSockDir, 0711, contracts.SELinuxSockDir},
		{contracts.PrivDir, 0700, contracts.SELinuxPrivDir},
		{contracts.WorkCfgDir, 0711, contracts.SELinuxCfgDir},
	}
	for _, d := range dirs {
		_ = os.MkdirAll(d.path, d.perm)
		_ = os.Chmod(d.path, d.perm)
		_ = os.Chown(d.path, 0, 0)
		_ = sysio.Lsetfilecon(d.path, d.ctx)
	}
}

func removeIfExist(path string) error {
	if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// RunCtl executes `sandbox_guard ctl <subcmd> [args...]`.
func isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return false
	}
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) || errors.Is(err, syscall.ENOENT) || errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) {
		return true
	}
	var opErr *net.OpError
	return errors.As(err, &opErr) && opErr.Op == "dial"
}

func RunCtl(args []string) error {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		return errors.New("missing ctl subcommand")
	}
	sub := args[0]
	rest := args[1:]
	ctlTimeout := 35 * time.Second
	if sub == "install-apk" {
		ctlTimeout = 120 * time.Second
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), ctlTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	runner := netfilter.ExecRunner{}
	nf := netfilter.NewController()

	switch sub {
	case "boot":
		ensureDevDirs()
		_ = removeIfExist(contracts.SandboxAckPath)
		bootID, err := sysio.ReadBootID()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if f, err := ReadUpgradeFence(bootID); err != nil || !f.Active {
			_ = removeIfExist(contracts.UpgradeFencePath)
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Println("unpinned")
			return nil
		}
		nf.LockPath = p.EffectiveNetfilterLockPath()
		_ = removeIfExist(p.EffectiveProxyAckPath())
		exPath := p.EffectiveExemptionPath()
		var gen uint64 = 1
		prevClientUID := 0
		if prev, err := ReadExemption(exPath); err == nil {
			if prev.Generation >= 1 {
				gen = prev.Generation + 1
			}
			if contracts.ValidClientUID(p.UserID, prev.ClientUID) {
				prevClientUID = prev.ClientUID
			}
		}
		ex := BuildBlockedExemption(p, bootID, prevClientUID, gen)
		if b, err := json.Marshal(ex); err == nil {
			_ = sysio.WriteAtomic(exPath, append(b, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0})
		}
		_ = SyncPerfConfig(contracts.PerfConfigPath)
		bootD := &Daemon{}
		_, _ = bootD.SyncStealthConfig(p, prevClientUID)
		extCap, derr := nf.DetectProxyCapture(ctx, p.ProxySkipPrefix)
		if derr != nil && p.ProxySkipPrefix != "" {
			extCap = true
		}
		spec := closedGateSpec(p, extCap)
		if err := nf.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, spec, false); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Printf("blocked user=%d serial=%d gen=%d\n", p.UserID, p.Serial, gen)
		return nil

	case "upgrade-begin":
		ttl := contracts.DefaultUpgradeTTLSeconds
		if len(rest) > 0 {
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(rest[0])
			if err != nil || v <= 0 || v > contracts.MaxUpgradeTTLSeconds {
				return fmt.Errorf("invalid ttl %q", rest[0])
			}
			ttl = v
		}
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "upgrade-begin", strconv.Itoa(ttl))
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		bootID, err := sysio.ReadBootID()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fence := contracts.UpgradeFence{
			BootID: bootID, Active: true,
			UntilMonoNs: sysio.MonotonicNowNs() + int64(ttl)*int64(time.Second),
			TTLSeconds:  ttl,
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(fence)
		_ = sysio.WriteAtomic(contracts.UpgradeFencePath, append(b, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0})
		_ = removeIfExist(contracts.SandboxAckPath)
		if p, err := ReadPolicy(); err == nil {
			nf.LockPath = p.EffectiveNetfilterLockPath()
			_ = removeIfExist(p.EffectiveProxyAckPath())
			spec := closedGateSpec(p, true)
			if err := nf.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, spec, false); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		fmt.Printf("upgrading fence active ttl=%ds (offline)\n", ttl)
		return nil

	case "upgrade-end":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "upgrade-end")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		_ = removeIfExist(contracts.UpgradeFencePath)
		if p, err := ReadPolicy(); err == nil {
			nf.LockPath = p.EffectiveNetfilterLockPath()
			extCap, derr := nf.DetectProxyCapture(ctx, p.ProxySkipPrefix)
		if derr != nil && p.ProxySkipPrefix != "" {
			extCap = true
		}
			_ = nf.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, closedGateSpec(p, extCap), false)
		}
		fmt.Println("upgrading fence cleared (offline)")
		return nil

	case "bootstrap-pin":
		fs := flag.NewFlagSet("bootstrap-pin", flag.ContinueOnError)
		userFlag := fs.Int("user", 0, "work profile user id")
		serialFlag := fs.Int("serial", 0, "work profile serial")
		pkgFlag := fs.String("pkg", contracts.DefaultWorkPackage, "controller package name")
		adminFlag := fs.String("admin", "", "explicit DPC admin component pkg/class")
		serviceFlag := fs.String("service", "", "explicit VPN service component pkg/class")
		apkFlag := fs.String("apk", "", "explicit base.apk path")
		certFlag := fs.String("cert", "", "explicit sha256 cert")
		modeFlag := fs.String("mode", "", "sandbox transport mode: tproxy|vpn (default: keep pinned mode, else tproxy)")
		tpPortFlag := fs.Int("tproxy-port", 0, "tproxy port (default 1537)")
		tpMarkFlag := fs.Uint("tproxy-mark", 0, "tproxy fwmark (default 0x1a)")
		endpointFlag := fs.String("endpoint", "", "optional pinned IPv4 endpoint for VPN mode")
		endpointPortFlag := fs.Int("endpoint-port", contracts.EndpointPort, "endpoint port for VPN mode")
		portalDNSFlag := fs.String("portal-dns", contracts.PortalDNS4, "portal DNSv4 inside sandbox")
		proxyDirFlag := fs.String("proxy-dir", "", "optional external proxy base dir")
		proxyCtlFlag := fs.String("proxy-ctl", "", "optional external proxy control script path")
		proxyConfigFlag := fs.String("proxy-config", "", "optional external proxy config.json path")
		proxyAckFlag := fs.String("proxy-ack", "", "optional external proxy ack file path")
		proxyPidFlag := fs.String("proxy-pid", "", "optional external proxy core.pid path")
		proxyInboundFlag := fs.String("proxy-inbound", "", "optional external proxy inbound name")
		proxyProcessFlag := fs.String("proxy-process", "", "optional external proxy core process name")
		proxySkipFlag := fs.String("proxy-skip-prefix", "", "optional external proxy iptables chain prefix")
		proxyExemptionFlag := fs.String("proxy-exemption", "", "optional external proxy exemption.v1.json path")
		proxyLockFlag := fs.String("proxy-lock", "", "optional external proxy netfilter flock path")
		if err := fs.Parse(rest); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		userID, serial := *userFlag, *serialFlag
		if userID == 0 || serial == 0 {
			prof, err := android.DiscoverManagedProfile(ctx, runner)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if userID == 0 {
				userID = prof.UserID
			}
			if serial == 0 {
				serial = prof.Serial
			}
		}
		if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) || serial <= 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid profile user=%d serial=%d", userID, serial)
		}
		pkg := strings.TrimSpace(*pkgFlag)
		if pkg == "" {
			pkg = contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
		}
		u0UID, discoveredAPK, err := android.DiscoverUser0Package(ctx, runner, pkg)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		apkPath := discoveredAPK
		if *apkFlag != "" {
			apkPath = *apkFlag
		}
		certSHA := *certFlag
		if certSHA == "" {
			certSHA, err = apkcert.ExtractPrimaryCertSHA256(apkPath)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		policy := contracts.Policy{
			UserID:                 userID,
			Serial:                 serial,
			CallerPackage:          pkg,
			CallerCertSHA256:       certSHA,
			AdminComponent:         strings.TrimSpace(*adminFlag),
			ServiceComponent:       strings.TrimSpace(*serviceFlag),
			PortalDNS4:             strings.TrimSpace(*portalDNSFlag),
			EndpointV4:             strings.TrimSpace(*endpointFlag),
			EndpointPort:           *endpointPortFlag,
			IPv6Enabled:            false,
			Mode:                   *modeFlag,
			TProxyPort:             *tpPortFlag,
			TProxyMark:             uint32(*tpMarkFlag),
			ProxyBaseDir:           strings.TrimSpace(*proxyDirFlag),
			ProxyCtlScript:         strings.TrimSpace(*proxyCtlFlag),
			ProxyConfigPath:        strings.TrimSpace(*proxyConfigFlag),
			ProxyAckPath:           strings.TrimSpace(*proxyAckFlag),
			ProxyCorePIDPath:       strings.TrimSpace(*proxyPidFlag),
			ProxyInboundName:       strings.TrimSpace(*proxyInboundFlag),
			ProxyCoreProcess:       strings.TrimSpace(*proxyProcessFlag),
			ProxySkipPrefix:        strings.TrimSpace(*proxySkipFlag),
			ProxyExemptionPath:     strings.TrimSpace(*proxyExemptionFlag),
			ProxyNetfilterLockPath: strings.TrimSpace(*proxyLockFlag),
		}
		if prev, perr := ReadPolicy(); perr == nil {
			if policy.Mode == "" {
				policy.Mode = prev.Mode
			}
			if policy.TProxyPort == 0 {
				policy.TProxyPort = prev.TProxyPort
			}
			if policy.TProxyMark == 0 {
				policy.TProxyMark = prev.TProxyMark
			}
			if policy.ProxyBaseDir == "" {
				policy.ProxyBaseDir = prev.ProxyBaseDir
			}
			if policy.ProxyCtlScript == "" {
				policy.ProxyCtlScript = prev.ProxyCtlScript
			}
			if policy.ProxyConfigPath == "" {
				policy.ProxyConfigPath = prev.ProxyConfigPath
			}
			if policy.ProxyAckPath == "" {
				policy.ProxyAckPath = prev.ProxyAckPath
			}
			if policy.ProxyCorePIDPath == "" {
				policy.ProxyCorePIDPath = prev.ProxyCorePIDPath
			}
			if policy.ProxyInboundName == "" {
				policy.ProxyInboundName = prev.ProxyInboundName
			}
			if policy.ProxyCoreProcess == "" {
				policy.ProxyCoreProcess = prev.ProxyCoreProcess
			}
			if policy.ProxySkipPrefix == "" {
				policy.ProxySkipPrefix = prev.ProxySkipPrefix
			}
			if policy.ProxyExemptionPath == "" {
				policy.ProxyExemptionPath = prev.ProxyExemptionPath
			}
			if policy.ProxyNetfilterLockPath == "" {
				policy.ProxyNetfilterLockPath = prev.ProxyNetfilterLockPath
			}
		}
		if policy.Mode == "" {
			policy.Mode = contracts.ModeTProxy
		}
		if policy.Mode == contracts.ModeVPN {
			policy.TProxyPort, policy.TProxyMark = 0, 0
		}
		if err := policy.NormalizeAndValidate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		pb, _ := json.MarshalIndent(policy, "", "  ")
		if err := sysio.WriteAtomic(contracts.PolicyPath, append(pb, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		ensureDevDirs()
		ab, _ := json.Marshal(contracts.BrokerAuth{AllowedUser0UID: u0UID})
		_ = sysio.WriteAtomic(contracts.BrokerAuthPath, append(ab, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{
			Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0, SELinux: contracts.SELinuxPrivFile,
		})
		_, _ = rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "reload-policy")
		fmt.Println(string(pb))
		return nil

	case "variant-info":
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(buildinfo.Current(), "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "reload-policy":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "reload-policy")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Println(out)
		return nil

	case "preset-apply":
		if len(rest) != 1 {
			return errors.New("usage: preset-apply <preset.json>")
		}
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "preset-apply", rest[0])
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		dOff := &Daemon{
			runner:               runner,
			stealthConfigPath:    contracts.StealthConfigPath,
			stealthRuntimePath:   contracts.StealthRuntimePath,
			zygiskDisabledFlag:   contracts.ZygiskDisabledFlag,
			stealthBootTriesPath: contracts.StealthBootTriesPath,
		}
		if p, err := ReadPolicy(); err == nil {
			dOff.policy = p
			dOff.policyLoaded = true
		}
		cfg, err := dOff.ApplyPresetFile(ctx, rest[0])
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "status":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "status")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		bootID, _ := sysio.ReadBootID()
		uidStart, uidEnd := p.UIDRange()
		spec := netfilter.GateSpec{
			UserID: p.UserID, UIDStart: uidStart, UIDEnd: uidEnd,
			PortalDNS4: p.PortalDNS4, EndpointV4: p.EndpointV4, EndpointPort: p.EndpointPort,
			IPv6Enabled: p.IPv6Enabled, ProxySkipPrefix: p.ProxySkipPrefix,
			GuardChainOut: p.GuardChainOut, GuardChainPost: p.GuardChainPost,
			Mode: p.Mode, TProxyPort: p.TProxyPort, TProxyMark: p.TProxyMark,
		}
		insp, err := nf.InspectRuntime(ctx, spec)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		outObj := map[string]any{
			"daemon_running":   false,
			"variant":          buildinfo.Current(),
			"boot_id":          bootID,
			"user_id":          p.UserID,
			"serial":           p.Serial,
			"external_capture": insp.ExternalCapture,
			"sbw_raw_armed":    insp.RawArmed,
			"sbw_open":         insp.OutputOpen && insp.EgressOpen,
		}
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(outObj, "", "  ")
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "sync-hide":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "sync-hide")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		res, err := android.SyncHideApps(ctx, runner, p.UserID, p.Serial)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(res)
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "pause-sandbox":
		if out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "pause-sandbox"); err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		return errors.New("sandbox_guard daemon not running")

	case "start-sandbox":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "start-sandbox")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Println(out)
		return nil

	case "sync-policies":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "sync-policies")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		dOff := &Daemon{runner: runner}
		res, err := dOff.syncPolicies(ctx, p)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(res)
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "perf-status":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "perf-status")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		perf := LoadPerfConfig(contracts.PerfConfigPath)
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(perf, "", "  ")
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "perf-trace":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "perf-trace")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Println("[]")
		return nil

	case "pause-hot":
		if out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "pause-hot"); err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		return errors.New("sandbox_guard daemon not running")

	case "prune-bloat":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "prune-bloat")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		res, err := android.PruneSandboxBloat(ctx, runner, p.UserID, contracts.PrunedPkgsPath, p.EffectiveCallerPackage())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(res, "", "  ")
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "restore-bloat":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "restore-bloat")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		res, err := android.RestoreSandboxBloat(ctx, runner, p.UserID, contracts.PrunedPkgsPath)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(res, "", "  ")
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "flush-sandbox-conns":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "flush-sandbox-conns")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		perf := LoadPerfConfig(contracts.PerfConfigPath)
		cfgPath := contracts.MainConfigPath
		inbound := perf.SandboxInboundName
		if p, perr := ReadPolicy(); perr == nil {
			cfgPath = p.EffectiveProxyConfigPath()
			if p.ProxyInboundName != "" {
				inbound = p.ProxyInboundName
			}
		}
		n, err := FlushSandboxConnections(ctx, cfgPath, inbound)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"inbound": inbound, "closed": n})
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "set-app-locale":
		if len(rest) != 2 {
			return errors.New("usage: set-app-locale <package> <locale|clear>")
		}
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "set-app-locale", rest...)
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := android.SetSandboxAppLocale(ctx, runner, p.UserID, rest[0], rest[1], p.EffectiveCallerPackage()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		perf := LoadPerfConfig(contracts.PerfConfigPath)
		if perf.LocaleOverrides == nil {
			perf.LocaleOverrides = map[string]string{}
		}
		if strings.EqualFold(rest[1], "clear") || strings.EqualFold(rest[1], "none") {
			perf.LocaleOverrides[rest[0]] = ""
		} else {
			perf.LocaleOverrides[rest[0]] = rest[1]
		}
		_ = WritePerfConfig(contracts.PerfConfigPath, perf)
		b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"user_id": p.UserID, "package": rest[0], "locale": perf.LocaleOverrides[rest[0]]})
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "install-apk":
		if len(rest) == 0 {
			return errors.New("install-apk requires at least 1 apk path")
		}
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "install-apk", rest...)
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		for _, apkPath := range rest {
			if !rpc.IsSafeAPKPath(apkPath) {
				return fmt.Errorf("unsafe apk path rejected: %q", apkPath)
			}
		}
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		res, err := android.InstallSandboxAPKs(ctx, runner, p.UserID, rest, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, _ = android.SyncHideApps(ctx, runner, p.UserID, p.Serial)
		dOff := &Daemon{runner: runner}
		_, _ = dOff.syncPolicies(ctx, p)
		b, _ := json.Marshal(res)
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "stealth-status":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "stealth-status")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		d := &Daemon{
			stealthConfigPath:    contracts.StealthConfigPath,
			stealthRuntimePath:   contracts.StealthRuntimePath,
			zygiskDisabledFlag:   contracts.ZygiskDisabledFlag,
			stealthBootTriesPath: contracts.StealthBootTriesPath,
		}
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(d.ReadStealthStatus(), "", "  ")
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "stealth-toggle":
		if len(rest) != 1 || (rest[0] != "on" && rest[0] != "off") {
			return errors.New("usage: stealth-toggle on|off")
		}
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "stealth-toggle", rest[0])
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		d := &Daemon{
			stealthConfigPath:    contracts.StealthConfigPath,
			stealthRuntimePath:   contracts.StealthRuntimePath,
			zygiskDisabledFlag:   contracts.ZygiskDisabledFlag,
			stealthBootTriesPath: contracts.StealthBootTriesPath,
		}
		if p, err := ReadPolicy(); err == nil {
			d.policy = p
			d.policyLoaded = true
		}
		cfg, err := d.ToggleStealth(rest[0] == "on")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return nil

	case "block":
		out, err := rpc.SendRootCtl(contracts.CtlSockPath, "block")
		if err == nil {
			fmt.Println(out)
			return nil
		}
		if !isCtlDaemonUnavailable(err) {
			return err
		}
		_ = SaveDesiredState(true)
		p, err := ReadPolicy()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		nf.LockPath = p.EffectiveNetfilterLockPath()
		exPath := p.EffectiveExemptionPath()
		bootID, _ := sysio.ReadBootID()
		var gen uint64 = 1
		if prev, err := ReadExemption(exPath); err == nil && prev.Generation >= 1 {
			gen = prev.Generation + 1
		}
		ex := BuildBlockedExemption(p, bootID, 0, gen)
		if b, err := json.Marshal(ex); err == nil {
			_ = sysio.WriteAtomic(exPath, append(b, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0})
		}
		extCap, derr := nf.DetectProxyCapture(ctx, p.ProxySkipPrefix)
		if derr != nil && p.ProxySkipPrefix != "" {
			extCap = true
		}
		if err := nf.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, closedGateSpec(p, extCap), false); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Println("blocked")
		return nil

	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown ctl subcommand %q", sub)
	}
}
```

```go
	d := &Daemon{

		policy:               pol,
		policyLoaded:         true,
		runner:               &playStoreStatusRunner{enabled: true},
		hibernatedPkgsPath:   filepath.Join(dir, "hibernated.json"),

		stealthConfigPath:    filepath.Join(dir, "stealth.json"),
		zygiskDisabledFlag:   filepath.Join(dir, "zygisk_disabled"),
		stealthBootTriesPath: filepath.Join(dir, "stealth_boot_tries"),

	d.runner = &playStoreStatusRunner{enabled: false}
	d.invalidateStatusCaches()

	if len(appsNoPlay) != 1 || appsNoPlay[0] != "com.android.chrome" {
		t.Fatalf("expected Play Store omitted when disabled, got %v", appsNoPlay)
	}
}
```

```go
type mockCmdRunner struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	calls []string
	out   map[string]string
}

func (m *mockCmdRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	cmdLine := name + " " + strings.Join(args, " ")
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.calls = append(m.calls, cmdLine)
	v, ok := m.out[cmdLine]
	m.mu.Unlock()

func TestDaemonRPCOperations(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	pol := testPolicy()
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	svc := contracts.DefaultServiceComponent
	runner := &mockCmdRunner{out: map[string]string{
		"cmd package install-existing --user 10 com.android.chrome":                                               "Package com.android.chrome installed for user: 10\n",
		"cmd package query-activities --user 10 -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER": "Activity #0:\n  ActivityInfo:\n    name=com.google.android.apps.chrome.Main\n    packageName=com.android.chrome\n",
		"settings --user 0 get secure miui_home_hide_app_list":                                                    `[{"activityName":"com.user0.App","mHashCode":1,"packageName":"com.user0","serialNumber":"0"}]`,
		"content insert --user 0 --uri content://com.miui.home.app.hide --bind packageName:s:com.android.chrome --bind activityName:s:com.google.android.apps.chrome.Main --bind serialNumber:s:1000": "",
		`settings --user 0 put secure miui_home_hide_app_list [{"activityName":"com.user0.App","mHashCode":1,"packageName":"com.user0","serialNumber":"0"},{"activityName":"com.google.android.apps.chrome.Main","mHashCode":1316322254,"packageName":"com.android.chrome","serialNumber":"1000"}]`: "",
		"cmd package list packages --user 10 -U " + pkg:                                                           "package:" + pkg + " uid:1010376\n",
		"settings get global private_dns_mode":                                                                    "off\n",
		"am start-foreground-service --user 10 -a " + pkg + ".action.RELOAD_CONFIG -n " + svc:                     "",
	}}

	d := &Daemon{
		runner:           runner,
		bootID:           "boot-test-1",
		policy:           pol,
		policyLoaded:     true,
		state:            StateBlockedLocked,
		lastGen:          4,
		workCfgDir:       dir,
		desiredStatePath: filepath.Join(dir, "desired_state.json"),
		exemptionPath:    filepath.Join(dir, "exemption.v1.json"),
		sandboxAckPath:   filepath.Join(dir, "sandbox_ack.v1.json"),
		upgradeFencePath: filepath.Join(dir, "upgrade_fence.json"),
		reconcileCh:      make(chan reconcileReq, 4),
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	go func() {
		for {
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			case req := <-d.reconcileCh:
				if req.reply != nil {
					req.reply <- nil
				}
			}
		}
	}()

	// 1. IMPORT_EXISTING installs package in user 10 and syncs HideApp (HyperOS) / skips cleanly elsewhere
	respImport := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{
		ID:  "imp-1",
		Op:  contracts.OpImportExisting,
		Pkg: "com.android.chrome",
	})
	if !respImport.OK {
		t.Fatalf("IMPORT_EXISTING failed: %+v", respImport)
	}
	if !oem.Current().SupportsHideApps {
		for _, c := range runner.calls {
			if strings.Contains(c, "miui_home_hide_app_list") {
				t.Fatalf("non-hyperos OEM %s must not touch MIUI hide list: %s", oem.Current().Name, c)
			}
		}
	}

	// 2. RELOAD_CONFIG writes /dev/sandbox_cfg/u10.pending.json atomically with MTU 1380
	respReload := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{
		ID:     "rel-1",
		Op:     contracts.OpReloadConfig,
		Config: &contracts.RPCConfigOverrides{QuicUDP443Mode: "allow", LogLevel: "info"},
	})
	if !respReload.OK {
		t.Fatalf("RELOAD_CONFIG failed: %+v", respReload)
	}
	cfgBytes, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "u10.pending.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var pending contracts.PendingConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal(cfgBytes, &pending); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if pending.MTU != contracts.SandboxMTU || pending.QuicUDP443Mode != "allow" || pending.Overrides["log_level"] != "info" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected pending.json content: %+v", pending)
	}

	// 3. GET_STATUS reports private_dns_mode, pending_config, and snake_case session
	d.lastSession = &netfilter.ActiveSession{
		ClientUID:   1010376,
		VPNNetID:    106,
		TunIf:       "tun0",
		TunIfindex:  19,
		UplinkNetID: 100,
		UplinkIf:    "wlan0",
		UplinkIndex: 12,
	}
	respStatus := d.HandleRPC(context.Background(), contracts.RPCRequest{
		ID: "st-1",
		Op: contracts.OpGetStatus,
	})
	if !respStatus.OK {
		t.Fatalf("GET_STATUS failed: %+v", respStatus)
	}
	rawResp, err := json.Marshal(respStatus)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rawStr := string(rawResp)
	for _, want := range []string{
		`"private_dns_mode":"off"`,
		`"user_id":10`,
		`"pending_config":{"generation":5,"mtu":1380,"quic_udp443_mode":"allow"}`,
		`"uplink_if":"wlan0"`,
		`"tun_if":"tun0"`,
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(rawStr, want) {
			t.Fatalf("GET_STATUS missing %s in %s", want, rawStr)
		}
	}

	// Ensure no call ever invoked /bin/sh or sh -c
	for _, c := range runner.calls {
		if strings.Contains(c, "sh -c") {
			t.Fatalf("forbidden shell invocation detected: %s", c)
		}
	}

	// 4. STOP_APP & REMOVE_APP respect protected packages and update sandbox_apps
	runner.out["am force-stop --user 10 com.android.chrome"] = ""
	runner.out["cmd package list packages -3 --user 10"] = "package:com.android.chrome\npackage:" + pkg + "\n"
	runner.out["pm uninstall --user 10 com.android.chrome"] = "Success\n"
	respStop := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "stp-1", Op: contracts.OpStopApp, Pkg: "com.android.chrome"})
	if !respStop.OK {
		t.Fatalf("STOP_APP failed: %+v", respStop)
	}
	if badStop := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "stp-2", Op: contracts.OpStopApp, Pkg: pkg}); badStop.OK {
		t.Fatalf("expected controller STOP_APP rejection")
	}
	respRemove := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "rm-1", Op: contracts.OpRemoveApp, Pkg: "com.android.chrome"})
	if !respRemove.OK {
		t.Fatalf("REMOVE_APP failed: %+v", respRemove)
	}
	if badRemove := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "rm-2", Op: contracts.OpRemoveApp, Pkg: "com.google.android.gms"}); badRemove.OK {
		t.Fatalf("expected protected GMS REMOVE_APP rejection")
	}
}

type mockVPNStatusHandle struct {
	*bytes.Reader
	uid int
}

func (m *mockVPNStatusHandle) Close() error { return nil }
func (m *mockVPNStatusHandle) StatMeta() (sysio.FileMeta, error) {
	return sysio.FileMeta{IsRegular: true, UID: m.uid, Size: int64(m.Reader.Len())}, nil
}

type mockVPNStatusResolver struct {
	payload []byte
	uid     int
}

func (m *mockVPNStatusResolver) OpenDirAbsolute(absPath string) (int, sysio.FileMeta, func() error, error) {
	return 10, sysio.FileMeta{IsDir: true, UID: 1000}, func() error { return nil }, nil
}
func (m *mockVPNStatusResolver) OpenDirBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how sysio.OpenHowSpec) (int, sysio.FileMeta, func() error, error) {
	return 11, sysio.FileMeta{IsDir: true, UID: 1000}, func() error { return nil }, nil
}
func (m *mockVPNStatusResolver) OpenFileBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how sysio.OpenHowSpec) (sysio.ReadHandle, error) {
	return &mockVPNStatusHandle{Reader: bytes.NewReader(m.payload), uid: m.uid}, nil
}

func TestPendingConfigFallbackAndVPNStatusContract(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	pol := testPolicy()
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	runner := &mockCmdRunner{out: map[string]string{
		"cmd package list packages --user 10 -U " + pkg: "package:" + pkg + " uid:1010376\n",
		"settings get global private_dns_mode":           "off\n",
	}}
	d := &Daemon{
		runner:       runner,
		bootID:       "boot-test-2",
		policy:       pol,
		policyLoaded: true,
		state:        StateOpen,
		workCfgDir:   dir,
	}

	// 1. Cold start with neither pending.json nor vpn_status.json -> defaults to quic_udp443_mode="reject", mtu=1380
	d.resolver = &mockVPNStatusResolver{payload: []byte(`{}`), uid: 1010376}
	cold := d.resolvePendingConfig(true, pol, nil)
	if cold["quic_udp443_mode"] != "reject" || cold["mtu"] != 1380 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected cold start pending_config: %+v", cold)
	}

	// 2. u10.pending.json present overrides cold-start fallback in status JSON
	pendingPayload := `{"contract_version":1,"generation":7,"user_id":10,"mtu":1380,"quic_udp443_mode":"allow"}`
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "u10.pending.json"), []byte(pendingPayload), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stData := d.buildStatusData(context.Background())
	rawBytes, err := json.Marshal(stData)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw := string(rawBytes)
	for _, want := range []string{`"mode":"tproxy"`, `"pending_config":{"generation":7,"mtu":1380,"quic_udp443_mode":"allow"}`} {
		if !strings.Contains(raw, want) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s in status JSON: %s", want, raw)
		}
	}
}

func TestRunProbeInstrumentationParsing(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	pol := testPolicy()

	makeDaemon := func(instrOut string, instrErr error) *Daemon {
		pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
		probePkg := contracts.VerifyProbePackage
		r := &mockCmdRunner{out: map[string]string{
			"cmd package list packages --user 10 -U " + pkg:      "package:" + pkg + " uid:1010376\n",
			"settings get global private_dns_mode":                "off\n",
			"cmd package list packages --user 10 " + probePkg:     "package:" + probePkg + "\n",
		}}
		if instrErr == nil {
			r.out["am instrument -w -r --user 10 -e compact true "+probePkg+"/.NetworkProbe"] = instrOut
		}
		return &Daemon{
			runner:       r,
			bootID:       "boot-probe",
			policy:       pol,
			policyLoaded: true,
			workCfgDir:   dir,
		}
	}

	// 1. INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1 + valid JSON -> OK=true
	dOK := makeDaemon("INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT: network={\"uid\":1010400,\"vpn\":true}\nINSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1\n", nil)
	rOK := dOK.HandleRPC(context.Background(), contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "p1", Op: contracts.OpRunProbe})
	if !rOK.OK {
		t.Fatalf("expected RUN_PROBE OK=true, got %+v", rOK)
	}

	// 2. am instrument exits 0 but returns INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: 0 -> MUST fail with OK=false
	dFailCode := makeDaemon("INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT: error=SecurityException\nINSTRUMENTATION_CODE: 0\n", nil)
	rFailCode := dFailCode.HandleRPC(context.Background(), contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "p2", Op: contracts.OpRunProbe})
	if rFailCode.OK || !strings.Contains(rFailCode.Error, "INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1") {
		t.Fatalf("expected RUN_PROBE failure on INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: 0, got %+v", rFailCode)
	}

	// 3. INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1 with invalid JSON -> MUST fail with OK=false
	dBadJSON := makeDaemon("INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT: network={broken\nINSTRUMENTATION_CODE: -1\n", nil)
	rBadJSON := dBadJSON.HandleRPC(context.Background(), contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "p3", Op: contracts.OpRunProbe})
	if rBadJSON.OK || !strings.Contains(rBadJSON.Error, "JSON") {
		t.Fatalf("expected RUN_PROBE failure on invalid JSON, got %+v", rBadJSON)
	}

	// 4. Probe APK not installed -> OK=true with probe_apk_installed=false
	dNoAPK := &Daemon{
		runner: &mockCmdRunner{out: map[string]string{
			"cmd package list packages --user 10 -U " + contracts.DefaultWorkPackage: "package:" + contracts.DefaultWorkPackage + " uid:1010376\n",
			"settings get global private_dns_mode":                                    "off\n",
		}},
		bootID:       "boot-probe",
		policy:       pol,
		policyLoaded: true,
		workCfgDir:   dir,
	}
	rNoAPK := dNoAPK.HandleRPC(context.Background(), contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "p4", Op: contracts.OpRunProbe})
	if !rNoAPK.OK {
		t.Fatalf("expected RUN_PROBE OK=true when optional probe APK absent, got %+v", rNoAPK)
	}
}

// statefulMockIPTables simulates iptables-save / iptables-restore per (tool-family, table)
// so reconcileOnce tests exercise real netfilter.ApplyOrVerify & DetectProxyCapture end-to-end.
type statefulMockIPTables struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	tables map[string]map[string][]string // "4/mangle" -> chain -> []rule
}

func newStatefulMockIPTables(withExtCap bool) *statefulMockIPTables {
	m := &statefulMockIPTables{
		tables: map[string]map[string][]string{
			"4/raw":    {"OUTPUT": nil},
			"4/filter": {"OUTPUT": nil},
			"4/mangle": {"POSTROUTING": nil, "OUTPUT": nil},
			"6/raw":    {"OUTPUT": nil},
			"6/filter": {"OUTPUT": nil},
			"6/mangle": {"POSTROUTING": nil, "OUTPUT": nil},
		},
	}
	if withExtCap {
		m.tables["4/mangle"]["OUTPUT"] = []string{"-j EXT_PROXY_OUTPUT"}
		m.tables["4/mangle"]["EXT_PROXY_OUTPUT"] = []string{"-j RETURN"}
	}
	return m
}

func (s *statefulMockIPTables) Run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	if name == "ip" {
		return "", nil
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	fam := "4"
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "ip6") {
		fam = "6"
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(name, "-save") && len(args) >= 2 && args[0] == "-t" {
		tbl := args[1]
		chains := s.tables[fam+"/"+tbl]
		var b strings.Builder
		b.WriteString("*" + tbl + "\n")
		for ch := range chains {
			b.WriteString(":" + ch + " - [0:0]\n")
		}
		for ch, rules := range chains {
			for _, r := range rules {
				b.WriteString("-A " + ch + " " + r + "\n")
			}
		}
		b.WriteString("COMMIT\n")
		return b.String(), nil
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(name, "-restore") {
		var tbl string
		for _, raw := range strings.Split(stdin, "\n") {
			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
			if line == "" || line == "COMMIT" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
				continue
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*") {
				tbl = line[1:]
				continue
			}
			chains := s.tables[fam+"/"+tbl]
			if chains == nil {
				chains = map[string][]string{}
				s.tables[fam+"/"+tbl] = chains
			}
			switch {
			case strings.HasPrefix(line, ":"):
				nameEnd := strings.IndexByte(line[1:], ' ')
				if nameEnd > 0 {
					ch := line[1 : 1+nameEnd]
					if _, ok := chains[ch]; !ok {
						chains[ch] = nil
					}
				}
			case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-F "):
				ch := strings.TrimSpace(line[3:])
				chains[ch] = nil
			case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-D "):
				rest := strings.TrimSpace(line[3:])
				sp := strings.IndexByte(rest, ' ')
				if sp > 0 {
					ch := rest[:sp]
					target := strings.TrimSpace(rest[sp+1:])
					cur := chains[ch]
					next := make([]string, 0, len(cur))
					removed := false
					for _, r := range cur {
						if !removed && r == target {
							removed = true
							continue
						}
						next = append(next, r)
					}
					chains[ch] = next
				}
			case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-I "):
				rest := strings.TrimSpace(line[3:])
				fields := strings.Fields(rest)
				if len(fields) >= 2 {
					ch := fields[0]
					idx := 1
					ruleStart := 1
					if len(fields[1]) > 0 && fields[1][0] >= '0' && fields[1][0] <= '9' {
						if fields[1] == "2" {
							idx = 2
						}
						ruleStart = 2
					}
					rule := strings.Join(fields[ruleStart:], " ")
					cur := chains[ch]
					pos := idx - 1
					if pos < 0 {
						pos = 0
					}
					if pos > len(cur) {
						pos = len(cur)
					}
					next := make([]string, 0, len(cur)+1)
					next = append(next, cur[:pos]...)
					next = append(next, rule)
					next = append(next, cur[pos:]...)
					chains[ch] = next
				}
			case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-A "):
				rest := strings.TrimSpace(line[3:])
				sp := strings.IndexByte(rest, ' ')
				if sp > 0 {
					ch := rest[:sp]
					chains[ch] = append(chains[ch], strings.TrimSpace(rest[sp+1:]))
				}
			}
		}
		return "", nil
	}
	return "", errors.New("unexpected iptables call: " + name)
}
```

`guard/internal/daemon/daemon_v230_test.go`:

```go
package daemon

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/netfilter"
)

type flexMockRunner struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	calls []string
	out   map[string]string
	onRun func(cmdLine string)
}

func (m *flexMockRunner) Run(_ context.Context, _ time.Duration, _ string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	line := name + " " + strings.Join(args, " ")
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.calls = append(m.calls, line)
	if m.onRun != nil {
		m.onRun(line)
	}
	if m.out != nil {
		if v, ok := m.out[line]; ok {
			return v, nil
		}
	}
	return "", nil
}

func startMockReconcilePump(ctx context.Context, d *Daemon) {
	go func() {
		for {
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			case req := <-d.reconcileCh:
				err := d.reconcileOnce(ctx, req)
				if req.reply != nil {
					req.reply <- err
				}
			}
		}
	}()
}

func TestSyncAndToggleStealthConfig(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	cfgPath := filepath.Join(dir, "stealth.json")
	rtPath := filepath.Join(dir, "rt_stealth.json")
	disFlag := filepath.Join(dir, "zygisk_disabled")

	// Seed custom override to verify preservation.
	custom := `{"enabled":true,"sandbox_user_id":10,"exempt_work_uid":0,"timezone":"Asia/Tokyo","locale":"ja-JP","sim_operator":"44020","sim_operator_name":"SoftBank","sim_country_iso":"jp"}`
	if err := os.WriteFile(cfgPath, []byte(custom), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	d := &Daemon{
		stealthConfigPath:  cfgPath,
		stealthRuntimePath: rtPath,
		zygiskDisabledFlag: disFlag,
		policy:             contracts.Policy{UserID: 10, Serial: 1000},
		policyLoaded:       true,
	}

	cfg, err := d.SyncStealthConfig(d.policy, 1010376)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cfg.SimOperator != "44020" || cfg.SimOperatorName != "SoftBank" || cfg.ExemptWorkUID != 1010376 || !cfg.Enabled {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected merged stealth cfg: %+v", cfg)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(rtPath); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("expected runtime stealth mirror %s NOT to exist (prevent self-exposure), got err=%v", rtPath, err)
	}

	// Toggle off -> creates zygisk_disabled & sets enabled=false.
	offCfg, err := d.ToggleStealth(false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if offCfg.Enabled {
		t.Fatal("expected enabled=false after ToggleStealth(false)")
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(disFlag); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected disabled flag created: %v", err)
	}
	stOff := d.ReadStealthStatus()
	if stOff["active_on_boot"] != false || stOff["zygisk_disabled"] != true {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected stealth status off: %+v", stOff)
	}

	// Toggle on -> deletes flag & re-enables.
	onCfg, err := d.ToggleStealth(true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !onCfg.Enabled {
		t.Fatal("expected enabled=true after ToggleStealth(true)")
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(disFlag); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("expected disabled flag removed, got err=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestTProxyStartAutoStartsProxyAndPauseStopsApps(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	script := filepath.Join(dir, "proxy.sh")
	if err := os.WriteFile(script, []byte("#!/system/bin/sh\n"), 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	tproxyUp := false
	nfMock := newStatefulMockIPTables(false)
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	runner := &flexMockRunner{
		out: map[string]string{
			"cmd user list -v":                       "0: id=0, name=Owner, type=full.SYSTEM, flags=PRIMARY|ADMIN|FULL|INITIALIZED (running) (current)\n1: id=10, name=Work, type=profile.MANAGED, flags=INITIALIZED|MANAGED_PROFILE|PROFILE (parentId=0) (running) (profile-owner)\n",
			"dumpsys user --user 10":                 "  UserInfo{10:Work:1030} serialNo=1000 isPrimary=false parentId=0\n    Type: android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED\n    Flags: 4144 (INITIALIZED|MANAGED_PROFILE|PROFILE)\n    State: RUNNING_UNLOCKED\n",
			"dumpsys activity users":                 "    User #0: state=RUNNING_UNLOCKED\n    User #10: state=RUNNING_UNLOCKED\n",
			"cmd device_policy list-owners":          "User 10: admin=" + contracts.DefaultAdminComponent + ",ManagedProfileOwner(parentUserId=0)\n",
			"cmd package list packages --user 10 -U " + pkg: "package:" + pkg + " uid:1010376\n",
			"cmd package list packages -3 --user 10": "package:" + pkg + "\npackage:com.google.android.apps.bard\n",
			"settings get global private_dns_mode":   "off\n",
		},
		onRun: func(cmdLine string) {
			if cmdLine == "sh "+script+" start" {
				tproxyUp = true
			}
		},
	}

	pol := testPolicy()
	pol.Mode = contracts.ModeTProxy
	pol.TProxyPort = contracts.DefaultTProxyPort
	pol.TProxyMark = contracts.DefaultTProxyMark

	d := &Daemon{
		nf:                 &netfilter.Controller{Runner: nfMock, LockPath: filepath.Join(dir, "nf.lock")},
		runner:             runner,
		bootID:             "boot-v230",
		policy:             pol,
		policyLoaded:       true,
		state:              StateBlockedLocked,
		paused:             true,
		workCfgDir:         dir,
		desiredStatePath:   filepath.Join(dir, "desired_state.json"),
		exemptionPath:      filepath.Join(dir, "exemption.v1.json"),
		sandboxAckPath:     filepath.Join(dir, "sandbox_ack.v1.json"),
		upgradeFencePath:   filepath.Join(dir, "upgrade_fence.json"),
		stealthConfigPath:  filepath.Join(dir, "stealth.json"),
		stealthRuntimePath: filepath.Join(dir, "rt_stealth.json"),
		zygiskDisabledFlag: filepath.Join(dir, "zygisk_disabled"),
		proxyCtlScript:     script,
		reconcileCh:        make(chan reconcileReq, 8),
		probeTProxyReady:   func(port int) bool { return tproxyUp && port == contracts.DefaultTProxyPort },
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	startMockReconcilePump(ctx, d)

	// Starting sandbox when proxy core is stopped must invoke `sh <script> start`.
	respStart := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "s1", Op: contracts.OpStartVPN})
	if !respStart.OK {
		t.Fatalf("START_VPN failed: %+v", respStart)
	}
	if !tproxyUp {
		t.Fatal("expected TProxy proxy auto-start script to run")
	}

	// Pausing sandbox must close gate and stop User 10 background apps excluding work package.
	runner.mu.Lock()
	runner.calls = nil
	runner.mu.Unlock()
	respPause := d.HandleRPC(ctx, contracts.RPCRequest{ID: "p1", Op: contracts.OpPauseVPN})
	if !respPause.OK {
		t.Fatalf("PAUSE_VPN failed: %+v", respPause)
	}
	if d.state != StateBlockedLocked || !d.paused {
		t.Fatalf("expected BlockedLocked paused=true, got state=%s paused=%v", d.state, d.paused)
	}
	runner.mu.Lock()
	joined := strings.Join(runner.calls, "\n")
	runner.mu.Unlock()
	if !strings.Contains(joined, "am stop-app --user 10 com.google.android.apps.bard") {
		t.Fatalf("expected pause to stop User 10 bard app, calls:\n%s", joined)
	}
	if strings.Contains(joined, "am stop-app --user 10 "+pkg) || strings.Contains(joined, "am force-stop --user 10 "+pkg) {
		t.Fatalf("must not stop/force-stop bridge package:\n%s", joined)
	}
}
```
