`guard/internal/daemon/fence.go`:

```go
package daemon

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strings"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/netfilter"
)

type State string

const (
	StateBlockedBoot    State = "BlockedBoot"
	StateBlockedLocked  State = "BlockedLocked"
	StateVerifying      State = "Verifying"
	StateAckWait        State = "AckWait"
	StateOpen           State = "Open"
	StateUpgradingFence State = "UpgradingFence"
)

const (
	AckWaitTimeoutNs  = int64(6_000_000_000) // 6s AckWait window
	SwitchoverGraceNs = int64(1_500_000_000) // 1.5s switchover grace while tun0 remains UP
)

type EvalInput struct {
	BootID            string
	NowMonoNs         int64
	PolicyLoaded      bool
	Policy            contracts.Policy
	KnownClientUID    int
	Paused            bool
	Fence             contracts.UpgradeFence
	IdentityOK        bool
	LGPPresent        bool
	Session           *netfilter.ActiveSession
	Ack               *contracts.SandboxAckV1
	CurrentExemption  *contracts.ExemptionV1
	LastGeneration    uint64
	AckWaitDeadlineNs int64
	AckWaitBlocked    bool // true after AckWait timeout until a new trigger clears it
	// TProxyReady is true when the proxy core is alive and listening on the sandbox TProxy port
	// (only consulted when Policy.Mode == "tproxy").
	TProxyReady bool
}

type EvalDecision struct {
	NextState        State
	WriteExemption   bool
	NewExemption     contracts.ExemptionV1
	ArmRawDrop       bool
	OpenGate         bool
	ClearFence       bool
	StartAckWait     bool
	ClearAckDeadline bool
	AckTimedOut      bool
	Reason           string
}

func FenceActive(f contracts.UpgradeFence, bootID string, nowMonoNs int64) bool {
	return f.Active && f.BootID != "" && f.BootID == bootID && nowMonoNs < f.UntilMonoNs
}

func AckMatchesExemption(ack *contracts.SandboxAckV1, ex *contracts.ExemptionV1, bootID string) bool {
	if ack == nil || ex == nil || bootID == "" {
		return false
	}
	return ack.ContractVersion == contracts.ContractVersion &&
		ack.BootID == bootID &&
		ex.BootID == bootID &&
		ack.AppliedGeneration == ex.Generation &&
		ack.WriterPID() > 0
}

func SameExemptionContent(a, b contracts.ExemptionV1) bool {
	return a.ContractVersion == b.ContractVersion &&
		a.BootID == b.BootID &&
		a.State == b.State &&
		a.UserID == b.UserID &&
		a.Serial == b.Serial &&
		a.UIDStart == b.UIDStart &&
		a.UIDEnd == b.UIDEnd &&
		a.ClientUID == b.ClientUID &&
		a.VPNNetID == b.VPNNetID &&
		a.TunIf == b.TunIf &&
		a.TunIfindex == b.TunIfindex &&
		a.PortalDNS4 == b.PortalDNS4 &&
		a.EndpointV4 == b.EndpointV4 &&
		a.EndpointPort == b.EndpointPort &&
		a.IPv6Enabled == b.IPv6Enabled &&
		a.Mode == b.Mode &&
		a.TProxyPort == b.TProxyPort &&
		a.TProxyMark == b.TProxyMark
}

func BuildBlockedExemption(policy contracts.Policy, bootID string, clientUID int, gen uint64) contracts.ExemptionV1 {
	uidStart, uidEnd := policy.UIDRange()
	ex := contracts.ExemptionV1{
		ContractVersion: contracts.ContractVersion,
		Generation:      gen,
		BootID:          bootID,
		State:           "blocked",
		UserID:          policy.UserID,
		Serial:          policy.Serial,
		UIDStart:        uidStart,
		UIDEnd:          uidEnd,
		ClientUID:       clientUID,
		VPNNetID:        0,
		TunIf:           "",
		TunIfindex:      0,
		PortalDNS4:      policy.PortalDNS4,
		EndpointV4:      policy.EndpointV4,
		EndpointPort:    policy.EndpointPort,
		IPv6Enabled:     policy.IPv6Enabled,
	}
	if policy.IsTProxy() {
		ex.Mode = contracts.ModeTProxy
		ex.TProxyPort = policy.TProxyPort
		ex.TProxyMark = policy.TProxyMark
	}
	return ex
}

func BuildOpenExemption(policy contracts.Policy, bootID string, sess *netfilter.ActiveSession, gen uint64) contracts.ExemptionV1 {
	uidStart, uidEnd := policy.UIDRange()
	return contracts.ExemptionV1{
		ContractVersion: contracts.ContractVersion,
		Generation:      gen,
		BootID:          bootID,
		State:           "open",
		UserID:          policy.UserID,
		Serial:          policy.Serial,
		UIDStart:        uidStart,
		UIDEnd:          uidEnd,
		ClientUID:       sess.ClientUID,
		VPNNetID:        sess.VPNNetID,
		TunIf:           sess.TunIf,
		TunIfindex:      sess.TunIfindex,
		PortalDNS4:      policy.PortalDNS4,
		EndpointV4:      policy.EndpointV4,
		EndpointPort:    policy.EndpointPort,
		IPv6Enabled:     policy.IPv6Enabled,
	}
}

// BuildTProxyOpenExemption builds the "open" exemption for Mode == "tproxy" (no tun/vpn_net_id).
func BuildTProxyOpenExemption(policy contracts.Policy, bootID string, clientUID int, gen uint64) contracts.ExemptionV1 {
	ex := BuildBlockedExemption(policy, bootID, clientUID, gen)
	ex.State = "open"
	ex.Mode = contracts.ModeTProxy
	ex.TProxyPort = policy.TProxyPort
	ex.TProxyMark = policy.TProxyMark
	return ex
}

func nextGen(in EvalInput) uint64 {
	g := in.LastGeneration
	if in.CurrentExemption != nil && in.CurrentExemption.Generation > g {
		g = in.CurrentExemption.Generation
	}
	return g + 1
}

// Evaluate implements the deterministic guard & upgrade-fence state machine.
func Evaluate(in EvalInput) EvalDecision {
	if !in.PolicyLoaded {
		return EvalDecision{
			NextState:        StateBlockedBoot,
			ArmRawDrop:       false,
			OpenGate:         false,
			ClearAckDeadline: true,
			Reason:           "policy not loaded",
		}
	}

	// 1. Upgrade Fence takes highest priority while active.
	if FenceActive(in.Fence, in.BootID, in.NowMonoNs) {
		// If a fresh matching ack arrived after upgrade-begin unlinked the old ack,
		// and our candidate exemption is open, exit the fence immediately -> Verifying.
		if in.CurrentExemption != nil && in.CurrentExemption.State == "open" &&
			AckMatchesExemption(in.Ack, in.CurrentExemption, in.BootID) {
			dec := evaluateNormal(in)
			dec.ClearFence = true
			return dec
		}
		return EvalDecision{
			NextState:        StateUpgradingFence,
			WriteExemption:   false, // Keep candidate exemption open during external proxy upgrade.
			ArmRawDrop:       true,
			OpenGate:         false,
			ClearAckDeadline: true,
			Reason:           "upgrade fence active",
		}
	}

	dec := evaluateNormal(in)
	if in.Fence.Active {
		dec.ClearFence = true
	}
	return dec
}

func evaluateNormal(in EvalInput) EvalDecision {
	tproxy := in.Policy.IsTProxy()
	// 2. Paused, unverified profile/DPC, or missing VPN session / TProxy core -> BlockedLocked.
	missingTransport := in.Session == nil
	if tproxy {
		missingTransport = !in.TProxyReady
	}
	if in.Paused || !in.IdentityOK || missingTransport {
		clientUID := in.KnownClientUID
		if clientUID == 0 && in.CurrentExemption != nil {
			clientUID = in.CurrentExemption.ClientUID
		}
		candidate := BuildBlockedExemption(in.Policy, in.BootID, clientUID, 0)
		var eff contracts.ExemptionV1
		writeEx := false
		if in.CurrentExemption == nil || !SameExemptionContent(*in.CurrentExemption, candidate) {
			candidate.Generation = nextGen(in)
			eff = candidate
			writeEx = true
		} else {
			eff = *in.CurrentExemption
		}
		armRaw := in.LGPPresent && !AckMatchesExemption(in.Ack, &eff, in.BootID)
		reason := "vpn session inactive"
		if tproxy {
			reason = "tproxy core not ready"
		}
		if in.Paused {
			reason = "paused by user"
		} else if !in.IdentityOK {
			reason = "profile/DPC/lockdown unverified"
		}
		return EvalDecision{
			NextState:        StateBlockedLocked,
			WriteExemption:   writeEx,
			NewExemption:     eff,
			ArmRawDrop:       armRaw,
			OpenGate:         false,
			ClearAckDeadline: true,
			Reason:           reason,
		}
	}

	// 3. Valid transport (work VPN session or TProxy core) -> prepare candidate "open" exemption.
	clientUID := in.KnownClientUID
	if in.Session != nil {
		clientUID = in.Session.ClientUID
	}
	if clientUID == 0 && in.CurrentExemption != nil {
		clientUID = in.CurrentExemption.ClientUID
	}
	var candidate contracts.ExemptionV1
	if tproxy {
		candidate = BuildTProxyOpenExemption(in.Policy, in.BootID, clientUID, 0)
	} else {
		candidate = BuildOpenExemption(in.Policy, in.BootID, in.Session, 0)
	}
	var eff contracts.ExemptionV1
	writeEx := false
	if in.CurrentExemption == nil || !SameExemptionContent(*in.CurrentExemption, candidate) {
		if in.AckWaitBlocked && in.LGPPresent {
			// Hold blocked until a new ack/upgrade/START_VPN clears AckWaitBlocked.
			blocked := BuildBlockedExemption(in.Policy, in.BootID, clientUID, 0)
			if in.CurrentExemption == nil || !SameExemptionContent(*in.CurrentExemption, blocked) {
				blocked.Generation = nextGen(in)
				eff = blocked
				writeEx = true
			} else {
				eff = *in.CurrentExemption
			}
			return EvalDecision{
				NextState:        StateBlockedLocked,
				WriteExemption:   writeEx,
				NewExemption:     eff,
				ArmRawDrop:       true,
				OpenGate:         false,
				ClearAckDeadline: true,
				Reason:           "waiting for proxy ack clearance",
			}
		}
		candidate.Generation = nextGen(in)
		eff = candidate
		writeEx = true
	} else {
		eff = *in.CurrentExemption
	}

	// 4. Standalone mode (no external capture) -> Open immediately.
	if !in.LGPPresent {
		return EvalDecision{
			NextState:        StateOpen,
			WriteExemption:   writeEx,
			NewExemption:     eff,
			ArmRawDrop:       false,
			OpenGate:         true,
			ClearAckDeadline: true,
			Reason:           "open (standalone)",
		}
	}

	// 5. External proxy hook present: require matching sandbox_ack.v1.json.
	if AckMatchesExemption(in.Ack, &eff, in.BootID) {
		return EvalDecision{
			NextState:        StateOpen,
			WriteExemption:   writeEx,
			NewExemption:     eff,
			ArmRawDrop:       false,
			OpenGate:         true,
			ClearAckDeadline: true,
			Reason:           "open (acked)",
		}
	}

	// 6. AckWait timeout check (3s).
	if in.AckWaitDeadlineNs > 0 && in.NowMonoNs >= in.AckWaitDeadlineNs {
		blocked := BuildBlockedExemption(in.Policy, in.BootID, clientUID, nextGen(in))
		return EvalDecision{
			NextState:        StateBlockedLocked,
			WriteExemption:   true,
			NewExemption:     blocked,
			ArmRawDrop:       true,
			OpenGate:         false,
			ClearAckDeadline: true,
			AckTimedOut:      true,
			Reason:           "sandbox_ack timeout",
		}
	}

	return EvalDecision{
		NextState:      StateAckWait,
		WriteExemption: writeEx,
		NewExemption:   eff,
		ArmRawDrop:     true,
		OpenGate:       false,
		StartAckWait:   in.AckWaitDeadlineNs == 0,
		Reason:         fmt.Sprintf("waiting for sandbox_ack generation %d", eff.Generation),
	}
}

func ParseSandboxAck(data []byte, expectedBootID string) (*contracts.SandboxAckV1, error) {
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(bytes.TrimSpace(data)))
	dec.UseNumber()
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := dec.Decode(&fields); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := dec.Decode(new(any)); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, errors.New("trailing data in sandbox_ack")
	}
	if fields == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("empty sandbox_ack object")
	}

	var ack contracts.SandboxAckV1
	for k, raw := range fields {
		switch k {
		case "contract_version":
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ack.ContractVersion); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case "applied_generation":
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ack.AppliedGeneration); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case "boot_id":
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ack.BootID); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case "core_pid":
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ack.CorePID); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case "pid":
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ack.PID); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		default:
			// Allow a proxy core to report its PID under an explicit *_pid key while rejecting unrelated fields.
			if strings.HasSuffix(k, "_pid") {
				var customPID int
				if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &customPID); err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid %s in sandbox_ack: %w", k, err)
				}
				if ack.CorePID == 0 && customPID > 0 {
					ack.CorePID = customPID
				}
				continue
			}
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("json: unknown field %q", k)
		}
	}
	if ack.ContractVersion != contracts.ContractVersion || ack.AppliedGeneration == 0 || ack.WriterPID() <= 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid sandbox_ack fields")
	}
	if expectedBootID != "" && ack.BootID != expectedBootID {
		return nil, errors.New("sandbox_ack boot_id mismatch")
	}
	return &ack, nil
}
```

`guard/internal/daemon/fence_test.go`:

```go
package daemon

import (
	"bufio"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/netfilter"
)

func testPolicy() contracts.Policy {
	p := contracts.Policy{
		UserID:           10,
		Serial:           1000,
		CallerPackage:    contracts.DefaultWorkPackage,
		CallerCertSHA256: strings.Repeat("a", 64),
	}
	_ = p.NormalizeAndValidate()
	return p
}

func testSession() *netfilter.ActiveSession {
	return &netfilter.ActiveSession{
		ClientUID:   1010376,
		VPNNetID:    106,
		TunIf:       "tun0",
		TunIfindex:  19,
		UplinkNetID: 100,
		UplinkIf:    "wlan0",
		UplinkIndex: 12,
	}
}

func TestUpgradeFenceStateMachine(t *testing.T) {
	const boot = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
	pol := testPolicy()
	sess := testSession()

	// 1. Policy not loaded -> BlockedBoot
	d1 := Evaluate(EvalInput{BootID: boot, PolicyLoaded: false})
	if d1.NextState != StateBlockedBoot || d1.OpenGate || d1.ArmRawDrop {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected BlockedBoot decision: %+v", d1)
	}

	// 2. Policy loaded, no VPN session, no LGP -> BlockedLocked, raw pass-through (fast tcp-reset)
	d2 := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 100, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: false, Session: nil,
	})
	if d2.NextState != StateBlockedLocked || !d2.WriteExemption || d2.NewExemption.State != "blocked" || d2.ArmRawDrop || d2.OpenGate {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected BlockedLocked decision: %+v", d2)
	}

	// 3. Ready + hook present -> enters AckWait, writes open exemption gen=2, arms SBW_RAW_OUTPUT
	exBlocked := d2.NewExemption
	d3 := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 1_000_000, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: true, TProxyReady: true, Session: sess,
		CurrentExemption: &exBlocked, LastGeneration: exBlocked.Generation,
	})
	if d3.NextState != StateAckWait || !d3.WriteExemption || d3.NewExemption.State != "open" || d3.NewExemption.Generation != 2 || !d3.ArmRawDrop || d3.OpenGate || !d3.StartAckWait {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected AckWait decision: %+v", d3)
	}

	// 4. Ack timeout after 3s -> BlockedLocked, reverts exemption to blocked, arms SBW_RAW_OUTPUT
	exOpen := d3.NewExemption
	d4Timeout := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 1_000_000 + AckWaitTimeoutNs + 1, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: true, TProxyReady: true, Session: sess,
		CurrentExemption: &exOpen, LastGeneration: exOpen.Generation,
		AckWaitDeadlineNs: 1_000_000 + AckWaitTimeoutNs,
	})
	if d4Timeout.NextState != StateBlockedLocked || !d4Timeout.AckTimedOut || !d4Timeout.ArmRawDrop || d4Timeout.OpenGate || d4Timeout.NewExemption.State != "blocked" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected AckWait timeout decision: %+v", d4Timeout)
	}

	// 5. Matching sandbox_ack arrives -> Open, disarms SBW_RAW_OUTPUT, opens SBW_OUTPUT/SBW_EGRESS
	ack := &contracts.SandboxAckV1{ContractVersion: 1, AppliedGeneration: exOpen.Generation, BootID: boot, CorePID: 4321}
	d5 := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 2_000_000, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: true, TProxyReady: true, Session: sess,
		Ack: ack, CurrentExemption: &exOpen, LastGeneration: exOpen.Generation,
	})
	if d5.NextState != StateOpen || d5.WriteExemption || d5.ArmRawDrop || !d5.OpenGate {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Open decision: %+v", d5)
	}

	// 6. Handoff wlan0 -> ccmni2 (same tun0, vpn_net_id, client_uid) -> zero rewrite of exemption.v1.json!
	sessCell := *sess
	sessCell.UplinkIf = "ccmni2"
	sessCell.UplinkNetID = 101
	dHandoff := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 3_000_000, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: true, TProxyReady: true, Session: &sessCell,
		Ack: ack, CurrentExemption: &exOpen, LastGeneration: exOpen.Generation,
	})
	if dHandoff.NextState != StateOpen || dHandoff.WriteExemption || !dHandoff.OpenGate {
		t.Fatalf("handoff must not rewrite exemption.v1.json: %+v", dHandoff)
	}

	// 7. Upgrade-begin fence (90s TTL, stale ack unlinked) -> UpgradingFence, keeps exemption open candidate, arms RAW DROP!
	fence := contracts.UpgradeFence{BootID: boot, Active: true, UntilMonoNs: 93_000_000_000, TTLSeconds: 90}
	dFence := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 5_000_000, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		Fence: fence, IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: true, TProxyReady: true, Session: sess,
		Ack: nil, CurrentExemption: &exOpen, LastGeneration: exOpen.Generation,
	})
	if dFence.NextState != StateUpgradingFence || dFence.WriteExemption || !dFence.ArmRawDrop || dFence.OpenGate {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected UpgradingFence decision: %+v", dFence)
	}

	// 8. Fresh matching ack arrives during fence -> exits fence immediately and opens!
	dFenceAck := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 6_000_000, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		Fence: fence, IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: true, TProxyReady: true, Session: sess,
		Ack: ack, CurrentExemption: &exOpen, LastGeneration: exOpen.Generation,
	})
	if dFenceAck.NextState != StateOpen || !dFenceAck.ClearFence || dFenceAck.ArmRawDrop || !dFenceAck.OpenGate {
		t.Fatalf("expected immediate exit from fence on matching ack: %+v", dFenceAck)
	}

	// 9. Fence TTL expires -> evaluates normal state
	dFenceExpire := Evaluate(EvalInput{
		BootID: boot, NowMonoNs: 94_000_000_000, PolicyLoaded: true, Policy: pol,
		Fence: fence, IdentityOK: true, LGPPresent: false, TProxyReady: true, Session: sess,
		CurrentExemption: &exOpen, LastGeneration: exOpen.Generation,
	})
	if dFenceExpire.NextState != StateOpen || !dFenceExpire.ClearFence || !dFenceExpire.OpenGate {
		t.Fatalf("expected TTL expiry to open standalone: %+v", dFenceExpire)
	}
}

func TestCountStuckSocketsFromReader(t *testing.T) {
	const procNetTCP = `  sl  local_address rem_address   st tx_queue rx_queue tr tm->when retrnsmt   uid  timeout inode
   0: 010011AC:A123 040013C6:01BB 02 00000000:00000000 00:00000000 00000000 1010376      0 12345
   1: 010011AC:A124 040012C6:01BB 02 00000000:00000000 00:00000000 00000000 1010555      0 12346
   2: 010011AC:A125 040012C6:01BB 02 00000000:00000000 00:00000000 00000000 10398        0 12347
   3: 010011AC:A126 040013C6:01BB 01 00000000:00000000 00:00000000 00000000 1010376      0 12348
`
	w, c := CountStuckSocketsFromReader(bufio.NewScanner(strings.NewReader(procNetTCP)), 1000000, 1099999)
	if w != 1 || c != 1 {

	}
}
```

`guard/internal/daemon/mihomo_flush.go`:

```go
package daemon

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/sysio"
)

type MihomoControllerConfig struct {
	ExternalController string `json:"external-controller"`
	Secret             string `json:"secret"`
}

// ReadMihomoControllerConfig parses /data/adb/sandbox_proxy/config.json safely and validates
// that external-controller resolves strictly to loopback so secrets never leave localhost.
func ReadMihomoControllerConfig(configPath string) (baseURL string, secret string, err error) {
	if configPath == "" {
		configPath = contracts.MainConfigPath
	}
	raw, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFilePerm(configPath, 4<<20, 0022)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	var cfg MihomoControllerConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cfg); err != nil {
		yamlCfg, ok := parseMihomoYAMLFields(raw)
		if !ok {
			return "", "", err
		}
		cfg = yamlCfg
	}
	addr := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.ExternalController)
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(addr), "http://") {
		addr = addr[7:]
	}
	addr = strings.TrimRight(addr, "/")
	if addr == "" {
		return "", "", errors.New("external-controller not configured")
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(addr, ":") {
		addr = "127.0.0.1" + addr
	}
	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("invalid external-controller %q: %w", addr, err)
	}
	if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && ip.IsUnspecified() {
		if ip.To4() != nil {
			host = "127.0.0.1"
		} else {
			host = "::1"
		}
	}
	if !isLoopbackHost(host) {
		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("refusing non-loopback external-controller host %q", host)
	}
	return "http://" + net.JoinHostPort(host, port), cfg.Secret, nil
}

func parseMihomoYAMLFields(raw []byte) (MihomoControllerConfig, bool) {
	var cfg MihomoControllerConfig
	found := false
	for _, row := range strings.Split(string(raw), "\n") {
		if len(row) == 0 || row[0] == ' ' || row[0] == '\t' || row[0] == '#' {
			continue
		}
		key, val, ok := strings.Cut(row, ":")
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		key = strings.TrimSpace(key)
		val = stripYAMLCommentAndQuotes(strings.TrimSpace(val))
		switch key {
		case "external-controller":
			cfg.ExternalController = val
			found = true
		case "secret":
			cfg.Secret = val
			found = true
		}
	}
	return cfg, found
}

func stripYAMLCommentAndQuotes(s string) string {
	if s == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if q := s[0]; q == '"' || q == '\'' {
		for i := 1; i < len(s); i++ {
			if s[i] == q {
				return s[1:i]
			}
		}
		return strings.Trim(s, `"'`)
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		if s[i] == '#' && (i == 0 || s[i-1] == ' ' || s[i-1] == '\t') {
			s = strings.TrimSpace(s[:i])
			break
		}
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(s)
}

func isLoopbackHost(host string) bool {
	if strings.EqualFold(host, "localhost") {
		return true
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(host)
	return ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback()
}

type mihomoConnsResp struct {
	Connections []struct {
		ID       string `json:"id"`
		Metadata struct {
			InboundName string `json:"inboundName"`
		} `json:"metadata"`
	} `json:"connections"`
}

// FlushSandboxConnections closes ONLY connections whose metadata.inboundName equals inboundName
// (e.g. "sandbox-tproxy") via mihomo's loopback REST API, leaving host/User 0 traffic untouched.
func FlushSandboxConnections(ctx context.Context, configPath, inboundName string) (int, error) {
	if inboundName == "" {
		inboundName = contracts.DefaultSandboxInName
	}
	baseURL, secret, err := ReadMihomoControllerConfig(configPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return flushMihomoInboundURL(ctx, baseURL, secret, inboundName)
}

const maxMihomoRespBytes = 2 << 20

func escapePathSegment(s string) string {
	const hexDigits = "0123456789ABCDEF"
	var b strings.Builder
	b.Grow(len(s))
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		c := s[i]
		isUnreserved := (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') ||
			(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') ||
			(c >= '0' && c <= '9') ||
			c == '-' || c == '.' || c == '_' || c == '~'
		if isUnreserved {
			b.WriteByte(c)
			continue
		}
		b.WriteByte('%')
		b.WriteByte(hexDigits[c>>4])
		b.WriteByte(hexDigits[c&0x0F])
	}
	return b.String()
}

func loopbackHTTPRequest(ctx context.Context, method, baseURL, reqPath, secret string) (int, []byte, error) {
	if strings.ContainsAny(reqPath, "\r\n") || strings.ContainsAny(secret, "\r\n") {
		return 0, nil, errors.New("invalid CR/LF in loopback HTTP request")
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(baseURL, "http://") {
		return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported controller scheme in %q", baseURL)
	}
	hostport := strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimPrefix(baseURL, "http://"), "/")
	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(hostport)
	if err != nil || !isLoopbackHost(host) {
		return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing non-loopback controller target %q", baseURL)
	}

	deadline := time.Now().Add(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	if cd, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok && cd.Before(deadline) {
		deadline = cd
	}

	var dialer net.Dialer
	conn, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", net.JoinHostPort(host, port))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(deadline)
	stopCancel := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() {
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now())
	})
	defer stopCancel()

	var reqBuf bytes.Buffer
	reqBuf.Grow(128 + len(reqPath) + len(secret))
	reqBuf.WriteString(method)
	reqBuf.WriteByte(' ')
	reqBuf.WriteString(reqPath)
	reqBuf.WriteString(" HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: ")
	reqBuf.WriteString(hostport)
	reqBuf.WriteString("\r\nConnection: close\r\n")
	if secret != "" {
		reqBuf.WriteString("Authorization: Bearer ")
		reqBuf.WriteString(secret)
		reqBuf.WriteString("\r\n")
	}
	reqBuf.WriteString("\r\n")

	if _, err := conn.Write(reqBuf.Bytes()); err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}

	br := bufio.NewReaderSize(conn, 4096)
	statusLine, err := br.ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	statusFields := strings.Fields(statusLine)
	if len(statusFields) < 2 || !strings.HasPrefix(statusFields[0], "HTTP/1.") {
		return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("malformed HTTP status line %q", strings.TrimSpace(statusLine))
	}
	code, err := strconv.Atoi(statusFields[1])
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid HTTP status code %q", statusFields[1])
	}

	chunked := false
	contentLen := int64(-1)
	for hdrCount := 0; hdrCount < 128; hdrCount++ {
		line, err := br.ReadString('\n')
		if err != nil {
			return 0, nil, err
		}
		trimmed := strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
		if trimmed == "" {
			break
		}
		k, v, ok := strings.Cut(trimmed, ":")
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(k)) {
		case "transfer-encoding":
			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(v), "chunked") {
				chunked = true
			}
		case "content-length":
			if n, perr := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimSpace(v), 10, 64); perr == nil && n >= 0 {
				contentLen = n
			}
		}
	}

	if code == 204 || code == 304 || method == "HEAD" {
		return code, nil, nil
	}
	if chunked {
		body, err := readChunkedBody(br, maxMihomoRespBytes)
		return code, body, err
	}
	if contentLen == 0 {
		return code, nil, nil
	}
	if contentLen > 0 {
		if contentLen > maxMihomoRespBytes {
			return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("response body %d exceeds limit", contentLen)
		}
		body := make([]byte, contentLen)
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(br, body); err != nil {
			return 0, nil, err
		}
		return code, body, nil
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(br, maxMihomoRespBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	if len(body) > maxMihomoRespBytes {
		return 0, nil, errors.New("response body exceeds limit")
	}
	return code, body, nil
}

func readChunkedBody(br *bufio.Reader, limit int) ([]byte, error) {
	var out bytes.Buffer
	for {
		line, err := br.ReadString('\n')
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		sizePart, _, _ := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(line), ";")
		sz, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimSpace(sizePart), 16, 64)
		if err != nil || sz < 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid chunk size %q", line)
		}
		if sz == 0 {
			return out.Bytes(), nil
		}
		if sz > int64(limit-out.Len()) {
			return nil, errors.New("chunked response exceeds limit")
		}
		if _, err := io.CopyN(&out, br, sz); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		crlf, err := br.ReadString('\n')
		if err != nil || strings.TrimRight(crlf, "\r\n") != "" {
			return nil, errors.New("malformed chunk terminator")
		}
	}
}

func flushMihomoInboundURL(ctx context.Context, baseURL, secret, inboundName string) (int, error) {
	cctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	status, body, err := loopbackHTTPRequest(cctx, "GET", baseURL, "/connections", secret)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if status != 200 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("GET /connections status %d", status)
	}

	var list mihomoConnsResp
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &list); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	var targetIDs []string
	for _, c := range list.Connections {
		if c.Metadata.InboundName != inboundName {
			continue
		}
		if c.ID == "" || c.ID == "." || c.ID == ".." || strings.ContainsAny(c.ID, "/?\\#%\r\n") {
			continue
		}
		targetIDs = append(targetIDs, c.ID)
	}
	if len(targetIDs) == 0 {
		return 0, nil
	}

	workers := 8
	if len(targetIDs) < workers {
		workers = len(targetIDs)
	}
	jobs := make(chan string, len(targetIDs))
	for _, id := range targetIDs {
		jobs <- id
	}
	close(jobs)

	var closed atomic.Int64
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(workers)
	for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for id := range jobs {
				if cctx.Err() != nil {
					return
				}
				delStatus, _, derr := loopbackHTTPRequest(cctx, "DELETE", baseURL, "/connections/"+escapePathSegment(id), secret)
				if derr == nil && delStatus >= 200 && delStatus < 300 {
					closed.Add(1)
				}
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	return int(closed.Load()), nil
}
```

`guard/internal/daemon/mihomo_flush_test.go`:

```go
package daemon

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

func TestFlushSandboxConnectionsOnlyClosesMatchingInbound(t *testing.T) {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var deleted []string
	var authHeader string

	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		mu.Lock()
		authHeader = r.Header.Get("Authorization")
		mu.Unlock()
		switch {
		case r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/connections":
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"connections":[
				{"id":"jp-1","metadata":{"inboundName":"sandbox-tproxy"}},
				{"id":"sg-1","metadata":{"inboundName":"tproxy-in"}},
				{"id":"jp-2","metadata":{"inboundName":"sandbox-tproxy"}},
				{"id":"bad/id","metadata":{"inboundName":"sandbox-tproxy"}}
			]}`))
		case r.Method == http.MethodDelete && strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/connections/"):
			mu.Lock()
			deleted = append(deleted, strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/connections/"))
			mu.Unlock()
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
		default:
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
		}
	}))
	defer srv.Close()

	dir := t.TempDir()
	cfgPath := filepath.Join(dir, "config.json")
	hostPort := strings.TrimPrefix(srv.URL, "http://")
	if err := os.WriteFile(cfgPath, []byte(`{"external-controller":"`+hostPort+`","secret":"topsecret"}`), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	closed, err := FlushSandboxConnections(context.Background(), cfgPath, "sandbox-tproxy")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if closed != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 closed sandbox-tproxy connections, got %d", closed)
	}
	if authHeader != "Bearer topsecret" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Authorization header: %q", authHeader)
	}
	sort.Strings(deleted)
	joined := strings.Join(deleted, ",")
	if joined != "jp-1,jp-2" {
		t.Fatalf("must delete ONLY jp-1,jp-2 (never sg-1 or bad/id), got %q", joined)
	}

	// Refuse non-loopback external-controller cleanly.
	badCfg := filepath.Join(dir, "bad.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(badCfg, []byte(`{"external-controller":"192.168.1.50:9097","secret":"x"}`), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, _, err := ReadMihomoControllerConfig(badCfg); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("must refuse non-loopback external-controller")
	}

	// Support 0.0.0.0:port, [::]:port, http:// prefix, 0640 group-readable files, and YAML fallback.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name     string
		body     string
		wantURL  string
		wantSec  string
	}{
		{"wildcard_v4", `{"external-controller":"0.0.0.0:9097","secret":"s1"}`, "http://127.0.0.1:9097", "s1"},
		{"wildcard_v6", `{"external-controller":"[::]:9097","secret":"s2"}`, "http://[::1]:9097", "s2"},
		{"http_scheme", `{"external-controller":"http://127.0.0.1:9097/","secret":"s3"}`, "http://127.0.0.1:9097", "s3"},
		{"yaml_fallback", "mode: rule\nexternal-controller: \"0.0.0.0:9099\" # clash api\nsecret: 'sec#yaml'\n", "http://127.0.0.1:9099", "sec#yaml"},
		{"yaml_unquoted_hash", "external-controller: 127.0.0.1:9098 # ctrl\nsecret: my#pass # comment\n", "http://127.0.0.1:9098", "my#pass"},
	} {
		p := filepath.Join(dir, tc.name+".cfg")
		if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(tc.body), 0640); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		gotURL, gotSec, err := ReadMihomoControllerConfig(p)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s failed: %v", tc.name, err)
		}
		if gotURL != tc.wantURL || gotSec != tc.wantSec {
			t.Fatalf("%s got (%q, %q) want (%q, %q)", tc.name, gotURL, gotSec, tc.wantURL, tc.wantSec)
		}
	}

	// Ensure HTTP_PROXY cannot hijack loopback REST calls.
	t.Setenv("HTTP_PROXY", "http://127.0.0.1:1")
	t.Setenv("http_proxy", "http://127.0.0.1:1")
	closed2, err := FlushSandboxConnections(context.Background(), cfgPath, "sandbox-tproxy")
	if err != nil || closed2 != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected direct loopback flush ignoring HTTP_PROXY, got closed=%d err=%v", closed2, err)
	}

	// Verify chunked Transfer-Encoding responses and CR/LF header injection rejection.
	chunkedSrv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/connections" {
			fl, _ := w.(http.Flusher)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"connections":[{"id":"chk 1",`))
			if fl != nil {
				fl.Flush()
			}
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`"metadata":{"inboundName":"sandbox-tproxy"}}]}`))
			return
		}
		if r.Method == http.MethodDelete && (r.RequestURI == "/connections/chk%201" || r.URL.Path == "/connections/chk 1") {
			if r.RequestURI != "/connections/chk%201" {
				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
	}))
	defer chunkedSrv.Close()
	if n, err := flushMihomoInboundURL(context.Background(), chunkedSrv.URL, "", "sandbox-tproxy"); err != nil || n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected chunked flush count=1, got %d err=%v", n, err)
	}
	if _, _, err := loopbackHTTPRequest(context.Background(), "GET", chunkedSrv.URL, "/connections", "bad\r\nInjected: 1"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected CR/LF in secret to be rejected")
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/daemon/perf_cfg.go`:

```go
package daemon

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/sysio"
)

const (
	PauseModeDeep   = "deep"
	PauseModeLight  = "light"
	PauseModeHot    = "hot"
	PauseModeHybrid = "hybrid"
)

// PerfConfig controls v2.5.0 performance, idle lifecycle, bloat pruning, and locale-preservation behavior.
type PerfConfig struct {
	PauseMode                   string            `json:"pause_mode"`
	AutoPauseIdleMinutes        int               `json:"auto_pause_idle_minutes"`
	HotFreezeMinutes            int               `json:"hot_freeze_minutes"`
	AutoPruneBloatOnStart       bool              `json:"auto_prune_bloat_on_start"`
	KernelRejectQuicUDP443      bool              `json:"kernel_reject_quic_udp443"`
	FlushSandboxConnsOnRouteChg bool              `json:"flush_sandbox_conns_on_route_change"`
	PreserveUserLocales         bool              `json:"preserve_user_locales"`
	SkipAppOpsForFrozen         bool              `json:"skip_appops_for_frozen"`
	SyncTargetOnly              bool              `json:"sync_target_only"`
	LaunchBoostMs               int               `json:"launch_boost_ms"`
	OOMScoreAdj                 int               `json:"oom_score_adj"`
	SandboxInboundName          string            `json:"sandbox_inbound_name,omitempty"`
	LocaleOverrides             map[string]string `json:"locale_overrides,omitempty"`
}

func DefaultPerfConfig() PerfConfig {
	return PerfConfig{
		PauseMode:                   PauseModeDeep,
		AutoPauseIdleMinutes:        15,
		HotFreezeMinutes:            30,
		AutoPruneBloatOnStart:       true,
		KernelRejectQuicUDP443:      true,
		FlushSandboxConnsOnRouteChg: true,
		PreserveUserLocales:         true,
		SkipAppOpsForFrozen:         false,
		SyncTargetOnly:              false,
		LaunchBoostMs:               1500,
		OOMScoreAdj:                 -900,
		SandboxInboundName:          contracts.DefaultSandboxInName,
	}
}

func (c *PerfConfig) Normalize() {
	if c == nil {
		return
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(c.PauseMode)) {
	case PauseModeLight:
		c.PauseMode = PauseModeLight
	case PauseModeHot:
		c.PauseMode = PauseModeHot
	case PauseModeHybrid:
		c.PauseMode = PauseModeHybrid
	default:
		c.PauseMode = PauseModeDeep
	}
	if c.AutoPauseIdleMinutes < 0 {
		c.AutoPauseIdleMinutes = 0
	} else if c.AutoPauseIdleMinutes > 1440 {
		c.AutoPauseIdleMinutes = 1440
	}
	if c.HotFreezeMinutes < 0 {
		c.HotFreezeMinutes = 0
	} else if c.HotFreezeMinutes > 1440 {
		c.HotFreezeMinutes = 1440
	}
	if c.LaunchBoostMs < 0 {
		c.LaunchBoostMs = 0
	} else if c.LaunchBoostMs > 5000 {
		c.LaunchBoostMs = 5000
	}
	if c.OOMScoreAdj < -1000 {
		c.OOMScoreAdj = -1000
	} else if c.OOMScoreAdj > 0 {
		c.OOMScoreAdj = 0
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.SandboxInboundName) == "" {
		c.SandboxInboundName = contracts.DefaultSandboxInName
	}
	if len(c.LocaleOverrides) > 0 {
		clean := make(map[string]string, len(c.LocaleOverrides))
		for pkg, loc := range c.LocaleOverrides {
			if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) {
				continue
			}
			loc = strings.TrimSpace(loc)
			if loc == "" || contracts.ValidLocaleTag(loc) {
				clean[pkg] = loc
			}
		}
		if len(clean) == 0 {
			c.LocaleOverrides = nil
		} else {
			c.LocaleOverrides = clean
		}
	}
}

// LoadPerfConfig reads path safely with defaults fallback; omitted JSON fields retain defaults.
func LoadPerfConfig(path string) PerfConfig {
	if path == "" {
		path = contracts.PerfConfigPath
	}
	cfg := DefaultPerfConfig()
	if b, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(path, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes); err == nil {
		var tmp = DefaultPerfConfig()
		if json.Unmarshal(b, &tmp) == nil {
			cfg = tmp
		}
	}
	cfg.Normalize()
	return cfg
}

// WritePerfConfig atomically persists perf.json with 0600 root ownership.
func WritePerfConfig(path string, cfg PerfConfig) error {
	if path == "" {
		path = contracts.PerfConfigPath
	}
	cfg.Normalize()
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return sysio.WriteAtomic(path, append(b, '\n'), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0})
}

// SyncPerfConfig loads existing perf.json (or seeds defaults if missing) and ensures normalized disk state.
func SyncPerfConfig(path string) PerfConfig {
	if path == "" {
		path = contracts.PerfConfigPath
	}
	cfg := DefaultPerfConfig()
	needWrite := true
	if b, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(path, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes); err == nil {
		tmp := DefaultPerfConfig()
		if json.Unmarshal(b, &tmp) == nil {
			cfg = tmp
			needWrite = false
		}
	}
	cfg.Normalize()
	if needWrite {
		_ = WritePerfConfig(path, cfg)
	}
	return cfg
}

// ApplyOOMScoreAdj protects the current process from system LMK termination.
func ApplyOOMScoreAdj(adj int) error {
	if adj < -1000 {
		adj = -1000
	} else if adj > 0 {
		adj = 0
	}
	return os.WriteFile("/proc/self/oom_score_adj", []byte(strconv.Itoa(adj)), 0644)
}
```

```go
func (d *Daemon) resolvedStealthPaths() (cfgPath, runtimePath, disabledFlag string) {
	cfgPath = d.stealthConfigPath
	if cfgPath == "" {
		cfgPath = contracts.StealthConfigPath
	}
	runtimePath = d.stealthRuntimePath
	if runtimePath == "" {
		runtimePath = contracts.StealthRuntimePath
	}
	disabledFlag = d.zygiskDisabledFlag
	if disabledFlag == "" {
		disabledFlag = contracts.ZygiskDisabledFlag
	}
	return
}

func loadExistingOrDefaultStealth(cfgPath string, userID, exemptUID int) StealthConfig {
	cfg := DefaultStealthConfig(userID, exemptUID)
	if existingBytes, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(cfgPath, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes); err == nil {
		existing := DefaultStealthConfig(userID, exemptUID)
		if json.Unmarshal(existingBytes, &existing) == nil {
			cfg = existing
		}
	}
	if userID > 0 {
		cfg.SandboxUserID = userID
	}
	if exemptUID > 0 {
		cfg.ExemptWorkUID = exemptUID
	}
	if cfg.Timezone == "" {
		cfg.Timezone = "UTC"
	}
	if cfg.Locale == "" {
		cfg.Locale = "en-US"
	}
	if cfg.NetworkOperator == "" {
		cfg.NetworkOperator = cfg.SimOperator
	}
	if cfg.NetworkOperatorName == "" {
		cfg.NetworkOperatorName = cfg.SimOperatorName
	}
	if cfg.NetworkCountryISO == "" {
		cfg.NetworkCountryISO = cfg.SimCountryISO
	}
	if cfg.SpoofLocationMode == "" {
		cfg.SpoofLocationMode = "block"
	}
	if cfg.PropHookMode == "" {
		cfg.PropHookMode = "plt"
	}
	if cfg.SandboxLinkIPv4 == "" {
		cfg.SandboxLinkIPv4 = "10.172.10.2"
	}
	if cfg.DeviceName == "" {
		cfg.DeviceName = oem.Current().DefaultDeviceName
	}
	if cfg.DeviceRegion == "" && cfg.MiuiRegion != "" {
		cfg.DeviceRegion = cfg.MiuiRegion
	} else if cfg.MiuiRegion == "" && cfg.DeviceRegion != "" {
		cfg.MiuiRegion = cfg.DeviceRegion
	}
	return cfg
}

func writeStealthFiles(cfgPath, runtimePath string, cfg StealthConfig) error {
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	payload := append(b, '\n')
	if err := sysio.WriteAtomic(cfgPath, payload, sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Purge any legacy world-readable mirror (/dev/sandbox_cfg/stealth.json);
	// Zygisk companion reads cfgPath (0600 root:root) directly without self-exposure.
	if runtimePath != "" {
		_ = removeIfExist(runtimePath)
	}
	return nil
}

// ResolveExemptUIDsForUser extracts sandbox app UIDs that must never be spoofed
// (controller package and com.android.managedprovisioning) from Android packages.list.
func ResolveExemptUIDsForUser(packagesListPath string, userID int, workUID int, callerPkgs ...string) []int {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return nil
	}
	if packagesListPath == "" {
		packagesListPath = contracts.PackagesListPath
	}
	callerPkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	if len(callerPkgs) > 0 && contracts.ValidPackageName(callerPkgs[0]) {
		callerPkg = callerPkgs[0]
	}
	seen := make(map[int]struct{}, 4)
	addUID := func(uid int) {
		if uid < contracts.AndroidUserWidth {
			return
		}
		if uid/contracts.AndroidUserWidth != userID {
			return
		}
		appID := uid % contracts.AndroidUserWidth
		if appID >= contracts.MinAppID && appID < 90000 {
			seen[uid] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	addUID(workUID)

	if f, err := os.Open(packagesListPath); err == nil {
		defer f.Close()
		sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
		for sc.Scan() {
			fields := strings.Fields(sc.Text())
			if len(fields) < 2 {
				continue
			}
			pkg := fields[0]
			if pkg != contracts.ManagedProvisioningPkg && pkg != callerPkg {
				continue
			}
			rawID, perr := strconv.Atoi(fields[1])
			if perr != nil || rawID < 0 {
				continue
			}
			appID := rawID % contracts.AndroidUserWidth
			addUID(userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + appID)
		}
	}

	if len(seen) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]int, 0, len(seen))
	for uid := range seen {
		out = append(out, uid)
	}
	sort.Ints(out)
	return out
}

func mergeExemptUIDs(existing []int, resolved []int, userID int) []int {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{}, len(existing)+len(resolved))
	add := func(uid int) {
		if uid >= contracts.AndroidUserWidth && uid/contracts.AndroidUserWidth == userID {
			appID := uid % contracts.AndroidUserWidth
			if appID >= contracts.MinAppID && appID < 90000 {
				seen[uid] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, u := range existing {
		add(u)
	}
	for _, u := range resolved {
		add(u)
	}
	if len(seen) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]int, 0, len(seen))
	for u := range seen {
		out = append(out, u)
	}
	sort.Ints(out)
	return out
}

// ResolvePackageUIDForUser resolves the User-N UID for a given package name from packages.list.
// Returns 0 if not found or invalid.
func ResolvePackageUIDForUser(packagesListPath string, userID int, targetPkg string) int {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) || !contracts.ValidPackageName(targetPkg) {
		return 0
	}
	if packagesListPath == "" {
		packagesListPath = contracts.PackagesListPath
	}
	f, err := os.Open(packagesListPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	defer f.Close()

	sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	for sc.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(sc.Text())
		if len(fields) < 2 || fields[0] != targetPkg {
			continue
		}
		rawID, perr := strconv.Atoi(fields[1])
		if perr != nil || rawID < 0 {
			continue
		}
		appID := rawID % contracts.AndroidUserWidth
		if appID >= contracts.MinAppID && appID < 90000 {
			return userID*contracts.AndroidUserWidth + appID
		}
	}
	return 0
}

// SyncStealthConfig maintains stealth.json preserving existing overrides while updating
// sandbox_user_id, exempt_work_uid, and exempt_uids.
func (d *Daemon) SyncStealthConfig(policy contracts.Policy, clientUID int) (StealthConfig, error) {
	d.stealthMu.Lock()
	defer d.stealthMu.Unlock()
	cfgPath, runtimePath, _ := d.resolvedStealthPaths()
	pkgList := contracts.PackagesListPath
	if d.packagesListPath != "" {
		pkgList = d.packagesListPath
	}
	callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
	if clientUID <= 0 {
		if resolvedWork := ResolvePackageUIDForUser(pkgList, policy.UserID, callerPkg); resolvedWork > 0 {
			clientUID = resolvedWork
		}
	}
	cfg := loadExistingOrDefaultStealth(cfgPath, policy.UserID, clientUID)
	resolved := ResolveExemptUIDsForUser(pkgList, policy.UserID, clientUID, callerPkg)
	cfg.ExemptUIDs = mergeExemptUIDs(cfg.ExemptUIDs, resolved, policy.UserID)
	if err := writeStealthFiles(cfgPath, runtimePath, cfg); err != nil {
		return cfg, err
	}
	return cfg, nil
}

func (d *Daemon) resolvedStealthBootTriesPath() string {
	if d.stealthBootTriesPath != "" {
		return d.stealthBootTriesPath
	}
	if d.stealthConfigPath != "" && d.stealthConfigPath != contracts.StealthConfigPath {
		return filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(d.stealthConfigPath), "stealth_boot_tries")
	}
	return contracts.StealthBootTriesPath
}

func (d *Daemon) ReadStealthStatus() map[string]any {
	cfgPath, runtimePath, disabledFlag := d.resolvedStealthPaths()
	_, flagErr := os.Stat(disabledFlag)
	disabledByFlag := flagErr == nil

	tries := 0
	if raw, err := os.ReadFile(d.resolvedStealthBootTriesPath()); err == nil {
		if n, perr := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))); perr == nil && n >= 0 {
			tries = n
		}
	}

	cfg := StealthConfig{}
	loaded := false
	if b, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(cfgPath, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes); err == nil {
		if json.Unmarshal(b, &cfg) == nil {
			loaded = true
		}
	}
	return map[string]any{
		"config_loaded":       loaded,
		"config_path":         cfgPath,
		"runtime_path":        runtimePath,
		"zygisk_disabled":     disabledByFlag,
		"stealth_boot_tries":  tries,
		"active_on_boot":      loaded && cfg.Enabled && !disabledByFlag,
		"active_preset":       cfg.ActivePreset,
		"active_region":       cfg.DeviceRegion,
		"region_spoof_active": cfg.SpoofCarrier && cfg.SpoofDeviceRegion && strings.TrimSpace(cfg.DeviceRegion) != "",
		"config":              cfg,
	}
}

func (d *Daemon) ToggleStealth(enable bool) (StealthConfig, error) {
	d.stealthMu.Lock()
	defer d.stealthMu.Unlock()
	cfgPath, runtimePath, disabledFlag := d.resolvedStealthPaths()
	if enable {
		_ = removeIfExist(disabledFlag)
		if err := sysio.WriteAtomic(d.resolvedStealthBootTriesPath(), []byte("0\n"), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: 0, GID: 0}); err != nil {
			return StealthConfig{}, err
		}
	} else {
		if err := sysio.WriteAtomic(disabledFlag, []byte("disabled via ctl\n"), sysio.WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0644, UID: 0, GID: 0}); err != nil {
			return StealthConfig{}, err
		}
	}

	d.mu.Lock()
	policy := d.policy
	clientUID := 0
	if d.cachedID != nil {
		clientUID = d.cachedID.ClientUID
	}
	d.mu.Unlock()

	if policy.UserID <= 0 {
		policy.UserID = 10
	}
	pkgList := contracts.PackagesListPath
	if d.packagesListPath != "" {
		pkgList = d.packagesListPath
	}
	callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
	if clientUID <= 0 {
		if resolvedWork := ResolvePackageUIDForUser(pkgList, policy.UserID, callerPkg); resolvedWork > 0 {
			clientUID = resolvedWork
		}
	}
	cfg := loadExistingOrDefaultStealth(cfgPath, policy.UserID, clientUID)
	resolved := ResolveExemptUIDsForUser(pkgList, policy.UserID, clientUID, callerPkg)
	cfg.ExemptUIDs = mergeExemptUIDs(cfg.ExemptUIDs, resolved, policy.UserID)
	cfg.Enabled = enable
	if err := writeStealthFiles(cfgPath, runtimePath, cfg); err != nil {
		return cfg, err
	}
	return cfg, nil
}

// RegionPreset models a region/carrier stealth preset JSON file loaded via `ctl preset-apply`.
type RegionPreset struct {
	Name                string  `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Timezone            *string `json:"timezone,omitempty"`
	Locale              *string `json:"locale,omitempty"`
	SimOperator         *string `json:"sim_operator,omitempty"`
	SimOperatorName     *string `json:"sim_operator_name,omitempty"`
	SimCountryISO       *string `json:"sim_country_iso,omitempty"`
	NetworkOperator     *string `json:"network_operator,omitempty"`
	NetworkOperatorName *string `json:"network_operator_name,omitempty"`
	NetworkCountryISO   *string `json:"network_country_iso,omitempty"`
	SpoofCarrier        *bool   `json:"spoof_carrier,omitempty"`
	SpoofTimezone       *bool   `json:"spoof_timezone,omitempty"`
	SpoofLocale         *bool   `json:"spoof_locale,omitempty"`
	SpoofDeviceRegion   *bool   `json:"spoof_device_region,omitempty"`
	SpoofBluetooth      *bool   `json:"spoof_bluetooth,omitempty"`
	DeviceName          *string `json:"device_name,omitempty"`
	DeviceRegion        *string `json:"device_region,omitempty"`
	MiuiRegion          *string `json:"miui_region,omitempty"`
	BootHWC             *string `json:"boot_hwc,omitempty"`
}

func normalizeRegionCode(cfg StealthConfig) string {
	if r := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(cfg.DeviceRegion)); r != "" {
		return r
	}
	if r := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(cfg.SimCountryISO)); r != "" {
		return r
	}
	return ""
}

// DetectRegionSwitch warns when a preset change alters an already-set country,
// which can fracture long-lived device and location trust consistency.
func DetectRegionSwitch(prev, next StealthConfig) string {
	p := normalizeRegionCode(prev)
	n := normalizeRegionCode(next)
	if p == "" || n == "" || p == n {
		return ""
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("cross-region preset switch %s -> %s may destabilize device/geo consistency", p, n)
}

// ApplyPresetFile overlays a bounded preset JSON file onto stealth.json and syncs sandbox policies when pinned.
func (d *Daemon) ApplyPresetFile(ctx context.Context, presetPath string) (StealthConfig, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(presetPath) == "" || strings.ContainsAny(presetPath, "\x00\r\n") {
		return StealthConfig{}, errors.New("invalid preset path")
	}
	raw, err := sysio.ReadSmallFileNoFollow(presetPath, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return StealthConfig{}, err
	}
	var p RegionPreset
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(&p); err != nil {
		return StealthConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse preset JSON: %w", err)
	}
	if p.Locale != nil && *p.Locale != "" && !contracts.ValidLocaleTag(strings.TrimSpace(*p.Locale)) {
		return StealthConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid preset locale %q", *p.Locale)
	}
	if p.Timezone != nil && strings.ContainsAny(*p.Timezone, "\x00\r\n;&|$`") {
		return StealthConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid preset timezone %q", *p.Timezone)
	}

	d.stealthMu.Lock()
	defer d.stealthMu.Unlock()

	d.mu.Lock()
	loaded := d.policyLoaded
	policy := d.policy
	clientUID := 0
	if d.cachedID != nil {
		clientUID = d.cachedID.ClientUID
	}
	d.mu.Unlock()

	if policy.UserID <= 0 {
		policy.UserID = 10
	}
	pkgList := contracts.PackagesListPath
	if d.packagesListPath != "" {
		pkgList = d.packagesListPath
	}
	callerPkg := policy.EffectiveCallerPackage()
	if clientUID <= 0 {
		if resolvedWork := ResolvePackageUIDForUser(pkgList, policy.UserID, callerPkg); resolvedWork > 0 {
			clientUID = resolvedWork
		}
	}

	cfgPath, runtimePath, _ := d.resolvedStealthPaths()
	cfg := loadExistingOrDefaultStealth(cfgPath, policy.UserID, clientUID)
	prevCfg := cfg
	if p.Timezone != nil {
		cfg.Timezone = strings.TrimSpace(*p.Timezone)
	}
	if p.Locale != nil {
		cfg.Locale = strings.TrimSpace(*p.Locale)
	}
	if p.SimOperator != nil {
		cfg.SimOperator = strings.TrimSpace(*p.SimOperator)
	}
	if p.SimOperatorName != nil {
		cfg.SimOperatorName = strings.TrimSpace(*p.SimOperatorName)
	}
	if p.SimCountryISO != nil {
		cfg.SimCountryISO = strings.TrimSpace(*p.SimCountryISO)
	}
	if p.NetworkOperator != nil {
		cfg.NetworkOperator = strings.TrimSpace(*p.NetworkOperator)
	} else if p.SimOperator != nil {
		cfg.NetworkOperator = cfg.SimOperator
	}
	if p.NetworkOperatorName != nil {
		cfg.NetworkOperatorName = strings.TrimSpace(*p.NetworkOperatorName)
	} else if p.SimOperatorName != nil {
		cfg.NetworkOperatorName = cfg.SimOperatorName
	}
	if p.NetworkCountryISO != nil {
		cfg.NetworkCountryISO = strings.TrimSpace(*p.NetworkCountryISO)
	} else if p.SimCountryISO != nil {
		cfg.NetworkCountryISO = cfg.SimCountryISO
	}
	if p.SpoofCarrier != nil {
		cfg.SpoofCarrier = *p.SpoofCarrier
	}
	if p.SpoofTimezone != nil {
		cfg.SpoofTimezone = *p.SpoofTimezone
	}
	if p.SpoofLocale != nil {
		cfg.SpoofLocale = *p.SpoofLocale
	}
	if p.SpoofDeviceRegion != nil {
		cfg.SpoofDeviceRegion = *p.SpoofDeviceRegion
	}
	if p.SpoofBluetooth != nil {
		cfg.SpoofBluetooth = *p.SpoofBluetooth
	}
	if p.DeviceName != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*p.DeviceName) != "" {
		cfg.DeviceName = strings.TrimSpace(*p.DeviceName)
	}
	if p.DeviceRegion != nil {
		cfg.DeviceRegion = strings.TrimSpace(*p.DeviceRegion)
		cfg.MiuiRegion = cfg.DeviceRegion
	} else if p.MiuiRegion != nil {
		cfg.MiuiRegion = strings.TrimSpace(*p.MiuiRegion)
		cfg.DeviceRegion = cfg.MiuiRegion
	}
	if p.BootHWC != nil {
		cfg.BootHWC = strings.TrimSpace(*p.BootHWC)
	}
	if name := strings.TrimSpace(p.Name); name != "" {
		cfg.ActivePreset = name
	}
	if warn := DetectRegionSwitch(prevCfg, cfg); warn != "" && d.log != nil {
		d.log.Printf("preset-apply warning: %s", warn)
	}
	resolved := ResolveExemptUIDsForUser(pkgList, policy.UserID, clientUID, callerPkg)
	cfg.ExemptUIDs = mergeExemptUIDs(cfg.ExemptUIDs, resolved, policy.UserID)
	if err := writeStealthFiles(cfgPath, runtimePath, cfg); err != nil {
		return cfg, err
	}
	if loaded && d.runner != nil {
		_, _ = d.syncPolicies(ctx, policy)
	}
	return cfg, nil
}

func (d *Daemon) readActivePresetName() string {
	cfgPath, _, _ := d.resolvedStealthPaths()
	raw, err := sysio.ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(cfgPath, contracts.MaxSmallFileBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return "neutral"
	}
	var cfg StealthConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cfg); err != nil {
		return "neutral"
	}
	if name := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.ActivePreset); name != "" {
		return name
	}
	return "neutral"
}
```

```go
//go:build linux

package daemon

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/sysio"
)

var rtGroups = []int{
	unix.RTNLGRP_LINK,
	unix.RTNLGRP_IPV4_IFADDR,
	unix.RTNLGRP_IPV4_ROUTE,
	unix.RTNLGRP_IPV4_RULE,
	unix.RTNLGRP_IPV6_IFADDR,
	unix.RTNLGRP_IPV6_ROUTE,
	unix.RTNLGRP_IPV6_RULE,
}

func wakeUp(ch chan<- struct{}) {
	select {
	case ch <- struct{}{}:
	default:
	}
}

// WatchRoutes monitors NETLINK_ROUTE events with zero polling via blocking Poll + wake pipe.
func WatchRoutes(wake chan<- struct{}, fail chan<- error) (func(), error) {
	fd, err := unix.Socket(unix.AF_NETLINK, unix.SOCK_RAW|unix.SOCK_CLOEXEC|unix.SOCK_NONBLOCK, unix.NETLINK_ROUTE)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := unix.Bind(fd, &unix.SockaddrNetlink{Family: unix.AF_NETLINK}); err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, g := range rtGroups {
		if err := unix.SetsockoptInt(fd, unix.SOL_NETLINK, unix.NETLINK_ADD_MEMBERSHIP, g); err != nil {
			_ = unix.Close(fd)
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("netlink group %d: %w", g, err)
		}
	}
	var pipeFds [2]int
	if err := unix.Pipe2(pipeFds[:], unix.O_CLOEXEC|unix.O_NONBLOCK); err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return nil, err
	}
	stopR, stopW := pipeFds[0], pipeFds[1]
	done := make(chan struct{})
	var once sync.Once
	closeFn := func() {
		once.Do(func() {
			close(done)
			_ = unix.Close(stopW)
		})
	}
	go func() {
		defer func() {
			_ = unix.Close(fd)
			_ = unix.Close(stopR)
		}()
		buf := make([]byte, 64<<10)
		fds := []unix.PollFd{
			{Fd: int32(fd), Events: unix.POLLIN},
			{Fd: int32(stopR), Events: unix.POLLIN},
		}
		for {
			if _, perr := unix.Poll(fds, -1); perr != nil {
				if perr == unix.EINTR {
					continue
				}
				select {
				case <-done:
					return
				case fail <- fmt.Errorf("netlink poll: %w", perr):
				default:
				}
				return
			}
			select {
			case <-done:
				return
			default:
			}
			if fds[1].Revents != 0 {
				return
			}
			for {
				_, _, err := unix.Recvfrom(fd, buf, 0)
				if err == nil {
					wakeUp(wake)
					continue
				}
				if err == unix.EAGAIN || err == unix.EWOULDBLOCK {
					break
				}
				if err == unix.ENOBUFS {
					wakeUp(wake)
					continue
				}
				if err == unix.EINTR {
					continue
				}
				select {
				case <-done:
					return
				case fail <- fmt.Errorf("netlink: %w", err):
				default:
				}
				return
			}
		}
	}()
	return closeFn, nil
}

type WatchChannels struct {
	RouteWake     chan struct{}
	AckWake       chan struct{}
	VPNStatusWake chan struct{}
	PkgWake       chan struct{}
	UserWake      chan struct{}
	Shutdown      chan string
	Fail          chan error
}

type InotifyWatcher struct {
	fd           int
	stopR        int
	stopW        int
	done         chan struct{}
	mu           sync.Mutex
	kinds        map[int]string
	proxyDirs    map[string]int
	workFD       int
	workWd       int
	workUserID   int
	workClientID int
	workPkg      string
	closed       bool
	closeOnce    sync.Once
}

func StartInotifyWatcher(ch WatchChannels) (*InotifyWatcher, error) {
	fd, err := unix.InotifyInit1(unix.IN_CLOEXEC | unix.IN_NONBLOCK)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var pipeFds [2]int
	if err := unix.Pipe2(pipeFds[:], unix.O_CLOEXEC|unix.O_NONBLOCK); err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return nil, err
	}
	w := &InotifyWatcher{
		fd:        fd,
		stopR:     pipeFds[0],
		stopW:     pipeFds[1],
		done:      make(chan struct{}),
		kinds:     make(map[int]string),
		proxyDirs: make(map[string]int),
		workFD:    -1,
		workWd:    -1,
	}

	add := func(path string, mask uint32, kind string, required bool) error {
		wd, err := unix.InotifyAddWatch(fd, path, mask|unix.IN_DONT_FOLLOW)
		if err != nil {
			if required {
				return fmt.Errorf("watch %s: %w", path, err)
			}
			return nil
		}
		w.mu.Lock()
		w.kinds[wd] = kind
		w.mu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}

	gone := uint32(unix.IN_DELETE_SELF | unix.IN_MOVE_SELF)
	if err := add(contracts.ModuleDir, unix.IN_CREATE|unix.IN_MOVED_TO|unix.IN_CLOSE_WRITE|gone, "module", true); err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		_ = unix.Close(w.stopR)
		_ = unix.Close(w.stopW)
		return nil, err
	}
	_ = os.MkdirAll(contracts.MainBase, 0700)
	_ = add(contracts.MainBase, unix.IN_CREATE|unix.IN_MOVED_TO|unix.IN_CLOSE_WRITE|unix.IN_DELETE|unix.IN_MOVED_FROM, "mainbase", false)
	w.mu.Lock()
	for wd, k := range w.kinds {
		if k == "mainbase" {
			w.proxyDirs[contracts.MainBase] = wd
		}
	}
	w.mu.Unlock()
	_ = add(filepath.Dir(contracts.PackagesListPath), unix.IN_MOVED_TO, "system", false)
	_ = add(contracts.UsersSystemDir, unix.IN_MOVED_TO|unix.IN_CLOSE_WRITE|unix.IN_CREATE|unix.IN_DELETE, "users", false)
	_ = add(contracts.NetdMiscDir, unix.IN_MOVED_TO|unix.IN_CLOSE_WRITE|unix.IN_CREATE|unix.IN_DELETE, "netd", false)

	go w.loop(ch)
	return w, nil
}

// EnsureProxyBaseWatch dynamically attaches an inotify watch on a custom proxy base directory
// so sandbox_ack.v1.json updates trigger AckWake immediately without waiting for the 3s fallback timer.
func (w *InotifyWatcher) EnsureProxyBaseWatch(dir string) {
	if w == nil {
		return
	}
	clean := filepath.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(dir))
	if clean == "" || clean == "." {
		return
	}
	w.mu.Lock()
	_, exists := w.proxyDirs[clean]
	w.mu.Unlock()
	if exists {
		return
	}
	_ = os.MkdirAll(clean, 0700)
	mask := uint32(unix.IN_CREATE|unix.IN_MOVED_TO|unix.IN_CLOSE_WRITE|unix.IN_DELETE|unix.IN_MOVED_FROM|unix.IN_DONT_FOLLOW)
	wd, err := unix.InotifyAddWatch(w.fd, clean, mask)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	w.mu.Lock()
	if w.closed {
		w.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	if _, dup := w.proxyDirs[clean]; dup {
		_, _ = unix.InotifyRmWatch(w.fd, uint32(wd))
	} else {
		w.proxyDirs[clean] = wd
		w.kinds[wd] = "mainbase"
	}
	w.mu.Unlock()
}

// EnsureWorkFilesWatch attaches an inotify watch on /data/user/<u>/<workPkg>/files
// using sysio.SafeResolver (openat2 or kernel_compat openat O_NOFOLLOW component walk).
func (w *InotifyWatcher) EnsureWorkFilesWatch(userID, clientUID int, workPkg ...string) {
	if w == nil || oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) || !contracts.ValidClientUID(userID, clientUID) {
		return
	}
	pkg := contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	if len(workPkg) > 0 && contracts.ValidPackageName(workPkg[0]) {
		pkg = workPkg[0]
	}
	w.mu.Lock()
	sameTarget := w.workWd >= 0 && w.workUserID == userID && w.workClientID == clientUID && w.workPkg == pkg
	needReset := w.workWd >= 0 && !sameTarget
	w.mu.Unlock()
	if sameTarget {
		return
	}
	if needReset {
		w.resetWorkFilesWatch()
	}

	resolver := sysio.DefaultResolver()
	parentFD, _, closeParent, err := resolver.OpenDirAbsolute("/data/user")
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	defer func() { _ = closeParent() }()

	dirHow := sysio.RequiredDirOpenHow()
	userFD, _, closeUser, err := resolver.OpenDirBeneath(parentFD, strconv.Itoa(userID), dirHow)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	defer func() { _ = closeUser() }()

	filesFD, meta, closeFiles, err := resolver.OpenDirBeneath(userFD, pkg+"/files", dirHow)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	if !meta.IsDir || meta.UID != clientUID {
		_ = closeFiles()
		return
	}
	wd, err := unix.InotifyAddWatch(w.fd, fmt.Sprintf("/proc/self/fd/%d", filesFD),
		unix.IN_CLOSE_WRITE|unix.IN_MOVED_TO|unix.IN_CREATE|unix.IN_DELETE_SELF|unix.IN_MOVE_SELF)
	if err != nil {
		_ = closeFiles()
		return
	}

	w.mu.Lock()
	if w.closed || w.workWd >= 0 {
		if !w.closed {
			_, _ = unix.InotifyRmWatch(w.fd, uint32(wd))
		}
		w.mu.Unlock()
		_ = closeFiles()
	} else {
		w.workFD = filesFD
		w.workWd = wd
		w.workUserID = userID
		w.workClientID = clientUID
		w.workPkg = pkg
		w.kinds[wd] = "workfiles"
		w.mu.Unlock()
	}
}

func (w *InotifyWatcher) resetWorkFilesWatch() {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	w.resetWorkFilesWatchLocked()
}

func (w *InotifyWatcher) resetWorkFilesWatchLocked() {
	if w.workWd >= 0 {
		delete(w.kinds, w.workWd)
		if !w.closed {
			_, _ = unix.InotifyRmWatch(w.fd, uint32(w.workWd))
		}
		w.workWd = -1
	}
	if w.workFD >= 0 {
		_ = unix.Close(w.workFD)
		w.workFD = -1
	}
	w.workUserID = 0
	w.workClientID = 0
	w.workPkg = ""
}

func (w *InotifyWatcher) Close() {
	w.closeOnce.Do(func() {
		w.mu.Lock()
		w.resetWorkFilesWatchLocked()
		w.mu.Unlock()
		close(w.done)
		_ = unix.Close(w.stopW)
	})
}

func (w *InotifyWatcher) loop(ch WatchChannels) {
	defer func() {
		w.mu.Lock()
		w.closed = true
		_ = unix.Close(w.fd)
		w.mu.Unlock()
		_ = unix.Close(w.stopR)
	}()
	buf := make([]byte, 16<<10)
	gone := uint32(unix.IN_DELETE_SELF | unix.IN_MOVE_SELF)
	fds := []unix.PollFd{
		{Fd: int32(w.fd), Events: unix.POLLIN},
		{Fd: int32(w.stopR), Events: unix.POLLIN},
	}
	for {
		if _, perr := unix.Poll(fds, -1); perr != nil {
			if perr == unix.EINTR {
				continue
			}
			select {
			case <-w.done:
				return
			case ch.Fail <- fmt.Errorf("inotify poll: %v", perr):
			default:
			}
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-w.done:
			return
		default:
		}
		if fds[1].Revents != 0 {
			return
		}
		for {
			n, err := unix.Read(w.fd, buf)
			if err == unix.EINTR {
				continue
			}
			if err == unix.EAGAIN || err == unix.EWOULDBLOCK {
				break
			}
			if err != nil || n <= 0 {
				select {
				case <-w.done:
					return
				case ch.Fail <- fmt.Errorf("inotify read: %v", err):
				default:
				}
				return
			}
			for off := 0; off+unix.SizeofInotifyEvent <= n; {
				ev := (*unix.InotifyEvent)(unsafe.Pointer(&buf[off]))
				evEnd := off + unix.SizeofInotifyEvent + int(ev.Len)
				if evEnd > n {
					break
				}
				name := ""
				if ev.Len > 0 {
					name = strings.TrimRight(string(buf[off+unix.SizeofInotifyEvent:evEnd]), "\x00")
				}
				off = evEnd

				w.mu.Lock()
				kind := w.kinds[int(ev.Wd)]
				w.mu.Unlock()

				switch kind {
				case "module":
					if ev.Mask&gone != 0 || name == "disable" || name == "remove" {
						select {
						case ch.Shutdown <- "module " + name:
						default:
						}
					}
				case "mainbase":
					if name == "sandbox_ack.v1.json" || name == "core.pid" || name == "" {
						wakeUp(ch.AckWake)
					}
				case "system":
					if name == "packages.list" || name == "" {
						wakeUp(ch.PkgWake)
					}
				case "users":
					wakeUp(ch.UserWake)
				case "netd":
					wakeUp(ch.RouteWake)
				case "workfiles":
					if ev.Mask&gone != 0 {
						w.resetWorkFilesWatch()
					} else if name == "vpn_status.json" || name == "" {
						wakeUp(ch.VPNStatusWake)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/netfilter/apply.go`:

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os/exec"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/sysio"
)

type Runner interface {
	Run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin string, name string, args ...string) (string, error)
}

var (
	iptOnce sync.Once
	ipt4Bin = "iptables"
	ipt6Bin = "ip6tables"
)

func resolveHostIPTablesBins() (string, string) {
	iptOnce.Do(func() {
		if runtime.GOOS != "linux" {
			return
		}
		for _, cand := range []string{"iptables", "iptables-nft", "iptables-legacy"} {
			if _, err := exec.LookPath(cand); err == nil {
				ipt4Bin = cand
				break
			}
		}
		for _, cand := range []string{"ip6tables", "ip6tables-nft", "ip6tables-legacy"} {
			if _, err := exec.LookPath(cand); err == nil {
				ipt6Bin = cand
				break
			}
		}
	})
	return ipt4Bin, ipt6Bin
}

func resolveIPTablesCompanionBin(name, v4, v6 string, lookPath func(string) (string, error)) string {
	switch {
	case name == "iptables":
		return v4
	case strings.HasPrefix(name, "iptables-") && v4 != "iptables":
		suf := strings.TrimPrefix(name, "iptables")
		if p, err := lookPath(v4 + suf); err == nil {
			return p
		}
		base := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(v4, "-nft"), "-legacy")
		if p, err := lookPath(base + suf); err == nil {
			return p
		}
	case name == "ip6tables":
		return v6
	case strings.HasPrefix(name, "ip6tables-") && v6 != "ip6tables":
		suf := strings.TrimPrefix(name, "ip6tables")
		if p, err := lookPath(v6 + suf); err == nil {
			return p
		}
		base := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(v6, "-nft"), "-legacy")
		if p, err := lookPath(base + suf); err == nil {
			return p
		}
	}
	return name
}

type ExecRunner struct{}

func (e ExecRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	var r io.Reader
	if stdin != "" {
		r = strings.NewReader(stdin)
	}
	return e.RunWithStdinReader(ctx, timeout, r, name, args...)
}

func (ExecRunner) RunWithStdinReader(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, stdin io.Reader, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	cctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
	defer cancel()
	bin := name
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "iptables") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "ip6tables") {
		v4, v6 := resolveHostIPTablesBins()
		bin = resolveIPTablesCompanionBin(name, v4, v6, exec.LookPath)
	}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(cctx, bin, args...)
	if stdin != nil {
		cmd.Stdin = stdin
	}
	var out, errb bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &out, &errb
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		msg := strings.TrimSpace(errb.String())
		if len(msg) > 300 {
			msg = msg[:300]
		}
		return out.String(), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w: %s", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err, msg)
	}
	return out.String(), nil
}

type Controller struct {
	Runner   Runner
	LockPath string

	routingCleaned bool
}

func NewController() *Controller {
	return &Controller{Runner: ExecRunner{}, LockPath: contracts.SharedLockPath}
}

func (c *Controller) lockPath() string {
	if c.LockPath != "" {
		return c.LockPath
	}
	return contracts.SharedLockPath
}

func (c *Controller) toolFor(family int) (string, error) {
	switch family {
	case 4:
		return "iptables", nil
	case 6:
		return "ip6tables", nil
	default:
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid family %d", family)
	}
}

func (c *Controller) saveTable(ctx context.Context, family int, table string) (Save, error) {
	tool, err := c.toolFor(family)
	if err != nil {
		return Save{}, err
	}
	out, err := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 10*time.Second, "", tool+"-save", "-t", table)
	if err != nil {
		return Save{}, err
	}
	return ParseSave(out), nil
}

func (c *Controller) saveAllTables(ctx context.Context, family int) (map[string]Save, error) {
	tool, err := c.toolFor(family)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out, err := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 10*time.Second, "", tool+"-save")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	parsed := ParseSaveAll(out)
	if len(parsed) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s-save returned no tables", tool)
	}
	return parsed, nil
}

func (c *Controller) loadFamilyTables(ctx context.Context, family int) func(table string) (Save, error) {
	all, allErr := c.saveAllTables(ctx, family)
	cache := make(map[string]Save, 4)
	if allErr == nil {
		for k, v := range all {
			cache[k] = v
		}
	}
	return func(table string) (Save, error) {
		if s, ok := cache[table]; ok {
			return s, nil
		}
		s, err := c.saveTable(ctx, family, table)
		if err == nil {
			cache[table] = s
		}
		return s, err
	}
}

func (c *Controller) restoreTable(ctx context.Context, family int, batch string) error {
	if batch == "" {
		return nil
	}
	tool, err := c.toolFor(family)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = c.Runner.Run(ctx, 15*time.Second, batch, tool+"-restore", "-w", "10", "--noflush")
	return err
}

// DetectProxyCapture inspects IPv4 and IPv6 mangle tables under the shared lock to determine
// whether external proxy capture chains (<prefix>OUTPUT / <prefix>OUTPUT6) are installed.
func (c *Controller) DetectProxyCapture(ctx context.Context, prefix string) (bool, error) {
	if prefix == "" {
		return false, nil
	}
	unlock, err := sysio.AcquireFlock(c.lockPath(), 0600, 15*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer unlock()
	return c.detectProxyCaptureLocked(ctx, prefix)
}

func (c *Controller) detectProxyCaptureLocked(ctx context.Context, prefix string) (bool, error) {
	if prefix == "" {
		return false, nil
	}
	for _, family := range []int{4, 6} {
		s, err := c.saveTable(ctx, family, "mangle")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		if HasExternalCapture(s, family, prefix) {
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

type pendingHookVerify struct {
	hook        GateHook
	expected    []string
	expectEmpty bool
}

func (c *Controller) useNativeNetlink() bool {
	if runtime.GOOS != "linux" {
		return false
	}
	if c.Runner == nil {
		return true
	}
	switch c.Runner.(type) {
	case ExecRunner, *ExecRunner:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (c *Controller) verifyTProxyRouting(ctx context.Context, spec GateSpec) error {
	mark := spec.tproxyMark()
	if c.useNativeNetlink() {
		err := nativeVerifyTProxyRouting(mark, contracts.DefaultTProxyPref, contracts.DefaultTProxyTable)
		if err == nil {
			return nil
		}
		if errors.Is(err, errTProxyVerifyMismatch) || c.Runner == nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	table := strconv.Itoa(contracts.DefaultTProxyTable)
	pref := strconv.Itoa(contracts.DefaultTProxyPref)
	wantFw := fmt.Sprintf("fwmark 0x%x/0x%x", mark, contracts.NetIDMask)

	rulesOut, err := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "rule", "show")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	haveRule := false
	for _, line := range strings.Split(rulesOut, "\n") {
		l := strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if strings.HasPrefix(l, pref+":") && strings.Contains(l, wantFw) && strings.Contains(l, "lookup "+table) {
			haveRule = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !haveRule {
		return fmt.Errorf("missing ip rule pref %s %s lookup %s", pref, wantFw, table)
	}
	routeOut, rerr := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "route", "show", "table", table)
	if rerr != nil {
		return rerr
	}
	if !strings.Contains(routeOut, "local") || !strings.Contains(routeOut, "dev lo") {
		return fmt.Errorf("missing local dev lo route in table %s", table)
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *Controller) ensureTProxyRouting(ctx context.Context, spec GateSpec) error {
	mark := spec.tproxyMark()
	if c.useNativeNetlink() {
		if err := nativeEnsureTProxyRouting(mark, contracts.DefaultTProxyPref, contracts.DefaultTProxyTable); err == nil {
			c.routingCleaned = false
			return nil
		} else if c.Runner == nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	table := strconv.Itoa(contracts.DefaultTProxyTable)
	pref := strconv.Itoa(contracts.DefaultTProxyPref)
	wantFw := fmt.Sprintf("fwmark 0x%x/0x%x", mark, contracts.NetIDMask)

	var (
		rulesOut, routeOut string
		err, rerr          error
		wg                 sync.WaitGroup
	)
	wg.Add(2)
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		rulesOut, err = c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "rule", "show")
	}()
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		routeOut, rerr = c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "route", "show", "table", table)
	}()
	wg.Wait()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	haveRule := false
	staleRules := 0
	for _, line := range strings.Split(rulesOut, "\n") {
		l := strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(l, pref+":") {
			continue
		}
		if strings.Contains(l, wantFw) && strings.Contains(l, "lookup "+table) {
			haveRule = true
		} else {
			staleRules++
		}
	}
	// ip -4 rule del pref <N> always deletes the highest remaining rule at that pref, so if
	// stale rules share the same pref with a valid rule, clear all pref rules and re-add cleanly.
	delCount := staleRules
	if haveRule && staleRules > 0 {
		delCount++
		haveRule = false
	}
	for i := 0; i < delCount && i < 8; i++ {
		if _, derr := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "rule", "del", "pref", pref); derr != nil {
			break
		}
	}
	haveRoute := rerr == nil && strings.Contains(routeOut, "local") && strings.Contains(routeOut, "dev lo")
	if !haveRoute {
		if _, err := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "route", "replace", "local", "0.0.0.0/0", "dev", "lo", "table", table); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if !haveRule {
		if _, err := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "rule", "add", "pref", pref, "fwmark",
			fmt.Sprintf("0x%x/0x%x", mark, contracts.NetIDMask), "lookup", table); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	c.routingCleaned = false
	return nil
}

func (c *Controller) cleanupTProxyRouting(ctx context.Context) {
	if c.routingCleaned {
		return
	}
	if c.useNativeNetlink() {
		if err := nativeCleanupTProxyRouting(contracts.DefaultTProxyPref, contracts.DefaultTProxyTable); err == nil {
			c.routingCleaned = true
			return
		} else if c.Runner == nil {
			return
		}
	}
	table := strconv.Itoa(contracts.DefaultTProxyTable)
	pref := strconv.Itoa(contracts.DefaultTProxyPref)
	out, err := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "rule", "show")
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for i := 0; i < 4 && strings.Contains(out, "lookup "+table); i++ {
		if !strings.Contains(out, pref+":") {
			break
		}
		if _, err := c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "rule", "del", "pref", pref, "lookup", table); err != nil {
			break
		}
		out, err = c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "rule", "show")
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
	}
	_, _ = c.Runner.Run(ctx, 4*time.Second, "", "ip", "-4", "route", "flush", "table", table)
	c.routingCleaned = true
}

func (c *Controller) ApplyOrVerify(ctx context.Context, spec GateSpec, inspect bool) error {
	if err := spec.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	unlock, err := sysio.AcquireFlock(c.lockPath(), 0600, 15*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer unlock()

	if !inspect {
		if spec.IsTProxy() {
			if spec.Open {
				if err := c.ensureTProxyRouting(ctx, spec); err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("tproxy routing: %w", err)
				}
			}
		} else {
			defer c.cleanupTProxyRouting(ctx)
		}
	} else if spec.IsTProxy() && spec.Open {
		if err := c.verifyTProxyRouting(ctx, spec); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("tproxy routing verification: %w", err)
		}
	}

	hooks := GateHooksFor(spec)
	var err4, err6 error
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(2)
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		err4 = c.applyOrVerifyFamily(ctx, 4, hooks, spec, inspect)
	}()
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		err6 = c.applyOrVerifyFamily(ctx, 6, hooks, spec, inspect)
	}()
	wg.Wait()
	if err4 != nil {
		return err4
	}
	return err6
}

func (c *Controller) applyOrVerifyFamily(ctx context.Context, family int, hooks []GateHook, spec GateSpec, inspect bool) error {
	getTable := c.loadFamilyTables(ctx, family)
	var batches []string
	var pendingVerify []pendingHookVerify

	for _, hook := range hooks {
		if !hookActive(hook, family, spec) {
			if hook.TProxyOnly && family == 4 {
				current, err := getTable(hook.Table)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if inspect {
					if ChainPresent(current, hook) {
						return fmt.Errorf("IPv%d %s (%s) still present outside tproxy mode", family, hook.Chain, hook.Table)
					}
					continue
				}
				if batch := RemoveBatch(current, hook); batch != "" {
					batches = append(batches, batch)
					pendingVerify = append(pendingVerify, pendingHookVerify{hook: hook, expectEmpty: true})
				}
			}
			continue
		}
		expected, err := RulesFor(family, hook, spec)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		current, err := getTable(hook.Table)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if inspect {
			if !GateInstalled(current, hook, expected) {
				return fmt.Errorf("IPv%d %s (%s) failed verification", family, hook.Chain, hook.Table)
			}
			continue
		}
		if GateInstalled(current, hook, expected) {
			continue
		}
		batches = append(batches, GateBatch(current, hook, expected))
		pendingVerify = append(pendingVerify, pendingHookVerify{hook: hook, expected: expected})
	}

	if inspect || len(batches) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	tableOrder := []string{"raw", "filter", "mangle"}
	if spec.Open {
		tableOrder = []string{"mangle", "filter", "raw"}
	}
	combined := MergeTableBatches(batches, tableOrder)
	if err := c.restoreTable(ctx, family, combined); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	verifyTable := c.loadFamilyTables(ctx, family)
	for _, pv := range pendingVerify {
		current, err := verifyTable(pv.hook.Table)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if pv.expectEmpty {
			if ChainPresent(current, pv.hook) {
				return fmt.Errorf("IPv%d %s (%s) removal failed verification", family, pv.hook.Chain, pv.hook.Table)
			}
			continue
		}
		if !GateInstalled(current, pv.hook, pv.expected) {
			return fmt.Errorf("IPv%d %s (%s) failed verification", family, pv.hook.Chain, pv.hook.Table)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type RuntimeInspection struct {
	ExternalCapture bool
	RawArmed        bool
	OutputOpen      bool
	EgressOpen      bool
	VerifyErr       string
}

func (c *Controller) InspectRuntime(ctx context.Context, spec GateSpec) (RuntimeInspection, error) {
	unlock, err := sysio.AcquireFlock(c.lockPath(), 0600, 15*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeInspection{}, err
	}
	defer unlock()

	extCap, err := c.detectProxyCaptureLocked(ctx, spec.ProxySkipPrefix)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeInspection{}, err
	}
	res := RuntimeInspection{ExternalCapture: extCap}

	raw4, err := c.saveTable(ctx, 4, "raw")
	if err == nil {
		res.RawArmed = len(raw4.Rules[contracts.ChainRawOutput]) > 0
	}
	out4, err := c.saveTable(ctx, 4, "filter")
	if err == nil {
		for _, r := range out4.Rules[contracts.ChainOutput] {
			if strings.HasSuffix(r, "-j RETURN") {
				res.OutputOpen = true
				break
			}
		}
	}
	eg4, err := c.saveTable(ctx, 4, "mangle")
	if err == nil {
		for _, r := range eg4.Rules[contracts.ChainEgress] {
			if strings.HasSuffix(r, "-j RETURN") {
				res.EgressOpen = true
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return res, nil
}
```
