```go
func TestResolveIPTablesCompanionBin(t *testing.T) {
	mockLook := func(avail map[string]bool) func(string) (string, error) {
		return func(bin string) (string, error) {
			if avail[bin] {
				return "/system/bin/" + bin, nil
			}
			return "", errors.New("not found")
		}
	}

	got4 := resolveIPTablesCompanionBin("iptables-restore", "iptables-nft", "ip6tables-nft",
		mockLook(map[string]bool{"iptables-nft-restore": true, "iptables-restore": true}))
	if got4 != "/system/bin/iptables-nft-restore" {
		t.Fatalf("expected iptables-nft-restore, got %s", got4)
	}

	got6 := resolveIPTablesCompanionBin("ip6tables-save", "iptables", "ip6tables-legacy",
		mockLook(map[string]bool{"ip6tables-legacy-save": true}))
	if got6 != "/system/bin/ip6tables-legacy-save" {
		t.Fatalf("expected ip6tables-legacy-save, got %s", got6)
	}

	fallback := resolveIPTablesCompanionBin("iptables-restore", "iptables-nft", "ip6tables",
		mockLook(map[string]bool{"iptables-restore": true}))
	if fallback != "/system/bin/iptables-restore" {
		t.Fatalf("expected fallback iptables-restore, got %s", fallback)
	}
}

type ruleMockRunner struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	calls []string
	rules string
	route string
}

func (r *ruleMockRunner) Run(_ context.Context, _ time.Duration, _ string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	line := name + " " + strings.Join(args, " ")
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.calls = append(r.calls, line)
	r.mu.Unlock()
	if line == "ip -4 rule show" {
		return r.rules, nil
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(line, "ip -4 route show table ") {
		return r.route, nil
	}
	return "", nil
}

func TestEnsureTProxyRoutingCleansStaleMarkRule(t *testing.T) {
	mr := &ruleMockRunner{
		rules: "0:\tfrom all lookup local\n2025:\tfrom all fwmark 0x99/0xffff lookup 2027\n32766:\tfrom all lookup main\n",
		route: "local default dev lo table 2027 scope host\n",
	}
	c := &Controller{Runner: mr}
	spec := testTProxySpecOpen()
	if err := c.ensureTProxyRouting(context.Background(), spec); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	joined := strings.Join(mr.calls, "\n")
	if !strings.Contains(joined, "ip -4 rule del pref 2025") {
		t.Fatalf("expected stale pref 2025 deletion, got:\n%s", joined)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(joined, "ip -4 rule add pref 2025 fwmark 0x1a/0xffff lookup 2027") {
		t.Fatalf("expected new mark rule installation, got:\n%s", joined)
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/netfilter/rtnetlink_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux

package netfilter

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
)

func openRouteNetlinkSocket() (int, error) {
	fd, err := unix.Socket(unix.AF_NETLINK, unix.SOCK_RAW|unix.SOCK_CLOEXEC, unix.NETLINK_ROUTE)
	if err != nil {
		return -1, err
	}
	tv := unix.NsecToTimeval(int64(4 * time.Second))
	_ = unix.SetsockoptTimeval(fd, unix.SOL_SOCKET, unix.SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv)
	_ = unix.SetsockoptTimeval(fd, unix.SOL_SOCKET, unix.SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv)
	if err := unix.Bind(fd, &unix.SockaddrNetlink{Family: unix.AF_NETLINK}); err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return -1, err
	}
	return fd, nil
}

func netlinkExchange(fd int, req []byte, seq uint32) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := unix.Sendto(fd, req, 0, &unix.SockaddrNetlink{Family: unix.AF_NETLINK}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	buf := make([]byte, 32768)
	var out []byte
	for {
		n, _, err := unix.Recvfrom(fd, buf, 0)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, unix.EINTR) {
				continue
			}
			return nil, err
		}
		if n == 0 {
			return out, nil
		}
		chunk := buf[:n]
		for len(chunk) >= 16 {
			mlen := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(chunk[0:4]))
			mtype := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(chunk[4:6])
			mseq := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(chunk[8:12])
			if mlen < 16 || mlen > len(chunk) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("malformed netlink msg len=%d buf=%d", mlen, len(chunk))
			}
			step := nlAlign4(mlen)
			if step <= 0 || step > len(chunk) {
				step = len(chunk)
			}
			if mseq != seq {
				chunk = chunk[step:]
				continue
			}
			msg := chunk[:mlen]
			if mtype == rtmNLMsgError {
				if len(msg) < 20 {
					return nil, errors.New("short nlmsgerr")
				}
				errnoVal := int32(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(msg[16:20]))
				if errnoVal != 0 {
					return nil, syscall.Errno(-errnoVal)
				}
				return out, nil
			}
			if mtype == rtmNLMsgDone {
				return out, nil
			}
			out = append(out, msg...)
			for z := mlen; z < step; z++ {
				out = append(out, 0)
			}
			chunk = chunk[step:]
		}
		// Single non-multi replies do not emit NLMSG_DONE.
		if len(out) > 0 && binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(out[6:8])&nlmFMulti == 0 {
			return out, nil
		}
	}
}

func loopbackIfindex() (uint32, error) {
	ifi, err := net.InterfaceByName("lo")
	if err != nil || ifi.Index <= 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("resolve lo ifindex: %v", err)
	}
	return uint32(ifi.Index), nil
}

func nativeEnsureTProxyRouting(mark uint32, pref, table int) error {
	fd, err := openRouteNetlinkSocket()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer unix.Close(fd)

	loIdx, err := loopbackIfindex()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	wantPref := uint32(pref)
	wantTable := uint32(table)
	wantMask := uint32(contracts.NetIDMask)

	rulesRaw, err := netlinkExchange(fd, encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmGetRule, nlmFRequest|nlmFDump, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), 1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	validCount := 0
	staleCount := 0
	for _, r := range parseIPv4Rules(rulesRaw) {
		if r.Pref != wantPref {
			continue
		}
		if r.Mark == mark && r.Mask == wantMask && r.Table == wantTable {
			validCount++
		} else {
			staleCount++
		}
	}

	haveRule := validCount == 1 && staleCount == 0
	delCount := 0
	if !haveRule && (validCount > 0 || staleCount > 0) {
		delCount = validCount + staleCount
	}
	var seq uint32 = 2
	for i := 0; i < delCount && i < 16; i++ {
		delMsg := encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmDelRule, nlmFRequest|nlmFAck, seq, wantPref, 0, 0, 0)
		seq++
		if _, derr := netlinkExchange(fd, delMsg, seq-1); derr != nil {
			if errors.Is(derr, syscall.ENOENT) {
				break
			}
			return derr
		}
	}
	if !haveRule {
		addMsg := encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmNewRule, nlmFRequest|nlmFCreate|nlmFExcl|nlmFAck, seq, wantPref, mark, wantMask, wantTable)
		seq++
		if _, aerr := netlinkExchange(fd, addMsg, seq-1); aerr != nil && !errors.Is(aerr, syscall.EEXIST) {
			return aerr
		}
	}

	routesRaw, err := netlinkExchange(fd, encodeIPv4LocalRouteMsg(rtmGetRoute, nlmFRequest|nlmFDump, seq, 0, 0), seq)
	seq++
	if err != nil || !parseIPv4LocalLoRoutes(routesRaw, loIdx, wantTable) {
		addRoute := encodeIPv4LocalRouteMsg(rtmNewRoute, nlmFRequest|nlmFCreate|nlmFReplace|nlmFAck, seq, loIdx, wantTable)
		if _, rerr := netlinkExchange(fd, addRoute, seq); rerr != nil {
			return rerr
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func nativeVerifyTProxyRouting(mark uint32, pref, table int) error {
	fd, err := openRouteNetlinkSocket()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer unix.Close(fd)

	loIdx, err := loopbackIfindex()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	wantPref := uint32(pref)
	wantTable := uint32(table)
	wantMask := uint32(contracts.NetIDMask)

	rulesRaw, err := netlinkExchange(fd, encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmGetRule, nlmFRequest|nlmFDump, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), 1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	validCount := 0
	staleCount := 0
	for _, r := range parseIPv4Rules(rulesRaw) {
		if r.Pref != wantPref {
			continue
		}
		if r.Mark == mark && r.Mask == wantMask && r.Table == wantTable {
			validCount++
		} else {
			staleCount++
		}
	}
	if validCount != 1 || staleCount > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: pref %d ip rule mismatch (valid=%d stale=%d want fwmark 0x%x/0x%x lookup %d)", errTProxyVerifyMismatch, pref, validCount, staleCount, mark, wantMask, table)
	}

	routesRaw, err := netlinkExchange(fd, encodeIPv4LocalRouteMsg(rtmGetRoute, nlmFRequest|nlmFDump, 2, 0, 0), 2)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !parseIPv4LocalLoRoutes(routesRaw, loIdx, wantTable) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: missing local dev lo route in table %d", errTProxyVerifyMismatch, table)
	}
	return nil
}

func nativeCleanupTProxyRouting(pref, table int) error {
	fd, err := openRouteNetlinkSocket()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer unix.Close(fd)

	var seq uint32 = 1
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		delMsg := encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmDelRule, nlmFRequest|nlmFAck, seq, uint32(pref), 0, 0, 0)
		seq++
		if _, derr := netlinkExchange(fd, delMsg, seq-1); derr != nil {
			if errors.Is(derr, syscall.ENOENT) {
				break
			}
			return derr
		}
	}
	if loIdx, lerr := loopbackIfindex(); lerr == nil {
		delRoute := encodeIPv4LocalRouteMsg(rtmDelRoute, nlmFRequest|nlmFAck, seq, loIdx, uint32(table))
		if _, rerr := netlinkExchange(fd, delRoute, seq); rerr != nil && !errors.Is(rerr, syscall.ENOENT) && !errors.Is(rerr, syscall.ESRCH) {
			return rerr
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

`guard/internal/netfilter/rtnetlink_test.go`:

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestRTNetlinkWireRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	ruleMsg := encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmNewRule, nlmFRequest|nlmFCreate|nlmFExcl, 7, 2025, 0x1a, 0xffff, 2027)
	rules := parseIPv4Rules(ruleMsg)
	if len(rules) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 parsed rule, got %d", len(rules))
	}
	r := rules[0]
	if r.Pref != 2025 || r.Mark != 0x1a || r.Mask != 0xffff || r.Table != 2027 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected decoded IPv4 rule: %+v", r)
	}

	// Verify multi-rule dump finds matching and stale rules at pref 2025.
	staleMsg := encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmNewRule, nlmFRequest, 8, 2025, 0x99, 0xffff, 2027)
	otherMsg := encodeIPv4RuleMsg(rtmNewRule, nlmFRequest, 9, 32766, 0, 0, 254)
	combined := append(append([]byte(nil), ruleMsg...), staleMsg...)
	combined = append(combined, otherMsg...)
	allRules := parseIPv4Rules(combined)
	if len(allRules) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 3 parsed rules, got %d", len(allRules))
	}
	if allRules[1].Mark != 0x99 || allRules[2].Pref != 32766 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected multi-rule parse: %+v", allRules)
	}

	// Route encode/decode round trip for local 0.0.0.0/0 dev lo table 2027.
	routeMsg := encodeIPv4LocalRouteMsg(rtmNewRoute, nlmFRequest|nlmFCreate|nlmFReplace, 10, 1, 2027)
	if !parseIPv4LocalLoRoutes(routeMsg, 1, 2027) {
		t.Fatal("expected local dev lo table 2027 route to match")
	}
	if parseIPv4LocalLoRoutes(routeMsg, 2, 2027) {
		t.Fatal("expected wrong ifindex not to match")
	}
	if parseIPv4LocalLoRoutes(routeMsg, 1, 254) {
		t.Fatal("expected wrong table not to match")
	}
	// Non-default dstLen (!= 0) must not match.
	badDst := append([]byte(nil), routeMsg...)
	badDst[17] = 24
	if parseIPv4LocalLoRoutes(badDst, 1, 2027) {
		t.Fatal("expected non-/0 local route not to match")
	}

	// Verify nlmsghdr length matches exact buffer size.
	if got := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(ruleMsg[0:4])); got != len(ruleMsg) {
		t.Fatalf("rule nlmsg_len=%d != buf len %d", got, len(ruleMsg))
	}
	if got := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(routeMsg[0:4])); got != len(routeMsg) {
		t.Fatalf("route nlmsg_len=%d != buf len %d", got, len(routeMsg))
	}
}

	return "", nil

func TestControllerUseNativeNetlinkSelection(t *testing.T) {
	ctrlMock := &Controller{Runner: mockRunnerCheck{}, LockPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "lock")}
	if ctrlMock.useNativeNetlink() {
		t.Fatal("useNativeNetlink must return false for mock runners")
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/netfilter/rtnetlink_wire.go`:

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
)

const (
	rtmNLMsgError   = 0x2
	rtmNLMsgDone    = 0x3
	rtmNewRoute     = 24
	rtmDelRoute     = 25
	rtmGetRoute     = 26
	rtmNewRule      = 32
	rtmDelRule      = 33
	rtmGetRule      = 34

	nlmFRequest = 0x01
	nlmFMulti   = 0x02
	nlmFAck     = 0x04
	nlmFRoot    = 0x100
	nlmFMatch   = 0x200
	nlmFDump    = nlmFRoot | nlmFMatch
	nlmFReplace = 0x100
	nlmFExcl    = 0x200
	nlmFCreate  = 0x400

	nlAfInet     = 2
	fraPriority  = 6
	fraFwMark    = 10
	fraTable     = 15
	fraFwMask    = 16
	frActToTbl   = 1

	rtnLocal    = 2
	rtProtBoot  = 3
	rtScopeHost = 254
	rtaOif      = 4
	rtaTable    = 15
)

type ipv4RuleEntry struct {
	Pref  uint32
	Mark  uint32
	Mask  uint32
	Table uint32
}

var errNetlinkUnsupported = errors.New("native rtnetlink unavailable")
var errTProxyVerifyMismatch = errors.New("tproxy routing mismatch")

func nlAlign4(n int) int {
	return (n + 3) &^ 3
}

func appendU32Attr(buf []byte, attrType uint16, val uint32) []byte {
	var a [8]byte
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(a[0:2], 8)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(a[2:4], attrType)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(a[4:8], val)
	return append(buf, a[:]...)
}

func encodeIPv4RuleMsg(msgType uint16, flags uint16, seq uint32, pref, mark, mask, table uint32) []byte {
	// 16B nlmsghdr + 12B fib_rule_hdr + up to 4 attrs * 8B = 60B
	buf := make([]byte, 28, 64)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(buf[4:6], msgType)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(buf[6:8], flags)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf[8:12], seq)

	// fib_rule_hdr (same wire layout as rtmsg: 12 bytes)
	buf[16] = nlAfInet
	if msgType == rtmGetRule {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf[0:4], uint32(len(buf)))
		return buf
	}
	if table > 0 && table <= 255 {
		buf[20] = byte(table)
	}
	buf[23] = frActToTbl
	if pref > 0 {
		buf = appendU32Attr(buf, fraPriority, pref)
	}
	if mark != 0 {
		buf = appendU32Attr(buf, fraFwMark, mark)
	}
	if mask != 0 {
		buf = appendU32Attr(buf, fraFwMask, mask)
	}
	if table > 0 {
		buf = appendU32Attr(buf, fraTable, table)
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf[0:4], uint32(len(buf)))
	return buf
}

func encodeIPv4LocalRouteMsg(msgType uint16, flags uint16, seq uint32, loIfindex, table uint32) []byte {
	// 16B nlmsghdr + 12B rtmsg + up to 2 attrs * 8B = 44B
	buf := make([]byte, 28, 48)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(buf[4:6], msgType)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(buf[6:8], flags)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf[8:12], seq)

	// rtmsg (12 bytes)
	buf[16] = nlAfInet
	if msgType == rtmGetRoute {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf[0:4], uint32(len(buf)))
		return buf
	}
	if table > 0 && table <= 255 {
		buf[20] = byte(table)
	}
	buf[21] = rtProtBoot
	buf[22] = rtScopeHost
	buf[23] = rtnLocal
	if loIfindex > 0 {
		buf = appendU32Attr(buf, rtaOif, loIfindex)
	}
	if table > 0 {
		buf = appendU32Attr(buf, rtaTable, table)
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf[0:4], uint32(len(buf)))
	return buf
}

func parseRTAttrs(b []byte, fn func(attrType uint16, val []byte)) {
	for len(b) >= 4 {
		alen := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(b[0:2]))
		atype := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(b[2:4]) & 0x7fff
		if alen < 4 || alen > len(b) {
			break
		}
		fn(atype, b[4:alen])
		step := nlAlign4(alen)
		if step <= 0 || step > len(b) {
			break
		}
		b = b[step:]
	}
}

func parseIPv4Rules(msgs []byte) []ipv4RuleEntry {
	var out []ipv4RuleEntry
	for len(msgs) >= 16 {
		mlen := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(msgs[0:4]))
		mtype := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(msgs[4:6])
		if mlen < 16 || mlen > len(msgs) {
			break
		}
		payload := msgs[16:mlen]
		if mtype == rtmNewRule && len(payload) >= 12 && payload[0] == nlAfInet {
			entry := ipv4RuleEntry{
				Table: uint32(payload[4]),
			}
			hasMark := false
			hasMask := false
			parseRTAttrs(payload[12:], func(atype uint16, val []byte) {
				if len(val) < 4 {
					return
				}
				u := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(val[:4])
				switch atype {
				case fraPriority:
					entry.Pref = u
				case fraFwMark:
					entry.Mark = u
					hasMark = true
				case fraFwMask:
					entry.Mask = u
					hasMask = true
				case fraTable:
					entry.Table = u
				}
			})
			if hasMark && !hasMask {
				entry.Mask = 0xffffffff
			}
			out = append(out, entry)
		}
		step := nlAlign4(mlen)
		if step <= 0 || step > len(msgs) {
			break
		}
		msgs = msgs[step:]
	}
	return out
}

func parseIPv4LocalLoRoutes(msgs []byte, loIfindex, table uint32) bool {
	for len(msgs) >= 16 {
		mlen := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(msgs[0:4]))
		mtype := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(msgs[4:6])
		if mlen < 16 || mlen > len(msgs) {
			break
		}
		payload := msgs[16:mlen]
		if mtype == rtmNewRoute && len(payload) >= 12 && payload[0] == nlAfInet &&
			payload[1] == 0 && payload[7] == rtnLocal {
			rtTable := uint32(payload[4])
			var oif uint32
			parseRTAttrs(payload[12:], func(atype uint16, val []byte) {
				if len(val) < 4 {
					return
				}
				u := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(val[:4])
				switch atype {
				case rtaOif:
					oif = u
				case rtaTable:
					rtTable = u
				}
			})
			if rtTable == table && oif == loIfindex {
				return true
			}
		}
		step := nlAlign4(mlen)
		if step <= 0 || step > len(msgs) {
			break
		}
		msgs = msgs[step:]
	}
	return false
}

```

`guard/internal/netfilter/rules.go`:

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

type GateHook struct {
	Table      string
	Builtin    string
	Chain      string
	MainGuard  string
	TProxyOnly bool
	SkipPrefix string
}

var GateHooks = []GateHook{
	{Table: "raw", Builtin: "OUTPUT", Chain: contracts.ChainRawOutput},
	{Table: "filter", Builtin: "OUTPUT", Chain: contracts.ChainOutput},
	{Table: "mangle", Builtin: "POSTROUTING", Chain: contracts.ChainEgress},
	{Table: "mangle", Builtin: "OUTPUT", Chain: contracts.ChainTProxyOut, TProxyOnly: true},
	{Table: "mangle", Builtin: "PREROUTING", Chain: contracts.ChainTProxyPre, TProxyOnly: true},
}

// GateHooksFor returns hooks configured for optional external proxy capture chains.
func GateHooksFor(spec GateSpec) []GateHook {
	hooks := make([]GateHook, len(GateHooks))
	copy(hooks, GateHooks)
	if spec.GuardChainOut != "" {
		hooks[1].MainGuard = spec.GuardChainOut
	}
	if spec.GuardChainPost != "" {
		hooks[2].MainGuard = spec.GuardChainPost
	}
	if spec.ProxySkipPrefix != "" {
		hooks[3].SkipPrefix = spec.ProxySkipPrefix
		hooks[4].SkipPrefix = spec.ProxySkipPrefix
	}
	return hooks
}

func hookActive(h GateHook, family int, spec GateSpec) bool {
	if !h.TProxyOnly {
		return true
	}
	return family == 4 && spec.IsTProxy()
}

type ActiveSession struct {
	ClientUID   int    `json:"client_uid"`
	VPNNetID    int    `json:"vpn_net_id"`
	TunIf       string `json:"tun_if"`
	TunIfindex  int    `json:"tun_ifindex"`
	UplinkNetID int    `json:"uplink_net_id"`
	UplinkIf    string `json:"uplink_if"`
	UplinkIndex int    `json:"uplink_index"`
}

func (s *ActiveSession) Validate(userID int) error {
	if s == nil {
		return errors.New("nil active session")
	}
	if !contracts.ValidClientUID(userID, s.ClientUID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid client_uid %d for user %d", s.ClientUID, userID)
	}
	if s.VPNNetID < 100 || s.VPNNetID > contracts.NetIDMask {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid vpn_net_id %d", s.VPNNetID)
	}
	if s.UplinkNetID < 100 || s.UplinkNetID > contracts.NetIDMask || s.VPNNetID == s.UplinkNetID {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid uplink_net_id %d (vpn=%d)", s.UplinkNetID, s.VPNNetID)
	}
	if !contracts.TunIfRegex.MatchString(s.TunIf) || len(s.TunIf) > 15 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid tun interface %q", s.TunIf)
	}
	if !contracts.UplinkIfRegex.MatchString(s.UplinkIf) || len(s.UplinkIf) > 15 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid uplink interface %q", s.UplinkIf)
	}
	if s.TunIfindex <= 0 || s.UplinkIndex <= 0 || s.TunIfindex == s.UplinkIndex {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid ifindexes tun=%d uplink=%d", s.TunIfindex, s.UplinkIndex)
	}
	return nil
}

type GateSpec struct {
	UserID       int
	UIDStart     int
	UIDEnd       int
	PortalDNS4   string
	EndpointV4   string
	EndpointPort int
	IPv6Enabled  bool
	ArmRawDrop   bool
	Open         bool
	Session      *ActiveSession
	LastVPNNetID int

	Mode       string
	TProxyPort int
	TProxyMark uint32

	ProxySkipPrefix  string
	GuardChainOut    string
	GuardChainPost   string

	// KernelRejectQuicUDP443 skips TPROXY marking for sandbox UDP dport 443 in SBW_TPROXY_OUT
	// so SBW_OUTPUT rejects QUIC directly in kernel space without userspace bounce.
	KernelRejectQuicUDP443 bool
}

func (g GateSpec) IsTProxy() bool { return g.Mode == contracts.ModeTProxy }

func (g GateSpec) tproxyPort() int {
	if g.TProxyPort == 0 {
		return contracts.DefaultTProxyPort
	}
	return g.TProxyPort
}

func (g GateSpec) tproxyMark() uint32 {
	if g.TProxyMark == 0 {
		return contracts.DefaultTProxyMark
	}
	return g.TProxyMark
}

func (g GateSpec) effectiveVPNNetID() int {
	if g.IsTProxy() {
		return 0
	}
	if g.Session != nil && g.Session.VPNNetID >= 100 && g.Session.VPNNetID <= contracts.NetIDMask {
		return g.Session.VPNNetID
	}
	if g.LastVPNNetID >= 100 && g.LastVPNNetID <= contracts.NetIDMask {
		return g.LastVPNNetID
	}
	return 0
}

func (g GateSpec) Validate() error {
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(g.UserID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid user_id %d", g.UserID)
	}
	wantStart := g.UserID * contracts.AndroidUserWidth
	wantEnd := wantStart + contracts.AndroidUserWidth - 1
	if g.UIDStart != wantStart || g.UIDEnd != wantEnd {
		return fmt.Errorf("uid range %d-%d does not match user %d", g.UIDStart, g.UIDEnd, g.UserID)
	}
	switch g.Mode {
	case "", contracts.ModeVPN:
		if !vpnTransportCompiled() {
			return errors.New("vpn mode requires build with -tags transport_vpn; use mode=tproxy")
		}
	case contracts.ModeTProxy:
		if err := contracts.ValidateTProxyParams(g.tproxyPort(), g.tproxyMark()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported gate mode %q", g.Mode)
	}
	if g.Open {
		if g.ArmRawDrop {
			return errors.New("cannot open while SBW_RAW_OUTPUT is armed")
		}
		if !g.IsTProxy() {
			if err := g.Session.Validate(g.UserID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func tproxyMarkSpec(mark uint32) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("0x%x/0x%x", mark, contracts.NetIDMask)
}

func tproxyRulesFor(family int, hook GateHook, spec GateSpec) ([]string, error) {
	ownerMatch := fmt.Sprintf("-m owner --uid-owner %d-%d", spec.UIDStart, spec.UIDEnd)
	mk := tproxyMarkSpec(spec.tproxyMark())
	port := spec.tproxyPort()

	switch hook.Chain {
	case contracts.ChainRawOutput:
		if !spec.ArmRawDrop {
			return nil, nil
		}
		return []string{ownerMatch + " -j DROP"}, nil

	case contracts.ChainTProxyOut:
		if family != 4 || !spec.Open {
			return nil, nil
		}
		rules := []string{
			fmt.Sprintf("%s -d 127.0.0.1/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 53 -j MARK --set-xmark %s", ownerMatch, mk),
			fmt.Sprintf("%s -d 127.0.0.1/32 -p udp -m udp --dport 53 -j MARK --set-xmark %s", ownerMatch, mk),
			fmt.Sprintf("%s -d 127.0.0.0/8 -j RETURN", ownerMatch),
		}
		if spec.KernelRejectQuicUDP443 {
			rules = append(rules, fmt.Sprintf("%s -p udp -m udp --dport 443 -j RETURN", ownerMatch))
		}
		rules = append(rules,
			fmt.Sprintf("%s -p tcp -j MARK --set-xmark %s", ownerMatch, mk),
			fmt.Sprintf("%s -p udp -j MARK --set-xmark %s", ownerMatch, mk),
			ownerMatch+" -j ACCEPT",
		)
		return rules, nil

	case contracts.ChainTProxyPre:
		if family != 4 || !spec.Open {
			return nil, nil
		}
		return []string{
			"! -i lo -j RETURN",
			"-m conntrack --ctdir REPLY -j RETURN",
			fmt.Sprintf("-i lo -p tcp -m mark --mark %s -j TPROXY --on-port %d --on-ip 127.0.0.1 --tproxy-mark %s", mk, port, mk),
			fmt.Sprintf("-i lo -p udp -m mark --mark %s -j TPROXY --on-port %d --on-ip 127.0.0.1 --tproxy-mark %s", mk, port, mk),
		}, nil

	case contracts.ChainOutput:
		var rules []string
		if spec.Open && family == 4 {
			rules = append(rules, fmt.Sprintf("%s -m mark --mark %s -j RETURN", ownerMatch, mk))
		}
		rules = append(rules,
			ownerMatch+" -p tcp -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset",
			ownerMatch+" -j REJECT",
		)
		return rules, nil

	case contracts.ChainEgress:
		var rules []string
		if spec.Open && family == 4 {
			rules = append(rules, fmt.Sprintf("-o lo %s -m mark --mark %s -j RETURN", ownerMatch, mk))
		}
		rules = append(rules, ownerMatch+" -j DROP")
		return rules, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown hook chain %q", hook.Chain)
}

func RulesFor(family int, hook GateHook, spec GateSpec) ([]string, error) {
	if err := spec.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if family != 4 && family != 6 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported IP family %d", family)
	}
	if spec.IsTProxy() {
		return tproxyRulesFor(family, hook, spec)
	}
	if hook.TProxyOnly {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return vpnRulesFor(family, hook, spec)
}

type Save struct {
	Chains []string
	Rules  map[string][]string
}

func parseSaveLineInto(s *Save, raw string) {
	line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") {
		if idx := strings.Index(line, "] "); idx > 0 {
			line = line[idx+2:]
		}
	}
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(line, ":"):
		fields := strings.Fields(line[1:])
		if len(fields) > 0 {
			s.Chains = append(s.Chains, fields[0])
		}
	case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-A "):
		fields := strings.SplitN(line, " ", 3)
		if len(fields) == 3 {
			s.Rules[fields[1]] = append(s.Rules[fields[1]], fields[2])
		}
	}
}

func ParseSave(text string) Save {
	s := Save{Rules: map[string][]string{}}
	for _, raw := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
		parseSaveLineInto(&s, raw)
	}
	return s
}

func ParseSaveAll(text string) map[string]Save {
	tables := make(map[string]Save)
	curTable := ""
	for _, raw := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
		if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || line == "COMMIT" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*") {
			tbl := strings.TrimSpace(line[1:])
			if tbl != "" {
				curTable = tbl
				if _, ok := tables[curTable]; !ok {
					tables[curTable] = Save{Rules: map[string][]string{}}
				}
			}
			continue
		}
		if curTable == "" {
			continue
		}
		s := tables[curTable]
		parseSaveLineInto(&s, line)
		tables[curTable] = s
	}
	return tables
}

func CombineBatches(batches []string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, chunk := range batches {
		if chunk == "" {
			continue
		}
		b.WriteString(chunk)
		if !strings.HasSuffix(chunk, "\n") {
			b.WriteByte('\n')
		}
	}
	return b.String()
}

func MergeTableBatches(batches []string, tableOrder []string) string {
	type tableAcc struct {
		seenDecl map[string]bool
		decls    []string
		cmds     []string
	}
	acc := make(map[string]*tableAcc, 4)
	var extraOrder []string

	for _, chunk := range batches {
		if chunk == "" {
			continue
		}
		curTbl := ""
		for _, raw := range strings.Split(chunk, "\n") {
			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || line == "COMMIT" {
				continue
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*") {
				curTbl = strings.TrimSpace(line[1:])
				if curTbl != "" && acc[curTbl] == nil {
					acc[curTbl] = &tableAcc{seenDecl: map[string]bool{}}
					extraOrder = append(extraOrder, curTbl)
				}
				continue
			}
			if curTbl == "" {
				continue
			}
			ta := acc[curTbl]
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, ":") {
				fields := strings.Fields(line[1:])
				if len(fields) > 0 && !ta.seenDecl[fields[0]] {
					ta.seenDecl[fields[0]] = true
					ta.decls = append(ta.decls, line)
				}
				continue
			}
			ta.cmds = append(ta.cmds, line)
		}
	}

	emitted := make(map[string]bool, len(acc))
	var b strings.Builder
	writeTable := func(tbl string) {
		ta := acc[tbl]
		if ta == nil || emitted[tbl] || (len(ta.decls) == 0 && len(ta.cmds) == 0) {
			return
		}
		emitted[tbl] = true
		b.WriteByte('*')
		b.WriteString(tbl)
		b.WriteByte('\n')
		for _, d := range ta.decls {
			b.WriteString(d)
			b.WriteByte('\n')
		}
		for _, c := range ta.cmds {
			b.WriteString(c)
			b.WriteByte('\n')
		}
		b.WriteString("COMMIT\n")
	}
	for _, tbl := range tableOrder {
		writeTable(tbl)
	}
	for _, tbl := range extraOrder {
		writeTable(tbl)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func jumpTarget(spec string) string {
	fields := strings.Fields(spec)
	for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i++ {
		if fields[i] == "-j" || fields[i] == "-g" {
			return fields[i+1]
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// HasExternalCapture reports whether an external proxy core capture chain
// (matching <prefix>*OUTPUT / <prefix>*OUTPUT6) is currently installed in mangle.
func HasExternalCapture(mangle Save, family int, prefix string) bool {
	if prefix == "" {
		return false
	}
	suffix := "OUTPUT"
	if family == 6 {
		suffix = "OUTPUT6"
	}
	matches := func(name string) bool {
		return strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) && strings.HasSuffix(name, suffix)
	}
	for _, c := range mangle.Chains {
		if matches(c) {
			return true
		}
	}
	for _, r := range mangle.Rules["OUTPUT"] {
		if matches(jumpTarget(r)) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hookIndex(rules []string, hook GateHook) int {
	idx := 0
	if hook.MainGuard != "" && len(rules) > 0 && rules[0] == "-j "+hook.MainGuard {
		idx = 1
	}
	if hook.SkipPrefix != "" {
		for idx < len(rules) && strings.HasPrefix(jumpTarget(rules[idx]), hook.SkipPrefix) {
			idx++
		}
	}
	return idx
}

func GateBatch(current Save, hook GateHook, rules []string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "*%s\n:%s - [0:0]\n-F %s\n", hook.Table, hook.Chain, hook.Chain)

	var remaining []string
	for _, rule := range current.Rules[hook.Builtin] {
		if jumpTarget(rule) == hook.Chain {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "-D %s %s\n", hook.Builtin, rule)
			continue
		}
		remaining = append(remaining, rule)
	}
	pos := hookIndex(remaining, hook) + 1
	for _, rule := range rules {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "-A %s %s\n", hook.Chain, rule)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "-I %s %d -j %s\nCOMMIT\n", hook.Builtin, pos, hook.Chain)
	return b.String()
}

func ChainPresent(current Save, hook GateHook) bool {
	for _, c := range current.Chains {
		if c == hook.Chain {
			return true
		}
	}
	for _, r := range current.Rules[hook.Builtin] {
		if jumpTarget(r) == hook.Chain {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func RemoveBatch(current Save, hook GateHook) string {
	if !ChainPresent(current, hook) {
		return ""
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "*%s\n", hook.Table)
	chainDeclared := false
	for _, c := range current.Chains {
		if c == hook.Chain {
			chainDeclared = true
		}
	}
	if !chainDeclared {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, ":%s - [0:0]\n", hook.Chain)
	}
	for _, rule := range current.Rules[hook.Builtin] {
		if jumpTarget(rule) == hook.Chain {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "-D %s %s\n", hook.Builtin, rule)
		}
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "-F %s\n-X %s\nCOMMIT\n", hook.Chain, hook.Chain)
	return b.String()
}

func GateInstalled(current Save, hook GateHook, expected []string) bool {
	rules := current.Rules[hook.Builtin]
	remaining := make([]string, 0, len(rules))
	foundIdx := -1
	for _, r := range rules {
		if jumpTarget(r) == hook.Chain {
			if foundIdx == -1 {
				foundIdx = len(remaining)
			}
			continue
		}
		remaining = append(remaining, r)
	}
	idx := hookIndex(remaining, hook)
	if foundIdx != idx || len(rules) <= idx || rules[idx] != "-j "+hook.Chain {
		return false
	}
	jumps := 0
	for _, r := range rules {
		if jumpTarget(r) == hook.Chain {
			jumps++
		}
	}
	if jumps != 1 {
		return false
	}
	actual := current.Rules[hook.Chain]
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for i, want := range expected {
		if !SameGateRule(want, actual[i]) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func SameGateRule(expected, actual string) bool {
	parse := func(line string) (map[string]string, string, bool) {
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		parsed := make(map[string]string)
		rejectWith := ""
		for i := 0; i < len(fields); {
			neg := false
			if fields[i] == "!" {
				neg = true
				i++
			}
			if i+1 >= len(fields) {
				return nil, "", false
			}
			k, v := fields[i], fields[i+1]
			i += 2
			if v == "!" {
				return nil, "", false
			}
			if neg {
				if k == "-m" || k == "-j" || k == "-g" || k == "--reject-with" {
					return nil, "", false
				}
				k = "!" + k
			}
			switch k {
			case "-m":
				if v != "tcp" && v != "udp" && v != "owner" && v != "mark" && v != "conntrack" {
					return nil, "", false
				}
				continue
			case "--reject-with":
				rejectWith = v
				continue
			case "-d":
				v = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(v, "/32"), "/128")
			case "--mark", "--set-xmark", "--tproxy-mark":
				parts := strings.Split(v, "/")
				if len(parts) != 2 {
					return nil, "", false
				}
				mark, err := strconv.ParseUint(parts[0], 0, 32)
				mask, maskErr := strconv.ParseUint(parts[1], 0, 32)
				if err != nil || maskErr != nil {
					return nil, "", false
				}
				v = fmt.Sprintf("0x%x/0x%x", mark, mask)
			}
			if _, exists := parsed[k]; exists {
				return nil, "", false
			}
			parsed[k] = v
		}
		return parsed, rejectWith, true
	}

	want, wantReject, ok := parse(expected)
	got, gotReject, ok2 := parse(actual)
	if !ok || !ok2 || len(want) != len(got) {
		return false
	}
	for k, v := range want {
		if got[k] != v {
			return false
		}
	}
	if wantReject != "" {
		return gotReject == wantReject
	}
	return gotReject == "" || gotReject == "icmp-port-unreachable" || gotReject == "icmp6-port-unreachable"
}
```

`guard/internal/netfilter/rules_tproxy_test.go`:

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
)

func testTProxySpecOpen() GateSpec {
	return GateSpec{
		UserID:                 10,
		UIDStart:               1000000,
		UIDEnd:                 1099999,
		PortalDNS4:             contracts.PortalDNS4,
		EndpointV4:             "203.0.113.10",
		EndpointPort:           443,
		IPv6Enabled:            false,
		ArmRawDrop:             false,
		Open:                   true,
		Mode:                   contracts.ModeTProxy,
		TProxyPort:             1537,
		TProxyMark:             0x1a,
		KernelRejectQuicUDP443: true,
	}
}

func TestGateBatchPreservesExternalGuardAndSkipPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	spec := testTProxySpecOpen()
	spec.GuardChainOut = "SB_GUARD_OUT"
	spec.ProxySkipPrefix = "PROXY_"
	hooks := GateHooksFor(spec)

	current := ParseSave(`*filter
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A OUTPUT -j SB_GUARD_OUT
-A OUTPUT -j SBW_OUTPUT
-A OUTPUT -j oem_out
COMMIT
`)
	batch := GateBatch(current, hooks[1], []string{"-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -p tcp -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset"})
	if !strings.Contains(batch, "-I OUTPUT 2 -j SBW_OUTPUT\n") {
		t.Fatalf("expected position 2 hook after SB_GUARD_OUT, got:\n%s", batch)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(batch, "-D OUTPUT -j SBW_OUTPUT\n") {
		t.Fatalf("expected old jump deletion:\n%s", batch)
	}
	if strings.Contains(batch, "-D OUTPUT -j SB_GUARD_OUT") {
		t.Fatalf("must not delete SB_GUARD_OUT:\n%s", batch)
	}

	corrupted := ParseSave("-A OUTPUT -j SBW_OUTPUT\n-A OUTPUT -j SB_GUARD_OUT\n")
	batch2 := GateBatch(corrupted, hooks[1], []string{"-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -j REJECT"})
	if !strings.Contains(batch2, "-I OUTPUT 2 -j SBW_OUTPUT\n") {
		t.Fatalf("expected healed position 2 hook, got:\n%s", batch2)
	}

	mangleCur := ParseSave(`*mangle
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A OUTPUT -j PROXY_OUTPUT
-A OUTPUT -j SBW_TPROXY_OUT
COMMIT
`)
	batch3 := GateBatch(mangleCur, hooks[3], []string{"-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -j ACCEPT"})
	if !strings.Contains(batch3, "-I OUTPUT 2 -j SBW_TPROXY_OUT\n") {
		t.Fatalf("expected TProxy hook after PROXY_OUTPUT, got:\n%s", batch3)
	}
}

func TestSameGateRuleCanonicalization(t *testing.T) {
	wantReset := "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -p tcp -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset"
	gotReset := "-p tcp -m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -m tcp -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset"
	if !SameGateRule(wantReset, gotReset) {
		t.Fatal("failed to match canonicalized tcp-reset rule")
	}
	gotDefault := "-p tcp -m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -m tcp -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable"
	if SameGateRule(wantReset, gotDefault) {
		t.Fatal("wrongly accepted icmp-port-unreachable when tcp-reset was required")
	}

	wantOuter := "-o wlan0 -p tcp -d 203.0.113.10/32 --dport 443 -m owner --uid-owner 1010376 -m mark --mark 0x20064/0x2ffff -j RETURN"
	gotOuter := "-d 203.0.113.10 -o wlan0 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -m owner --uid-owner 1010376 -m mark --mark 0x00020064/0x0002ffff -j RETURN"
	if !SameGateRule(wantOuter, gotOuter) {
		t.Fatal("failed to match canonicalized outer rule")
	}

	if !SameGateRule("! -i lo -j RETURN", "! -i lo -j RETURN") {
		t.Fatal("failed to match negated interface rule")
	}
	if SameGateRule("! -i lo -j RETURN", "-i lo -j RETURN") {
		t.Fatal("wrongly matched non-negated -i lo against ! -i lo")
	}
	if SameGateRule("! -j RETURN", "! -j RETURN") {
		t.Fatal("must reject invalid ! -j rule")
	}
	if SameGateRule("-i lo -j !", "-i lo -j !") {
		t.Fatal("must reject dangling ! token")
	}
	if SameGateRule("-i lo !", "-i lo !") {
		t.Fatal("must reject trailing ! token")
	}
}

func TestTProxyRulesQuicKernelRejectAndPreBypass(t *testing.T) {
	spec := testTProxySpecOpen()
	outRules, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[3], spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(outRules) != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 7 SBW_TPROXY_OUT rules with QUIC bypass, got %d: %v", len(outRules), outRules)
	}
	if outRules[3] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -p udp -m udp --dport 443 -j RETURN" {
		t.Fatalf("expected kernel UDP 443 RETURN at index 3, got %s", outRules[3])
	}

	preRules, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[4], spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(preRules) != 4 || preRules[0] != "! -i lo -j RETURN" {
		t.Fatalf("expected ! -i lo -j RETURN as rule 0 in SBW_TPROXY_PRE, got %v", preRules)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(preRules[2], "--on-ip 127.0.0.1") || !strings.Contains(preRules[3], "--on-ip 127.0.0.1") {
		t.Fatalf("expected SBW_TPROXY_PRE TCP/UDP rules to target --on-ip 127.0.0.1, got %v", preRules)
	}

	spec.KernelRejectQuicUDP443 = false
	outNoReject, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[3], spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(outNoReject) != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 6 SBW_TPROXY_OUT rules without QUIC bypass, got %d", len(outNoReject))
	}

	// Verify Open=true IPv6 keeps ::1 loopback strictly blocked on both SBW_OUTPUT and SBW_EGRESS.
	v6OpenOut, err := RulesFor(6, GateHooks[1], spec)
	if err != nil || len(v6OpenOut) == 0 || v6OpenOut[0] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -p tcp -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset" {
		t.Fatalf("expected IPv6 OUTPUT to reject all work loopback/external traffic while open, got err=%v rules=%v", err, v6OpenOut)
	}
	v6OpenEg, err := RulesFor(6, GateHooks[2], spec)
	if err != nil || len(v6OpenEg) != 1 || v6OpenEg[0] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -j DROP" {
		t.Fatalf("expected IPv6 EGRESS to drop all work traffic while open, got err=%v rules=%v", err, v6OpenEg)
	}

	// Verify Open=false remains strictly fail-closed on OUTPUT/EGRESS and clears TProxy chains.
	spec.Open = false
	closedOut, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[3], spec)
	if err != nil || len(closedOut) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("closed TPROXY_OUT must be empty, got err=%v rules=%v", err, closedOut)
	}
	filterClosed, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[1], spec)
	if err != nil || len(filterClosed) != 2 || filterClosed[1] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -j REJECT" {
		t.Fatalf("closed OUTPUT must fail-closed, got err=%v rules=%v", err, filterClosed)
	}
	spec.ArmRawDrop = true
	rawArmed, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[0], spec)
	if err != nil || len(rawArmed) != 1 || rawArmed[0] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -j DROP" {
		t.Fatalf("armed RAW_OUTPUT must DROP, got err=%v rules=%v", err, rawArmed)
	}
	spec.Open = true
	if _, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[0], spec); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invariant error when Open=true and ArmRawDrop=true")
	}
}

func TestHasExternalCapture(t *testing.T) {
	m4 := ParseSave("*mangle\n:PROXY_OUTPUT - [0:0]\n-A OUTPUT -p tcp -j PROXY_OUTPUT\n")
	if !HasExternalCapture(m4, 4, "PROXY_") || HasExternalCapture(m4, 6, "PROXY_") {
		t.Fatal("unexpected HasExternalCapture result")
	}
	tpx4 := ParseSave("*mangle\n:TPX_PROXY_OUTPUT - [0:0]\n-A OUTPUT -p tcp -j TPX_PROXY_OUTPUT\n")
	if !HasExternalCapture(tpx4, 4, "TPX_") || HasExternalCapture(tpx4, 6, "TPX_") {
		t.Fatal("expected TPX_PROXY_OUTPUT to match IPv4 prefix TPX_ only")
	}
	tpx6 := ParseSave("*mangle\n:TPX_PROXY_OUTPUT6 - [0:0]\n-A OUTPUT -p tcp -j TPX_PROXY_OUTPUT6\n")
	if !HasExternalCapture(tpx6, 6, "TPX_") || HasExternalCapture(tpx6, 4, "TPX_") {
		t.Fatal("expected TPX_PROXY_OUTPUT6 to match IPv6 prefix TPX_ only")
	}
	if HasExternalCapture(m4, 4, "") {
		t.Fatal("empty prefix must return false")
	}
	onlyACL := ParseSave("*mangle\n:SBW_EGRESS - [0:0]\n")
	if HasExternalCapture(onlyACL, 4, "PROXY_") {
		t.Fatal("false positive on capture chain detection")
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/netfilter/rules_v250_test.go`:

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type v250TableState struct {
	Chains map[string]bool
	Rules  map[string][]string
}

type v250IPTablesMock struct {
	mu             sync.Mutex
	tables         map[int]map[string]*v250TableState
	saveAllCalls   map[int]int
	saveTableCalls map[int]int
	restoreCalls   map[int]int
	ipRules        []string
	ipRoutes       map[string]string
}

func newV250IPTablesMock() *v250IPTablesMock {
	initFam := func() map[string]*v250TableState {
		m := make(map[string]*v250TableState)
		for _, tbl := range []string{"raw", "filter", "mangle", "nat"} {
			m[tbl] = &v250TableState{
				Chains: map[string]bool{"INPUT": true, "OUTPUT": true, "POSTROUTING": true, "PREROUTING": true},
				Rules:  map[string][]string{},
			}
		}
		return m
	}
	return &v250IPTablesMock{
		tables:         map[int]map[string]*v250TableState{4: initFam(), 6: initFam()},
		saveAllCalls:   map[int]int{},
		saveTableCalls: map[int]int{},
		restoreCalls:   map[int]int{},
		ipRoutes:       map[string]string{},
	}
}

func (m *v250IPTablesMock) renderSave(fam map[string]*v250TableState, onlyTable string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, tbl := range []string{"raw", "filter", "mangle", "nat"} {
		if onlyTable != "" && tbl != onlyTable {
			continue
		}
		st := fam[tbl]
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "*%s\n", tbl)
		for _, builtin := range []string{"INPUT", "OUTPUT", "PREROUTING", "POSTROUTING"} {
			if st.Chains[builtin] {
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, ":%s ACCEPT [0:0]\n", builtin)
			}
		}
		for ch := range st.Chains {
			if ch == "INPUT" || ch == "OUTPUT" || ch == "PREROUTING" || ch == "POSTROUTING" {
				continue
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, ":%s - [0:0]\n", ch)
		}
		for _, chain := range []string{"OUTPUT", "PREROUTING", "POSTROUTING"} {
			for _, r := range st.Rules[chain] {
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "-A %s %s\n", chain, r)
			}
		}
		for chain, rules := range st.Rules {
			if chain == "OUTPUT" || chain == "PREROUTING" || chain == "POSTROUTING" {
				continue
			}
			for _, r := range rules {
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "-A %s %s\n", chain, r)
			}
		}
		b.WriteString("COMMIT\n")
	}
	return b.String()
}

func (m *v250IPTablesMock) applyRestore(fam map[string]*v250TableState, script string) error {
	curTbl := ""
	for _, raw := range strings.Split(script, "\n") {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
		if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || line == "COMMIT" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*") {
			curTbl = strings.TrimSpace(line[1:])
			if _, ok := fam[curTbl]; !ok {
				fam[curTbl] = &v250TableState{Chains: map[string]bool{}, Rules: map[string][]string{}}
			}
			continue
		}
		st := fam[curTbl]
		if st == nil {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, ":"):
			ch := strings.Fields(line[1:])[0]
			st.Chains[ch] = true
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-F "):
			ch := strings.Fields(line)[1]
			st.Rules[ch] = nil
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-X "):
			ch := strings.Fields(line)[1]
			delete(st.Chains, ch)
			delete(st.Rules, ch)
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-I "):
			parts := strings.SplitN(line, " ", 4)
			if len(parts) == 4 {
				ch := parts[1]
				idx := 0
				_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[2], "%d", &idx)
				idx--
				rule := parts[3]
				cur := st.Rules[ch]
				if idx <= 0 || len(cur) == 0 {
					st.Rules[ch] = append([]string{rule}, cur...)
				} else if idx >= len(cur) {
					st.Rules[ch] = append(cur, rule)
				} else {
					next := append([]string{}, cur[:idx]...)
					next = append(next, rule)
					next = append(next, cur[idx:]...)
					st.Rules[ch] = next
				}
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-D "):
			parts := strings.SplitN(line, " ", 3)
			if len(parts) == 3 {
				ch, rule := parts[1], parts[2]
				var kept []string
				for _, r := range st.Rules[ch] {
					if r != rule {
						kept = append(kept, r)
					}
				}
				st.Rules[ch] = kept
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "-A "):
			parts := strings.SplitN(line, " ", 3)
			if len(parts) == 3 {
				st.Rules[parts[1]] = append(st.Rules[parts[1]], parts[2])
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (m *v250IPTablesMock) Run(_ context.Context, _ time.Duration, stdin string, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if name == "ip" {
		if len(args) >= 3 && args[0] == "-4" && args[1] == "rule" && args[2] == "show" {
			var b strings.Builder
			b.WriteString("0:\tfrom all lookup local\n")
			for _, r := range m.ipRules {
				b.WriteString(r)
				b.WriteByte('\n')
			}
			b.WriteString("32766:\tfrom all lookup main\n")
			return b.String(), nil
		}
		if len(args) >= 7 && args[0] == "-4" && args[1] == "rule" && args[2] == "add" {
			// ip -4 rule add fwmark <mark> pref <pref> lookup <table>
			var fw, pref, tbl string
			for i := 3; i+1 < len(args); i++ {
				switch args[i] {
				case "fwmark":
					fw = args[i+1]
				case "pref":
					pref = args[i+1]
				case "lookup":
					tbl = args[i+1]
				}
			}
			if pref != "" && fw != "" && tbl != "" {
				m.ipRules = append(m.ipRules, fmt.Sprintf("%s:\tfrom all fwmark %s lookup %s", pref, fw, tbl))
			}
			return "", nil
		}
		if len(args) >= 5 && args[0] == "-4" && args[1] == "rule" && args[2] == "del" && args[3] == "pref" {
			pref := args[4]
			deleted := false
			kept := make([]string, 0, len(m.ipRules))
			for _, r := range m.ipRules {
				if !deleted && strings.HasPrefix(r, pref+":") {
					deleted = true
					continue
				}
				kept = append(kept, r)
			}
			m.ipRules = kept
			return "", nil
		}
		if len(args) >= 5 && args[0] == "-4" && args[1] == "route" && args[2] == "show" && args[3] == "table" {
			return m.ipRoutes[args[4]], nil
		}
		if len(args) >= 8 && args[0] == "-4" && args[1] == "route" && args[2] == "replace" {
			tbl := ""
			for i := 3; i+1 < len(args); i++ {
				if args[i] == "table" {
					tbl = args[i+1]
				}
			}
			if tbl != "" {
				m.ipRoutes[tbl] = "local default dev lo scope host\n"
			}
			return "", nil
		}
		return "", nil
	}
	fam := 4
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "ip6tables") {
		fam = 6
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(name, "-save") {
		if len(args) == 2 && args[0] == "-t" {
			m.saveTableCalls[fam]++
			return m.renderSave(m.tables[fam], args[1]), nil
		}
		if len(args) == 0 {
			m.saveAllCalls[fam]++
			return m.renderSave(m.tables[fam], ""), nil
		}
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(name, "-restore") {
		m.restoreCalls[fam]++
		return "", m.applyRestore(m.tables[fam], stdin)
	}
	return "", fmt.Errorf("unexpected cmd %s %v", name, args)
}

func TestParseSaveAllAndCombineBatches(t *testing.T) {
	sample := `# generated
*raw
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:SBW_RAW_OUTPUT - [0:0]
-A OUTPUT -j SBW_RAW_OUTPUT
COMMIT
*filter
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:SBW_OUTPUT - [0:0]
-A OUTPUT -j SBW_OUTPUT
-A SBW_OUTPUT -p udp --dport 443 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable
COMMIT
*mangle
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:SBW_EGRESS - [0:0]
-A POSTROUTING -j SBW_EGRESS
COMMIT
`
	all := ParseSaveAll(sample)
	if len(all) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 3 tables, got %d (%+v)", len(all), all)
	}
	if len(all["raw"].Rules["OUTPUT"]) != 1 || all["raw"].Rules["OUTPUT"][0] != "-j SBW_RAW_OUTPUT" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected raw parse: %+v", all["raw"])
	}
	if len(all["filter"].Rules["SBW_OUTPUT"]) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected filter parse: %+v", all["filter"])
	}
	if len(all["mangle"].Rules["POSTROUTING"]) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected mangle parse: %+v", all["mangle"])
	}

	combined := CombineBatches([]string{"*raw\nCOMMIT", "", "*filter\nCOMMIT\n"})
	if combined != "*raw\nCOMMIT\n*filter\nCOMMIT\n" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected CombineBatches output: %q", combined)
	}
}

func TestApplyOrVerifySingleSaveAndSingleRestoreBatching(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	mock := newV250IPTablesMock()
	ctrl := &Controller{
		Runner:   mock,
		LockPath: filepath.Join(dir, "nf.lock"),
	}

	spec := testTProxySpecOpen()
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, spec, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApplyOrVerify(apply) failed: %v", err)
	}
	if mock.saveAllCalls[4] != 2 || mock.saveAllCalls[6] != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected exactly 2 full-family saves per IP family (pre + verify), got v4=%d v6=%d", mock.saveAllCalls[4], mock.saveAllCalls[6])
	}
	if mock.saveTableCalls[4] != 0 || mock.saveTableCalls[6] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 0 per-table saves when iptables-save succeeds, got v4=%d v6=%d", mock.saveTableCalls[4], mock.saveTableCalls[6])
	}
	if mock.restoreCalls[4] != 1 || mock.restoreCalls[6] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 merged multi-table restore per IP family, got v4=%d v6=%d", mock.restoreCalls[4], mock.restoreCalls[6])
	}

	// Verify idempotent inspect mode requires 0 restores and uses 1 full-family save per family.
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, spec, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApplyOrVerify(inspect) failed: %v", err)
	}
	if mock.saveAllCalls[4] != 3 || mock.saveAllCalls[6] != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 additional full-family save on inspect, got v4=%d v6=%d", mock.saveAllCalls[4], mock.saveAllCalls[6])
	}
	if mock.restoreCalls[4] != 1 || mock.restoreCalls[6] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 0 extra restores on inspect, got v4=%d v6=%d", mock.restoreCalls[4], mock.restoreCalls[6])
	}

	// Inspect must fail when TProxy ip rule pref 2025 or route table 2027 goes missing.
	savedRules := append([]string(nil), mock.ipRules...)
	mock.ipRules = nil
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, spec, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected inspect error when TProxy ip rule pref 2025 is missing")
	}
	mock.ipRules = savedRules
	savedRoute := mock.ipRoutes["2027"]
	mock.ipRoutes["2027"] = ""
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, spec, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected inspect error when TProxy local route in table 2027 is missing")
	}
	mock.ipRoutes["2027"] = savedRoute
}

func TestGateInstalledDetectsMisplacedJumpAndEnsureTProxyClearsStalePref(t *testing.T) {
	spec := testTProxySpecOpen()
	spec.GuardChainOut = "SB_GUARD_OUT"
	hooks := GateHooksFor(spec)
	filterHook := hooks[1]
	expected, err := RulesFor(4, filterHook, spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Correct order: SB_GUARD_OUT then SBW_OUTPUT.
	validSave := ParseSave("*filter\n:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:" + filterHook.Chain + " - [0:0]\n-A OUTPUT -j SB_GUARD_OUT\n-A OUTPUT -j " + filterHook.Chain + "\n")
	validSave.Rules[filterHook.Chain] = expected
	if !GateInstalled(validSave, filterHook, expected) {
		t.Fatal("expected GateInstalled=true when jump follows GuardChainOut")
	}
	// Misplaced: SBW_OUTPUT appears before SB_GUARD_OUT -> GateInstalled MUST return false!
	misplacedSave := ParseSave("*filter\n:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:" + filterHook.Chain + " - [0:0]\n-A OUTPUT -j " + filterHook.Chain + "\n-A OUTPUT -j SB_GUARD_OUT\n")
	misplacedSave.Rules[filterHook.Chain] = expected
	if GateInstalled(misplacedSave, filterHook, expected) {
		t.Fatal("expected GateInstalled=false when jump precedes GuardChainOut")
	}

	// Stale pref 2025 rule sharing pref with valid rule must be replaced cleanly.
	dir := t.TempDir()
	mock := newV250IPTablesMock()
	mock.ipRules = []string{
		"2025:\tfrom all fwmark 0x99/0xffff lookup 2027",
		"2025:\tfrom all fwmark 0x1a/0xffff lookup 2027",
	}
	ctrl := &Controller{Runner: mock, LockPath: filepath.Join(dir, "nf.lock")}
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(context.Background(), spec, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApplyOrVerify with stale pref failed: %v", err)
	}
	if len(mock.ipRules) != 1 || !strings.Contains(mock.ipRules[0], "0x1a/0xffff") {
		t.Fatalf("expected clean single 0x1a/0xffff rule after stale cleanup, got %v", mock.ipRules)
	}
}
```

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

func TestV251LoopbackBlockedExceptMarkedDNSAndTProxyPreReturn(t *testing.T) {
	spec := testTProxySpecOpen()

	outV4, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[1], spec) // SBW_OUTPUT
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	joinedOut4 := strings.Join(outV4, "\n")
	if strings.Contains(joinedOut4, "127.0.0.1") || strings.Contains(joinedOut4, "127.0.0.0") {
		t.Fatalf("SBW_OUTPUT must NEVER allow generic 127.0.0.1/127.0.0.0 loopback access to User 0 listeners:\n%s", joinedOut4)
	}
	if outV4[0] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -m mark --mark 0x1a/0xffff -j RETURN" {
		t.Fatalf("expected marked DNS/outbound return rule first, got %q", outV4[0])
	}

	egV4, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[2], spec) // SBW_EGRESS
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	joinedEg4 := strings.Join(egV4, "\n")
	if strings.Contains(joinedEg4, "127.0.0.1") {
		t.Fatalf("SBW_EGRESS must not allow unmarked 127.0.0.1:\n%s", joinedEg4)
	}

	tpOut, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[3], spec) // SBW_TPROXY_OUT
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tpOut[2] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -d 127.0.0.0/8 -j RETURN" {
		t.Fatalf("expected 127.0.0.0/8 un-marked return (catching 127.0.0.2+ before TProxy), got %q", tpOut[2])
	}

	tpPre, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[4], spec) // SBW_TPROXY_PRE
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tpPre[1] != "-m conntrack --ctdir REPLY -j RETURN" {
		t.Fatalf("SBW_TPROXY_PRE reply rule must use -j RETURN (not -j ACCEPT affecting User 0), got %q", tpPre[1])
	}
}

func TestV251MergeTableBatchesAndCommitOrder(t *testing.T) {
	openScript := MergeTableBatches([]string{
		"*raw\n:SBW_RAW_OUTPUT - [0:0]\n-F SBW_RAW_OUTPUT\n-I OUTPUT 1 -j SBW_RAW_OUTPUT\nCOMMIT\n",
		"*filter\n:SBW_OUTPUT - [0:0]\n-F SBW_OUTPUT\n-A SBW_OUTPUT -j RETURN\nCOMMIT\n",
		"*mangle\n:SBW_EGRESS - [0:0]\n-F SBW_EGRESS\nCOMMIT\n",
		"*mangle\n:SBW_TPROXY_OUT - [0:0]\n-F SBW_TPROXY_OUT\nCOMMIT\n",
		"*mangle\n:SBW_TPROXY_PRE - [0:0]\n-F SBW_TPROXY_PRE\nCOMMIT\n",
	}, []string{"mangle", "filter", "raw"})

	if strings.Count(openScript, "*mangle\n") != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 3 mangle hooks coalesced into 1 *mangle block, got:\n%s", openScript)
	}
	mStart := strings.Index(openScript, "*mangle\n")
	fStart := strings.Index(openScript, "*filter\n")
	rStart := strings.Index(openScript, "*raw\n")
	if !(mStart >= 0 && mStart < fStart && fStart < rStart) {
		t.Fatalf("expected open order mangle -> filter -> raw, got:\n%s", openScript)
	}
	mangleBlock := openScript[mStart:fStart]
	lastDecl := strings.LastIndex(mangleBlock, "\n:")
	firstCmd := strings.Index(mangleBlock, "\n-")
	if lastDecl > firstCmd {
		t.Fatalf("all :CHAIN declarations must precede commands in *mangle:\n%s", mangleBlock)
	}
}

```

`guard/internal/netfilter/rules_vpn.go`:

```go
//go:build transport_vpn

package netfilter

import (
	"fmt"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
)

func vpnTransportCompiled() bool { return true }

func vpnRulesFor(family int, hook GateHook, spec GateSpec) ([]string, error) {
	portal := spec.PortalDNS4
	if portal == "" {
		portal = contracts.PortalDNS4
	}
	endpoint := spec.EndpointV4
	port := spec.EndpointPort
	if port == 0 {
		port = contracts.EndpointPort
	}
	ownerMatch := fmt.Sprintf("-m owner --uid-owner %d-%d", spec.UIDStart, spec.UIDEnd)
	vpnNetID := spec.effectiveVPNNetID()
	vpnMark := ""
	if vpnNetID > 0 {
		vpnMark = fmt.Sprintf("-m mark --mark 0x%x/0x%x", vpnNetID, contracts.NetIDMask)
	}

	switch hook.Chain {
	case contracts.ChainRawOutput:
		if !spec.ArmRawDrop {
			return nil, nil
		}
		rules := []string{ownerMatch + " -j DROP"}
		if family == 4 {
			rules = append(rules,
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p udp --dport 53 -j DROP", portal),
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p tcp --dport 53 -j DROP", portal),
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p tcp --dport 853 -j DROP", portal),
			)
		}
		if vpnMark != "" {
			rules = append(rules, vpnMark+" -j DROP")
		}
		return rules, nil

	case contracts.ChainOutput:
		var rules []string
		if family == 4 && spec.Open && spec.Session != nil {
			s := spec.Session
			outerMark := s.UplinkNetID | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit
			outerMask := contracts.NetIDMask | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit
			rules = append(rules,
				fmt.Sprintf("-o %s %s -j RETURN", s.TunIf, ownerMatch),
				fmt.Sprintf("-o %s -m mark --mark 0x%x/0x%x -j RETURN", s.TunIf, s.VPNNetID, contracts.NetIDMask),
			)
			if endpoint != "" {
				rules = append(rules, fmt.Sprintf("-o %s -p tcp -d %s/32 --dport %d -m owner --uid-owner %d -m mark --mark 0x%x/0x%x -j RETURN",
					s.UplinkIf, endpoint, port, s.ClientUID, outerMark, outerMask))
			}
		}
		// VPN mode has no IPv6 tunnel; always fail-closed for family == 6 even if IPv6Enabled is set.
		rules = append(rules,
			ownerMatch+" -p tcp -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset",
			ownerMatch+" -j REJECT",
		)
		if family == 4 {
			rules = append(rules,
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p tcp --dport 53 -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset", portal),
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p udp --dport 53 -j REJECT", portal),
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p tcp --dport 853 -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset", portal),
			)
		}
		if vpnMark != "" {
			rules = append(rules,
				vpnMark+" -p tcp -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset",
				vpnMark+" -j REJECT",
			)
		}
		return rules, nil

	case contracts.ChainEgress:
		var rules []string
		if family == 4 && spec.Open && spec.Session != nil {
			s := spec.Session
			outerMark := s.UplinkNetID | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit
			outerMask := contracts.NetIDMask | contracts.ProtectedVPNBit
			rules = append(rules,
				fmt.Sprintf("-o %s %s -j RETURN", s.TunIf, ownerMatch),
				fmt.Sprintf("-o %s -m mark --mark 0x%x/0x%x -j RETURN", s.TunIf, s.VPNNetID, contracts.NetIDMask),
			)
			if endpoint != "" {
				rules = append(rules, fmt.Sprintf("-o %s -p tcp -d %s/32 --dport %d -m owner --uid-owner %d -m mark --mark 0x%x/0x%x -j RETURN",
					s.UplinkIf, endpoint, port, s.ClientUID, outerMark, outerMask))
			}
		}
		rules = append(rules, ownerMatch+" -j DROP")
		if family == 4 {
			rules = append(rules,
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p udp --dport 53 -j DROP", portal),
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p tcp --dport 53 -j DROP", portal),
				fmt.Sprintf("-d %s/32 -p tcp --dport 853 -j DROP", portal),
			)
		}
		if vpnMark != "" {
			rules = append(rules, vpnMark+" -j DROP")
		}
		return rules, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown hook chain %q", hook.Chain)
}
```

```go
package netfilter

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
)

func testVPNSpecOpen() GateSpec {
	return GateSpec{
		UserID:       10,
		UIDStart:     1000000,
		UIDEnd:       1099999,
		PortalDNS4:   contracts.PortalDNS4,
		EndpointV4:   "203.0.113.10",
		EndpointPort: 443,
		IPv6Enabled:  false,
		ArmRawDrop:   false,
		Open:         true,
		Session: &ActiveSession{
			ClientUID:   1010376,
			VPNNetID:    106,
			TunIf:       "tun0",
			TunIfindex:  19,
			UplinkNetID: 100,
			UplinkIf:    "wlan0",
			UplinkIndex: 12,
		},
	}
}

func TestHotPathRulesAndTCPReset(t *testing.T) {
	spec := testVPNSpecOpen()

	rawRules, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[0], spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(rawRules) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected empty pass-through SBW_RAW_OUTPUT, got %v", rawRules)
	}

	outRules, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[1], spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(outRules) < 6 {
		t.Fatalf("expected >=6 SBW_OUTPUT rules, got %v", outRules)
	}
	if outRules[0] != "-o tun0 -m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -j RETURN" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected rule 0: %s", outRules[0])
	}
	if outRules[1] != "-o tun0 -m mark --mark 0x6a/0xffff -j RETURN" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected rule 1: %s", outRules[1])
	}
	wantOuter := "-o wlan0 -p tcp -d 203.0.113.10/32 --dport 443 -m owner --uid-owner 1010376 -m mark --mark 0x20064/0x2ffff -j RETURN"
	if outRules[2] != wantOuter {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected rule 2: %s\nwant: %s", outRules[2], wantOuter)
	}

	egRules, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[2], spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if egRules[0] != outRules[0] || egRules[1] != outRules[1] || egRules[2] != outRules[2] {
		t.Fatalf("egress allow rules mismatch: %v", egRules[:3])
	}

	out6, err := RulesFor(6, GateHooks[1], spec)
	if err != nil || len(out6) == 0 || strings.Contains(strings.Join(out6, "\n"), "RETURN") {
		t.Fatalf("IPv6 OUTPUT must reject all work traffic, got %v (err=%v)", out6, err)
	}
}

func TestArmedRawDropAndFenceInvariantVPN(t *testing.T) {
	spec := testVPNSpecOpen()
	spec.ArmRawDrop = true
	if _, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[0], spec); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invariant error when Open=true and ArmRawDrop=true")
	}
	spec.Open = false
	spec.Session = nil
	spec.LastVPNNetID = 106
	raw4, err := RulesFor(4, GateHooks[0], spec)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(raw4) != 5 || raw4[0] != "-m owner --uid-owner 1000000-1099999 -j DROP" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected armed raw4 rules: %v", raw4)
	}
}

func TestActiveSessionJSONSnakeCase(t *testing.T) {
	s := testVPNSpecOpen().Session
	b, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw := string(b)
	for _, key := range []string{`"client_uid":1010376`, `"vpn_net_id":106`, `"tun_if":"tun0"`, `"tun_ifindex":19`, `"uplink_net_id":100`, `"uplink_if":"wlan0"`, `"uplink_index":12`} {
		if !strings.Contains(raw, key) {
			t.Fatalf("missing snake_case field %s in %s", key, raw)
		}
	}
}

func TestV251TProxyToVPNCleanupAndVerify(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	mock := newV250IPTablesMock()
	ctrl := &Controller{Runner: mock, LockPath: filepath.Join(dir, "nf.lock")}
	ctx := context.Background()

	tproxySpec := testTProxySpecOpen()
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, tproxySpec, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("apply tproxy failed: %v", err)
	}
	vpnSpec := testVPNSpecOpen()
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, vpnSpec, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("switch to vpn (TProxy cleanup + verification) failed: %v", err)
	}
	if err := ctrl.ApplyOrVerify(ctx, vpnSpec, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("inspect vpn after TProxy cleanup failed: %v", err)
	}

	// VPN mode has no IPv6 tunnel; IPv6 OUTPUT/EGRESS must remain fail-closed even if IPv6Enabled=true.
	vpnIPv6 := testVPNSpecOpen()
	vpnIPv6.IPv6Enabled = true
	out6, err := RulesFor(6, GateHooks[1], vpnIPv6)
	if err != nil || len(out6) == 0 || strings.Contains(strings.Join(out6, "\n"), "RETURN") {
		t.Fatalf("expected IPv6 OUTPUT fail-closed even when IPv6Enabled=true, got %v (err=%v)", out6, err)
	}
	eg6, err := RulesFor(6, GateHooks[2], vpnIPv6)
	if err != nil || len(eg6) == 0 || strings.Contains(strings.Join(eg6, "\n"), "RETURN") {
		t.Fatalf("expected IPv6 EGRESS fail-closed even when IPv6Enabled=true, got %v (err=%v)", eg6, err)
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/oem/oem.go`:

```go
package oem

// Profile captures compile-time OEM characteristics stripped to zero dead branches per variant.
type Profile struct {
	Name                      string
	ExcludedCloneUsers        []int
	BloatCandidates           []string
	ExtraProtectedPackages    []string
	ExtraLocationDenyPackages []string
	SupportsHideApps          bool
	FreezerName               string
	DefaultDeviceName         string
	HideProviderURI           string
	HideSecureListKey         string
}

// Current returns the compile-time selected OEM profile.
func Current() Profile {
	return currentProfile
}

// IsExcludedUser reports whether userID is an OEM dual-app / secure-folder / reserved clone user
// that the sandbox guard must never modify, freeze, prune, or signal.
func (p Profile) IsExcludedUser(userID int) bool {
	for _, u := range p.ExcludedCloneUsers {
		if userID == u {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// IsForbiddenUser returns true for user <= 0 or any OEM clone/secure-folder user.
func IsForbiddenUser(userID int) bool {
	if userID <= 0 {
		return true
	}
	return currentProfile.IsExcludedUser(userID)
}
```

`guard/internal/oem/oem_test.go`:

```go
package oem

import "testing"

func TestOEMProfileInvariants(t *testing.T) {
	p := Current()
	if p.Name == "" || p.FreezerName == "" || p.DefaultDeviceName == "" {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete OEM profile: %+v", p)
	}
	if !IsForbiddenUser(0) || !IsForbiddenUser(-1) {
		t.Fatal("user <= 0 must always be forbidden")
	}
	if IsForbiddenUser(10) {
		t.Fatal("standard managed profile user 10 must be allowed")
	}
	if p.Name == "hyperos" {
		if !p.SupportsHideApps || !IsForbiddenUser(999) {
			t.Fatalf("hyperos profile invariants failed: %+v", p)
		}
		protected := make(map[string]bool, len(p.ExtraProtectedPackages))
		for _, pkg := range p.ExtraProtectedPackages {
			protected[pkg] = true
		}
		for _, bloat := range p.BloatCandidates {
			if protected[bloat] || bloat == "com.android.vending" || bloat == "com.google.android.gms" {
				t.Fatalf("bloat candidate %q conflicts with protected package", bloat)
			}
		}
	} else if p.SupportsHideApps {
		t.Fatalf("non-hyperos OEM %q must not enable MIUI hideapps", p.Name)
	}
	if p.Name == "oneui" {
		for _, u := range []int{95, 150, 999} {
			if !IsForbiddenUser(u) {
				t.Fatalf("oneui must exclude reserved user %d", u)
			}
		}
	}
	if p.Name == "oplus" || p.Name == "generic" {
		if !IsForbiddenUser(999) {
			t.Fatalf("%s must exclude clone user 999", p.Name)
		}
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/rpc/rpc_test.go`:

```go
package rpc

import (
	"bytes"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
)

func TestParseAndValidateRequest(t *testing.T) {
	// Valid ops
	for _, line := range []string{
		`{"id":"req-1","op":"GET_STATUS"}`,
		`{"id":"req-2","op":"IMPORT_EXISTING","pkg":"com.android.chrome"}`,
		`{"id":"req-3","op":"START_VPN","pkg":""}`,
		`{"id":"req-4","op":"PAUSE_VPN"}`,
		`{"id":"req-5","op":"RELOAD_CONFIG","config":{"quic_udp443_mode":"allow","log_level":"info"}}`,
		`{"id":"req-6","op":"SYNC_HIDE_APPS"}`,
		`{"id":"req-7","op":"RUN_PROBE"}`,
		`{"id":"req-8","op":"INSTALL_APK","apk_paths":["/data/local/tmp/base.apk","` + contracts.StagingDir + `/split_config.arm64_v8a.apk"]}`,
		`{"id":"req-9","op":"LAUNCH_APP","pkg":"com.google.android.apps.bard","activity":"com.google.android.apps.bard.shellapp.BardEntryPointActivity"}`,
		`{"id":"req-10","op":"LAUNCH_APP","pkg":"com.android.vending"}`,
		`{"id":"req-11","op":"STOP_APP","pkg":"com.android.chrome"}`,
		`{"id":"req-12","op":"REMOVE_APP","pkg":"com.example.app"}`,
	} {
		if _, err := ParseAndValidateRequest([]byte(line)); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("valid line %s rejected: %v", line, err)
		}
	}

	// Reject oversized >8192B
	oversized := `{"id":"big","op":"GET_STATUS","pkg":"` + strings.Repeat("a", contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes) + `"}`
	if _, err := ParseAndValidateRequest([]byte(oversized)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted >8192B RPC request")
	}

	// Reject shell injection / malformed package names / unknown ops / unknown fields
	badLines := []string{
		`{"id":"1","op":"SHELL_EXEC"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"IMPORT_EXISTING","pkg":"com.foo;id"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"IMPORT_EXISTING","pkg":"com.foo && rm -rf /"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"IMPORT_EXISTING","pkg":"../evil"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"IMPORT_EXISTING","pkg":"singleword"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"IMPORT_EXISTING","pkg":""}`,
		`{"id":"","op":"GET_STATUS"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"GET_STATUS","extra":true}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"RELOAD_CONFIG","config":{"quic_udp443_mode":"bypass"}}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"GET_STATUS","config":{"log_level":"info"}}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"INSTALL_APK"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"INSTALL_APK","apk_paths":["/data/local/tmp/../evil.apk"]}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"INSTALL_APK","apk_paths":["/sdcard/Download/app.apk"]}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"INSTALL_APK","apk_paths":["/data/local/tmp/app.zip"]}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"INSTALL_APK","apk_paths":["/data/local/tmp/a;id.apk"]}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"GET_STATUS","apk_paths":["/data/local/tmp/base.apk"]}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"LAUNCH_APP","pkg":""}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"LAUNCH_APP","pkg":"com.foo;id"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"LAUNCH_APP","pkg":"com.android.vending","activity":"../evil"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"LAUNCH_APP","pkg":"com.android.vending","activity":".Main;id"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"GET_STATUS","activity":".Main"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"STOP_APP","pkg":""}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"STOP_APP","pkg":"com.foo;id"}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"REMOVE_APP","pkg":""}`,
		`{"id":"1","op":"REMOVE_APP","pkg":"../evil"}`,
	}
	for _, bad := range badLines {
		if _, err := ParseAndValidateRequest([]byte(bad)); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted bad RPC line: %s", bad)
		}
	}
}

func TestReadLineBounded(t *testing.T) {
	line, err := ReadLineBounded(bytes.NewBufferString(`{"id":"1","op":"GET_STATUS"}`+"\n"), 128)
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(line), "GET_STATUS") {
		t.Fatalf("failed valid bounded read: %v %q", err, string(line))
	}
	tooLong := bytes.NewBufferString(strings.Repeat("x", 8193) + "\n")
	if _, err := ReadLineBounded(tooLong, contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted line exceeding 8192 bytes")
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/rpc/server.go`:

```go
package rpc

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/sysio"
)

type Handler interface {
	HandleRPC(ctx context.Context, req contracts.RPCRequest) contracts.RPCResponse
}

type CtlHandler interface {
	HandleCtl(ctx context.Context, cmd string, args []string) (string, error)
}

var allowedOps = map[string]bool{
	contracts.OpGetStatus:      true,
	contracts.OpImportExisting: true,
	contracts.OpInstallApk:     true,
	contracts.OpStartVPN:       true,
	contracts.OpPauseVPN:       true,
	contracts.OpReloadConfig:   true,
	contracts.OpSyncHideApps:   true,
	contracts.OpRunProbe:       true,
	contracts.OpLaunchApp:      true,
	contracts.OpStopApp:        true,
	contracts.OpRemoveApp:      true,
}

func IsSafeAPKPath(p string) bool {
	if len(p) == 0 || len(p) > 512 {
		return false
	}
	if !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".apk") {
		return false
	}
	if strings.Contains(p, "..") || strings.ContainsAny(p, "\x00\r\n\t;&|$`'\"\\ ") {
		return false
	}
	return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/data/local/tmp/") || strings.HasPrefix(p, contracts.StagingDir+"/")
}

// ParseAndValidateRequest enforces the frozen max-8192B newline-JSON RPC schema
// and strict package regex validation.
func ParseAndValidateRequest(rawLine []byte) (contracts.RPCRequest, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(rawLine)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, errors.New("empty request")
	}
	if len(rawLine) > contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("request exceeds %d bytes", contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes)
	}
	var req contracts.RPCRequest
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(&req); err != nil {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid json: %w", err)
	}
	if err := dec.Decode(new(any)); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, errors.New("trailing data after json object")
	}
	if req.ID == "" || len(req.ID) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(req.ID, "\r\n\t") {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, errors.New("invalid request id")
	}
	if !allowedOps[req.Op] {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported op %q", req.Op)
	}
	if req.Op == contracts.OpImportExisting || req.Op == contracts.OpLaunchApp ||
		req.Op == contracts.OpStopApp || req.Op == contracts.OpRemoveApp {
		if !contracts.ValidPackageName(req.Pkg) {
			return contracts.RPCRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid package name %q", req.Pkg)
		}
	} else if req.Pkg != "" && !contracts.ValidPackageName(req.Pkg) {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid package name %q", req.Pkg)
	}
	if req.Activity != "" {
		if req.Op != contracts.OpLaunchApp {
			return contracts.RPCRequest{}, errors.New("activity field only allowed on LAUNCH_APP")
		}
		if !contracts.ValidComponentClass(req.Activity) {
			return contracts.RPCRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid activity class %q", req.Activity)
		}
	}
	if req.Op == contracts.OpInstallApk {
		if len(req.ApkPaths) == 0 || len(req.ApkPaths) > 32 {
			return contracts.RPCRequest{}, errors.New("INSTALL_APK requires 1..32 apk_paths")
		}
		for _, p := range req.ApkPaths {
			if !IsSafeAPKPath(p) {
				return contracts.RPCRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("unsafe apk_path %q", p)
			}
		}
	} else if len(req.ApkPaths) > 0 {
		return contracts.RPCRequest{}, errors.New("apk_paths only allowed on INSTALL_APK")
	}
	if req.Config != nil {
		if req.Op != contracts.OpReloadConfig {
			return contracts.RPCRequest{}, errors.New("config field only allowed on RELOAD_CONFIG")
		}
		if err := ValidateConfigOverrides(req.Config); err != nil {
			return contracts.RPCRequest{}, err
		}
	}
	return req, nil
}

func ValidateConfigOverrides(cfg *contracts.RPCConfigOverrides) error {
	if cfg == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if cfg.QuicUDP443Mode != "" && cfg.QuicUDP443Mode != "reject" && cfg.QuicUDP443Mode != "allow" {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid quic_udp443_mode %q", cfg.QuicUDP443Mode)
	}
	switch cfg.LogLevel {
	case "", "silent", "error", "warning", "info", "debug":
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid log_level %q", cfg.LogLevel)
	}
	return nil
}

// ReadLineBounded reads a single newline-terminated line up to maxBytes without buffering unbounded memory.
func ReadLineBounded(r io.Reader, maxBytes int) ([]byte, error) {
	br := bufio.NewReaderSize(io.LimitReader(r, int64(maxBytes)+1), maxBytes+1)
	line, err := br.ReadBytes('\n')
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) && len(line) > 0 {
			if len(line) > maxBytes {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("line exceeds %d bytes", maxBytes)
			}
			return line, nil
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(line) > maxBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("line exceeds %d bytes", maxBytes)
	}
	return line, nil
}

// ListenUnixSecured creates a Unix stream listener with deterministic permissions and optional SELinux label.
func ListenUnixSecured(sockPath string, perm os.FileMode, seCtx string) (net.Listener, error) {
	_ = os.Remove(sockPath)
	oldMask := sysio.SetUmask(0077)
	ln, err := net.Listen("unix", sockPath)
	sysio.SetUmask(oldMask)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(sockPath, perm); err != nil {
		_ = ln.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(sockPath)
		return nil, err
	}
	if seCtx != "" {
		if err := sysio.Lsetfilecon(sockPath, seCtx); err != nil {
			_ = ln.Close()
			_ = os.Remove(sockPath)
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return ln, nil
}

func authorizeUnixPeer(conn net.Conn, sockPath, wantCtx string) error {
	if runtime.GOOS != "linux" {
		return nil
	}
	creds, err := sysio.GetUnixPeerCreds(conn)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(sockPath, "/dev/") {
		if creds.UID != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("unauthorized uid %d on %s", creds.UID, sockPath)
		}
		peerCtx := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimRight(creds.Context, "\x00"))
		if wantCtx != "" && peerCtx != wantCtx {
			return fmt.Errorf("unauthorized peer context %q on %s", peerCtx, sockPath)
		}
		return nil
	}
	// Non-/dev test listeners only accept same-user (or root) peer credentials.
	if creds.UID != 0 && creds.UID != os.Getuid() {
		return fmt.Errorf("unauthorized uid %d on %s", creds.UID, sockPath)
	}
	return nil
}

func ServeGuardRPC(ctx context.Context, sockPath string, handler Handler) (func(), error) {
	ln, err := ListenUnixSecured(sockPath, 0600, contracts.SELinuxPrivSock)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sem := make(chan struct{}, 16)
	go func() {
		<-ctx.Done()
		_ = ln.Close()
	}()
	go func() {
		for {
			conn, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			select {
			case sem <- struct{}{}:
				go func(c net.Conn) {
					defer func() { <-sem }()
					if aerr := authorizeUnixPeer(c, sockPath, contracts.SELinuxBrokerCtx); aerr != nil {
						_ = c.Close()
						return
					}
					handleGuardConn(ctx, c, handler)
				}(conn)
			default:
				_ = conn.Close()
			}
		}
	}()
	return func() {
		_ = ln.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(sockPath)
	}, nil
}

func handleGuardConn(parent context.Context, conn net.Conn, handler Handler) {
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(36 * time.Second))

	line, err := ReadLineBounded(conn, contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes)
	if err != nil {
		writeResp(conn, contracts.RPCResponse{OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}})
		return
	}
	req, err := ParseAndValidateRequest(line)
	if err != nil {
		writeResp(conn, contracts.RPCResponse{OK: false, Error: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{}})
		return
	}
	reqTimeout := 30 * time.Second
	if req.Op == contracts.OpInstallApk {
		reqTimeout = 120 * time.Second
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(125 * time.Second))
	}
	cctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parent, reqTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	resp := handler.HandleRPC(cctx, req)
	if resp.ID == "" {
		resp.ID = req.ID
	}
	if resp.Data == nil {
		resp.Data = map[string]any{}
	}
	writeResp(conn, resp)
}

func writeResp(conn net.Conn, resp contracts.RPCResponse) {
	b, err := json.Marshal(resp)
	if err != nil {
		b = []byte(`{"id":"","ok":false,"error":"marshal error","data":{}}`)
	}
	b = append(b, '\n')
	_, _ = conn.Write(b)
}

type CtlRequest struct {
	Cmd  string   `json:"cmd"`
	Args []string `json:"args,omitempty"`
}

type CtlResponse struct {
	OK     bool   `json:"ok"`
	Output string `json:"output,omitempty"`
	Error  string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func ServeRootCtl(ctx context.Context, sockPath string, handler CtlHandler) (func(), error) {
	ln, err := ListenUnixSecured(sockPath, 0600, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sem := make(chan struct{}, 16)
	go func() {
		<-ctx.Done()
		_ = ln.Close()
	}()
	go func() {
		for {
			conn, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			select {
			case sem <- struct{}{}:
				go func(c net.Conn) {
					defer func() { <-sem }()
					defer c.Close()
					if aerr := authorizeUnixPeer(c, sockPath, ""); aerr != nil {
						return
					}
					_ = c.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second))
					line, err := ReadLineBounded(c, contracts.MaxRPCLineBytes)
					if err != nil {
						_ = json.NewEncoder(c).Encode(CtlResponse{OK: false, Error: err.Error()})
						return
					}
					var req CtlRequest
					if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes.TrimSpace(line), &req); err != nil {
						_ = json.NewEncoder(c).Encode(CtlResponse{OK: false, Error: err.Error()})
						return
					}
					ctlTimeout := 25 * time.Second
					if req.Cmd == "install-apk" || req.Cmd == "boot" {
						ctlTimeout = 120 * time.Second
						_ = c.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(125 * time.Second))
					}
					cctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, ctlTimeout)
					defer cancel()
					out, err := handler.HandleCtl(cctx, req.Cmd, req.Args)
					if err != nil {
						_ = json.NewEncoder(c).Encode(CtlResponse{OK: false, Error: err.Error()})
						return
					}
					_ = json.NewEncoder(c).Encode(CtlResponse{OK: true, Output: out})
				}(conn)
			default:
				_ = conn.Close()
			}
		}
	}()
	return func() {
		_ = ln.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(sockPath)
	}, nil
}

func SendRootCtl(sockPath, cmd string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	conn, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", sockPath, 3*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	deadline := 30 * time.Second
	if cmd == "install-apk" || cmd == "boot" {
		deadline = 125 * time.Second
	}
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(deadline))
	b, err := json.Marshal(CtlRequest{Cmd: cmd, Args: args})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if _, err := conn.Write(append(b, '\n')); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	line, err := ReadLineBounded(conn, contracts.MaxRPCRespBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	var resp CtlResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes.TrimSpace(line), &resp); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if !resp.OK {
		return "", errors.New(resp.Error)
	}
	return resp.Output, nil
}
```
