`guard/internal/sysio/atomic.go`:

```go
package sysio

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
)

// WriteAtomicOptions specifies ownership, permissions, and SELinux label applied before rename.
type WriteAtomicOptions struct {
	Perm    os.FileMode
	UID     int // -1 to skip chown
	GID     int // -1 to skip chown
	SELinux string
}

// WriteAtomic writes data via a synced temporary file, applying chmod, chown, and lsetfilecon
// BEFORE atomically renaming into path so readers never observe half-written or mislabeled files.
func WriteAtomic(path string, data []byte, opts WriteAtomicOptions) error {
	dir := filepath.Dir(path)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, ".tmp."+filepath.Base(path)+".*")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tmp := f.Name()
	cleanup := func() {
		_ = f.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(tmp)
	}

	if _, err := f.Write(data); err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return err
	}
	if err := f.Chmod(opts.Perm); err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return err
	}
	if err := fchownFile(f, opts.UID, opts.GID); err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return err
	}
	if err := f.Sync(); err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return err
	}
	if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(tmp)
		return err
	}
	if opts.SELinux != "" {
		if err := Lsetfilecon(tmp, opts.SELinux); err != nil {
			_ = os.Remove(tmp)
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := renameAtomicTemp(tmp, path); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(tmp)
		return err
	}
	if d, err := os.Open(dir); err == nil {
		_ = d.Sync()
		_ = d.Close()
	}
	return nil
}

// ReadBootID reads /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id.
func ReadBootID() (string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(contracts.ProcBootID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	id := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
	if id == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("empty boot_id")
	}
	return id, nil
}
```

`guard/internal/sysio/atomic_rename.go`:

```go
package sysio

import (
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

var writeRenameMu sync.Mutex

// renameAtomicTemp serializes atomic file replacements inside the process and
// retries transient Windows NTFS sharing/access-denied rename races.
func renameAtomicTemp(tmp, path string) error {
	writeRenameMu.Lock()
	defer writeRenameMu.Unlock()

	err := os.Rename(tmp, path)
	if err == nil || runtime.GOOS != "windows" {
		return err
	}
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 5; attempt++ {
		time.Sleep(2 * time.Millisecond)
		if err = os.Rename(tmp, path); err == nil {
			return nil
		}
	}
	return err
}
```

`guard/internal/sysio/atomic_v251_test.go`:

```go
package sysio

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

func TestWriteAtomicConcurrentWritersNoCorruption(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	target := filepath.Join(dir, "concurrent.json")

	const workers = 16
	const iters = 20
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make(chan error, workers*iters)

	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(id int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			payload := []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"worker":%d,"status":"ok"}`+"\n", id))
			for i := 0; i < iters; i++ {
				if err := WriteAtomic(target, payload, WriteAtomicOptions{Perm: 0600, UID: -1, GID: -1}); err != nil {
					errs <- err
				}
			}
		}(w)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	close(errs)
	for err := range errs {
		t.Fatalf("concurrent WriteAtomic failed: %v", err)
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/sysio/openat2.go`:

```go
package sysio

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"sandbox_guard/internal/contracts"
	"sandbox_guard/internal/oem"
)

const (
	ResolveNoSymlinks uint64 = 0x04
	ResolveBeneath    uint64 = 0x08
	SysOpenat2Arm64          = 437
)

var (
	ErrSymlinkBlocked = errors.New("symlink or path escape blocked by openat2")
	ErrInvalidOwner   = errors.New("unexpected file or directory owner")
	ErrNotRegularFile = errors.New("target is not a regular file")
	ErrNotDirectory   = errors.New("target is not a directory")
	ErrFileTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds maximum allowed size")
)

type OpenHowSpec struct {
	Flags   uint64
	Mode    uint64
	Resolve uint64
}

type FileMeta struct {
	IsRegular bool
	IsDir     bool
	UID       int
	Perm      uint32
	Size      int64
}

type ReadHandle interface {
	io.ReadCloser
	StatMeta() (FileMeta, error)
}

// SafeResolver abstracts Linux openat2 (or strict O_NOFOLLOW component walk in kernel_compat)
// + dirfd traversal so symlink-escape checks are enforced identically across variants.
type SafeResolver interface {
	OpenDirAbsolute(absPath string) (dirFD int, meta FileMeta, closeFn func() error, err error)
	OpenDirBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how OpenHowSpec) (subFD int, meta FileMeta, closeFn func() error, err error)
	OpenFileBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how OpenHowSpec) (ReadHandle, error)
}

func RequiredVPNStatusOpenHow() OpenHowSpec {
	return OpenHowSpec{
		Flags:   platformReadOnlyNonBlockCloexec(),
		Mode:    0,
		Resolve: ResolveNoSymlinks | ResolveBeneath,
	}
}

func RequiredDirOpenHow() OpenHowSpec {
	return OpenHowSpec{
		Flags:   platformReadOnlyDirCloexec(),
		Mode:    0,
		Resolve: ResolveNoSymlinks | ResolveBeneath,
	}
}

// DefaultResolver returns the platform SafeResolver (exposed for sibling packages like daemon).
func DefaultResolver() SafeResolver {
	return defaultResolver()
}

// ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes securely reads /data/user/<userID>/<workPkg>/files/vpn_status.json
// without ever calling setresuid and strictly rejecting symlinks, path escapes, wrong owners,
// non-regular files, and oversized payloads (>4096B).
func ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(resolver SafeResolver, userID, workClientUID int, workPkg string) ([]byte, error) {
	if resolver == nil {
		resolver = defaultResolver()
	}
	if oem.IsForbiddenUser(userID) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing unsafe user_id %d", userID)
	}
	if !contracts.ValidClientUID(userID, workClientUID) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid work client uid %d for user %d", workClientUID, userID)
	}
	pkg := strings.TrimSpace(workPkg)
	if pkg == "" {
		pkg = contracts.DefaultWorkPackage
	}
	if !contracts.ValidPackageName(pkg) || strings.ContainsAny(pkg, "/\\") || strings.Contains(pkg, "..") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid work package %q", workPkg)
	}

	parentFD, parentMeta, closeParent, err := resolver.OpenDirAbsolute("/data/user")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer closeParent()
	if !parentMeta.IsDir {
		return nil, ErrNotDirectory
	}
	if parentMeta.UID != 0 && parentMeta.UID != 1000 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: /data/user owned by uid %d", ErrInvalidOwner, parentMeta.UID)
	}

	userFD, userMeta, closeUser, err := resolver.OpenDirBeneath(parentFD, strconv.Itoa(userID), RequiredDirOpenHow())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer closeUser()
	if !userMeta.IsDir {
		return nil, ErrNotDirectory
	}
	if userMeta.UID != 0 && userMeta.UID != 1000 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: /data/user/%d owned by uid %d", ErrInvalidOwner, userID, userMeta.UID)
	}

	handle, err := resolver.OpenFileBeneath(userFD, pkg+"/files/vpn_status.json", RequiredVPNStatusOpenHow())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer handle.Close()

	meta, err := handle.StatMeta()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !meta.IsRegular {
		return nil, ErrNotRegularFile
	}
	if meta.UID != workClientUID {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: vpn_status.json owned by uid %d, want %d", ErrInvalidOwner, meta.UID, workClientUID)
	}
	if meta.Size > contracts.MaxVPNStatusBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d bytes", ErrFileTooLarge, meta.Size)
	}

	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(handle, contracts.MaxVPNStatusBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(data) > contracts.MaxVPNStatusBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: >%d bytes", ErrFileTooLarge, contracts.MaxVPNStatusBytes)
	}
	return data, nil
}

```

`guard/internal/sysio/openat2_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux && !kernel_compat

package sysio

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func (linuxResolver) OpenDirBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how OpenHowSpec) (int, FileMeta, func() error, error) {
	uHow := unix.OpenHow{
		Flags:   how.Flags,
		Mode:    how.Mode,
		Resolve: how.Resolve,
	}
	fd, err := unix.Openat2(dirFD, relPath, &uHow)
	if err != nil {
		return -1, FileMeta{}, nil, mapOpenat2Err(err)
	}
	meta, err := fstatMeta(fd)
	if err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return -1, FileMeta{}, nil, err
	}
	return fd, meta, func() error { return unix.Close(fd) }, nil
}

func (linuxResolver) OpenFileBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how OpenHowSpec) (ReadHandle, error) {
	uHow := unix.OpenHow{
		Flags:   how.Flags,
		Mode:    how.Mode,
		Resolve: how.Resolve,
	}
	fd, err := unix.Openat2(dirFD, relPath, &uHow)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapOpenat2Err(err)
	}
	return &linuxHandle{
		file: os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), filepath.Base(relPath)),
		fd:   fd,
	}, nil
}
```

```go
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrSymlinkBlocked, path)

	return nil

var (
	hostLocksMu sync.Mutex
	hostLocks   = map[string]*sync.Mutex{}
)

func AcquireFlock(path string, perm os.FileMode, timeout time.Duration) (func(), error) {
	hostLocksMu.Lock()
	mu, ok := hostLocks[path]
	if !ok {
		mu = &sync.Mutex{}
		hostLocks[path] = mu
	}
	hostLocksMu.Unlock()
	mu.Lock()
	return func() { mu.Unlock() }, nil
}

func TryFlockNonBlocking(path string, perm os.FileMode) (func(), bool, error) {
	hostLocksMu.Lock()
	mu, ok := hostLocks[path]
	if !ok {
		mu = &sync.Mutex{}
		hostLocks[path] = mu
	}
	hostLocksMu.Unlock()
	if !mu.TryLock() {
		return nil, false, nil
	}
	return func() { mu.Unlock() }, true, nil
}

func MonotonicNowNs() int64 {
	return time.Since(startTime).Nanoseconds()

	return nil
```

```go
func TestReadWorkVPNStatusBytes_SecurityChecks(t *testing.T) {
	baseResolver := func() *fakeOpenat2Resolver {
		return &fakeOpenat2Resolver{
			absDirs: map[string]FileMeta{
				"/data/user": {IsDir: true, UID: 1000},
			},
			beneathDirs: map[string]FileMeta{
				"10": {IsDir: true, UID: 1000},
			},
			beneathFiles: map[string]struct {
				data []byte
				meta FileMeta
				err  error
			}{
				"com.sandbox.controller/files/vpn_status.json": {
					data: []byte(`{"running":true,"tun_if":"tun0"}`),
					meta: FileMeta{IsRegular: true, UID: 1010376, Size: 32},
				},
			},
		}
	}

	// Valid read verifies exact RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS|RESOLVE_BENEATH and flags.
	r := baseResolver()
	got, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(r, 10, 1010376, "com.sandbox.controller")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if string(got) != `{"running":true,"tun_if":"tun0"}` {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected payload: %s", string(got))
	}
	if len(r.seenHow) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 openat2 calls, got %d", len(r.seenHow))
	}
	if r.seenHow[1].Resolve != (ResolveNoSymlinks | ResolveBeneath) {
		t.Fatalf("wrong resolve flags: %#x", r.seenHow[1].Resolve)
	}
	if r.seenHow[1].Flags != platformReadOnlyNonBlockCloexec() {
		t.Fatalf("wrong open flags: %#x", r.seenHow[1].Flags)
	}

	// Rejects user 999 / user 0.
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(r, 999, 99910376, "com.sandbox.controller"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted non-managed clone user 999")
	}
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(r, 0, 10376, "com.sandbox.controller"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted user 0")
	}
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(r, 10, 1010376, "../evil"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted traversal package")
	}

	// Rejects symlink on files/ or vpn_status.json.
	rSym := baseResolver()
	rSym.beneathFiles["com.sandbox.controller/files/vpn_status.json"] = struct {
		data []byte
		meta FileMeta
		err  error
	}{err: ErrSymlinkBlocked}
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(rSym, 10, 1010376, "com.sandbox.controller"); !errors.Is(err, ErrSymlinkBlocked) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrSymlinkBlocked, got %v", err)
	}

	// Rejects FIFO/device (IsRegular == false).
	rPipe := baseResolver()
	rPipe.beneathFiles["com.sandbox.controller/files/vpn_status.json"] = struct {
		data []byte
		meta FileMeta
		err  error
	}{meta: FileMeta{IsRegular: false, UID: 1010376, Size: 10}}
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(rPipe, 10, 1010376, "com.sandbox.controller"); !errors.Is(err, ErrNotRegularFile) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrNotRegularFile, got %v", err)
	}

	// Rejects wrong UID on vpn_status.json.
	rUID := baseResolver()
	rUID.beneathFiles["com.sandbox.controller/files/vpn_status.json"] = struct {
		data []byte
		meta FileMeta
		err  error
	}{data: []byte("{}"), meta: FileMeta{IsRegular: true, UID: 1010999, Size: 2}}
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(rUID, 10, 1010376, "com.sandbox.controller"); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidOwner) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidOwner, got %v", err)
	}

	// Rejects /data/user/10 owned by workClientUID.
	rUserOwner := baseResolver()
	rUserOwner.beneathDirs["10"] = FileMeta{IsDir: true, UID: 1010376}
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(rUserOwner, 10, 1010376, "com.sandbox.controller"); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidOwner) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidOwner on user dir, got %v", err)
	}

	// Rejects oversized payload (>4096B) even if stat lies.
	rBig := baseResolver()
	rBig.beneathFiles["com.sandbox.controller/files/vpn_status.json"] = struct {
		data []byte
		meta FileMeta
		err  error
	}{data: bytes.Repeat([]byte("a"), 4097), meta: FileMeta{IsRegular: true, UID: 1010376, Size: 100}}
	if _, err := ReadWorkVPNStatusBytes(rBig, 10, 1010376, "com.sandbox.controller"); !errors.Is(err, ErrFileTooLarge) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrFileTooLarge, got %v", err)
	}
}
```

`guard/internal/sysio/openat_common_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux

package sysio

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

var unprivilegedTestMode atomic.Bool

// EnableUnprivilegedTestMode relaxes root-only UID/chcon/fchown checks inside go tests
// when executed by an unprivileged CI user. No-op when running as euid 0.
func EnableUnprivilegedTestMode() {
	if os.Geteuid() != 0 {
		unprivilegedTestMode.Store(true)
	}
}

func isUnprivilegedGoTest() bool {
	return unprivilegedTestMode.Load() && os.Geteuid() != 0
}

func platformReadOnlyNonBlockCloexec() uint64 {
	return uint64(unix.O_RDONLY | unix.O_NONBLOCK | unix.O_CLOEXEC)
}

func platformReadOnlyDirCloexec() uint64 {
	return uint64(unix.O_RDONLY | unix.O_DIRECTORY | unix.O_NOFOLLOW | unix.O_CLOEXEC)
}

type linuxResolver struct{}

func defaultResolver() SafeResolver { return linuxResolver{} }

type linuxHandle struct {
	file *os.File
	fd   int
}

func (h *linuxHandle) Read(p []byte) (int, error) { return h.file.Read(p) }
func (h *linuxHandle) Close() error               { return h.file.Close() }

func (h *linuxHandle) StatMeta() (FileMeta, error) {
	return fstatMeta(h.fd)
}

func fstatMeta(fd int) (FileMeta, error) {
	var st unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fd, &st); err != nil {
		return FileMeta{}, err
	}
	typ := st.Mode & unix.S_IFMT
	return FileMeta{
		IsRegular: typ == unix.S_IFREG,
		IsDir:     typ == unix.S_IFDIR,
		UID:       int(st.Uid),
		Perm:      uint32(st.Mode) & 0777,
		Size:      st.Size,
	}, nil
}

func mapOpenat2Err(err error) error {
	if errors.Is(err, unix.ELOOP) || errors.Is(err, unix.EXDEV) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrSymlinkBlocked, err)
	}
	return err
}

func (linuxResolver) OpenDirAbsolute(absPath string) (int, FileMeta, func() error, error) {
	fd, err := unix.Open(absPath, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return -1, FileMeta{}, nil, mapOpenat2Err(err)
	}
	meta, err := fstatMeta(fd)
	if err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return -1, FileMeta{}, nil, err
	}
	return fd, meta, func() error { return unix.Close(fd) }, nil
}

// ReadRootOwnedSmallFile reads a root-owned 0600-max regular file with O_NOFOLLOW.
func ReadRootOwnedSmallFile(path string, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
	return ReadRootOwnedSmallFilePerm(path, maxBytes, 0077)
}

// ReadRootOwnedSmallFilePerm reads a root-owned regular file enforcing forbidPermMask == 0.
func ReadRootOwnedSmallFilePerm(path string, maxBytes int64, forbidPermMask uint32) ([]byte, error) {
	return readSmallFileNoFollow(path, maxBytes, true, forbidPermMask)
}

// ReadSmallFileNoFollow opens path with O_NOFOLLOW, verifies regular file & size bound, and reads it.
func ReadSmallFileNoFollow(path string, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
	return readSmallFileNoFollow(path, maxBytes, false, 0)
}

func readSmallFileNoFollow(path string, maxBytes int64, checkOwnerPerm bool, forbidPermMask uint32) ([]byte, error) {
	fd, err := unix.Open(path, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_NONBLOCK|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapOpenat2Err(err)
	}
	f := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), path)
	defer f.Close()

	meta, err := fstatMeta(fd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !meta.IsRegular {
		return nil, ErrNotRegularFile
	}
	if checkOwnerPerm {
		expectedUID := 0
		if isUnprivilegedGoTest() {
			expectedUID = os.Geteuid()
		}
		if meta.UID != expectedUID {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s uid=%d", ErrInvalidOwner, path, meta.UID)
		}
		if meta.Perm&forbidPermMask != 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %s has unsafe permissions %04o", path, meta.Perm)
		}
	}
	if meta.Size > maxBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s size=%d", ErrFileTooLarge, path, meta.Size)
	}
	data := make([]byte, 0, minInt64(meta.Size, maxBytes)+1)
	buf := make([]byte, 4096)
	for {
		n, rerr := f.Read(buf)
		if n > 0 {
			if int64(len(data)+n) > maxBytes {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrFileTooLarge, path)
			}
			data = append(data, buf[:n]...)
		}
		if rerr != nil {
			if errors.Is(rerr, io.EOF) {
				break
			}
			return nil, rerr
		}
	}
	return data, nil
}

func minInt64(a, b int64) int64 {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

// Lsetfilecon applies a SELinux context without following symlinks.
func Lsetfilecon(path, seCtx string) error {
	if seCtx == "" {
		return nil
	}
	err := unix.Lsetxattr(path, "security.selinux", append([]byte(seCtx), 0), 0)
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	out, cerr := exec.Command("/system/bin/chcon", "-h", seCtx, path).CombinedOutput()
	if cerr != nil {
		if isUnprivilegedGoTest() {
			return nil
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("lsetxattr security.selinux (%v) and chcon (%v: %s)", err, cerr, strings.TrimSpace(string(out)))
	}
	return nil
}

// AcquireFlock acquires an exclusive advisory flock with O_NOFOLLOW and bounded timeout.
func AcquireFlock(path string, perm os.FileMode, timeout time.Duration) (func(), error) {
	f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, perm)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	for {
		if err := syscall.Flock(int(f.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_EX|syscall.LOCK_NB); err == nil {
			return func() {
				_ = syscall.Flock(int(f.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_UN)
				_ = f.Close()
			}, nil
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			_ = f.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("flock timeout on %s", path)
		}
		time.Sleep(15 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// TryFlockNonBlocking tries to lock path without waiting.
func TryFlockNonBlocking(path string, perm os.FileMode) (func(), bool, error) {
	f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, perm)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	if err := syscall.Flock(int(f.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_EX|syscall.LOCK_NB); err != nil {
		_ = f.Close()
		return nil, false, nil
	}
	return func() {
		_ = syscall.Flock(int(f.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_UN)
		_ = f.Close()
	}, true, nil
}

// MonotonicNowNs returns Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds.
func MonotonicNowNs() int64 {
	var ts unix.Timespec
	if err := unix.ClockGettime(unix.CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts); err != nil {
		return time.Now().UnixNano()
	}
	return ts.Nano()
}

func fchownFile(f *os.File, uid, gid int) error {
	if uid < 0 && gid < 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if isUnprivilegedGoTest() {
		return nil
	}
	return unix.Fchown(int(f.Fd()), uid, gid)
}
```

`guard/internal/sysio/openat_compat_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux && kernel_compat

package sysio

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func splitSafeRelPath(relPath string) ([]string, error) {
	if relPath == "" || strings.HasPrefix(relPath, "/") || strings.ContainsRune(relPath, '\\') || strings.ContainsRune(relPath, 0) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid relative path %q", ErrSymlinkBlocked, relPath)
	}
	parts := strings.Split(relPath, "/")
	out := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, p := range parts {
		if p == "" || p == "." || p == ".." {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsafe path component in %q", ErrSymlinkBlocked, relPath)
		}
		out = append(out, p)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// walkNoFollowComponents walks relPath beneath dirFD component-by-component with O_NOFOLLOW
// so Linux 4.19 / 5.4 kernels lacking openat2 retain full symlink/escape confinement.
func openBeneathNoFollow(dirFD int, relPath string, leafFlags int) (int, error) {
	parts, err := splitSafeRelPath(relPath)
	if err != nil {
		return -1, err
	}
	curFD := dirFD
	ownCur := false
	closeCur := func() {
		if ownCur && curFD >= 0 {
			_ = unix.Close(curFD)
		}
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(parts)-1; i++ {
		nextFD, err := unix.Openat(curFD, parts[i], unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		closeCur()
		if err != nil {
			return -1, mapOpenat2Err(err)
		}
		curFD = nextFD
		ownCur = true
	}
	leafFD, err := unix.Openat(curFD, parts[len(parts)-1], leafFlags|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	closeCur()
	if err != nil {
		return -1, mapOpenat2Err(err)
	}
	return leafFD, nil
}

func (linuxResolver) OpenDirBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how OpenHowSpec) (int, FileMeta, func() error, error) {
	fd, err := openBeneathNoFollow(dirFD, relPath, int(how.Flags)|unix.O_DIRECTORY)
	if err != nil {
		return -1, FileMeta{}, nil, err
	}
	meta, err := fstatMeta(fd)
	if err != nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return -1, FileMeta{}, nil, err
	}
	return fd, meta, func() error { return unix.Close(fd) }, nil
}

func (linuxResolver) OpenFileBeneath(dirFD int, relPath string, how OpenHowSpec) (ReadHandle, error) {
	fd, err := openBeneathNoFollow(dirFD, relPath, int(how.Flags))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &linuxHandle{
		file: os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), filepath.Base(relPath)),
		fd:   fd,
	}, nil
}
```

`guard/internal/sysio/peercred_linux.go`:

```go
//go:build linux

package sysio

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

type PeerCredentials struct {
	PID     int
	UID     int
	GID     int
	Context string
}

// GetUnixPeerCreds inspects SO_PEERCRED and SO_PEERSEC atomically on an accepted Unix stream socket.
func GetUnixPeerCreds(conn net.Conn) (PeerCredentials, error) {
	uc, ok := conn.(*net.UnixConn)
	if !ok {
		return PeerCredentials{}, fmt.Errorf("not a unix socket connection")
	}
	raw, err := uc.SyscallConn()
	if err != nil {
		return PeerCredentials{}, err
	}
	var (
		creds PeerCredentials
		opErr error
	)
	if err := raw.Control(func(fd uintptr) {
		ucred, err := unix.GetsockoptUcred(int(fd), unix.SOL_SOCKET, unix.SO_PEERCRED)
		if err != nil {
			opErr = fmt.Errorf("getsockopt SO_PEERCRED: %w", err)
			return
		}
		sec, err := unix.GetsockoptString(int(fd), unix.SOL_SOCKET, unix.SO_PEERSEC)
		if err != nil {
			opErr = fmt.Errorf("getsockopt SO_PEERSEC: %w", err)
			return
		}
		creds = PeerCredentials{
			PID:     int(ucred.Pid),
			UID:     int(ucred.Uid),
			GID:     int(ucred.Gid),
			Context: sec,
		}
	}); err != nil {
		return PeerCredentials{}, err
	}
	if opErr != nil {
		return PeerCredentials{}, opErr
	}
	return creds, nil
}

// SetUmask sets the process umask and returns the previous mask.
func SetUmask(mask int) int {
	return unix.Umask(mask)
}

```

`packaging/common/action.sh.tmpl`:

```tmpl
#!/system/bin/sh
# Magisk 28+ / KernelSU 1.0+ / APatch in-app Action button handler for KernBox.

MODDIR=${0%/*}
[ "$MODDIR" = "$0" ] && MODDIR=.
GUARD_HOME=/data/adb/sandbox_guard
GUARD_BIN="$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard"
export PATH={{ROOT_PATH_PREFIX}}:/data/adb/ksu/bin:/data/adb/ap/bin:/data/adb/magisk/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin:$PATH

echo "=== KernBox {{VERSION}} ({{OEM}}/{{KERNEL}}/{{ROOT}}) ==="

if [ ! -x "$GUARD_BIN" ]; then
    echo "! sandbox_guard binary not found at $GUARD_BIN"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -S /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock ]; then
    w=0
    if [ -f /data/adb/sandbox_guard/service.pid ]; then
        svc_pid=$(cat /data/adb/sandbox_guard/service.pid 2>/dev/null || true)
        case "$svc_pid" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*) ;;
            *)
                if kill -0 "$svc_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
                    while [ "$w" -lt 20 ] && [ ! -S /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock ]; do
                        sleep 0.1
                        w=$((w + 1))
                    done
                fi
                ;;
        esac
    fi
fi

if [ ! -S /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock ]; then
    echo "- Daemon socket offline; starting service.sh..."
    if [ -f "$MODDIR/service.sh" ]; then
        sh "$MODDIR/service.sh" --daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    w=0
    while [ "$w" -lt 20 ] && [ ! -S /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock ]; do
        sleep 0.1
        w=$((w + 1))
    done
fi

status_out=$("$GUARD_BIN" ctl status 2>&1 || true)
case "$status_out" in
    *'"paused": true'*|*'"paused":true'*)
        echo "- Sandbox is PAUSED; resuming..."
        "$GUARD_BIN" ctl start-sandbox
        ;;
    *'"state"'*)
        echo "- Sandbox is ACTIVE; pausing & hibernating..."
        "$GUARD_BIN" ctl pause-sandbox
        ;;
    *)
        echo "! Unable to query sandbox status:"
        echo "$status_out"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
```

```tmpl
#!/system/bin/sh

SKIPUNZIP=0

GUARD_HOME=/data/adb/sandbox_guard
VARIANT_OEM="{{OEM}}"
VARIANT_KERNEL="{{KERNEL}}"
VARIANT_ROOT="{{ROOT}}"
VARIANT_VER="{{VERSION}}"

if [ "$ARCH" != "arm64" ]; then
    abort "! Only arm64-v8a is supported (got ARCH=$ARCH)"
fi

ui_print "- Installing KernBox v${VARIANT_VER} (${VARIANT_OEM}/${VARIANT_KERNEL}/${VARIANT_ROOT})"

KVER=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ "$VARIANT_KERNEL" = "k510" ] && [ -n "$KVER" ]; then
    kmaj=${KVER%%.*}
    krest=${KVER#*.}
    kmin=${krest%%.*}
    case "$kmaj:$kmin" in
        [0-4]:*|5:[0-9])
            ui_print "! Warning: kernel $KVER appears older than 5.10; k419 variant is recommended if openat2/cgroup.freeze is unavailable"
            ;;
    esac
fi

mkdir -p "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"
chown 0:0 "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"
chmod 0700 "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"

install_exec_atomic() {
    src=$1
    dst=$2
    se=$3
    [ -f "$src" ] || abort "! Missing binary asset: $src"
    tmp="${dst}.new.$$"
    cp "$src" "$tmp" || abort "! Failed to copy $src"
    chown 0:0 "$tmp"
    chmod 0700 "$tmp"
    [ -n "$se" ] && chcon "$se" "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true
    mv -f "$tmp" "$dst" || abort "! Failed to install $dst"
}

install_exec_atomic "$MODPATH/bin/sandbox_guard" "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard" ""
install_exec_atomic "$MODPATH/bin/sandbox_broker" "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_broker" "u:object_r:sandbox_broker_exec:s0"
rm -rf "$MODPATH/bin"

seed_default_json() {
    src=$1
    dst=$2
    [ -f "$src" ] || return 0
    if [ ! -f "$dst" ]; then
        tmp="${dst}.new.$$"
        cp "$src" "$tmp" || abort "! Failed to copy $src"
        chown 0:0 "$tmp"
        chmod 0600 "$tmp"
        mv -f "$tmp" "$dst" || abort "! Failed to install $dst"
        ui_print "- Seeded default $dst"
    else
        ui_print "- Preserved existing $dst"
    fi
}

seed_default_json "$MODPATH/defaults/stealth.json" "$GUARD_HOME/stealth.json"
seed_default_json "$MODPATH/defaults/perf.json" "$GUARD_HOME/perf.json"

if [ -f "$MODPATH/variant.json" ]; then
    cp "$MODPATH/variant.json" "$GUARD_HOME/variant.json" 2>/dev/null || true
    chown 0:0 "$GUARD_HOME/variant.json" 2>/dev/null || true
    chmod 0644 "$GUARD_HOME/variant.json" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

rm -f "$MODPATH/zygisk_disabled"
echo 0 > "$GUARD_HOME/stealth_boot_tries"
chmod 0600 "$GUARD_HOME/stealth_boot_tries"

set_perm_recursive "$MODPATH" 0 0 0755 0644
set_perm "$MODPATH/post-fs-data.sh" 0 0 0755
set_perm "$MODPATH/service.sh" 0 0 0755
[ -f "$MODPATH/action.sh" ] && set_perm "$MODPATH/action.sh" 0 0 0755
[ -f "$MODPATH/uninstall.sh" ] && set_perm "$MODPATH/uninstall.sh" 0 0 0755
[ -f "$MODPATH/zygisk/arm64-v8a.so" ] && set_perm "$MODPATH/zygisk/arm64-v8a.so" 0 0 0644

if [ "$VARIANT_ROOT" = "magisk" ]; then
    ui_print "- Tip: Ensure Zygisk is enabled in Magisk Settings before rebooting."
else
    ui_print "- Tip: Ensure ZygiskNext or ReZygisk is active alongside $VARIANT_ROOT for SystemServer/Phone stealth."
fi
ui_print "- Ready. Reboot to activate (${VARIANT_OEM}/${VARIANT_KERNEL}/${VARIANT_ROOT}, bootloop kill-switch armed)."
```

`packaging/common/post-fs-data.sh.tmpl`:

```tmpl
#!/system/bin/sh

MODDIR=${0%/*}
GUARD_HOME=/data/adb/sandbox_guard
MAIN_BASE=/data/adb/sandbox_proxy
export PATH={{ROOT_PATH_PREFIX}}:/data/adb/ksu/bin:/data/adb/ap/bin:/data/adb/magisk/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin:$PATH

[ ! -e "$MODDIR/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/remove" ] || exit 0
umask 077

mkdir -p "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"
chown 0:0 "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"
chmod 0700 "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"

# Bootloop kill-switch for SystemServer/Phone Zygisk stealth hook:
# Incremented pre-Zygote and reset to 0 by service.sh after sys.boot_completed=1.
BOOT_TRIES_FILE="$GUARD_HOME/stealth_boot_tries"
tries=0
if [ -f "$BOOT_TRIES_FILE" ]; then
    read -r tries < "$BOOT_TRIES_FILE" 2>/dev/null || tries=0
fi
case "$tries" in ''|*[!0-9]*) tries=0 ;; esac
if [ "$tries" -ge 2 ]; then
    : > "$MODDIR/zygisk_disabled"
    chmod 0644 "$MODDIR/zygisk_disabled" 2>/dev/null || true
    if [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/stealth.json" ]; then
        tmp_stealth="$GUARD_HOME/stealth.json.killswitch.$$"
        if sed 's/"enabled"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true/"enabled": false/g' "$GUARD_HOME/stealth.json" > "$tmp_stealth" 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$tmp_stealth" ]; then
            chown 0:0 "$tmp_stealth" 2>/dev/null || true
            chmod 0600 "$tmp_stealth" 2>/dev/null || true
            mv -f "$tmp_stealth" "$GUARD_HOME/stealth.json" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$tmp_stealth"
        else
            rm -f "$tmp_stealth"
        fi
    fi
    rm -f /dev/sandbox_cfg/stealth.json
else
    tmp_tries="$BOOT_TRIES_FILE.tmp.$$"
    echo "$((tries + 1))" > "$tmp_tries"
    chmod 0600 "$tmp_tries" 2>/dev/null || true
    mv -f "$tmp_tries" "$BOOT_TRIES_FILE" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$tmp_tries"
    sync 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# Hide unlocked bootloader properties natively (skipped if stealth kill-switch triggered).
if [ ! -e "$MODDIR/zygisk_disabled" ]; then
    RESETPROP=""
    for cand in {{RESETPROP_CANDIDATES}} "$(command -v resetprop 2>/dev/null || true)"; do
        if [ -n "$cand" ] && [ -x "$cand" ]; then
            RESETPROP=$cand
            break
        fi
    done
    run_resetprop() {
        if [ -n "$RESETPROP" ]; then
            "$RESETPROP" "$@"
        else
            magisk resetprop "$@"
        fi
    }
    if [ -n "$RESETPROP" ] || command -v magisk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        run_resetprop -n ro.boot.verifiedbootstate green 2>/dev/null || true
        run_resetprop -n ro.boot.flash.locked 1 2>/dev/null || true
        run_resetprop -n ro.boot.vbmeta.device_state locked 2>/dev/null || true
        run_resetprop -n ro.boot.veritymode enforcing 2>/dev/null || true
        run_resetprop -n ro.boot.warranty_bit 0 2>/dev/null || true
        run_resetprop -n sys.oem_unlock_allowed 0 2>/dev/null || true

        for wprop in ro.warranty_bit ro.vendor.boot.warranty_bit ro.vendor.warranty_bit; do
            wval=$(getprop "$wprop" 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$wval" ] && [ "$wval" != "0" ]; then
                run_resetprop -n "$wprop" 0 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
        done

        if [ "$(getprop ro.debuggable 2>/dev/null || true)" = "1" ]; then
            run_resetprop -n ro.debuggable 0 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
        if [ "$(getprop ro.secure 2>/dev/null || true)" = "0" ]; then
            run_resetprop -n ro.secure 1 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
        if [ "$(getprop ro.adb.secure 2>/dev/null || true)" = "0" ]; then
            run_resetprop -n ro.adb.secure 1 2>/dev/null || true
        fi

        btags=$(getprop ro.build.tags 2>/dev/null || true)
        if [ "$btags" = "test-keys" ] || [ "$btags" = "dev-keys" ]; then
            run_resetprop -n ro.build.tags release-keys 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
        btype=$(getprop ro.build.type 2>/dev/null || true)
        if [ "$btype" = "userdebug" ] || [ "$btype" = "eng" ]; then
            run_resetprop -n ro.build.type user 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
fi

# Purge stale external proxy sandbox ack from prior boot before Zygote starts.
rm -f "$MAIN_BASE/sandbox_ack.v1.json"

# Pre-create anti-squat UDS and config directories before Zygote.
mkdir -p /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl /dev/socket/sandbox_priv /dev/sandbox_cfg
chown 0:0 /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl /dev/socket/sandbox_priv /dev/sandbox_cfg
chmod 0711 /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl
chmod 0700 /dev/socket/sandbox_priv
chmod 0711 /dev/sandbox_cfg
chcon u:object_r:sandbox_ctrl_sock_dir:s0 /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl 2>/dev/null || true
chcon u:object_r:sandbox_priv_dir:s0 /dev/socket/sandbox_priv 2>/dev/null || true
chcon u:object_r:sandbox_cfg_dir:s0 /dev/sandbox_cfg 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock /dev/sandbox_cfg/stealth.json

if [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_broker" ]; then
    chown 0:0 "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_broker"
    chmod 0700 "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_broker"
    chcon u:object_r:sandbox_broker_exec:s0 "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_broker" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard" ]; then
    chown 0:0 "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard"
    chmod 0700 "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard"
    "$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard" ctl boot > "$GUARD_HOME/boot.status" 2>&1 || true
fi
```

`packaging/common/service.sh.tmpl`:

```tmpl
#!/system/bin/sh

MODDIR=${0%/*}
[ "$MODDIR" = "$0" ] && MODDIR=.
GUARD_HOME=/data/adb/sandbox_guard
GUARD_BIN="$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard"
BROKER_BIN="$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_broker"
export PATH={{ROOT_PATH_PREFIX}}:/data/adb/ksu/bin:/data/adb/ap/bin:/data/adb/magisk/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin:$PATH

BB=""
for cand in {{BUSYBOX_CANDIDATES}}; do
    if [ -x "$cand" ]; then
        BB=$cand
        break
    fi
done
if [ -z "$BB" ]; then
    BB=$(command -v busybox 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ -n "$BB" ] && [ ! -x "$BB" ] && BB=""
fi

# Android /system/bin/sh (mksh) sets FD_CLOEXEC on exec fd>=3, breaking `exec 9>...; flock 9`.
# Re-exec under BusyBox sh (ash) whenever running under mksh.
if [ -n "${KSH_VERSION:-}" ] && [ -z "${_SBW_SH_SWITCHED:-}" ] && [ -n "$BB" ] && [ -x "$BB" ]; then
    _SBW_SH_SWITCHED=1 exec "$BB" sh "$0" "$@"
fi
unset _SBW_SH_SWITCHED

kill_pid_file() {
    local pfile=$1
    local expected=$2
    [ -f "$pfile" ] || return 0
    read -r cpid < "$pfile" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f "$pfile"; return 0; }
    case "$cpid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) rm -f "$pfile"; return 0 ;; esac
    local exe
    exe=$(readlink "/proc/$cpid/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ "$exe" = "$expected" ] || [ "$exe" = "$expected (deleted)" ]; then
        kill "$cpid" 2>/dev/null || true
        local n=0
        while [ "$n" -lt 25 ] && [ -d "/proc/$cpid" ]; do
            sleep 0.2
            n=$((n + 1))
        done
        [ -d "/proc/$cpid" ] && kill -9 "$cpid" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    rm -f "$pfile"
}

stop_daemon() {
    if [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid" ]; then
        local spid cmd n
        read -r spid < "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid" 2>/dev/null || spid=""
        case "$spid" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*) ;;
            *)
                if [ -d "/proc/$spid" ] && [ "$spid" != "$$" ]; then
                    cmd=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$spid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)
                    case "$cmd" in
                        *service.sh*)
                            kill -TERM "$spid" 2>/dev/null || true
                            n=0
                            while [ "$n" -lt 25 ] && [ -d "/proc/$spid" ]; do
                                sleep 0.2
                                n=$((n + 1))
                            done
                            if [ -d "/proc/$spid" ]; then
                                kill -9 "$spid" 2>/dev/null || true
                                sleep 0.1
                            fi
                            ;;
                    esac
                fi
                ;;
        esac
    fi
    kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/broker-svc.pid" "$BROKER_BIN"
    kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.pid" "$GUARD_BIN"
    kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/guard.pid" "$GUARD_BIN"
    rm -f /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid"
}

if [ "${1:-}" = "stop" ]; then
    stop_daemon
    exit 0
fi

[ ! -e "$MODDIR/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/remove" ] || exit 0
umask 077

BROKER_SELINUX_OK=1

post_boot_alert() {
    local tag=$1
    local msg=$2
    [ -n "$msg" ] || return 0
    local stamp="/dev/sandbox_cfg/.boot_alert_${tag}"
    if [ -f "$stamp" ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    : > "$stamp" 2>/dev/null || true
    (
        local w=0
        while [ "$w" -lt 30 ] && [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null || true)" != "1" ]; do
            sleep 2
            w=$((w + 1))
        done
        if ! cmd notification post -S bigtext -t "KernBox 启动异常" "$tag" "$msg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            rm -f "$stamp" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 9>&- &
}

prepare_env() {
    mkdir -p "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"
    chown 0:0 "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"
    chmod 0700 "$GUARD_HOME" "$GUARD_HOME/staging"

    mkdir -p /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl /dev/socket/sandbox_priv /dev/sandbox_cfg
    chown 0:0 /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl /dev/socket/sandbox_priv /dev/sandbox_cfg
    chmod 0711 /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl
    chmod 0700 /dev/socket/sandbox_priv
    chmod 0711 /dev/sandbox_cfg
    chcon u:object_r:sandbox_ctrl_sock_dir:s0 /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl 2>/dev/null || true
    chcon u:object_r:sandbox_priv_dir:s0 /dev/socket/sandbox_priv 2>/dev/null || true
    chcon u:object_r:sandbox_cfg_dir:s0 /dev/sandbox_cfg 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f /dev/sandbox_cfg/stealth.json

    [ -f "$GUARD_BIN" ] || {
        echo "missing guard binary in $GUARD_HOME" > "$GUARD_HOME/service.status"
        post_boot_alert "kernbox_guard_missing" "sandbox_guard 核心二进制缺失，请重新刷入模块"
        return 1
    }
    chown 0:0 "$GUARD_BIN"
    chmod 0700 "$GUARD_BIN"

    if [ -f "$BROKER_BIN" ]; then
        chown 0:0 "$BROKER_BIN"
        chmod 0700 "$BROKER_BIN"
        if ! chcon u:object_r:sandbox_broker_exec:s0 "$BROKER_BIN" 2>/dev/null; then
            BROKER_SELINUX_OK=0
            echo "warn: chcon sandbox_broker_exec failed; starting sandbox_guard in degraded mode" >> "$GUARD_HOME/service.status"
            post_boot_alert "kernbox_broker_selinux" "sandbox_broker SELinux 标签配置失败，控制端 App 将无法连接"
        fi
    else
        BROKER_SELINUX_OK=0
        post_boot_alert "kernbox_broker_missing" "sandbox_broker 缺失，控制端 App 将无法连接"
    fi
    return 0
}

apply_kernel_perf_tuning() {
    local kpath val
    for kv in \
        "/proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_slow_start_after_idle:0" \
        "/proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_fastopen:3" \
        "/proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_mtu_probing:1" \
        "/proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_notsent_lowat:16384"; do
        kpath=${kv%:*}
        val=${kv#*:}
        [ -w "$kpath" ] && echo "$val" > "$kpath" 2>/dev/null || true
    done
    if [ -r /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_available_congestion_control ] &&
       grep -qw bbr /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_available_congestion_control 2>/dev/null; then
        [ -w /proc/sys/net/core/default_qdisc ] && echo fq > /proc/sys/net/core/default_qdisc 2>/dev/null || true
        [ -w /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_congestion_control ] && echo bbr > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_congestion_control 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
}

protect_oom_pidfile() {
    local pfile=$1
    local expected=$2
    [ -f "$pfile" ] || return 0
    read -r cpid < "$pfile" 2>/dev/null || return 0
    case "$cpid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 0 ;; esac
    if [ -n "$expected" ]; then
        local exe
        exe=$(readlink "/proc/$cpid/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
        [ "$exe" = "$expected" ] || [ "$exe" = "$expected (deleted)" ] || return 0
    fi
    [ -w "/proc/$cpid/oom_score_adj" ] && echo -900 > "/proc/$cpid/oom_score_adj" 2>/dev/null || true
}

if [ "${1:-}" = "restart" ] || [ "${1:-}" = "--restart" ]; then
    stop_daemon
fi

if [ "${1:-}" != "--daemon" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$GUARD_HOME"
    : > "$GUARD_HOME/service.status" 2>/dev/null || true
    prepare_env || exit 1
    "$GUARD_BIN" ctl boot >> "$GUARD_HOME/service.status" 2>&1 || true

    if [ -n "$BB" ] && [ -x "$BB" ]; then
        ASH_STANDALONE=1 nohup "$BB" setsid "$BB" sh "$MODDIR/service.sh" --daemon </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    else
        nohup /system/bin/sh "$MODDIR/service.sh" --daemon </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    fi

    # Wait briefly (<=3s) so sockets and broker domain are active before returning.
    w=0
    while [ "$w" -lt 30 ]; do
        if [ -S /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock ]; then
            if [ "$BROKER_SELINUX_OK" != "1" ] || [ -S /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock ]; then
                break
            fi
        fi
        sleep 0.1
        w=$((w + 1))
    done
    exit 0
fi

prepare_env || exit 1
apply_kernel_perf_tuning

SVC_LOG="$GUARD_HOME/service-sup.log"

# Single-supervisor lock so concurrent invokes cannot duplicate child loops.
# Must run under BusyBox sh (enforced via mksh re-exec guard above) so FD 9 lacks FD_CLOEXEC.
if [ -n "$BB" ] && [ -x "$BB" ]; then
    exec 9>"$GUARD_HOME/service.lock"
    flock_err=$("$BB" flock -n 9 2>&1)
    flock_rc=$?
    if [ "$flock_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
        holder_pid=$(cat "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
        printf '%s service.sh --daemon flock -n 9 failed (rc=%s bb=%s ksh=%s holder_pid=%s): %s\n' \
            "$(date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S' 2>/dev/null || echo '00-00 00:00:00')" \
            "$flock_rc" "$BB" "${KSH_VERSION:-none}" "${holder_pid:-none}" "${flock_err:-already locked}" >> "$SVC_LOG"
        exit 0
    fi
elif [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid" ]; then
    read -r old_sup < "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid" 2>/dev/null || old_sup=""
    case "$old_sup" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) ;;
        *) [ -d "/proc/$old_sup" ] && exit 0 ;;
    esac
fi
echo "$$" > "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid"

# Reset bootloop counter once Android confirms sys.boot_completed=1, protect core daemons from LMK,
# and verify startup sockets / Zygisk health so boot failures never go silent.
(
    bn=0
    boot_cleared=0
    post_boot_ticks=0
    health_checked=0
    while [ "$bn" -lt 120 ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/remove" ]; do
        protect_oom_pidfile "$GUARD_HOME/guard.pid" "$GUARD_BIN"
        protect_oom_pidfile "$GUARD_HOME/broker-svc.pid" "$BROKER_BIN"
        local custom_proxy_dir=""
        if [ -r "$GUARD_HOME/policy.json" ]; then
            custom_proxy_dir=$(sed -n 's/.*"proxy_base_dir"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$GUARD_HOME/policy.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
        fi
        protect_oom_pidfile "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/core.pid" "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/mihomo"
        [ -n "$custom_proxy_dir" ] && protect_oom_pidfile "$custom_proxy_dir/core.pid" "$custom_proxy_dir/mihomo"
        if [ "$boot_cleared" = 0 ] && [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null || true)" = "1" ]; then
            tmp_tries="$GUARD_HOME/stealth_boot_tries.tmp.$$"
            echo 0 > "$tmp_tries"
            chmod 0600 "$tmp_tries" 2>/dev/null || true
            mv -f "$tmp_tries" "$GUARD_HOME/stealth_boot_tries" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$tmp_tries"
            apply_kernel_perf_tuning
            boot_cleared=1
        fi
        if [ "$boot_cleared" = 1 ]; then
            post_boot_ticks=$((post_boot_ticks + 1))
            if [ "$health_checked" = 0 ] && [ "$post_boot_ticks" -ge 8 ]; then
                health_checked=1
                if [ -e "$MODDIR/zygisk_disabled" ]; then
                    echo "zygisk_disabled triggered during boot" > "$GUARD_HOME/service.status"
                    post_boot_alert "kernbox_zygisk_disabled" "Zygisk 隐身组件因启动异常已自动熔断关闭，请打开 KernBox 检查"
                fi
                if [ ! -S /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock ]; then
                    echo "guard.sock missing 16s after boot_completed" > "$GUARD_HOME/service.status"
                    post_boot_alert "kernbox_guard_sock" "sandbox_guard 守护进程启动异常 (guard.sock 未就绪)"
                elif [ "$BROKER_SELINUX_OK" = 1 ] && [ ! -S /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock ]; then
                    echo "ctrl.sock missing 16s after boot_completed" > "$GUARD_HOME/service.status"
                    post_boot_alert "kernbox_broker_sock" "sandbox_broker 通信接口未就绪，KernBox 控制端无法连接"
                fi
            fi
            if [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/guard.pid" ] && [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/broker-svc.pid" ]; then
                if [ -f "/data/adb/sandbox_proxy/core.pid" ] || { [ -n "$custom_proxy_dir" ] && [ -f "$custom_proxy_dir/core.pid" ]; } || [ "$post_boot_ticks" -ge 15 ]; then
                    break
                fi
            fi
        fi
        sleep 2
        bn=$((bn + 1))
    done
) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 9>&- &

# Clean any orphaned child processes/pidfiles left behind by a prior SIGKILL.
kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/broker-svc.pid" "$BROKER_BIN"
kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.pid" "$GUARD_BIN"
kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/guard.pid" "$GUARD_BIN"

trap '' HUP
SUP_ROOT_PID=$$
STOPPING=0
GUARD_SUP_PID=""
BROKER_SUP_PID=""

log_sup() {
    if [ -f "$SVC_LOG" ]; then
        local sz
        sz=$(wc -c < "$SVC_LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        [ "$sz" -gt 131072 ] && mv -f "$SVC_LOG" "$SVC_LOG.1"
    fi
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S' 2>/dev/null || echo '00-00 00:00:00')" "$1" >> "$SVC_LOG"
}

cleanup() {
    STOPPING=1
    [ -n "$BROKER_SUP_PID" ] && kill "$BROKER_SUP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    [ -n "$GUARD_SUP_PID" ] && kill "$GUARD_SUP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/broker-svc.pid" "$BROKER_BIN"
    kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.pid" "$GUARD_BIN"
    kill_pid_file "$GUARD_HOME/guard.pid" "$GUARD_BIN"
    wait "$BROKER_SUP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$GUARD_SUP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl/ctrl.sock /dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid"
    exit 0
}

trap cleanup TERM INT

supervise_proc() {
    trap 'STOPPING=1; exit 0' TERM INT
    local name=$1
    local bin=$2
    local arg=$3
    local pidfile=$4
    local wait_sock=$5

    local rapid_fails=0
    local max_rapid=10
    local healthy_sec=60
    local backoff=1

    while [ "$STOPPING" = 0 ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/remove" ]; do
        if [ -n "$wait_sock" ]; then
            local w=0
            while [ "$w" -lt 25 ] && [ ! -S "$wait_sock" ] && [ "$STOPPING" = 0 ]; do
                sleep 0.2
                w=$((w + 1))
            done
        fi
        [ "$STOPPING" = 0 ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/remove" ] || break

        local start_ts
        start_ts=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$name" = "broker" ]; then
            chcon u:object_r:sandbox_broker_exec:s0 "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true
            # Never inherit adb_data_file stdout/stderr or lock fd 9 into u:r:sandbox_broker:s0.
            "$bin" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 9>&- &
        else
            if [ -f "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.log" ]; then
                local g_sz
                g_sz=$(wc -c < "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.log" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
                [ "$g_sz" -gt 131072 ] && mv -f "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.log" "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.log.1"
            fi
            GOMAXPROCS=1 GOGC=10 GOMEMLIMIT=3MiB "$bin" "$arg" >> "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.log" 2>&1 9>&- &
        fi
        local child=$!
        echo "$child" > "$pidfile"
        [ -w "/proc/$child/oom_score_adj" ] && echo -900 > "/proc/$child/oom_score_adj" 2>/dev/null || true
        wait "$child"
        local rc=$?
        rm -f "$pidfile"

        [ "$STOPPING" = 0 ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/remove" ] || {
            kill -TERM "$$" 2>/dev/null || true
            break
        }

        local end_ts elapsed
        end_ts=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        elapsed=$((end_ts - start_ts))
        if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$healthy_sec" ]; then
            rapid_fails=0
            backoff=1
        else
            rapid_fails=$((rapid_fails + 1))
        fi

        if [ "$rapid_fails" -eq 3 ]; then
            echo "$name crash-looping ($rapid_fails rapid failures rc=$rc)" > "$GUARD_HOME/service.status"
            post_boot_alert "kernbox_crash_${name}" "$name 服务连续异常退出 ($rapid_fails 次, rc=$rc)，请检查 service-sup.log"
        fi

        if [ "$rapid_fails" -ge "$max_rapid" ]; then
            log_sup "$name exceeded max rapid restarts ($max_rapid); stopping loop"
            echo "$name stopped after $max_rapid rapid restarts (rc=$rc)" > "$GUARD_HOME/service.status"
            post_boot_alert "kernbox_stopped_${name}" "$name 已连续崩溃 $max_rapid 次并停止重启 (rc=$rc)"
            [ "$name" = "guard" ] && kill -TERM "$SUP_ROOT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
            break
        fi

        log_sup "$name exited rc=$rc after ${elapsed}s; respawning in ${backoff}s"
        local sl=0
        while [ "$sl" -lt "$backoff" ] && [ "$STOPPING" = 0 ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$MODDIR/remove" ]; do
            sleep 1
            sl=$((sl + 1))
        done
        backoff=$((backoff * 2))
        [ "$backoff" -gt 30 ] && backoff=30
    done
}

supervise_proc "guard" "$GUARD_BIN" "supervise" "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.pid" "" 9>&- &
GUARD_SUP_PID=$!

if [ "$BROKER_SELINUX_OK" = 1 ]; then
    supervise_proc "broker" "$BROKER_BIN" "" "$GUARD_HOME/broker-svc.pid" "/dev/socket/sandbox_priv/guard.sock" 9>&- &
    BROKER_SUP_PID=$!
    wait "$GUARD_SUP_PID" "$BROKER_SUP_PID"
else
    log_sup "sandbox_broker supervision skipped (BROKER_SELINUX_OK=$BROKER_SELINUX_OK)"
    wait "$GUARD_SUP_PID"
fi
cleanup

```

`packaging/common/uninstall.sh.tmpl`:

```tmpl
#!/system/bin/sh
# Clean module uninstall hook for KernBox.

MODDIR=${0%/*}
[ "$MODDIR" = "$0" ] && MODDIR=.
GUARD_HOME=/data/adb/sandbox_guard
GUARD_BIN="$GUARD_HOME/sandbox_guard"
export PATH={{ROOT_PATH_PREFIX}}:/data/adb/ksu/bin:/data/adb/ap/bin:/data/adb/magisk/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin:$PATH

# Best-effort restore of hibernated sandbox apps and pruned bloat before stopping daemon.
if [ -x "$GUARD_BIN" ]; then
    "$GUARD_BIN" ctl start-sandbox >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    "$GUARD_BIN" ctl restore-bloat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

if [ -f "$MODDIR/service.sh" ]; then
    sh "$MODDIR/service.sh" stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

for pfile in "$GUARD_HOME/broker-svc.pid" "$GUARD_HOME/guard-svc.pid" "$GUARD_HOME/guard.pid" "$GUARD_HOME/service.pid"; do
    if [ -f "$pfile" ]; then
        read -r pid < "$pfile" 2>/dev/null || pid=""
        case "$pid" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*) ;;
            *) kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true ;;
        esac
    fi
done

# Tear down any remaining SBW_* netfilter hooks and policy routing rules.
for ipt in iptables ip6tables; do
    command -v "$ipt" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
    "$ipt" -t mangle -D OUTPUT -j SBW_TPROXY_OUT 2>/dev/null || true
    "$ipt" -t mangle -D PREROUTING -j SBW_TPROXY_PRE 2>/dev/null || true
    "$ipt" -t raw -D OUTPUT -j SBW_RAW_OUTPUT 2>/dev/null || true
    "$ipt" -t filter -D OUTPUT -j SBW_OUTPUT 2>/dev/null || true
    "$ipt" -t mangle -D POSTROUTING -j SBW_EGRESS 2>/dev/null || true
    for tbl_chain in \
        "mangle:SBW_TPROXY_OUT" \
        "mangle:SBW_TPROXY_PRE" \
        "raw:SBW_RAW_OUTPUT" \
        "filter:SBW_OUTPUT" \
        "mangle:SBW_EGRESS"; do
        tbl=${tbl_chain%%:*}
        ch=${tbl_chain#*:}
        "$ipt" -t "$tbl" -F "$ch" 2>/dev/null || true
        "$ipt" -t "$tbl" -X "$ch" 2>/dev/null || true
    done
done

for pref in 2025 2026; do
    ip rule del pref "$pref" 2>/dev/null || true
    ip -6 rule del pref "$pref" 2>/dev/null || true
done

rm -rf /dev/socket/sandbox_ctrl /dev/socket/sandbox_priv /dev/sandbox_cfg "$GUARD_HOME"

```

`packaging/pack_variant.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Packages a single KernBox (OEM, KernelTier, RootManager) root module ZIP."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import sys
import zipfile

PKG_DIR = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
COMMON_DIR = PKG_DIR / "common"
SEPOLICY_DIR = PKG_DIR / "sepolicy"

OEMS = ("hyperos", "aosp", "oplus", "oneui", "generic")
KERNELS = ("k510", "k419")
ROOTS = ("ksu", "ksu_legacy", "magisk", "apatch")

ROOT_PROFILE = {
    "ksu": {
        "sepolicy": "ksu.rule",
        "path_prefix": "/data/adb/ksu/bin",
        "resetprop": "/data/adb/ksu/bin/resetprop",
        "busybox": "/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox /data/adb/magisk/busybox /data/adb/ap/bin/busybox",
    },
    "ksu_legacy": {
        "sepolicy": "ksu_legacy.rule",
        "path_prefix": "/data/adb/ksu/bin",
        "resetprop": "/data/adb/ksu/bin/resetprop",
        "busybox": "/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox /data/adb/magisk/busybox /data/adb/ap/bin/busybox",
    },
    "magisk": {
        "sepolicy": "magisk.rule",
        "path_prefix": "/data/adb/magisk",
        "resetprop": "/data/adb/magisk/resetprop /sbin/resetprop /debug_ramdisk/resetprop",
        "busybox": "/data/adb/magisk/busybox /data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox /data/adb/ap/bin/busybox",
    },
    "apatch": {
        "sepolicy": "apatch.rule",
        "path_prefix": "/data/adb/ap/bin",
        "resetprop": "/data/adb/ap/bin/resetprop /data/adb/ksu/bin/resetprop",
        "busybox": "/data/adb/ap/bin/busybox /data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox /data/adb/magisk/busybox",
    },
}

FIXED_DATE = (2026, 11, 25, 0, 0, 0)


def version_to_code(ver: str) -> str:
    """Convert semver 'major.minor.patch' to a monotonic integer code (e.g. 1.2.0 -> '10200')."""
    parts = [int(p) for p in ver.strip().lstrip("vV").split(".") if p.isdigit()]
    if len(parts) >= 3:
        return str(parts[0] * 10000 + parts[1] * 100 + parts[2])
    if len(parts) == 2:
        return str(parts[0] * 10000 + parts[1] * 100)
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return str(parts[0] * 10000)
    return "10000"


def render_template(raw_text: str, mapping: dict) -> bytes:
    rendered = raw_text
    for key, val in mapping.items():
        rendered = rendered.replace("{{" + key + "}}", val)
    if "{{" in rendered or "}}" in rendered:
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpanded template placeholder in rendered output")
    out = rendered.replace("\r\n", "\n").encode("utf-8")
    if b"\r" in out:
        raise AssertionError("CR byte present after LF normalization")
    return out


def make_zipinfo(arcname: str, mode: int) -> zipfile.ZipInfo:
    zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(filename=arcname, date_time=FIXED_DATE)
    zi.create_system = 3  # Unix
    zi.external_attr = ((0o100000 | mode) & 0xFFFF) << 16
    zi.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
    return zi


def pack_variant(
    oem: str,
    kernel: str,
    root: str,
    version: str,
    guard_bin: pathlib.Path,
    broker_bin: pathlib.Path,
    zygisk_so: pathlib.Path,
    out_zip: pathlib.Path,
    quiet: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    for p in (guard_bin, broker_bin, zygisk_so):
        if not p.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing binary artifact: {p}")

    rp = ROOT_PROFILE[root]
    mapping = {
        "OEM": oem,
        "KERNEL": kernel,
        "ROOT": root,
        "VERSION": version,
        "VERSION_CODE": version_to_code(version),
        "ROOT_PATH_PREFIX": rp["path_prefix"],
        "RESETPROP_CANDIDATES": rp["resetprop"],
        "BUSYBOX_CANDIDATES": rp["busybox"],
    }

    variant_meta = json.dumps(
        {
            "version": version,
            "oem": oem,
            "kernel": kernel,
            "root": root,
            "arch": "arm64-v8a",
            "transport": "tproxy",
            "artifact": out_zip.name,
        },
        indent=2,
        sort_keys=True,
    ) + "\n"

    text_entries = [
        ("module.prop", render_template((COMMON_DIR / "module.prop.tmpl").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), mapping), 0o644),
        ("customize.sh", render_template((COMMON_DIR / "customize.sh.tmpl").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), mapping), 0o755),
        ("post-fs-data.sh", render_template((COMMON_DIR / "post-fs-data.sh.tmpl").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), mapping), 0o755),
        ("service.sh", render_template((COMMON_DIR / "service.sh.tmpl").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), mapping), 0o755),
        ("action.sh", render_template((COMMON_DIR / "action.sh.tmpl").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), mapping), 0o755),
        ("uninstall.sh", render_template((COMMON_DIR / "uninstall.sh.tmpl").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), mapping), 0o755),
        ("sepolicy.rule", (SEPOLICY_DIR / rp["sepolicy"]).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"), 0o644),
        ("defaults/stealth.json", (COMMON_DIR / "defaults" / "stealth.json").read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"), 0o600),
        ("defaults/perf.json", (COMMON_DIR / "defaults" / "perf.json").read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"), 0o600),
        ("variant.json", variant_meta.encode("utf-8"), 0o644),
    ]

    bin_entries = [
        ("bin/sandbox_guard", guard_bin, 0o755),
        ("bin/sandbox_broker", broker_bin, 0o755),
        ("zygisk/arm64-v8a.so", zygisk_so, 0o644),
    ]

    out_zip.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(out_zip, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as zf:
        for arcname, data, mode in text_entries:
            if b"\r" in data:
                raise AssertionError(f"CR byte found in {arcname}")
            zf.writestr(make_zipinfo(arcname, mode), data)
        for arcname, src, mode in bin_entries:
            zf.writestr(make_zipinfo(arcname, mode), src.read_bytes())

    with zipfile.ZipFile(out_zip, "r") as zf:
        bad = zf.testzip()
        if bad is not None:
            raise AssertionError(f"Corrupted ZIP entry {bad} in {out_zip}")
        for arcname, _, _ in text_entries:
            if b"\r" in zf.read(arcname):
                raise AssertionError(f"CR byte in zip entry {arcname}")

    zip_bytes = out_zip.read_bytes()
    sha256 = hashlib.sha256(zip_bytes).hexdigest().lower()
    if not quiet:
        print(f"PACKAGED {out_zip.name} size={len(zip_bytes)} sha256={sha256}")
    return {
        "artifact": out_zip.name,
        "oem": oem,
        "kernel": kernel,
        "root": root,
        "version": version,
        "size": len(zip_bytes),
        "sha256": sha256,
    }


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Package a single KernBox root module ZIP")
    p.add_argument("--oem", required=True, choices=OEMS)
    p.add_argument("--kernel", required=True, choices=KERNELS)
    p.add_argument("--root", required=True, choices=ROOTS)
    p.add_argument("--version", default="1.2.0")
    p.add_argument("--guard-bin", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    p.add_argument("--broker-bin", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    p.add_argument("--zygisk-so", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    p.add_argument("--out", type=pathlib.Path)
    p.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)

    out_zip = args.out or pathlib.Path(f"KernBox-{args.oem}-{args.kernel}-{args.root}-arm64.zip")
    pack_variant(
        oem=args.oem,
        kernel=args.kernel,
        root=args.root,
        version=args.version,
        guard_bin=args.guard_bin,
        broker_bin=args.broker_bin,
        zygisk_so=args.zygisk_so,
        out_zip=out_zip,
        quiet=args.quiet,
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

```rule
type sandbox_ctrl_sock_dir file_type

typeattribute sandbox_cfg_dir mlstrustedobject

typeattribute sandbox_cfg_file mlstrustedobject

typeattribute sandbox_broker_exec exec_type

allow magisk sandbox_broker process transition
allow su sandbox_broker_exec file { read getattr map execute open }
allow su sandbox_broker process transition
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker_exec file { read getattr map execute open entrypoint }

type_transition su sandbox_broker_exec process sandbox_broker
allow sandbox_broker magisk fd use
allow sandbox_broker su fd use
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker fd use
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker fifo_file { read write getattr ioctl }
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker dir { search getattr read open }
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker file { read write open getattr }
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker lnk_file { read getattr }
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker process { fork sigchld getattr getsched setsched signal sigkill }
allow sandbox_broker sandbox_broker unix_stream_socket { create bind listen accept connect read write getattr setattr getopt setopt shutdown }
```

`stealth/build.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Builds OEM-specialized Zygisk stealth libraries (DEX -> header -> arm64 .so) + ELF hygiene check."""

import argparse
import os
import pathlib
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OEMS = ("hyperos", "aosp", "oplus", "oneui", "generic")
IS_WIN = os.name == "nt"


def exe_name(base: str, win_ext: str = ".exe") -> str:
    return f"{base}{win_ext}" if IS_WIN else base


def resolve_toolchain(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
    jdk_home_str = args.jdk or os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME") or ""
    if not jdk_home_str:
        javac_on_path = shutil.which("javac")
        if javac_on_path:
            jdk_home_str = str(pathlib.Path(javac_on_path).resolve().parent.parent)
    if not jdk_home_str:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing JDK: pass --jdk or set JAVA_HOME")
    jdk_home = pathlib.Path(jdk_home_str)
    jdk_bin = jdk_home / "bin"
    javac = jdk_bin / exe_name("javac")
    if not javac.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"javac not found at {javac}")

    sdk_str = args.sdk or os.environ.get("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT") or os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME") or ""
    if not sdk_str:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing Android SDK: pass --sdk or set ANDROID_SDK_ROOT / ANDROID_HOME")
    sdk = pathlib.Path(sdk_str)
    android_jar = sdk / "platforms" / "android-35" / "android.jar"
    if not android_jar.is_file():
        platforms = sorted((sdk / "platforms").glob("android-*/android.jar"), reverse=True)
        if not platforms:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No android.jar found under {sdk / 'platforms'}")
        android_jar = platforms[0]

    d8_name = "d8.bat" if IS_WIN else "d8"
    d8 = sdk / "build-tools" / "35.0.0" / d8_name
    if not d8.is_file():
        d8_hits = sorted((sdk / "build-tools").glob(f"*/{d8_name}"), reverse=True)
        if not d8_hits:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No {d8_name} found under {sdk / 'build-tools'}")
        d8 = d8_hits[0]
    d8_jar = d8.parent / "lib" / "d8.jar"
    java = jdk_bin / exe_name("java")

    ndk_str = (
        args.ndk
        or os.environ.get("ANDROID_NDK_HOME")
        or os.environ.get("ANDROID_NDK_ROOT")
        or os.environ.get("ANDROID_NDK")
        or ""
    )
    if not ndk_str and (sdk / "ndk").is_dir():
        ndk_dirs = sorted((sdk / "ndk").iterdir(), reverse=True)
        if ndk_dirs:
            ndk_str = str(ndk_dirs[0])
    if not ndk_str:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing Android NDK: pass --ndk or set ANDROID_NDK_HOME / ANDROID_NDK_ROOT")
    ndk = pathlib.Path(ndk_str)

    prebuilt_candidates = sorted((ndk / "toolchains" / "llvm" / "prebuilt").glob("*/bin"))
    if not prebuilt_candidates:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"LLVM toolchain bin dir not found under {ndk}")
    ndk_bin = prebuilt_candidates[0]
    min_sdk = int(getattr(args, "min_sdk", 31) or 31)
    clang_target = f"aarch64-linux-android{min_sdk}"
    if IS_WIN and (ndk_bin / "clang++.exe").is_file():
        clangxx = ndk_bin / "clang++.exe"
    else:
        clang_name = (
            f"{clang_target}-clang++.cmd"
            if IS_WIN
            else f"{clang_target}-clang++"
        )
        clangxx = ndk_bin / clang_name
        if not clangxx.is_file():
            clang_hits = sorted(ndk_bin.glob("aarch64-linux-android*-clang++" + (".cmd" if IS_WIN else "")), reverse=True)
            if not clang_hits:
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"aarch64 clang++ not found under {ndk_bin}")
            clangxx = clang_hits[0]

    llvm_nm = ndk_bin / exe_name("llvm-nm")
    llvm_readelf = ndk_bin / exe_name("llvm-readelf")
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["JAVA_HOME"] = str(jdk_home)
    env["PATH"] = str(jdk_bin) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")

    return {
        "java": java,
        "javac": javac,
        "android_jar": android_jar,
        "d8": d8,
        "d8_jar": d8_jar,
        "clangxx": clangxx,
        "clang_target": clang_target,
        "llvm_nm": llvm_nm,
        "llvm_readelf": llvm_readelf,
        "env": env,
    }


def run(cmd, env=None):
    str_cmd = [str(x) for x in cmd]
    print("+", " ".join(str_cmd))
    subprocess.run(str_cmd, env=env, check=True)


def build_dex(tc: dict, build_dir: pathlib.Path) -> bytes:
    classes_dir = build_dir / "classes"
    dex_dir = build_dir / "dex"
    if classes_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(classes_dir)
    if dex_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(dex_dir)
    classes_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dex_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    java_files = sorted((ROOT / "java").rglob("*.java"))
    assert java_files, f"No Java source files under {ROOT / 'java'}"

    run(
        [
            tc["javac"],
            "--release",
            "11",
            "-encoding",
            "UTF-8",
            "-Xlint:all",
            "-Werror",
            "-cp",
            tc["android_jar"],
            "-d",
            classes_dir,
            *java_files,
        ],
        env=tc["env"],
    )

    class_files = sorted(classes_dir.rglob("*.class"))
    assert class_files, "javac produced no .class files"

    if IS_WIN and tc["d8_jar"].is_file():
        d8_cmd = [str(tc["java"]), "-cp", str(tc["d8_jar"]), "com.android.tools.r8.D8"]
    elif IS_WIN and str(tc["d8"]).lower().endswith(".bat"):
        d8_cmd = ["cmd", "/c", str(tc["d8"])]
    else:
        d8_cmd = [str(tc["d8"])]
    d8_cmd.extend(["--min-api", "26", "--release", "--output", str(dex_dir), *[str(p) for p in class_files]])
    run(d8_cmd, env=tc["env"])

    dex_path = dex_dir / "classes.dex"
    assert dex_path.exists(), f"Missing {dex_path}"
    data = dex_path.read_bytes()
    assert data[:4] == b"dex\n", "Invalid DEX magic"
    print(f"Built classes.dex: {len(data)} bytes")
    return data


def write_dex_header(data: bytes, build_dir: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path:
    build_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    hdr = build_dir / "stealth_agent_dex.h"
    lines = [
        "#pragma once",
        "#include <cstddef>",
        "#include <cstdint>",
        "",
        "inline constexpr uint8_t kStealthAgentDex[] = {",
    ]
    for off in range(0, len(data), 16):
        chunk = data[off : off + 16]
        lines.append("    " + ", ".join(f"0x{b:02x}" for b in chunk) + ",")
    lines.extend([
        "};",
        "inline constexpr size_t kStealthAgentDexLen = sizeof(kStealthAgentDex);",
        "",
    ])
    hdr.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(f"Wrote {hdr} ({len(data)} bytes)")
    return hdr


def build_so(tc: dict, build_dir: pathlib.Path, oem: str, out_so: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path:
    out_so.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src_cpp = ROOT / "jni" / "stealth_module.cpp"
    macro = f"-DOEM_{oem.upper()}"

    cmd = ["cmd", "/c", str(tc["clangxx"])] if IS_WIN and str(tc["clangxx"]).lower().endswith(".cmd") else [str(tc["clangxx"])]
    if tc["clangxx"].name.lower().startswith("clang++"):
        cmd.append(f"--target={tc['clang_target']}")
    cmd.extend([
        "-std=c++17",
        "-Oz",
        "-flto",
        "-fmerge-all-constants",
        "-Wall",
        "-Wextra",
        "-Werror",
        macro,
        f"-I{build_dir}",
        f"-I{ROOT / 'jni'}",
        "-fvisibility=hidden",
        "-ffunction-sections",
        "-fdata-sections",
        "-fno-unwind-tables",
        "-fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables",
        "-static-libstdc++",
        "-fno-exceptions",
        "-fno-rtti",
        "-shared",
        str(src_cpp),
        "-o",
        str(out_so),
        "-llog",
        "-Wl,--gc-sections,-s,--icf=all,--exclude-libs,ALL,--hash-style=both,-z,max-page-size=16384",
    ])
    run(cmd, env=tc["env"])
    print(f"Built {out_so} (oem={oem}): {out_so.stat().st_size} bytes")
    return out_so


def verify_elf(tc: dict, so_path: pathlib.Path):
    nm_res = subprocess.run(
        [str(tc["llvm_nm"]), "--dynamic", "--defined-only", str(so_path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    exported = []
    for line in nm_res.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[1] in ("T", "D", "R", "W"):
            exported.append(parts[2])
    expected = {"zygisk_companion_entry", "zygisk_module_entry"}
    if set(exported) != expected:
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected exported ELF symbols: {exported} (want {sorted(expected)})")
    print(f"ELF dynamic exports verified: {sorted(exported)}")

    re_res = subprocess.run(
        [str(tc["llvm_readelf"]), "-d", str(so_path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    if "TEXTREL" in re_res.stdout:
        raise AssertionError("ELF contains forbidden TEXTREL")
    needed = re.findall(r"Shared library:\s*\[([^\]]+)\]", re_res.stdout)
    allowed_needed = {"liblog.so", "libm.so", "libdl.so", "libc.so"}
    disallowed = [lib for lib in needed if lib not in allowed_needed]
    if disallowed:
        raise AssertionError(f"ELF contains non-system DT_NEEDED entries: {disallowed} (all={needed})")
    print(f"ELF dynamic section verified: zero TEXTREL, DT_NEEDED={needed}")


def parse_args(argv=None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build OEM-specialized Zygisk stealth module library")
    p.add_argument("--oem", choices=OEMS, default="generic", help="OEM property specialization profile")
    p.add_argument("--min-sdk", type=int, default=31, help="NDK target API level for ARM64 clang++ (default: 31 / Android 12+)")
    p.add_argument("--out", help="Output path for compiled arm64-v8a .so")
    p.add_argument("--build-dir", help="Intermediate build directory (defaults to stealth/build)")
    p.add_argument("--skip-dex-if-exists", action="store_true", help="Reuse existing stealth_agent_dex.h in build-dir")
    p.add_argument("--jdk", help="JDK home path (overrides JAVA_HOME)")
    p.add_argument("--sdk", help="Android SDK path (overrides ANDROID_SDK_ROOT / ANDROID_HOME)")
    p.add_argument("--ndk", help="Android NDK path (overrides ANDROID_NDK_HOME / ANDROID_NDK_ROOT)")
    return p.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    tc = resolve_toolchain(args)
    build_dir = pathlib.Path(args.build_dir) if args.build_dir else (ROOT / "build")
    hdr = build_dir / "stealth_agent_dex.h"
    if not (args.skip_dex_if_exists and hdr.is_file()):
        dex = build_dex(tc, build_dir)
        write_dex_header(dex, build_dir)
    out_so = pathlib.Path(args.out) if args.out else (build_dir / f"zygisk-{args.oem}-arm64-v8a.so")
    so_path = build_so(tc, build_dir, args.oem, out_so)
    verify_elf(tc, so_path)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
