    public static StealthConfig fromJson(String json) {
        if (json == null || json.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new StealthConfig(
                    false, 10, -1, null, "UTC", "en-US",
                    "", "", "", "", "", "",
                    true, "block", true, false);
        }
        Map<String, String> kv = parseFlatJson(json);
        if (kv.isEmpty()) {
            return new StealthConfig(
                    false, 10, -1, null, "UTC", "en-US",
                    "", "", "", "", "", "",
                    true, "block", true, false);
        }
        boolean enabled = parseBool(kv.get("enabled"), false);
        int userId = parseInt(kv.get("sandbox_user_id"), 10);
        int exemptUid = parseInt(kv.get("exempt_work_uid"), -1);
        int[] exemptUids = parseIntArray(kv.get("exempt_uids"));
        String tz = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("timezone"), "UTC");
        String loc = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("locale"), "en-US");
        String simOp = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("sim_operator"), "");
        String simAlpha = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("sim_operator_name"), "");
        String simIso = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("sim_country_iso"), "");
        String netOp = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("network_operator"), simOp);
        String netAlpha = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("network_operator_name"), simAlpha);
        String netIso = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("network_country_iso"), simIso);
        boolean hideManaged = parseBool(kv.get("hide_managed_profile"), true);
        String locMode = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("spoof_location_mode"), "block");
        boolean blockWifi = parseBool(kv.get("block_wifi_scan"), true);
        boolean carrier = parseBool(kv.get("spoof_carrier"), false);
        boolean sanitizeNet = parseBool(kv.get("sanitize_network"), true);
        boolean spoofBt = parseBool(kv.get("spoof_bluetooth"), true);
        boolean spoofRegion = parseBool(kv.get("spoof_device_region"), false);
        String linkIpv4 = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("sandbox_link_ipv4"), "10.172.10.2");
        String devName = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("device_name"), "Android");
        String primaryRegion = kv.get("device_region");
        String legacyRegion = kv.get("miui_region");
        String region = (primaryRegion != null && !primaryRegion.isEmpty())
                ? primaryRegion
                : nonEmptyOrDefault(legacyRegion, "");
        String hwc = nonEmptyOrDefault(kv.get("boot_hwc"), "");

        return new StealthConfig(
                enabled, userId, exemptUid, exemptUids, tz, loc,
                simOp, simAlpha, simIso, netOp, netAlpha, netIso,
                hideManaged, locMode, blockWifi, carrier,
                sanitizeNet, spoofBt, spoofRegion, linkIpv4, devName, region, hwc);
    }

    /**
     * Only intercept non-exempt ordinary app UIDs inside the designated sandbox profile.
     * User 0 (< 100000), clone user 999, system UIDs (< 10000 appId),
     * and exempt controller/provisioning UIDs pass straight through unmodified.
     */
    public boolean shouldIntercept(int callingUid) {
        if (!enabled || sandboxUserId <= 0 || sandboxUserId == 999) {
            return false;
        }
        if (callingUid < USER_UID_STRIDE) {
            return false;
        }
        if ((callingUid / USER_UID_STRIDE) != sandboxUserId) {
            return false;
        }
        int appId = callingUid % USER_UID_STRIDE;
        if (appId < FIRST_APP_ID || appId >= USER_UID_STRIDE) {
            return false;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < exemptUids.length; i++) {
            if (callingUid == exemptUids[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static String nonEmptyOrDefault(String v, String def) {
        return (v == null || v.isEmpty()) ? def : v;
    }

    private static boolean parseBool(String v, boolean def) {
        if (v == null) return def;
        if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(v)) return true;
        if ("false".equalsIgnoreCase(v)) return false;
        return def;
    }

    private static int parseInt(String v, int def) {
        if (v == null) return def;
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(v.trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            return def;
        }
    }

    private static int[] parseIntArray(String raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        List<Integer> vals = new ArrayList<>();
        int n = raw.length();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            char c = raw.charAt(i);
            if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '-') {
                int start = i++;
                while (i < n && raw.charAt(i) >= '0' && raw.charAt(i) <= '9') {
                    i++;
                }
                try {
                    vals.add(Integer.parseInt(raw.substring(start, i)));
                } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                }
            } else {
                i++;
            }
        }
        if (vals.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        int[] out = new int[vals.size()];
        for (int k = 0; k < vals.size(); k++) {
            out[k] = vals.get(k);
        }
        return out;
    }

    static Map<String, String> parseFlatJson(String json) {
        Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
        if (json == null) {
            return map;
        }
        int n = json.length();
        int i = skipWs(json, 0);
        if (i >= n || json.charAt(i) != '{') {
            return map;
        }
        i++;
        while (i < n) {
            i = skipWs(json, i);
            if (i < n && json.charAt(i) == ',') {
                i = skipWs(json, i + 1);
            }
            if (i >= n || json.charAt(i) == '}') {
                break;
            }
            if (json.charAt(i) != '"') {
                break;
            }
            StringBuilder key = new StringBuilder();
            i = readJsonString(json, i + 1, key);
            if (i < 0) {
                break;
            }
            i = skipWs(json, i);
            if (i >= n || json.charAt(i) != ':') {
                break;
            }
            i = skipWs(json, i + 1);
            if (i >= n) {
                break;
            }
            char c = json.charAt(i);
            if (c == '"') {
                StringBuilder val = new StringBuilder();
                i = readJsonString(json, i + 1, val);
                if (i < 0) {
                    break;
                }
                map.put(key.toString(), val.toString());
            } else if (c == '[') {
                int vStart = i;
                i = skipJsonCompound(json, i, '[', ']');
                if (i < 0) {
                    break;
                }
                map.put(key.toString(), json.substring(vStart, i));
            } else if (c == '{') {
                // Skip nested objects completely so nested fields never overwrite top-level keys.
                i = skipJsonCompound(json, i, '{', '}');
                if (i < 0) {
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                int vStart = i;
                while (i < n && json.charAt(i) != ',' && json.charAt(i) != '}' && !Character.isWhitespace(json.charAt(i))) {
                    i++;
                }
                map.put(key.toString(), json.substring(vStart, i));
            }
        }
        return map;
    }

    private static int skipWs(String s, int i) {
        int n = s.length();
        while (i < n && Character.isWhitespace(s.charAt(i))) {
            i++;
        }
        return i;
    }

    private static int skipJsonCompound(String s, int start, char openCh, char closeCh) {
        int n = s.length();
        int depth = 0;
        int i = start;
        StringBuilder discard = new StringBuilder();
        while (i < n) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '"') {
                discard.setLength(0);
                i = readJsonString(s, i + 1, discard);
                if (i < 0) {
                    return -1;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (c == openCh) {
                depth++;
            } else if (c == closeCh) {
                depth--;
                if (depth == 0) {
                    return i + 1;
                }
            }
            i++;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static int readJsonString(String s, int from, StringBuilder out) {
        int n = s.length();
        int i = from;
        while (i < n) {
            char c = s.charAt(i++);
            if (c == '"') return i;
            if (c == '\\' && i < n) {
                char esc = s.charAt(i++);
                switch (esc) {
                    case '"': out.append('"'); break;
                    case '\\': out.append('\\'); break;
                    case '/': out.append('/'); break;
                    case 'b': out.append('\b'); break;
                    case 'f': out.append('\f'); break;
                    case 'n': out.append('\n'); break;
                    case 'r': out.append('\r'); break;
                    case 't': out.append('\t'); break;
                    case 'u':
                        if (i + 4 <= n) {
                            try {
                                out.append((char) Integer.parseInt(s.substring(i, i + 4), 16));
                            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
                            i += 4;
                        }
                        break;
                    default: out.append(esc); break;
                }
            } else {
                out.append(c);
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}

`stealth/java/com/sandbox/stealth/SystemServerHook.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.stealth;

import android.os.IBinder;
import android.util.Log;

import java.lang.reflect.Field;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationHandler;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;

/**
 * Installs a dynamic Proxy around ServiceManager.sServiceManager in system_server
 * or com.android.phone so selected system services are wrapped on addService().
 * Internal system_server lookups receive the raw unwrapped delegate (preventing direct
 * ClassCastException such as RestrictionsManagerService casting to IUserManager), while
 * ActivityManagerService.addServiceToMap()/getCommonServicesLocked() and cross-process
 * clients receive the wrapped SandboxBinderWrapper.
 */
public final class SystemServerHook {
    private static final String TAG = "SandboxStealthHook";
    private static volatile boolean installed = false;

    private static final Set<String> SYSTEM_SERVER_SERVICES = Collections.unmodifiableSet(
            new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
                    "user", "device_policy", "crossprofileapps",
                    "location", "wifi", "connectivity", "bluetooth_manager")));

    private static final Set<String> PHONE_SERVICES = Collections.unmodifiableSet(
            new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("phone", "isub", "iphonesubinfo")));

    private SystemServerHook() {}

    private static void logInfo(String msg) {
        try {
            Log.i(TAG, msg);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
        }
    }

    private static void logWarn(String msg) {
        try {
            Log.w(TAG, msg);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
        }
    }

    public static Set<String> targetServicesForProcess(String targetProcess) {
        if ("system_server".equals(targetProcess)) {
            return SYSTEM_SERVER_SERVICES;
        }
        if ("com.android.phone".equals(targetProcess)) {
            return PHONE_SERVICES;
        }
        return Collections.emptySet();
    }

    public static boolean install(String configJson, String targetProcess) {
        if (installed) {
            return true;
        }
        try {
            StealthConfig cfg = StealthConfig.fromJson(configJson);
            if (!cfg.enabled) {
                logInfo("disabled in stealth config; skipping hook for " + targetProcess);
                return false;
            }
            Set<String> targets = targetServicesForProcess(targetProcess);
            if (targets.isEmpty()) {
                return false;
            }

            Class<?> smClass = Class.forName("android.os.ServiceManager");
            Method getIsm = smClass.getDeclaredMethod("getIServiceManager");
            getIsm.setAccessible(true);
            Object realSm = getIsm.invoke(null);
            if (realSm == null) {
                logWarn("real IServiceManager is null");
                return false;
            }

            Field sSmField = smClass.getDeclaredField("sServiceManager");
            sSmField.setAccessible(true);

            Class<?> ismClass = Class.forName("android.os.IServiceManager");
            Object proxy = createProxy(realSm, ismClass, targets, cfg);
            sSmField.set(null, proxy);
            installed = true;
            logInfo("installed IServiceManager hook for " + targetProcess + " targets=" + targets);
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            logWarn("install failed for " + targetProcess + ": " + t);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Hook factory interface so host JVM tests can swap in a pure-Java wrapper without Binder stubs. */
    public interface BinderWrapperFactory {
        boolean isWrappable(Object candidate);
        boolean isAlreadyWrapped(Object candidate);
        Object wrap(Object delegate, String serviceName, StealthConfig config);
    }

    private static final BinderWrapperFactory BINDER_FACTORY = new BinderWrapperFactory() {
        @Override
        public boolean isWrappable(Object candidate) {
            return candidate instanceof IBinder;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isAlreadyWrapped(Object candidate) {
            return candidate instanceof SandboxBinderWrapper;
        }

        @Override
        public Object wrap(Object delegate, String serviceName, StealthConfig config) {
            return new SandboxBinderWrapper((IBinder) delegate, serviceName, config);
        }
    };

    static boolean isAppBindCaller(StackTraceElement[] frames) {
        if (frames == null) {
            return false;
        }
        int limit = Math.min(frames.length, 24);
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            StackTraceElement f = frames[i];
            if (f != null && "com.android.server.am.ActivityManagerService".equals(f.getClassName())) {
                String m = f.getMethodName();
                if ("addServiceToMap".equals(m) || "getCommonServicesLocked".equals(m)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Visible to host JVM unit tests to verify addService wrapping & caller-aware getService routing. */
    public static Object createProxy(
            final Object realSm,
            Class<?> ismInterface,
            final Set<String> targetServices,
            final StealthConfig config) {
        return createProxy(realSm, ismInterface, targetServices, config, BINDER_FACTORY);
    }

    public static Object createProxy(
            final Object realSm,
            Class<?> ismInterface,
            final Set<String> targetServices,
            final StealthConfig config,
            final BinderWrapperFactory factory) {
        return createProxy(realSm, ismInterface, targetServices, config, factory,
                () -> isAppBindCaller(Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace()));
    }

    public static Object createProxy(
            final Object realSm,
            Class<?> ismInterface,
            final Set<String> targetServices,
            final StealthConfig config,
            final BinderWrapperFactory factory,
            final BooleanSupplier exportWrappedPredicate) {
        final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Object> rawServices = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        InvocationHandler handler = new InvocationHandler() {
            @Override
            public Object invoke(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) throws Throwable {
                String name = method.getName();
                if ("addService".equals(name) && args != null && args.length >= 2 && args[0] instanceof String) {
                    String svcName = (String) args[0];
                    Object svcBinder = args[1];
                    if (factory.isWrappable(svcBinder) && targetServices.contains(svcName) && !factory.isAlreadyWrapped(svcBinder)) {
                        rawServices.put(svcName, svcBinder);
                        args[1] = factory.wrap(svcBinder, svcName, config);
                        logInfo("wrapped service " + svcName);
                    }
                } else if (("getService".equals(name) || "checkService".equals(name) || "waitForService".equals(name))
                        && args != null && args.length >= 1 && args[0] instanceof String) {
                    String svcName = (String) args[0];
                    Object raw = rawServices.get(svcName);
                    if (raw != null) {
                        if (exportWrappedPredicate != null && exportWrappedPredicate.getAsBoolean()) {
                            logInfo("exporting wrapped service " + svcName + " to AMS commonServices");
                        } else {
                            return raw;
                        }
                    }
                } else if (("getService2".equals(name) || "checkService2".equals(name))
                        && args != null && args.length >= 1 && args[0] instanceof String) {
                    String svcName = (String) args[0];
                    Object raw = rawServices.get(svcName);
                    if (raw != null) {
                        Object res;
                        try {
                            res = method.invoke(realSm, args);
                        } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
                            throw e.getTargetException() != null ? e.getTargetException() : e;
                        }
                        if (exportWrappedPredicate != null && exportWrappedPredicate.getAsBoolean()) {
                            logInfo("exporting wrapped service2 " + svcName + " to AMS commonServices");
                            return res;
                        }
                        if (res != null) {
                            replaceServiceWithMetadataBinder(res, raw);
                        }
                        return res;
                    }
                }
                try {
                    return method.invoke(realSm, args);
                } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
                    throw e.getTargetException() != null ? e.getTargetException() : e;
                }
            }
        };
        return Proxy.newProxyInstance(ismInterface.getClassLoader(), new Class<?>[]{ismInterface}, handler);
    }

    /**
     * Android 15/16 ServiceManager.rawGetService() queries IServiceManager.getService2()/checkService2(),
     * returning a ServiceWithMetadata/Service carrier whose binder field must be unwrapped for internal callers.
     */
    private static void replaceServiceWithMetadataBinder(Object holder, Object rawBinder) {
        if (holder == null || rawBinder == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            Field svcField = findField(holder.getClass(), "service");
            if (svcField == null) {
                svcField = findField(holder.getClass(), "binder");
            }
            if (svcField == null) {
                return;
            }
            svcField.setAccessible(true);
            Object current = svcField.get(holder);
            if (svcField.getType().isInstance(rawBinder)) {
                svcField.set(holder, rawBinder);
                return;
            }
            if (current != null && current != holder) {
                Field nested = findField(current.getClass(), "binder");
                if (nested == null) {
                    nested = findField(current.getClass(), "service");
                }
                if (nested != null && nested.getType().isInstance(rawBinder)) {
                    nested.setAccessible(true);
                    nested.set(current, rawBinder);
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
        }
    }

    private static Field findField(Class<?> cls, String name) {
        for (Class<?> c = cls; c != null && c != Object.class; c = c.getSuperclass()) {
            try {
                return c.getDeclaredField(name);
            } catch (NoSuchFieldException ignored) {
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

```

`stealth/jni/stealth_logic.hpp`:

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

inline constexpr int kFirstIsolatedId = 90000;

inline constexpr size_t kBakedPropCount = 17;

inline constexpr size_t kBakedPropCount = 17;

#elif defined(OEM_AOSP)

inline constexpr size_t kBakedPropCount = 13;

inline constexpr size_t kBakedPropCount = 13;

namespace detail {

inline void skipJsonWs(const std::string& json, size_t& p) {
    while (p < json.size() && (json[p] == ' ' || json[p] == '\t' || json[p] == '\r' || json[p] == '\n')) {
        p++;
    }
}

inline bool readJsonStringToken(const std::string& json, size_t& p, std::string* out_val) {
    if (p >= json.size() || json[p] != '"') {
        return false;
    }
    if (out_val) {
        out_val->clear();
    }
    p++;
    while (p < json.size()) {
        char c = json[p++];
        if (c == '"') {
            return true;
        }
        if (c == '\\') {
            if (p >= json.size()) {
                return false;
            }
            char e = json[p++];
            if (out_val) {
                switch (e) {
                    case '"': out_val->push_back('"'); break;
                    case '\\': out_val->push_back('\\'); break;
                    case '/': out_val->push_back('/'); break;
                    case 'b': out_val->push_back('\b'); break;
                    case 'f': out_val->push_back('\f'); break;
                    case 'n': out_val->push_back('\n'); break;
                    case 'r': out_val->push_back('\r'); break;
                    case 't': out_val->push_back('\t'); break;
                    case 'u': {
                        if (p + 4 <= json.size()) {
                            uint32_t cp = 0;
                            bool hex_ok = true;
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                                char h = json[p + k];
                                cp <<= 4;
                                if (h >= '0' && h <= '9') cp |= static_cast<uint32_t>(h - '0');
                                else if (h >= 'a' && h <= 'f') cp |= static_cast<uint32_t>(h - 'a' + 10);
                                else if (h >= 'A' && h <= 'F') cp |= static_cast<uint32_t>(h - 'A' + 10);
                                else { hex_ok = false; break; }
                            }
                            if (hex_ok) {
                                p += 4;
                                if (cp <= 0x7Fu) {
                                    out_val->push_back(static_cast<char>(cp));
                                } else if (cp <= 0x7FFu) {
                                    out_val->push_back(static_cast<char>(0xC0u | (cp >> 6)));
                                    out_val->push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu)));
                                } else {
                                    out_val->push_back(static_cast<char>(0xE0u | (cp >> 12)));
                                    out_val->push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3Fu)));
                                    out_val->push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu)));
                                }
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        out_val->push_back('u');
                        break;
                    }
                    default: out_val->push_back(e); break;
                }
            }
        } else if (out_val) {
            out_val->push_back(c);
        }
    }
    return false;
}

inline bool readJsonCompoundToken(
    const std::string& json,
    size_t& p,
    char open_ch,
    char close_ch,
    std::string* out_raw) {
    if (p >= json.size() || json[p] != open_ch) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t start = p;
    int depth = 0;
    while (p < json.size()) {
        char c = json[p];
        if (c == '"') {
            if (!readJsonStringToken(json, p, nullptr)) {
                return false;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (c == open_ch) {
            depth++;
        } else if (c == close_ch) {
            depth--;
            if (depth == 0) {
                p++;
                if (out_raw) {
                    out_raw->assign(json.data() + start, p - start);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
        p++;
    }
    return false;
}

inline bool skipJsonValueToken(const std::string& json, size_t& p) {
    skipJsonWs(json, p);
    if (p >= json.size()) {
        return false;
    }
    char c = json[p];
    if (c == '"') {
        return readJsonStringToken(json, p, nullptr);
    }
    if (c == '[') {
        return readJsonCompoundToken(json, p, '[', ']', nullptr);
    }
    if (c == '{') {
        return readJsonCompoundToken(json, p, '{', '}', nullptr);
    }
    size_t start = p;
    while (p < json.size() && json[p] != ',' && json[p] != '}' && json[p] != ']' &&
           json[p] != ' ' && json[p] != '\t' && json[p] != '\r' && json[p] != '\n') {
        p++;
    }
    return p > start;
}

inline bool parseFlatJsonValue(const std::string& json, const char* key, std::string& out_val, bool& is_string) {
    out_val.clear();
    is_string = false;
    if (!key || key[0] == '\0') {
        return false;
    }
    size_t p = 0;
    skipJsonWs(json, p);
    if (p >= json.size() || json[p] != '{') {
        return false;
    }
    p++;
    std::string cur_key;
    std::string tmp_val;
    bool found = false;
    while (p < json.size()) {
        skipJsonWs(json, p);
        if (p < json.size() && json[p] == ',') {
            p++;
            skipJsonWs(json, p);
        }
        if (p >= json.size()) {
            return found;
        }
        if (json[p] == '}') {
            return found;
        }
        if (!readJsonStringToken(json, p, &cur_key)) {
            return found;
        }
        skipJsonWs(json, p);
        if (p >= json.size() || json[p] != ':') {
            return found;
        }
        p++;
        skipJsonWs(json, p);
        if (p >= json.size()) {
            return found;
        }
        const bool match = (cur_key == key);
        char c = json[p];
        if (!match) {
            if (!skipJsonValueToken(json, p)) {
                return found;
            }
            continue;
        }
        tmp_val.clear();
        bool tmp_is_string = false;
        bool val_ok = false;
        if (c == '"') {
            tmp_is_string = true;
            val_ok = readJsonStringToken(json, p, &tmp_val);
        } else if (c == '[') {
            val_ok = readJsonCompoundToken(json, p, '[', ']', &tmp_val);
        } else if (c == '{') {
            val_ok = readJsonCompoundToken(json, p, '{', '}', &tmp_val);
        } else {
            size_t start = p;
            while (p < json.size() && json[p] != ',' && json[p] != '}' &&
                   json[p] != ' ' && json[p] != '\t' && json[p] != '\r' && json[p] != '\n') {
                p++;
            }
            tmp_val.assign(json.data() + start, p - start);
            val_ok = !tmp_val.empty();
        }
        if (!val_ok) {
            return found;
        }
        out_val = tmp_val;
        is_string = tmp_is_string;
        found = true;
    }
    return found;
}

inline bool readBoolField(const std::string& json, const char* key, bool def) {
    std::string v;
    bool is_str = false;
    if (!parseFlatJsonValue(json, key, v, is_str)) return def;
    if (v == "true") return true;
    if (v == "false") return false;
    return def;
}

inline int readIntField(const std::string& json, const char* key, int def) {
    std::string v;
    bool is_str = false;
    if (!parseFlatJsonValue(json, key, v, is_str) || v.empty()) return def;
    char* end = nullptr;
    long parsed = std::strtol(v.c_str(), &end, 10);
    if (end == v.c_str() || *end != '\0') return def;
    return static_cast<int>(parsed);
}

inline std::vector<int> readIntArrayField(const std::string& json, const char* key) {
    std::vector<int> out;
    std::string raw;
    bool is_str = false;
    if (!parseFlatJsonValue(json, key, raw, is_str) || is_str || raw.empty()) {
        return out;
    }
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < raw.size()) {
        char c = raw[i];
        if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '-') {
            char* end = nullptr;
            long val = std::strtol(raw.c_str() + i, &end, 10);
            if (end > raw.c_str() + i) {
                if (val > 0) {
                    out.push_back(static_cast<int>(val));
                }
                i = static_cast<size_t>(end - raw.c_str());
                continue;
            }
        }
        i++;
    }
    return out;
}

inline std::string readStringField(const std::string& json, const char* key, const std::string& def) {
    std::string v;
    bool is_str = false;
    if (!parseFlatJsonValue(json, key, v, is_str) || !is_str || v.empty()) return def;
    return v;
}

} // namespace detail

inline StealthConfig parseStealthConfig(const std::string& json) {
    StealthConfig cfg;
    if (json.empty()) {
        return cfg;
    }
    cfg.enabled = detail::readBoolField(json, "enabled", false);
    cfg.sandbox_user_id = detail::readIntField(json, "sandbox_user_id", 10);
    cfg.exempt_work_uid = detail::readIntField(json, "exempt_work_uid", -1);
    cfg.exempt_uids = detail::readIntArrayField(json, "exempt_uids");
    cfg.timezone = detail::readStringField(json, "timezone", cfg.timezone);
    cfg.locale = detail::readStringField(json, "locale", cfg.locale);
    cfg.sim_operator = detail::readStringField(json, "sim_operator", cfg.sim_operator);
    cfg.sim_operator_name = detail::readStringField(json, "sim_operator_name", cfg.sim_operator_name);
    cfg.sim_country_iso = detail::readStringField(json, "sim_country_iso", cfg.sim_country_iso);
    cfg.network_operator = detail::readStringField(json, "network_operator", cfg.sim_operator);
    cfg.network_operator_name = detail::readStringField(json, "network_operator_name", cfg.sim_operator_name);
    cfg.network_country_iso = detail::readStringField(json, "network_country_iso", cfg.sim_country_iso);
    cfg.prop_hook_mode = detail::readStringField(json, "prop_hook_mode", "plt");
    cfg.spoof_carrier = detail::readBoolField(json, "spoof_carrier", false);
    cfg.spoof_timezone = detail::readBoolField(json, "spoof_timezone", true);
    cfg.spoof_locale = detail::readBoolField(json, "spoof_locale", true);
    cfg.sanitize_network = detail::readBoolField(json, "sanitize_network", true);
    cfg.spoof_device_region = detail::readBoolField(json, "spoof_device_region", false);
    cfg.sandbox_link_ipv4 = detail::readStringField(json, "sandbox_link_ipv4", cfg.sandbox_link_ipv4);

    std::string legacy_region = detail::readStringField(json, "miui_region", "");
    std::string primary_region = detail::readStringField(json, "device_region", "");
    if (!primary_region.empty()) {
        cfg.device_region = primary_region;
    } else if (!legacy_region.empty()) {
        cfg.device_region = legacy_region;
    }
    cfg.boot_hwc = detail::readStringField(json, "boot_hwc", "");
    return cfg;
}

// Strict 4-octet decimal IPv4 parser (zero heap allocation).
inline bool parseIPv4Octets(const std::string& ip, uint8_t out[4]) {
    if (!out || ip.empty()) {
        return false;
    }
    int octet = 0;
    size_t idx = 0;
    const size_t n = ip.size();
    while (idx < n && (ip[idx] == ' ' || ip[idx] == '\t')) {
        idx++;
    }
    for (; octet < 4; octet++) {
        if (idx >= n || ip[idx] < '0' || ip[idx] > '9') {
            return false;
        }
        if (ip[idx] == '0' && idx + 1 < n && ip[idx + 1] >= '0' && ip[idx + 1] <= '9') {
            return false; // reject leading zeros
        }
        unsigned int val = 0;
        while (idx < n && ip[idx] >= '0' && ip[idx] <= '9') {
            val = val * 10U + static_cast<unsigned int>(ip[idx] - '0');
            if (val > 255U) {
                return false;
            }
            idx++;
        }
        out[octet] = static_cast<uint8_t>(val);
        if (octet < 3) {
            if (idx >= n || ip[idx] != '.') {
                return false;
            }
            idx++;
        }
    }
    while (idx < n && (ip[idx] == ' ' || ip[idx] == '\t')) {
        idx++;
    }
    return idx == n;
}

inline bool shouldSpoofAppUid(const StealthConfig& cfg, int uid) {
    if (!cfg.enabled || cfg.sandbox_user_id <= 0 || cfg.sandbox_user_id == kXSpaceUserId) {
        return false;
    }
    if (uid < kAndroidUserStride) {
        return false;
    }
    if ((uid / kAndroidUserStride) != cfg.sandbox_user_id) {
        return false;
    }
    int app_id = uid % kAndroidUserStride;
    if (app_id < kFirstAppId || app_id >= kAndroidUserStride) {
        return false;
    }
    if (cfg.exempt_work_uid > 0 && uid == cfg.exempt_work_uid) {
        return false;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < cfg.exempt_uids.size(); i++) {
        if (uid == cfg.exempt_uids[i]) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

/**
 * Formats dual-SIM comma-separated TelephonyProperties while preserving empty slots.
 */
inline std::string formatMultiSimValue(const std::string& orig, const std::string& spoof) {
    if (orig.empty() || orig.find(',') == std::string::npos) {
        return spoof;
    }
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(orig.size() + spoof.size() * 2);
    size_t start = 0;
    while (start <= orig.size()) {
        size_t comma = orig.find(',', start);
        size_t end = (comma == std::string::npos) ? orig.size() : comma;
        if (end > start) {
            out.append(spoof);
        }
        if (comma == std::string::npos) {
            break;
        }
        out.push_back(',');
        start = comma + 1;
    }
    return out;
}

// Allocation-free dual-SIM formatter into caller stack buffer. Returns false on overflow.
inline bool formatMultiSimIntoBuf(const char* orig, const char* spoof, char* out, size_t cap) {
    if (!out || cap == 0 || !spoof) return false;
    size_t spoof_len = std::strlen(spoof);
    if (!orig || orig[0] == '\0' || std::strchr(orig, ',') == nullptr) {
        if (spoof_len + 1 > cap) return false;
        std::memcpy(out, spoof, spoof_len + 1);
        return true;
    }
    size_t out_pos = 0;
    const char* p = orig;
    for (;;) {
        const char* comma = std::strchr(p, ',');
        size_t seg_len = comma ? static_cast<size_t>(comma - p) : std::strlen(p);
        if (seg_len > 0) {
            if (out_pos + spoof_len >= cap) return false;
            std::memcpy(out + out_pos, spoof, spoof_len);
            out_pos += spoof_len;
        }
        if (!comma) break;
        if (out_pos + 1 >= cap) return false;
        out[out_pos++] = ',';
        p = comma + 1;
    }
    out[out_pos] = '\0';
    return true;
}

// O(1) first-byte dispatch rejects non-target system property keys in 1 comparison.
// Slots 0..12 are universal across all OEMs; slots 13+ are compiled per OEM profile.
inline bool isMultiSimCarrierSlot(int idx) {
    return (idx >= 1 && idx <= 6) || idx == 11;
}

inline int spoofablePropIndex(const char* name) {
    if (!name) return -1;
    switch (name[0]) {
        case 'p':
            if (std::strcmp(name, "persist.sys.timezone") == 0) return 0;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "persist.sys.locale") == 0) return 7;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "persist.sys.country") == 0) return 9;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "persist.sys.language") == 0) return 10;
#if defined(OEM_OPLUS)
            if (std::strcmp(name, "persist.sys.oplus.region") == 0) return 13;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "persist.sys.oppo.region") == 0) return 16;
#elif defined(OEM_ONEUI)
            if (std::strcmp(name, "persist.omc.sales_code") == 0) return 17;
#endif
            return -1;
        case 'g':
            if (name[1] != 's' || name[2] != 'm' || name[3] != '.') return -1;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "gsm.sim.operator.numeric") == 0) return 1;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "gsm.sim.operator.iso-country") == 0) return 2;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "gsm.sim.operator.alpha") == 0) return 3;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "gsm.operator.numeric") == 0) return 4;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "gsm.operator.iso-country") == 0) return 5;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "gsm.operator.alpha") == 0) return 6;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "gsm.sim.state") == 0) return 11;
            return -1;
        case 'r':
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.product.locale") == 0) return 8;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.boot.hwcountry") == 0) return 12;
#if defined(OEM_HYPEROS)
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.boot.hwc") == 0) return 13;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.miui.region") == 0) return 14;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.miui.cust_variant") == 0) return 15;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.miui.build.region") == 0) return 16;
#elif defined(OEM_OPLUS)
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.oplus.region") == 0) return 14;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.vendor.oplus.regionmark") == 0) return 15;
#elif defined(OEM_ONEUI)
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.csc.country_code") == 0) return 13;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.csc.countryiso_code") == 0) return 14;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.csc.sales_code") == 0) return 15;
            if (std::strcmp(name, "ro.csc.omcnw_code") == 0) return 16;
#endif
            return -1;
        default:
            return -1;
    }
}

namespace detail {

inline std::string asciiLower(const std::string& in) {
    std::string out = in;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) {
        if (out[i] >= 'A' && out[i] <= 'Z') {
            out[i] = static_cast<char>(out[i] - 'A' + 'a');
        }
    }
    return out;
}

inline std::string asciiUpper(const std::string& in) {
    std::string out = in;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) {
        if (out[i] >= 'a' && out[i] <= 'z') {
            out[i] = static_cast<char>(out[i] - 'a' + 'A');
        }
    }
    return out;
}

inline void splitLocaleTag(const std::string& locale, const std::string& fallback_region, std::string& out_lang, std::string& out_country) {
    out_lang.clear();
    out_country.clear();
    size_t sep = locale.find_first_of("-_");
    if (sep == std::string::npos) {
        out_lang = asciiLower(locale);
        out_country = asciiUpper(fallback_region);
        return;
    }
    out_lang = asciiLower(locale.substr(0, sep));
    size_t rest = sep + 1;
    while (rest < locale.size() && (locale[rest] == '-' || locale[rest] == '_')) {
        rest++;
    }
    size_t next_sep = locale.find_first_of("-_", rest);
    std::string seg = (next_sep == std::string::npos) ? locale.substr(rest) : locale.substr(rest, next_sep - rest);
    if (seg.size() == 4) {
        // Skip BCP-47 4-letter script subtag (e.g. zh-Hans-CN -> CN)
        if (next_sep != std::string::npos) {
            size_t r2 = next_sep + 1;
            size_t s2 = locale.find_first_of("-_", r2);
            seg = (s2 == std::string::npos) ? locale.substr(r2) : locale.substr(r2, s2 - r2);
        } else {
            seg.clear();
        }
    }
    out_country = seg.empty() ? asciiUpper(fallback_region) : asciiUpper(seg);
}

} // namespace detail

inline BakedProps bakeSpoofedProps(const StealthConfig& cfg) {
    BakedProps baked;
    if (!cfg.enabled) {
        return baked;
    }
    auto setSlot = [&](size_t idx, bool cond, const std::string& val) {
        if (idx >= kBakedPropCount || !cond || val.empty() || val.size() >= kMaxBakedValueBytes) return;
        baked.active[idx] = true;
        std::memcpy(baked.values[idx], val.c_str(), val.size() + 1);
    };
    std::string lang;
    std::string country;
    detail::splitLocaleTag(cfg.locale, cfg.device_region, lang, country);
    const std::string effective_region = !cfg.device_region.empty() ? cfg.device_region : country;
    const std::string region_lower = detail::asciiLower(effective_region);
    const std::string region_upper = detail::asciiUpper(effective_region);
    const std::string effective_hwc = !cfg.boot_hwc.empty() ? cfg.boot_hwc : region_upper;

    setSlot(0, cfg.spoof_timezone, cfg.timezone);
    setSlot(1, cfg.spoof_carrier, cfg.sim_operator);
    setSlot(2, cfg.spoof_carrier, cfg.sim_country_iso);
    setSlot(3, cfg.spoof_carrier, cfg.sim_operator_name);
    setSlot(4, cfg.spoof_carrier, cfg.network_operator);
    setSlot(5, cfg.spoof_carrier, cfg.network_country_iso);
    setSlot(6, cfg.spoof_carrier, cfg.network_operator_name);
    setSlot(7, cfg.spoof_locale, cfg.locale);
    setSlot(8, cfg.spoof_locale, cfg.locale);
    setSlot(9, cfg.spoof_locale, country);
    setSlot(10, cfg.spoof_locale, lang);
    setSlot(11, cfg.spoof_carrier, std::string("READY"));

    setSlot(12, cfg.spoof_device_region, effective_hwc);
#if defined(OEM_HYPEROS)
    setSlot(13, cfg.spoof_device_region, effective_hwc);
    setSlot(14, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(15, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_lower);
    setSlot(16, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_lower);
#elif defined(OEM_OPLUS)
    setSlot(13, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(14, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(15, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(16, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
#elif defined(OEM_ONEUI)
    setSlot(13, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(14, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(15, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(16, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
    setSlot(17, cfg.spoof_device_region, region_upper);
#endif
    return baked;
}

// Zero-allocation property lookup for PLT hook hot path.
inline bool lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(
    const BakedProps& baked,
    const char* name,
    const char* orig_val,
    char* stack_buf,
    size_t stack_cap,
    const char** out_ptr) {
    if (!out_ptr) return false;
    int idx = spoofablePropIndex(name);
    if (idx < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(idx) >= kBakedPropCount || !baked.active[idx]) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!isMultiSimCarrierSlot(idx)) {
        *out_ptr = baked.values[idx];
        return true;
    }
    if (!orig_val || orig_val[0] == '\0' || std::strchr(orig_val, ',') == nullptr) {
        *out_ptr = baked.values[idx];
        return true;
    }
    if (formatMultiSimIntoBuf(orig_val, baked.values[idx], stack_buf, stack_cap)) {
        *out_ptr = stack_buf;
        return true;
    }
    // Never leak raw multi-SIM property on formatting overflow; fall back to primary spoof value.
    *out_ptr = baked.values[idx];
    return true;
}

inline bool lookupSpoofedProperty(
    const StealthConfig& cfg,
    const char* name,
    const char* orig_val,
    std::string& out) {
    BakedProps baked = bakeSpoofedProps(cfg);
    char buf[192];
    const char* res = nullptr;
    if (!lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, name, orig_val, buf, sizeof(buf), &res) || !res) {
        return false;
    }
    out.assign(res);
    return true;
}

} // namespace stealth

void populateFakeProps(const stealth::BakedProps& baked, FakePropInfo (&out)[stealth::kBakedPropCount]) {
    std::memset(out, 0, sizeof(out));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < stealth::kBakedPropCount; i++) {
        if (!baked.active[i]) continue;
        const char* pname = stealth::spoofablePropNameByIndex(static_cast<int>(i));
        if (!pname) continue;

        const size_t nlen = strnlen(pname, sizeof(out[i].name) - 1);
        out[i].serial = (static_cast<uint32_t>(vlen & 0xFFu) << 24) | 2u;
        if (vlen > 0) {

        }
        out[i].value[vlen] = '\0';
        std::memcpy(out[i].name, pname, nlen);
        out[i].name[nlen] = '\0';
    }

bool isTunnelIfaceName(const char* name) {
    if (!name) return false;
    return std::strncmp(name, "tun", 3) == 0 ||
           std::strncmp(name, "wg", 2) == 0 ||
           std::strncmp(name, "utun", 4) == 0 ||
           std::strncmp(name, "ppp", 3) == 0 ||
           std::strncmp(name, "tailscale", 9) == 0;
}

int hookGetifaddrsImpl(FnGetIfAddrs orig, struct ifaddrs** ifap) {
    if (!orig) {
        errno = ENOSYS;
        return -1;
    }
    int rc = orig(ifap);
    if (rc != 0 || !ifap || !*ifap) {
        return rc;
    }
    const uint32_t mask_nbo = htonl(0xFFFFFF00u);
    for (struct ifaddrs* cur = *ifap; cur != nullptr; cur = cur->ifa_next) {
        if (isTunnelIfaceName(cur->ifa_name)) {
            // Coalesce tunnel interfaces into "lo" with null addrs so NetworkInterface skips them while freeifaddrs() frees cleanly.
            cur->ifa_name[0] = 'l';
            cur->ifa_name[1] = 'o';
            cur->ifa_name[2] = '\0';
            cur->ifa_addr = nullptr;
            cur->ifa_netmask = nullptr;
            cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_broadaddr = nullptr;
            cur->ifa_flags = IFF_LOOPBACK | IFF_UP;
            continue;
        }
        if (!cur->ifa_addr) {
            continue;
        }
        if (cur->ifa_name && std::strcmp(cur->ifa_name, "lo") == 0) {
            continue;
        }
        const int fam = cur->ifa_addr->sa_family;
        if (fam == AF_PACKET) {
            auto* sll = reinterpret_cast<struct sockaddr_ll*>(cur->ifa_addr);
            sll->sll_halen = 0;
            std::memset(sll->sll_addr, 0, sizeof(sll->sll_addr));
        } else if (fam == AF_INET6) {
            // Preserve node pointer so freeifaddrs() releases every node without leaking memory.
            cur->ifa_addr = nullptr;
            cur->ifa_netmask = nullptr;
            cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_broadaddr = nullptr;
        } else if (fam == AF_INET && g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo != 0) {
            struct sockaddr_in sin{};
            std::memcpy(&sin, cur->ifa_addr, sizeof(sin));
            sin.sin_addr.s_addr = g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo;
            std::memcpy(cur->ifa_addr, &sin, sizeof(sin));
            if (cur->ifa_netmask != nullptr &&
                (cur->ifa_netmask->sa_family == AF_INET || cur->ifa_netmask->sa_family == AF_UNSPEC)) {
                struct sockaddr_in netmask_sin{};
                std::memcpy(&netmask_sin, cur->ifa_netmask, sizeof(netmask_sin));
                netmask_sin.sin_family = AF_INET;
                netmask_sin.sin_addr.s_addr = mask_nbo;
                std::memcpy(cur->ifa_netmask, &netmask_sin, sizeof(netmask_sin));
            }
            if ((cur->ifa_flags & IFF_BROADCAST) != 0 && cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_broadaddr != nullptr &&
                (cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_broadaddr->sa_family == AF_INET ||
                 cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_broadaddr->sa_family == AF_UNSPEC)) {
                struct sockaddr_in bcast_sin{};
                std::memcpy(&bcast_sin, cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_broadaddr, sizeof(bcast_sin));
                bcast_sin.sin_family = AF_INET;
                bcast_sin.sin_addr.s_addr = (g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo & mask_nbo) | ~mask_nbo;
                std::memcpy(cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_broadaddr, &bcast_sin, sizeof(bcast_sin));
            } else if ((cur->ifa_flags & IFF_POINTOPOINT) != 0 && cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_dstaddr != nullptr &&
                       (cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_dstaddr->sa_family == AF_INET ||
                        cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_dstaddr->sa_family == AF_UNSPEC)) {
                struct sockaddr_in dst_sin{};
                std::memcpy(&dst_sin, cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_dstaddr, sizeof(dst_sin));
                dst_sin.sin_family = AF_INET;
                const uint32_t gw_cand = (g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo & mask_nbo) | htonl(1u);
                dst_sin.sin_addr.s_addr = (g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo == gw_cand)
                    ? ((g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo & mask_nbo) | htonl(254u))
                    : gw_cand;
                std::memcpy(cur->ifa_ifu.ifu_dstaddr, &dst_sin, sizeof(dst_sin));
            }
        }
    }
    return rc;
}

struct PropCbCtx {
    void (*orig_cb)(void* cookie, const char* name, const char* value, uint32_t serial);
    void* orig_cookie;
};

void wrappedPropReadCallback(void* raw_ctx, const char* name, const char* value, uint32_t serial) {
    auto* ctx = static_cast<PropCbCtx*>(raw_ctx);
    char stack_buf[PROP_VALUE_MAX];
    const char* spoofed = nullptr;
    if (stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(g_baked_props, name, value, stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &spoofed)) {
        ctx->orig_cb(ctx->orig_cookie, name, spoofed, serial);
        return;
    }
    ctx->orig_cb(ctx->orig_cookie, name, value, serial);
}

const prop_info* hookPropFindImpl(FnPropFind orig, const char* name) {
    const int idx = stealth::spoofablePropIndex(name);
    if (idx >= 0 && g_baked_props.active[idx] && !stealth::isMultiSimCarrierSlot(idx)) {
        return reinterpret_cast<const prop_info*>(&g_fake_props[idx]);
    }
    const prop_info* pi = orig ? orig(name) : nullptr;
    if (pi != nullptr) {
        return pi;
    }
    if (idx >= 0 && g_baked_props.active[idx]) {
        return reinterpret_cast<const prop_info*>(&g_fake_props[idx]);
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void hookPropReadCbImpl(
    FnPropReadCb orig,
    const prop_info* pi,
    void (*callback)(void* cookie, const char* name, const char* value, uint32_t serial),
    void* cookie) {
    if (!callback) return;
    if (pi != nullptr) {
        const uintptr_t ptr = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(pi);
        const uintptr_t begin = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&g_fake_props[0]);
        const uintptr_t end = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&g_fake_props[stealth::kBakedPropCount]);
        if (ptr >= begin && ptr < end && ((ptr - begin) % sizeof(FakePropInfo)) == 0) {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>((ptr - begin) / sizeof(FakePropInfo));
            if (g_baked_props.active[idx] && g_fake_props[idx].name[0] != '\0') {
                callback(cookie, g_fake_props[idx].name, g_fake_props[idx].value, g_fake_props[idx].serial);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!orig) return;
    PropCbCtx ctx{callback, cookie};
    orig(pi, wrappedPropReadCallback, &ctx);
}

int hookPropReadImpl(FnPropRead orig, const prop_info* pi, char* name, char* value) {
    if (pi != nullptr) {
        const uintptr_t ptr = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(pi);
        const uintptr_t begin = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&g_fake_props[0]);
        const uintptr_t end = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&g_fake_props[stealth::kBakedPropCount]);
        if (ptr >= begin && ptr < end && ((ptr - begin) % sizeof(FakePropInfo)) == 0) {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>((ptr - begin) / sizeof(FakePropInfo));
            if (g_baked_props.active[idx] && g_fake_props[idx].name[0] != '\0') {
                if (name) {
                    const size_t nlen = std::strlen(g_fake_props[idx].name);
                    std::memcpy(name, g_fake_props[idx].name, nlen + 1);
                }
                const size_t vlen = std::strlen(g_fake_props[idx].value);
                if (value && vlen < PROP_VALUE_MAX) {
                    std::memcpy(value, g_fake_props[idx].value, vlen + 1);
                    return static_cast<int>(vlen);
                }
                if (value) value[0] = '\0';
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!orig) {
        if (name) name[0] = '\0';
        if (value) value[0] = '\0';
        return 0;
    }
    char local_name[128] = {};
    char local_val[PROP_VALUE_MAX] = {};
    int len = orig(pi, name ? name : local_name, value ? value : local_val);
    const char* resolved_name = name ? name : local_name;
    const char* resolved_val = value ? value : local_val;
    char stack_buf[PROP_VALUE_MAX];
    const char* spoofed = nullptr;
    if (stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(g_baked_props, resolved_name, resolved_val, stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &spoofed) && spoofed) {
        const size_t slen = std::strlen(spoofed);
        if (slen < PROP_VALUE_MAX) {
            if (value) {
                std::memcpy(value, spoofed, slen + 1);
            }
            return static_cast<int>(slen);
        }
    }
    return len;
}

template <size_t Slot>
int hook_prop_read_slot(const prop_info* pi, char* name, char* value) {
    return hookPropReadImpl(g_orig_prop_read[Slot], pi, name, value);
}

int hookPropGetImpl(FnPropGet orig, const char* name, char* value) {
    if (!name || !value) {
        return orig ? orig(name, value) : 0;
    }
    const int idx = stealth::spoofablePropIndex(name);
    if (idx >= 0 && g_baked_props.active[idx]) {
        if (stealth::isMultiSimCarrierSlot(idx)) {
            char orig_val[PROP_VALUE_MAX] = {};
            if (orig) {
                orig(name, orig_val);
            }
            char stack_buf[PROP_VALUE_MAX];
            const char* res = nullptr;
            if (stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(
                    g_baked_props, name, orig_val, stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && res) {
                const size_t len = std::strlen(res);
                if (len < PROP_VALUE_MAX) {
                    std::memcpy(value, res, len + 1);
                    return static_cast<int>(len);
                }
            }
        }
        const size_t fallback_len = strnlen(g_baked_props.values[idx], stealth::kMaxBakedValueBytes);
        if (fallback_len < PROP_VALUE_MAX) {
            std::memcpy(value, g_baked_props.values[idx], fallback_len + 1);
            return static_cast<int>(fallback_len);
        }
        value[0] = '\0';
        return 0;
    }
    return orig ? orig(name, value) : 0;
}
