int hook_prop_get_slot(const char* name, char* value) {
    return hookPropGetImpl(g_orig_prop_get[Slot], name, value);
}

template <size_t... Is>
void fillPropHookTables(
    FnPropFind (&find_hooks)[kMaxPropHookSlots],
    FnPropReadCb (&cb_hooks)[kMaxPropHookSlots],
    FnPropRead (&read_hooks)[kMaxPropHookSlots],
    FnPropGet (&get_hooks)[kMaxPropHookSlots],
    std::index_sequence<Is...>) {
    ((find_hooks[Is] = hook_prop_find_slot<Is>,
      cb_hooks[Is] = hook_prop_read_cb_slot<Is>,
      read_hooks[Is] = hook_prop_read_slot<Is>,
      get_hooks[Is] = hook_prop_get_slot<Is>), ...);
}

bool writeExact(int fd, const void* buf, size_t len) {
    const auto* p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(buf);
    size_t sent = 0;
    while (sent < len) {
        ssize_t w = write(fd, p + sent, len - sent);
        if (w < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            return false;
        }
        sent += static_cast<size_t>(w);
    }
    return true;
}

bool readExact(int fd, void* buf, size_t len) {
    auto* p = static_cast<uint8_t*>(buf);
    size_t got = 0;
    while (got < len) {
        ssize_t r = read(fd, p + got, len - got);
        if (r < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            return false;
        }
        if (r == 0) return false;
        got += static_cast<size_t>(r);
    }
    return true;
}

std::string readSafeRootConfig() {
    if (access(kZygiskDisabledFlag, F_OK) == 0) {
        return kDisabledJson;
    }
    int fd = open(kStealthConfigPath, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0) {
        return kDisabledJson;
    }
    struct stat st{};
    if (fstat(fd, &st) != 0 || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode) || st.st_uid != 0 ||
        st.st_size <= 0 || static_cast<size_t>(st.st_size) > kMaxConfigBytes) {
        close(fd);
        return kDisabledJson;
    }
    std::string out(static_cast<size_t>(st.st_size), '\0');
    size_t total = 0;
    while (total < out.size()) {
        ssize_t r = read(fd, &out[total], out.size() - total);
        if (r < 0) {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            close(fd);
            return kDisabledJson;
        }
        if (r == 0) break;
        total += static_cast<size_t>(r);
    }
    close(fd);
    out.resize(total);
    return out.empty() ? kDisabledJson : out;
}

void companionHandler(int client_fd) {
    std::string json = readSafeRootConfig();
    if (json.size() > kMaxConfigBytes) {
        json = kDisabledJson;
    }
    uint32_t len = static_cast<uint32_t>(json.size());
    if (writeExact(client_fd, &len, sizeof(len))) {
        (void)writeExact(client_fd, json.data(), json.size());
    }
    close(client_fd);
}

bool fetchConfigFromCompanion(zygisk::Api* api, std::string& out_json) {
    int fd = api->connectCompanion();
    if (fd < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    struct timeval tv{};
    tv.tv_sec = 2;
    tv.tv_usec = 0;
    (void)setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
    uint32_t len = 0;
    if (!readExact(fd, &len, sizeof(len)) || len == 0 || len > kMaxConfigBytes) {
        close(fd);
        return false;
    }
    out_json.resize(len);
    bool ok = readExact(fd, &out_json[0], len);
    close(fd);
    if (!ok) {
        out_json.clear();
    }
    return ok;
}

struct ResolvedTarget {
    dev_t dev;
    ino_t inode;
};

struct TargetList {
    ResolvedTarget items[kMaxPropHookSlots];
    size_t count = 0;
    size_t cap = 0;
};

bool endsWithAnySuffix(const char* path, size_t plen, const char* const* suffixes, size_t suffix_count) {
    if (!path || !suffixes) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < suffix_count; i++) {
        const char* s = suffixes[i];
        if (!s) continue;
        const size_t slen = std::strlen(s);
        if (slen > 0 && plen >= slen && std::memcmp(path + plen - slen, s, slen) == 0) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void appendUniqueTarget(TargetList& list, dev_t dev, ino_t inode) {
    if (list.count >= list.cap) return;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < list.count; i++) {
        if (list.items[i].dev == dev && list.items[i].inode == inode) {
            return;
        }
    }
    list.items[list.count++] = ResolvedTarget{dev, inode};
}

void insertPriorityTarget(TargetList& list, dev_t dev, ino_t inode) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < list.count; i++) {
        if (list.items[i].dev == dev && list.items[i].inode == inode) {
            return;
        }
    }
    if (list.cap == 0) return;
    size_t move_end = list.count < list.cap ? list.count : list.cap - 1;
    for (size_t i = move_end; i > 0; i--) {
        list.items[i] = list.items[i - 1];
    }
    list.items[0] = ResolvedTarget{dev, inode};
    if (list.count < list.cap) {
        list.count++;
    }
}

struct PhdrMultiCtx {
    TargetList* prop_list;
    bool want_props;
    bool have_android_runtime;
    TargetList* net_list;
    bool want_net;
};

int phdrMultiMatchCallback(struct dl_phdr_info* info, [[maybe_unused]] size_t size, void* raw_ctx) {
    auto* ctx = static_cast<PhdrMultiCtx*>(raw_ctx);
    if (!info || !info->dlpi_name || info->dlpi_name[0] != '/') {
        return 0;
    }
    const size_t plen = std::strlen(info->dlpi_name);
    const bool is_runtime = ctx->want_props && endsWithAnySuffix(info->dlpi_name, plen, &kPropTargetSuffixes[0], 1);
    const bool match_prop = is_runtime || (ctx->want_props && ctx->prop_list->count < ctx->prop_list->cap &&
        endsWithAnySuffix(info->dlpi_name, plen, kPropTargetSuffixes, kPropSuffixCount));
    const bool match_net = ctx->want_net && ctx->net_list->count < ctx->net_list->cap &&
        endsWithAnySuffix(info->dlpi_name, plen, kNetTargetSuffixes, kNetSuffixCount);
    if (!match_prop && !match_net) {
        return 0;
    }
    struct stat st{};
    if (stat(info->dlpi_name, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
        if (is_runtime) {
            insertPriorityTarget(*ctx->prop_list, st.st_dev, st.st_ino);
            ctx->have_android_runtime = true;
        } else if (match_prop) {
            appendUniqueTarget(*ctx->prop_list, st.st_dev, st.st_ino);
        }
        if (match_net) appendUniqueTarget(*ctx->net_list, st.st_dev, st.st_ino);
    }
    const bool props_full = !ctx->want_props || (ctx->prop_list->count >= ctx->prop_list->cap && ctx->have_android_runtime);
    const bool net_full = !ctx->want_net || ctx->net_list->count >= ctx->net_list->cap;
    return (props_full && net_full) ? 1 : 0;
}

// Single-pass /proc/self/maps resolution collects up to kMaxPropHookSlots unique (dev, ino)
// prop library mappings (always prioritizing libandroid_runtime.so ahead of APEX libbase/libcutils duplicates).
void findLibrariesFromMaps(bool want_props, TargetList& prop_list, bool want_net, TargetList& net_list) {
    prop_list.count = 0;
    prop_list.cap = kMaxPropHookSlots;
    net_list.count = 0;
    net_list.cap = kMaxNetHookSlots;
    if (!want_props && !want_net) return;
    bool have_android_runtime = false;

    FILE* fp = std::fopen("/proc/self/maps", "re");
    if (fp) {
        char line[1024];
        while (std::fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) != nullptr) {
            const size_t llen = std::strlen(line);
            if (llen == sizeof(line) - 1 && line[llen - 1] != '\n') {
                int ch;
                while ((ch = std::fgetc(fp)) != EOF && ch != '\n') {}
            }
            unsigned long long start = 0, end = 0, offset = 0, inode = 0;
            unsigned int major_id = 0, minor_id = 0;
            char perms[8] = {};
            int path_offset = 0;
            if (std::sscanf(line, "%llx-%llx %7s %llx %x:%x %llu %n",
                            &start, &end, perms, &offset, &major_id, &minor_id, &inode, &path_offset) >= 7) {
                if (inode == 0 || path_offset <= 0) continue;
                const char* path = line + path_offset;
                if (path[0] != '/') continue;
                size_t plen = std::strlen(path);
                while (plen > 0 && (path[plen - 1] == '\n' || path[plen - 1] == '\r')) plen--;
                const dev_t dev = makedev(major_id, minor_id);
                const ino_t ino = static_cast<ino_t>(inode);
                if (want_props && endsWithAnySuffix(path, plen, &kPropTargetSuffixes[0], 1)) {
                    insertPriorityTarget(prop_list, dev, ino);
                    have_android_runtime = true;
                } else if (want_props && prop_list.count < prop_list.cap &&
                           endsWithAnySuffix(path, plen, kPropTargetSuffixes, kPropSuffixCount)) {
                    appendUniqueTarget(prop_list, dev, ino);
                }
                if (want_net && net_list.count < net_list.cap &&
                    endsWithAnySuffix(path, plen, kNetTargetSuffixes, kNetSuffixCount)) {
                    appendUniqueTarget(net_list, dev, ino);
                }
                const bool props_full = !want_props || (prop_list.count >= prop_list.cap && have_android_runtime);
                const bool net_full = !want_net || net_list.count >= net_list.cap;
                if (props_full && net_full) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        std::fclose(fp);
    }

    if ((want_props && (!have_android_runtime || prop_list.count == 0)) || (want_net && net_list.count == 0)) {
        PhdrMultiCtx ctx{&prop_list, want_props, have_android_runtime, &net_list, want_net};
        dl_iterate_phdr(phdrMultiMatchCallback, &ctx);
    }
}

void clearJniException(JNIEnv* env) {
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        env->ExceptionClear();
    }
}

jstring newJniStringSafe(JNIEnv* env, const std::string& s) {
    if (!env) return nullptr;
    bool ascii_safe = true;
    for (unsigned char c : s) {
        if (c == 0 || c >= 0x80) {
            ascii_safe = false;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (ascii_safe) {
        jstring out = env->NewStringUTF(s.c_str());
        if (!out || env->ExceptionCheck()) {
            clearJniException(env);
            return nullptr;
        }
        return out;
    }
    jbyteArray arr = env->NewByteArray(static_cast<jsize>(s.size()));
    if (!arr || env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        clearJniException(env);
        return nullptr;
    }
    env->SetByteArrayRegion(arr, 0, static_cast<jsize>(s.size()),
                            reinterpret_cast<const jbyte*>(s.data()));
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        clearJniException(env);
        env->DeleteLocalRef(arr);
        return nullptr;
    }
    jclass str_cls = env->FindClass("java/lang/String");
    if (!str_cls || env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        clearJniException(env);
        env->DeleteLocalRef(arr);
        return nullptr;
    }
    jmethodID ctor = env->GetMethodID(str_cls, "<init>", "([BLjava/lang/String;)V");
    jstring utf8 = env->NewStringUTF("UTF-8");
    if (!ctor || !utf8 || env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        clearJniException(env);
        if (utf8) env->DeleteLocalRef(utf8);
        env->DeleteLocalRef(str_cls);
        env->DeleteLocalRef(arr);
        return nullptr;
    }
    auto res = static_cast<jstring>(env->NewObject(str_cls, ctor, arr, utf8));
    env->DeleteLocalRef(utf8);
    env->DeleteLocalRef(str_cls);
    env->DeleteLocalRef(arr);
    if (!res || env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        clearJniException(env);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return res;
}

void injectDexAndInstallSystemHook(JNIEnv* env, const char* process_name) {
    if (!env || g_cfg_json.empty()) return;
    if (env->PushLocalFrame(32) != 0) {
        clearJniException(env);
        return;
    }

    jclass cl_cls = env->FindClass("java/lang/ClassLoader");
    if (!cl_cls) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    jmethodID get_boot = env->GetStaticMethodID(cl_cls, "getSystemClassLoader", "()Ljava/lang/ClassLoader;");
    if (!get_boot) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    jobject parent_cl = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(cl_cls, get_boot);
    if (env->ExceptionCheck() || !parent_cl) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }

    jbyteArray dex_bytes = env->NewByteArray(static_cast<jsize>(kStealthAgentDexLen));
    if (!dex_bytes) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    env->SetByteArrayRegion(dex_bytes, 0, static_cast<jsize>(kStealthAgentDexLen),
                            reinterpret_cast<const jbyte*>(kStealthAgentDex));
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }

    jclass bb_cls = env->FindClass("java/nio/ByteBuffer");
    if (!bb_cls || env->ExceptionCheck()) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    jmethodID wrap_mid = env->GetStaticMethodID(bb_cls, "wrap", "([B)Ljava/nio/ByteBuffer;");
    if (!wrap_mid || env->ExceptionCheck()) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    jobject dex_buf = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(bb_cls, wrap_mid, dex_bytes);
    if (env->ExceptionCheck() || !dex_buf) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }

    jclass loader_cls = env->FindClass("dalvik/system/InMemoryDexClassLoader");
    if (!loader_cls || env->ExceptionCheck()) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    jmethodID ctor_mid = env->GetMethodID(loader_cls, "<init>", "(Ljava/nio/ByteBuffer;Ljava/lang/ClassLoader;)V");
    if (!ctor_mid || env->ExceptionCheck()) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    jobject mem_cl = env->NewObject(loader_cls, ctor_mid, dex_buf, parent_cl);
    if (env->ExceptionCheck() || !mem_cl) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }

    jmethodID load_mid = env->GetMethodID(cl_cls, "loadClass", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Class;");
    if (!load_mid || env->ExceptionCheck()) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    jstring hook_name = newJniStringSafe(env, "com.sandbox.stealth.SystemServerHook");
    if (!hook_name) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }
    auto hook_cls = static_cast<jclass>(env->CallObjectMethod(mem_cl, load_mid, hook_name));
    if (env->ExceptionCheck() || !hook_cls) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }

    jmethodID install_mid = env->GetStaticMethodID(
        hook_cls, "install", "(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)Z");
    if (!install_mid || env->ExceptionCheck()) { clearJniException(env); env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr); return; }

    jstring json_str = newJniStringSafe(env, g_cfg_json);
    jstring proc_str = newJniStringSafe(env, process_name ? process_name : "");
    if (!json_str || !proc_str || env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        clearJniException(env);
        env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr);
        return;
    }
    jboolean ok = env->CallStaticBooleanMethod(hook_cls, install_mid, json_str, proc_str);
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        clearJniException(env);
        env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr);
        LOGW("SystemServerHook.install threw exception in %s", process_name);
        return;
    }
    env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr);
    LOGI("SystemServerHook.install(%s, oem=%s) => %s", process_name, stealth::kOemProfileName, ok ? "true" : "false");
}

void applyJavaTimezoneAndLocale(JNIEnv* env, const stealth::StealthConfig& cfg) {
    if (!env) return;
    if (env->PushLocalFrame(16) != 0) {
        clearJniException(env);
        return;
    }

    if (cfg.spoof_timezone && !cfg.timezone.empty()) {
        jclass tz_cls = env->FindClass("java/util/TimeZone");
        if (tz_cls && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
            jmethodID get_tz = env->GetStaticMethodID(tz_cls, "getTimeZone", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/util/TimeZone;");
            if (get_tz && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                jmethodID set_tz = env->GetStaticMethodID(tz_cls, "setDefault", "(Ljava/util/TimeZone;)V");
                if (set_tz && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                    jstring tz_id = newJniStringSafe(env, cfg.timezone);
                    if (tz_id) {
                        jobject tz_obj = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(tz_cls, get_tz, tz_id);
                        if (!env->ExceptionCheck() && tz_obj) {
                            env->CallStaticVoidMethod(tz_cls, set_tz, tz_obj);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clearJniException(env);

        jclass icu_tz_cls = env->FindClass("android/icu/util/TimeZone");
        if (icu_tz_cls && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
            jmethodID get_icu_tz = env->GetStaticMethodID(icu_tz_cls, "getTimeZone", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Landroid/icu/util/TimeZone;");
            if (get_icu_tz && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                jmethodID set_icu_tz = env->GetStaticMethodID(icu_tz_cls, "setDefault", "(Landroid/icu/util/TimeZone;)V");
                if (set_icu_tz && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                    jstring tz_id = newJniStringSafe(env, cfg.timezone);
                    if (tz_id) {
                        jobject tz_obj = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(icu_tz_cls, get_icu_tz, tz_id);
                        if (!env->ExceptionCheck() && tz_obj) {
                            env->CallStaticVoidMethod(icu_tz_cls, set_icu_tz, tz_obj);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clearJniException(env);
    }

    if (cfg.spoof_locale && !cfg.locale.empty()) {
        jclass loc_cls = env->FindClass("java/util/Locale");
        if (loc_cls && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
            jmethodID for_tag = env->GetStaticMethodID(loc_cls, "forLanguageTag", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/util/Locale;");
            if (for_tag && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                jmethodID set_def = env->GetStaticMethodID(loc_cls, "setDefault", "(Ljava/util/Locale;)V");
                if (set_def && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                    jstring tag = newJniStringSafe(env, cfg.locale);
                    if (tag) {
                        jobject loc_obj = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(loc_cls, for_tag, tag);
                        if (!env->ExceptionCheck() && loc_obj) {
                            env->CallStaticVoidMethod(loc_cls, set_def, loc_obj);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clearJniException(env);

        jclass uloc_cls = env->FindClass("android/icu/util/ULocale");
        if (uloc_cls && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
            jmethodID for_utag = env->GetStaticMethodID(uloc_cls, "forLanguageTag", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Landroid/icu/util/ULocale;");
            if (for_utag && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                jmethodID set_udef = env->GetStaticMethodID(uloc_cls, "setDefault", "(Landroid/icu/util/ULocale;)V");
                if (set_udef && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                    jstring tag = newJniStringSafe(env, cfg.locale);
                    if (tag) {
                        jobject uloc_obj = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(uloc_cls, for_utag, tag);
                        if (!env->ExceptionCheck() && uloc_obj) {
                            env->CallStaticVoidMethod(uloc_cls, set_udef, uloc_obj);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clearJniException(env);

        jclass ll_cls = env->FindClass("android/os/LocaleList");
        if (ll_cls && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
            jmethodID for_tags = env->GetStaticMethodID(ll_cls, "forLanguageTags", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Landroid/os/LocaleList;");
            if (for_tags && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                jmethodID set_ll = env->GetStaticMethodID(ll_cls, "setDefault", "(Landroid/os/LocaleList;)V");
                if (set_ll && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                    jstring tags = newJniStringSafe(env, cfg.locale);
                    if (tags) {
                        jobject ll_obj = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(ll_cls, for_tags, tags);
                        if (!env->ExceptionCheck() && ll_obj) {
                            env->CallStaticVoidMethod(ll_cls, set_ll, ll_obj);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        clearJniException(env);

        // Clear stale Zygote pre-fork user.language/country/region system properties.
        std::string lang;
        std::string country;
        stealth::detail::splitLocaleTag(cfg.locale, cfg.device_region, lang, country);
        jclass sys_cls = env->FindClass("java/lang/System");
        if (sys_cls && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
            jmethodID set_prop = env->GetStaticMethodID(
                sys_cls, "setProperty", "(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;");
            if (set_prop && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                auto setSysProp = [&](const char* k, const std::string& v) {
                    if (v.empty()) return;
                    jstring jk = newJniStringSafe(env, k);
                    jstring jv = newJniStringSafe(env, v);
                    jobject prev = nullptr;
                    if (jk && jv && !env->ExceptionCheck()) {
                        prev = env->CallStaticObjectMethod(sys_cls, set_prop, jk, jv);
                    }
                    clearJniException(env);
                    if (prev) env->DeleteLocalRef(prev);
                    if (jk) env->DeleteLocalRef(jk);
                    if (jv) env->DeleteLocalRef(jv);
                };
                setSysProp("user.language", lang);
                setSysProp("user.country", country);
                setSysProp("user.region", country);
            }
        }
        clearJniException(env);
    }
    env->PopLocalFrame(nullptr);
}

class SandboxStealthModule : public zygisk::ModuleBase {
public:
    void onLoad(zygisk::Api* api, JNIEnv* env) override {
        api_ = api;
        env_ = env;
    }

    void preServerSpecialize([[maybe_unused]] zygisk::ServerSpecializeArgs* args) override {
        if (!fetchConfigFromCompanion(api_, g_cfg_json)) {
            g_cfg = stealth::StealthConfig{};
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
            return;
        }
        g_cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(g_cfg_json);
        if (!g_cfg.enabled) {
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
        } else {
            LOGI("preServerSpecialize armed for sandbox user %d (oem=%s)", g_cfg.sandbox_user_id, stealth::kOemProfileName);
        }
    }

    void postServerSpecialize([[maybe_unused]] const zygisk::ServerSpecializeArgs* args) override {
        if (g_cfg.enabled) {
            injectDexAndInstallSystemHook(env_, "system_server");
        }
        api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
    }

    void preAppSpecialize(zygisk::AppSpecializeArgs* args) override {
        if (!args) {
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
            return;
        }

        const char* raw_name = nullptr;
        if (args->nice_name != nullptr) {
            raw_name = env_->GetStringUTFChars(args->nice_name, nullptr);
            if (!raw_name || env_->ExceptionCheck()) {
                clearJniException(env_);
                if (raw_name != nullptr) {
                    env_->ReleaseStringUTFChars(args->nice_name, raw_name);
                    raw_name = nullptr;
                }
            }
        }
        std::string proc_name = raw_name ? raw_name : "";
        if (raw_name != nullptr) {
            env_->ReleaseStringUTFChars(args->nice_name, raw_name);
        }

        const int uid = static_cast<int>(args->uid);
        const int user_id = uid / stealth::kAndroidUserStride;
        const int app_id = uid % stealth::kAndroidUserStride;

        // 1. Phone service host process: inject ServiceManager wrapper only, never PLT hook.
        if (uid == 1001 && proc_name == "com.android.phone") {
            if (fetchConfigFromCompanion(api_, g_cfg_json)) {
                g_cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(g_cfg_json);
                g_is_phone_proc = g_cfg.enabled;
            }
            if (!g_is_phone_proc) {
                api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
            }
            return;
        }

        // 2. Fast zero-IPC exit for User 0, dual-clone user 999, and system UIDs (<10000); keep isolated processes (90000..99999) in scope.
        if (user_id <= 0 || user_id == stealth::kXSpaceUserId ||
            app_id < stealth::kFirstAppId || app_id >= stealth::kAndroidUserStride) {
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
            return;
        }

        // 3. Sandbox user process: verify against companion policy.
        if (!fetchConfigFromCompanion(api_, g_cfg_json)) {
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
            return;
        }
        g_cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(g_cfg_json);
        if (!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(g_cfg, uid)) {
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
            return;
        }
        g_baked_props = stealth::bakeSpoofedProps(g_cfg);
        populateFakeProps(g_baked_props, g_fake_props);

        g_is_sandbox_app = true;
        if (g_cfg.sanitize_network) {
            uint8_t octets[4] = {10, 172, 10, 2};
            if (!stealth::parseIPv4Octets(g_cfg.sandbox_link_ipv4, octets)) {
                octets[0] = 10;
                octets[1] = 172;
                octets[2] = 10;
                octets[3] = 2;
            }
            std::memcpy(&g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo, octets, sizeof(g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo));
        } else {
            g_sandbox_ipv4_nbo = 0;
        }
        if (g_cfg.spoof_timezone && !g_cfg.timezone.empty()) {
            // Bionic localtime() reads persist.sys.timezone directly inside libc.so (outside PLT hook scope)
            // unless overridden via TZ.
            setenv("TZ", g_cfg.timezone.c_str(), 1);
            tzset();
        }

        if (g_cfg.prop_hook_mode != "dlclose") {
            const bool want_props = g_cfg.spoof_carrier || g_cfg.spoof_timezone || g_cfg.spoof_locale || g_cfg.spoof_device_region;
            const bool want_net = g_cfg.sanitize_network;
            TargetList prop_hits{};
            TargetList net_hits{};
            findLibrariesFromMaps(want_props, prop_hits, want_net, net_hits);

            bool has_registered = false;
            FnPropFind propFindHooks[kMaxPropHookSlots] = {};
            FnPropReadCb propCbHooks[kMaxPropHookSlots] = {};
            FnPropRead propReadHooks[kMaxPropHookSlots] = {};
            FnPropGet propGetHooks[kMaxPropHookSlots] = {};
            fillPropHookTables(propFindHooks, propCbHooks, propReadHooks, propGetHooks,
                               std::make_index_sequence<kMaxPropHookSlots>{});
            FnGetIfAddrs netHooks[kMaxNetHookSlots] = {
                hook_getifaddrs_slot<0>, hook_getifaddrs_slot<1>,
            };

            size_t prop_libs_registered = prop_hits.count;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < prop_hits.count; i++) {
                const ResolvedTarget& pt = prop_hits.items[i];
                api_->pltHookRegister(pt.dev, pt.inode, "__system_property_find",
                                      reinterpret_cast<void*>(propFindHooks[i]),
                                      reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_orig_prop_find[i]));
                api_->pltHookRegister(pt.dev, pt.inode, "__system_property_read_callback",
                                      reinterpret_cast<void*>(propCbHooks[i]),
                                      reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_orig_prop_cb[i]));
                api_->pltHookRegister(pt.dev, pt.inode, "__system_property_read",
                                      reinterpret_cast<void*>(propReadHooks[i]),
                                      reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_orig_prop_read[i]));
                api_->pltHookRegister(pt.dev, pt.inode, "__system_property_get",
                                      reinterpret_cast<void*>(propGetHooks[i]),
                                      reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_orig_prop_get[i]));
                has_registered = true;
            }
            size_t net_libs_registered = net_hits.count;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < net_hits.count; i++) {
                const ResolvedTarget& nt = net_hits.items[i];
                api_->pltHookRegister(nt.dev, nt.inode, "getifaddrs",
                                      reinterpret_cast<void*>(netHooks[i]),
                                      reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_orig_getifaddrs[i]));
                has_registered = true;
            }
            if (has_registered) {
                bool committed = api_->pltHookCommit();
                bool any_orig = false;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < prop_libs_registered; i++) {
                    if (g_orig_prop_find[i] || g_orig_prop_cb[i] || g_orig_prop_read[i] || g_orig_prop_get[i]) any_orig = true;
                }
                for (size_t i = 0; i < net_libs_registered; i++) {
                    if (g_orig_getifaddrs[i]) any_orig = true;
                }
                g_plt_hooked = committed || any_orig;
                if (g_plt_hooked) {
                    LOGI("pltHookCommit active for %s (%d) oem=%s committed=%d prop_libs=%zu net_libs=%zu",
                         proc_name.c_str(), uid, stealth::kOemProfileName, committed ? 1 : 0, prop_libs_registered, net_libs_registered);
                } else {
                    LOGW("pltHookCommit failed in %s (%d)", proc_name.c_str(), uid);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void postAppSpecialize([[maybe_unused]] const zygisk::AppSpecializeArgs* args) override {
        if (g_is_phone_proc) {
            injectDexAndInstallSystemHook(env_, "com.android.phone");
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
            return;
        }

        if (g_is_sandbox_app) {
            applyJavaTimezoneAndLocale(env_, g_cfg);
        }

        if (!g_plt_hooked) {
            api_->setOption(zygisk::DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY);
        }
    }

private:
    zygisk::Api* api_ = nullptr;
    JNIEnv* env_ = nullptr;
};

} // namespace

REGISTER_ZYGISK_MODULE(SandboxStealthModule)
REGISTER_ZYGISK_COMPANION(companionHandler)

// This is the public API for Zygisk modules.
// DO NOT MODIFY ANY CODE IN THIS HEADER.

#pragma once

#include <jni.h>

#define ZYGISK_API_VERSION 4

/*

***************
* Introduction
***************

On Android, all app processes are forked from a special daemon called "Zygote".
For each new app process, zygote will fork a new process and perform "specialization".
This specialization operation enforces the Android security sandbox on the newly forked
process to make sure that 3rd party application code is only loaded after it is being
restricted within a sandbox.

On Android, there is also this special process called "system_server". This single
process hosts a significant portion of system services, which controls how the
Android operating system and apps interact with each other.

The Zygisk framework provides a way to allow developers to build modules and run custom
code before and after system_server and any app processes' specialization.
This enable developers to inject code and alter the behavior of system_server and app processes.

Please note that modules will only be loaded after zygote has forked the child process.
THIS MEANS ALL OF YOUR CODE RUNS IN THE APP/SYSTEM_SERVER PROCESS, NOT THE ZYGOTE DAEMON!

*********************
* Development Guide
*********************

Define a class and inherit zygisk::ModuleBase to implement the functionality of your module.
Use the macro REGISTER_ZYGISK_MODULE(className) to register that class to Zygisk.

Example code:

static jint (*orig_logger_entry_max)(JNIEnv *env);
static jint my_logger_entry_max(JNIEnv *env) { return orig_logger_entry_max(env); }

class ExampleModule : public zygisk::ModuleBase {
public:
    void onLoad(zygisk::Api *api, JNIEnv *env) override {
        this->api = api;
        this->env = env;
    }
    void preAppSpecialize(zygisk::AppSpecializeArgs *args) override {
        JNINativeMethod methods[] = {
            { "logger_entry_max_payload_native", "()I", (void*) my_logger_entry_max },
        };
        api->hookJniNativeMethods(env, "android/util/Log", methods, 1);
        *(void **) &orig_logger_entry_max = methods[0].fnPtr;
    }
private:
    zygisk::Api *api;
    JNIEnv *env;
};

REGISTER_ZYGISK_MODULE(ExampleModule)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Since your module class's code runs with either Zygote's privilege in pre[XXX]Specialize,
or runs in the sandbox of the target process in post[XXX]Specialize, the code in your class
never runs in a true superuser environment.

If your module require access to superuser permissions, you can create and register
a root companion handler function. This function runs in a separate root companion
daemon process, and an Unix domain socket is provided to allow you to perform IPC between
your target process and the root companion process.

Example code:

static void example_handler(int socket) { ... }

REGISTER_ZYGISK_COMPANION(example_handler)

*/

namespace zygisk {

struct Api;
struct AppSpecializeArgs;
struct ServerSpecializeArgs;

class ModuleBase {
public:

    // This method is called as soon as the module is loaded into the target process.
    // A Zygisk API handle will be passed as an argument.
    virtual void onLoad([[maybe_unused]] Api *api, [[maybe_unused]] JNIEnv *env) {}

    // This method is called before the app process is specialized.
    // At this point, the process just got forked from zygote, but no app specific specialization
    // is applied. This means that the process does not have any sandbox restrictions and
    // still runs with the same privilege of zygote.
    //
    // All the arguments that will be sent and used for app specialization is passed as a single
    // AppSpecializeArgs object. You can read and overwrite these arguments to change how the app
    // process will be specialized.
    //
    // If you need to run some operations as superuser, you can call Api::connectCompanion() to
    // get a socket to do IPC calls with a root companion process.
    // See Api::connectCompanion() for more info.
    virtual void preAppSpecialize([[maybe_unused]] AppSpecializeArgs *args) {}

    // This method is called after the app process is specialized.
    // At this point, the process has all sandbox restrictions enabled for this application.
    // This means that this method runs with the same privilege of the app's own code.
    virtual void postAppSpecialize([[maybe_unused]] const AppSpecializeArgs *args) {}

    // This method is called before the system server process is specialized.
    // See preAppSpecialize(args) for more info.
    virtual void preServerSpecialize([[maybe_unused]] ServerSpecializeArgs *args) {}

    // This method is called after the system server process is specialized.
    // At this point, the process runs with the privilege of system_server.
    virtual void postServerSpecialize([[maybe_unused]] const ServerSpecializeArgs *args) {}
};

struct AppSpecializeArgs {
    // Required arguments. These arguments are guaranteed to exist on all Android versions.
    jint &uid;
    jint &gid;
    jintArray &gids;
    jint &runtime_flags;
    jobjectArray &rlimits;
    jint &mount_external;
    jstring &se_info;
    jstring &nice_name;
    jstring &instruction_set;
    jstring &app_data_dir;

    // Optional arguments. Please check whether the pointer is null before de-referencing
    jintArray *const fds_to_ignore;
    jboolean *const is_child_zygote;
    jboolean *const is_top_app;
    jobjectArray *const pkg_data_info_list;
    jobjectArray *const whitelisted_data_info_list;
    jboolean *const mount_data_dirs;
    jboolean *const mount_storage_dirs;

    AppSpecializeArgs() = delete;
};

struct ServerSpecializeArgs {
    jint &uid;
    jint &gid;
    jintArray &gids;
    jint &runtime_flags;
    jlong &permitted_capabilities;
    jlong &effective_capabilities;

    ServerSpecializeArgs() = delete;
};

namespace internal {
struct api_table;
template <class T> void entry_impl(api_table *, JNIEnv *);
}

// These values are used in Api::setOption(Option)
enum Option : int {
    // Force Magisk's denylist unmount routines to run on this process.
    //
    // Setting this option only makes sense in preAppSpecialize.
    // The actual unmounting happens during app process specialization.
    //
    // Set this option to force all Magisk and modules' files to be unmounted from the
    // mount namespace of the process, regardless of the denylist enforcement status.
    FORCE_DENYLIST_UNMOUNT = 0,

    // When this option is set, your module's library will be dlclose-ed after post[XXX]Specialize.
    // Be aware that after dlclose-ing your module, all of your code will be unmapped from memory.
    // YOU MUST NOT ENABLE THIS OPTION AFTER HOOKING ANY FUNCTIONS IN THE PROCESS.
    DLCLOSE_MODULE_LIBRARY = 1,
};

// Bit masks of the return value of Api::getFlags()
enum StateFlag : uint32_t {
    // The user has granted root access to the current process
    PROCESS_GRANTED_ROOT = (1u << 0),

    // The current process was added on the denylist
    PROCESS_ON_DENYLIST = (1u << 1),
};

// All API methods will stop working after post[XXX]Specialize as Zygisk will be unloaded
// from the specialized process afterwards.
struct Api {

    // Connect to a root companion process and get a Unix domain socket for IPC.
    //
    // This API only works in the pre[XXX]Specialize methods due to SELinux restrictions.
    //
    // The pre[XXX]Specialize methods run with the same privilege of zygote.
    // If you would like to do some operations with superuser permissions, register a handler
    // function that would be called in the root process with REGISTER_ZYGISK_COMPANION(func).
    // Another good use case for a companion process is that if you want to share some resources
    // across multiple processes, hold the resources in the companion process and pass it over.
    //
    // The root companion process is ABI aware; that is, when calling this method from a 32-bit
    // process, you will be connected to a 32-bit companion process, and vice versa for 64-bit.
    //
    // Returns a file descriptor to a socket that is connected to the socket passed to your
    // module's companion request handler. Returns -1 if the connection attempt failed.
    int connectCompanion();

    // Get the file descriptor of the root folder of the current module.
    //
    // This API only works in the pre[XXX]Specialize methods.
    // Accessing the directory returned is only possible in the pre[XXX]Specialize methods
    // or in the root companion process (assuming that you sent the fd over the socket).
    // Both restrictions are due to SELinux and UID.
    //
    // Returns -1 if errors occurred.
    int getModuleDir();

    // Set various options for your module.
    // Please note that this method accepts one single option at a time.
    // Check zygisk::Option for the full list of options available.
    void setOption(Option opt);

    // Get information about the current process.
    // Returns bitwise-or'd zygisk::StateFlag values.
    uint32_t getFlags();

    // Exempt the provided file descriptor from being automatically closed.
    //
    // This API only make sense in preAppSpecialize; calling this method in any other situation
    // is either a no-op (returns true) or an error (returns false).
    //
    // When false is returned, the provided file descriptor will eventually be closed by zygote.
    bool exemptFd(int fd);

    // Hook JNI native methods for a class
    //
    // Lookup all registered JNI native methods and replace it with your own methods.
    // The original function pointer will be saved in each JNINativeMethod's fnPtr.
    // If no matching class, method name, or signature is found, that specific JNINativeMethod.fnPtr
    // will be set to nullptr.
    void hookJniNativeMethods(JNIEnv *env, const char *className, JNINativeMethod *methods, int numMethods);

    // Hook functions in the PLT (Procedure Linkage Table) of ELFs loaded in memory.
    //
    // Parsing /proc/[PID]/maps will give you the memory map of a process. As an example:
    //
    //       <address>       <perms>  <offset>   <dev>  <inode>           <pathname>
    // 56b4346000-56b4347000  r-xp    00002000   fe:00    235       /system/bin/app_process64
    // (More details: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/proc.5.html)
    //
    // The `dev` and `inode` pair uniquely identifies a file being mapped into memory.
    // For matching ELFs loaded in memory, replace function `symbol` with `newFunc`.
    // If `oldFunc` is not nullptr, the original function pointer will be saved to `oldFunc`.
    void pltHookRegister(dev_t dev, ino_t inode, const char *symbol, void *newFunc, void **oldFunc);

    // Commit all the hooks that was previously registered.
    // Returns false if an error occurred.
    bool pltHookCommit();

private:
    internal::api_table *tbl;
    template <class T> friend void internal::entry_impl(internal::api_table *, JNIEnv *);
};

// Register a class as a Zygisk module

#define REGISTER_ZYGISK_MODULE(clazz) \
void zygisk_module_entry(zygisk::internal::api_table *table, JNIEnv *env) { \
    zygisk::internal::entry_impl<clazz>(table, env);                        \
}

// Register a root companion request handler function for your module
//
// The function runs in a superuser daemon process and handles a root companion request from
// your module running in a target process. The function has to accept an integer value,
// which is a Unix domain socket that is connected to the target process.
// See Api::connectCompanion() for more info.
//
// NOTE: the function can run concurrently on multiple threads.
// Be aware of race conditions if you have globally shared resources.

#define REGISTER_ZYGISK_COMPANION(func) \
void zygisk_companion_entry(int client) { func(client); }

/*********************************************************
 * The following is internal ABI implementation detail.
 * You do not have to understand what it is doing.
 *********************************************************/

namespace internal {

struct module_abi {
    long api_version;
    ModuleBase *impl;

    void (*preAppSpecialize)(ModuleBase *, AppSpecializeArgs *);
    void (*postAppSpecialize)(ModuleBase *, const AppSpecializeArgs *);
    void (*preServerSpecialize)(ModuleBase *, ServerSpecializeArgs *);
    void (*postServerSpecialize)(ModuleBase *, const ServerSpecializeArgs *);

    module_abi(ModuleBase *module) : api_version(ZYGISK_API_VERSION), impl(module) {
        preAppSpecialize = [](auto m, auto args) { m->preAppSpecialize(args); };
        postAppSpecialize = [](auto m, auto args) { m->postAppSpecialize(args); };
        preServerSpecialize = [](auto m, auto args) { m->preServerSpecialize(args); };
        postServerSpecialize = [](auto m, auto args) { m->postServerSpecialize(args); };
    }
};

struct api_table {
    // Base
    void *impl;
    bool (*registerModule)(api_table *, module_abi *);

    void (*hookJniNativeMethods)(JNIEnv *, const char *, JNINativeMethod *, int);
    void (*pltHookRegister)(dev_t, ino_t, const char *, void *, void **);
    bool (*exemptFd)(int);
    bool (*pltHookCommit)();
    int  (*connectCompanion)(void * /* impl */);
    void (*setOption)(void * /* impl */, Option);
    int  (*getModuleDir)(void * /* impl */);
    uint32_t (*getFlags)(void * /* impl */);
};

template <class T>
void entry_impl(api_table *table, JNIEnv *env) {
    static Api api;
    api.tbl = table;
    static T module;
    ModuleBase *m = &module;
    static module_abi abi(m);
    if (!table->registerModule(table, &abi)) return;
    m->onLoad(&api, env);
}

} // namespace internal

inline int Api::connectCompanion() {
    return tbl->connectCompanion ? tbl->connectCompanion(tbl->impl) : -1;
}
inline int Api::getModuleDir() {
    return tbl->getModuleDir ? tbl->getModuleDir(tbl->impl) : -1;
}
inline void Api::setOption(Option opt) {
    if (tbl->setOption) tbl->setOption(tbl->impl, opt);
}
inline uint32_t Api::getFlags() {
    return tbl->getFlags ? tbl->getFlags(tbl->impl) : 0;
}
inline bool Api::exemptFd(int fd) {
    return tbl->exemptFd != nullptr && tbl->exemptFd(fd);
}
inline void Api::hookJniNativeMethods(JNIEnv *env, const char *className, JNINativeMethod *methods, int numMethods) {
    if (tbl->hookJniNativeMethods) tbl->hookJniNativeMethods(env, className, methods, numMethods);
}
inline void Api::pltHookRegister(dev_t dev, ino_t inode, const char *symbol, void *newFunc, void **oldFunc) {
    if (tbl->pltHookRegister) tbl->pltHookRegister(dev, inode, symbol, newFunc, oldFunc);
}
inline bool Api::pltHookCommit() {
    return tbl->pltHookCommit != nullptr && tbl->pltHookCommit();
}

} // namespace zygisk

extern "C" {

[[gnu::visibility("default"), maybe_unused]]
void zygisk_module_entry(zygisk::internal::api_table *, JNIEnv *);

[[gnu::visibility("default"), maybe_unused]]
void zygisk_companion_entry(int);

} // extern "C"

package com.sandbox.stealth;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Host JDK 21 test harness covering StealthConfig, dynamic AIDL transaction maps,
 * BinderInterceptionPolicy decisions across all 10 system services, and SystemServerHook proxy.
 */
public final class StealthHookHostTest {
    public interface FakeIServiceManager {

    private static StealthConfig japanSampleConfig() {
        return StealthConfig.fromJson("{\n"
                + "  \"enabled\": true,\n"
                + "  \"sandbox_user_id\": 10,\n"
                + "  \"exempt_work_uid\": 1010376,\n"

    private static void testStealthConfig() {
        StealthConfig empty = StealthConfig.fromJson("");
        check(!empty.enabled, "empty json must disable");
        check("UTC".equals(empty.timezone), "neutral default timezone=UTC");
        check("en-US".equals(empty.locale), "neutral default locale=en-US");
        check(!empty.spoofCarrier, "neutral default spoofCarrier=false");
        check(!empty.spoofDeviceRegion, "neutral default spoofDeviceRegion=false");
        check("Android".equals(empty.deviceName), "neutral default deviceName=Android");
        check("".equals(empty.deviceRegion), "neutral default deviceRegion empty");
        check(!empty.shouldIntercept(1010377), "disabled config must not intercept");

        StealthConfig cfg = japanSampleConfig();
        check(cfg.enabled, "enabled=true");
        check(cfg.sandboxUserId == 10, "sandboxUserId=10");
        check(cfg.exemptWorkUid == 1010376, "exemptWorkUid=1010376");
        check(cfg.exemptUids.length == 2, "deduped exemptUids len=2");
        check("44010".equals(cfg.networkOperator), "networkOperator fallback to sim_operator");
        check("jp".equals(cfg.networkCountryIso), "networkCountryIso fallback");

        // UID scoping tests
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(10377), "User 0 must NEVER be intercepted");
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(1000), "SYSTEM_UID 1000 must pass through");
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(1001), "PHONE_UID 1001 must pass through");
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(1001000), "User 10 system UID must pass through");
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(1010376), "exempt sandbox controller UID must pass through");
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(1010076), "exempt com.android.managedprovisioning UID must pass through");
        check(cfg.shouldIntercept(1099211), "User 10 isolated process UID must intercept");
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(99910123), "Dual-clone user 999 must pass through");
        check(cfg.shouldIntercept(1010377), "User 10 app UID 1010377 must intercept");
        check(cfg.shouldIntercept(1010122), "User 10 GMS UID 1010122 must intercept");
        check(cfg.sanitizeNetwork && cfg.spoofBluetooth, "anti-linkage flags default true");
        check("10.172.10.2".equals(cfg.sandboxLinkIpv4), "default sandboxLinkIpv4=10.172.10.2");
        check("Pixel 9".equals(cfg.deviceName), "parsed deviceName=Pixel 9");
        check(cfg.spoofDeviceRegion, "parsed spoofDeviceRegion=true");
        check("JP".equals(cfg.deviceRegion), "parsed deviceRegion=JP");
        check("JP".equals(cfg.bootHwc), "parsed bootHwc=JP");

        StealthConfig customCfg = StealthConfig.fromJson(
                "{\"enabled\":true,\"sanitize_network\":false,\"spoof_bluetooth\":false,"
                        + "\"spoof_device_region\":false,\"miui_region\":\"US\",\"boot_hwc\":\"Global\","
                        + "\"sandbox_link_ipv4\":\"10.172.99.2\",\"device_name\":\"ModelX\"}");
        check(!customCfg.sanitizeNetwork && !customCfg.spoofBluetooth, "custom anti-linkage false honored");
        check(!customCfg.spoofDeviceRegion && "US".equals(customCfg.deviceRegion) && "Global".equals(customCfg.bootHwc),
                "legacy miui_region alias parsed");
        check("10.172.99.2".equals(customCfg.sandboxLinkIpv4), "custom sandboxLinkIpv4 parsed");
        check("ModelX".equals(customCfg.deviceName), "custom deviceName parsed");
    }

    private static void testTransactionReflection() {
        Map<Integer, String> m = BinderInterceptionPolicy.buildTransactionMap(
                ShiftedVendorUserManagerService.class, null);
        check("getProfileType".equals(m.get(17)), "tx 17 -> getProfileType");
        check("isUserOfType".equals(m.get(19)), "tx 19 -> isUserOfType");
        check("getProfileIds".equals(m.get(41)), "tx 41 -> getProfileIds");
        check("isProfile".equals(m.get(105)), "tx 105 -> isProfile");
        check("isPrivateProfile".equals(m.get(108)), "tx 108 -> isPrivateProfile");
        check("isManagedProfile".equals(m.get(99)), "tx 99 -> isManagedProfile");
    }

    private static void testBinderInterceptionDecisions() {
        StealthConfig cfg = japanSampleConfig();
        int u10 = 1010377;
        int u0 = 10377;

        // User 0 always passthrough
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("user", "getProfileType", cfg, u0, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.PASSTHROUGH, "u0 passthrough");

        // User service in User 10
        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision d = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("user", "getProfileType", cfg, u10, null);
        check(d.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_STRING && "".equals(d.stringValue), "getProfileType empty");

        d = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("user", "isUserOfType", cfg, u10, "android.os.usertype.profile.MANAGED");
        check(d.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_BOOL && !d.boolValue, "isUserOfType managed false");

        d = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("user", "isUserOfType", cfg, u10, "android.os.usertype.full.SYSTEM");

        d = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("user", "isPrivateProfile", cfg, u10, null);

                && Arrays.equals(d.intArrayValue, new int[]{10}), "getProfileIds [10]");

        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("device_policy", "getActiveAdmins", cfg, u10, null).action

        d = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("device_policy", "isOrganizationOwnedDeviceWithManagedProfile", cfg, u10, null);
        check(d.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_BOOL && !d.boolValue, "dpm org owned false");

                "bt getAddress locally-administered");

                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_EMPTY_TYPED_LIST, "bt bonded devices empty");

    private static void testSystemServerHookProxy() {
        final Map<String, Object> stored = new HashMap<>();
        FakeIServiceManager real = new FakeIServiceManager() {
            @Override
            public void addService(String name, Object service, boolean allowIsolated, int dumpPriority) {
                stored.put(name, service);
            }
            @Override
            public Object getService(String name) {
                return stored.get(name);
            }
            @Override
            public Object checkService(String name) {
                return stored.get(name);
            }
            @Override
            public Object getService2(String name) {
                Object v = stored.get(name);
                return v == null ? null : new FakeServiceWithMetadata(v);
            }
            @Override
            public Object checkService2(String name) {
                Object v = stored.get(name);
                return v == null ? null : new FakeNestedServiceWithMetadata(v);
            }
        };

        Set<String> targets = SystemServerHook.targetServicesForProcess("system_server");
        check(targets.contains("user") && targets.contains("device_policy")
                && targets.contains("crossprofileapps") && targets.contains("location")
                && targets.contains("wifi") && targets.contains("connectivity")
                && targets.contains("bluetooth_manager") && !targets.contains("phone"), "system_server target set");

        Set<String> phoneTargets = SystemServerHook.targetServicesForProcess("com.android.phone");
        check(phoneTargets.size() == 3 && phoneTargets.contains("phone")
                && phoneTargets.contains("isub") && phoneTargets.contains("iphonesubinfo"),
                "phone target set includes phone, isub, and iphonesubinfo");

        SystemServerHook.BinderWrapperFactory testFactory = new SystemServerHook.BinderWrapperFactory() {
            @Override public boolean isWrappable(Object c) { return c != null; }
            @Override public boolean isAlreadyWrapped(Object c) { return c instanceof FakeWrapper; }
            @Override public Object wrap(Object d, String s, StealthConfig c) { return new FakeWrapper(d, s); }
        };

        FakeIServiceManager proxy = (FakeIServiceManager) SystemServerHook.createProxy(
                real, FakeIServiceManager.class, new HashSet<>(targets), japanSampleConfig(), testFactory);

        Object rawUser = new Object();
        Object rawActivity = new Object();
        Object rawConn = new Object();
        Object rawBt = new Object();

        proxy.addService("user", rawUser, false, 0);
        proxy.addService("activity", rawActivity, false, 0);
        proxy.addService("connectivity", rawConn, false, 0);
        proxy.addService("bluetooth_manager", rawBt, false, 0);

        check(stored.get("user") instanceof FakeWrapper, "target service must be wrapped in real ServiceManager");
        check(((FakeWrapper) stored.get("user")).delegate == rawUser, "wrapper must delegate to rawUser");
        check(stored.get("activity") == rawActivity, "non-target service must stay unwrapped");
        check(stored.get("connectivity") instanceof FakeWrapper, "connectivity must be wrapped");
        check(stored.get("bluetooth_manager") instanceof FakeWrapper, "bluetooth_manager must be wrapped");

        check(proxy.getService("user") == rawUser, "default proxy getService must return rawUser");
        check(proxy.checkService("user") == rawUser, "default proxy checkService must return rawUser");
        check(proxy.getService("connectivity") == rawConn, "default proxy getService(connectivity) must return rawConn");
        FakeServiceWithMetadata meta2 = (FakeServiceWithMetadata) proxy.getService2("user");
        check(meta2 != null && meta2.service == rawUser, "default proxy getService2(user) must unwrap ServiceWithMetadata.service");
        FakeNestedServiceWithMetadata nestedMeta2 = (FakeNestedServiceWithMetadata) proxy.checkService2("connectivity");
        check(nestedMeta2 != null && nestedMeta2.service.binder == rawConn,
                "default proxy checkService2(connectivity) must unwrap nested service.binder");

        FakeIServiceManager exportProxy = (FakeIServiceManager) SystemServerHook.createProxy(
                real, FakeIServiceManager.class, new HashSet<>(targets), japanSampleConfig(), testFactory,
                () -> true);
        Object rawWifi = new Object();
        exportProxy.addService("user", rawUser, false, 0);
        exportProxy.addService("wifi", rawWifi, false, 0);
        exportProxy.addService("connectivity", rawConn, false, 0);
        exportProxy.addService("bluetooth_manager", rawBt, false, 0);
        check(exportProxy.getService("user") instanceof FakeWrapper, "export proxy getService(user) must return wrapped");
        check(((FakeServiceWithMetadata) exportProxy.getService2("user")).service instanceof FakeWrapper,
                "export proxy getService2(user) must keep wrapped binder");
        check(((FakeNestedServiceWithMetadata) exportProxy.checkService2("connectivity")).service.binder instanceof FakeWrapper,
                "export proxy checkService2(connectivity) must keep wrapped binder");
        check(exportProxy.getService("connectivity") instanceof FakeWrapper, "export proxy getService(connectivity) wrapped");
        check(exportProxy.getService("wifi") instanceof FakeWrapper, "export proxy getService(wifi) wrapped");
        check(exportProxy.getService("bluetooth_manager") instanceof FakeWrapper, "export proxy getService(bt) wrapped");

        check(SystemServerHook.isAppBindCaller(new StackTraceElement[]{
                new StackTraceElement("android.os.ServiceManager", "getService", "ServiceManager.java", 140),
                new StackTraceElement("com.android.server.am.ActivityManagerService", "addServiceToMap", "ActivityManagerService.java", 1),
        }), "addServiceToMap frame must match");
        check(!SystemServerHook.isAppBindCaller(new StackTraceElement[]{
                new StackTraceElement("com.android.server.restrictions.RestrictionsManagerService$RestrictionsManagerImpl", "<init>", "RestrictionsManagerService.java", 66),
        }), "RestrictionsManagerService frame must not export wrapped binder");
    }

    private static final class BenchSlot {
        final String methodName;
        final BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision decision;
        BenchSlot(String methodName, BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision decision) {
            this.methodName = methodName;
            this.decision = decision;
        }
    }

    private static void testStaticDecisionCacheAndBenchmark() {
        StealthConfig cfg = japanSampleConfig();
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.supportsStaticDecisionCache("user", "getProfileType"), "getProfileType cacheable");
        check(!BinderInterceptionPolicy.supportsStaticDecisionCache("user", "isUserOfType"), "isUserOfType not static-cacheable");
        check(!BinderInterceptionPolicy.supportsStaticDecisionCache("user", "isSameProfileGroup"), "isSameProfileGroup not static-cacheable");

        AtomicReferenceArray<BenchSlot> table = new AtomicReferenceArray<>(256);
        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision d17 = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decideForIntercepted("user", "getProfileType", cfg, null, -1, -2);
        table.set(17, new BenchSlot("getProfileType", d17));

        CountDownLatch startGate = new CountDownLatch(1);
        CountDownLatch doneGate = new CountDownLatch(4);
        AtomicInteger anomalies = new AtomicInteger(0);
        for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++) {
            new Thread(() -> {
                try {
                    startGate.await();
                    for (int k = 0; k < 200; k++) {
                        int idx = 32 + (k % 64);
                        BenchSlot s = table.get(idx);
                        if (s == null) {
                            BenchSlot cand = new BenchSlot("getProfileIds", BinderInterceptionPolicy.decideForIntercepted("user", "getProfileIds", cfg, null, -1, -2));
                            table.compareAndSet(idx, null, cand);
                            s = table.get(idx);
                        }
                        if (s == null || s.methodName == null || s.decision == null) {
                            anomalies.incrementAndGet();
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Throwable ex) {
                    anomalies.incrementAndGet();
                } finally {
                    doneGate.countDown();
                }
            }).start();
        }
        startGate.countDown();
        try {
            doneGate.await();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            throw new AssertionError(ex);
        }
        check(anomalies.get() == 0, "concurrent AtomicReferenceArray publication must have 0 anomalies");
    }

    private static void testHardeningPolicies() {
        StealthConfig cfg = japanSampleConfig();
        int u10Isolated = 1099001;
        int u0Isolated = 99001;
        int u0App = 10100;
        int u10App = 1010395;

        check(cfg.shouldIntercept(u10Isolated), "u10 isolated UID must be intercepted");
        check(!cfg.shouldIntercept(u0Isolated), "u0 isolated UID must not be intercepted");

        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("bluetooth_manager", "registerAdapter", cfg, u10App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_NULL_STRONG_BINDER, "bluetooth_manager.registerAdapter -> null binder");
        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision dBtState = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("bluetooth_manager", "getState", cfg, u10Isolated, null);
        check(dBtState.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_INT && dBtState.intValue == 10,
                "bluetooth_manager.getState -> STATE_OFF (10)");

        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision dWifiCc = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("wifi", "getCountryCode", cfg, u10App, null);
        check(dWifiCc.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_STRING && "JP".equals(dWifiCc.stringValue),
                "wifi.getCountryCode -> JP");
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("wifi", "getCountryCode", StealthConfig.defaults(), u10App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.PASSTHROUGH, "wifi.getCountryCode neutral defaults passthrough");
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("wifi", "getDhcpInfo", cfg, u10App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_NULL_PARCELABLE, "wifi.getDhcpInfo redacted");

        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("phone", "requestCellInfoUpdate", cfg, u10App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_VOID, "phone.requestCellInfoUpdate blocked");
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("phone", "getCellLocationForSubscriber", cfg, u10App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_NULL_PARCELABLE, "phone.getCellLocationForSubscriber blocked");
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("phone", "getNeighboringCellInfo", cfg, u10App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_EMPTY_TYPED_LIST, "phone.getNeighboringCellInfo empty");
        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision dCidName = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("phone", "getSimCarrierIdName", cfg, u10App, null);
        check(dCidName.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_STRING && "NTT DOCOMO".equals(dCidName.stringValue),
                "phone.getSimCarrierIdName -> NTT DOCOMO");
        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision dDoUid = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("device_policy", "getDeviceOwnerUserId", cfg, u10App, null);
        check(dDoUid.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_INT && dDoUid.intValue == -1,
                "device_policy.getDeviceOwnerUserId -> -1");
        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision dAdminActive = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("device_policy", "isAdminActiveAsUser", cfg, u10App, null);
        check(dAdminActive.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_BOOL && !dAdminActive.boolValue,
                "device_policy.isAdminActiveAsUser -> false");

        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("connectivity", "getNetworkInfo", cfg, u10App, null, 17, -1).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_NULL_PARCELABLE,
                "connectivity.getNetworkInfo(TYPE_VPN=17) returns null");
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("connectivity", "listenForNetwork", cfg, u10App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRAP_CONNECTIVITY_MESSENGER,
                "connectivity.listenForNetwork wraps Messenger");

        BinderInterceptionPolicy.Decision dCid = BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("phone", "getSubscriptionCarrierId", cfg, u10App, null);
        check(dCid.action == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.WRITE_INT && dCid.intValue == 850,
                "phone.getSubscriptionCarrierId -> 850");
        check(BinderInterceptionPolicy.decide("isub", "getPhoneNumber", cfg, u0App, null).action
                == BinderInterceptionPolicy.Action.PASSTHROUGH, "isub u0 passthrough");

        StealthConfig nestedCfg = StealthConfig.fromJson(
                "{\"enabled\":false,\"extra\":{\"enabled\":false,\"device_region\":\"CN\"},"
                + "\"sim_operator_name\":\"NTT]DOCOMO\",\"exempt_uids\":[1010376],\"enabled\":true}");
        check(nestedCfg.enabled, "Java parseFlatJson last-wins & skips nested objects");
        check("".equals(nestedCfg.deviceRegion), "nested device_region must not leak into top-level");
        check("NTT]DOCOMO".equals(nestedCfg.simOperatorName), "bracket inside string must preserve value");
        check(!nestedCfg.shouldIntercept(1010376), "exempt_uids array parsed past string bracket");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        testStealthConfig();

        testSystemServerHookProxy();
        testStaticDecisionCacheAndBenchmark();
        testHardeningPolicies();
