`stealth/tests/stealth_logic_test.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../jni/stealth_logic.hpp"

#include <cassert>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    // 1. Neutral defaults / empty / disabled configs
    {
        auto empty = stealth::parseStealthConfig("");
        assert(!empty.enabled);
        assert(empty.timezone == "UTC");
        assert(empty.locale == "en-US");
        assert(empty.sim_operator.empty());
        assert(empty.sim_operator_name.empty());
        assert(empty.sim_country_iso.empty());
        assert(!empty.spoof_carrier);
        assert(!empty.spoof_device_region);
        assert(empty.device_region.empty());
        assert(empty.boot_hwc.empty());
        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(empty, 1010377));

        std::string out;
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(empty, "gsm.sim.operator.numeric", "46002", out));
    }

    // 2. Active sandbox config parsing + UID filter
    {
        std::string json = R"({
            "enabled": true,
            "sandbox_user_id": 10,
            "exempt_work_uid": 1010376,
            "exempt_uids": [1010076, 1010376],
            "timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
            "locale": "ja-JP",
            "sim_operator": "44010",
            "sim_operator_name": "NTT DOCOMO",
            "sim_country_iso": "jp",
            "prop_hook_mode": "plt",
            "spoof_carrier": true,
            "spoof_timezone": true,
            "spoof_locale": true
        })";
        auto cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(json);
        assert(cfg.enabled);
        assert(cfg.sandbox_user_id == 10);
        assert(cfg.exempt_work_uid == 1010376);
        assert(cfg.exempt_uids.size() == 2 && cfg.exempt_uids[0] == 1010076);
        assert(cfg.timezone == "Asia/Tokyo");
        assert(cfg.locale == "ja-JP");
        assert(cfg.sim_operator == "44010");
        assert(cfg.network_operator == "44010");
        assert(cfg.network_country_iso == "jp");

        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 10377));     // User 0
        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1001));      // Phone
        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1001000));   // User 10 system uid
        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1010376));   // Exempt work bridge UID
        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1010076));   // Exempt managedprovisioning UID
        assert(stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1099211));    // User 10 isolated renderer must also spoof
        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 99910123));  // Dual clone user 999
        assert(stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1010377));    // Verify probe / regular app
        assert(stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1010122));    // GMS in User 10
    }

    // 3. Multi-SIM formatting
    {
        assert(stealth::formatMultiSimValue("", "44010") == "44010");
        assert(stealth::formatMultiSimValue("46002", "44010") == "44010");
        assert(stealth::formatMultiSimValue("46002,46000", "44010") == "44010,44010");
        assert(stealth::formatMultiSimValue(",46002", "44010") == ",44010");
        assert(stealth::formatMultiSimValue("46002,", "44010") == "44010,");
        assert(stealth::formatMultiSimValue(",", "jp") == ",");
    }

    // 4. Property lookup whitelist + passthrough
    {
        auto cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"timezone":"Asia/Tokyo","locale":"ja-JP","spoof_carrier":true,"sim_operator":"44010","sim_country_iso":"jp","sim_operator_name":"NTT DOCOMO"})");
        std::string out;
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "persist.sys.timezone", "Asia/Shanghai", out) && out == "Asia/Tokyo");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "gsm.sim.operator.numeric", "46002,", out) && out == "44010,");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "gsm.sim.operator.iso-country", "cn,cn", out) && out == "jp,jp");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "gsm.sim.operator.alpha", "CarrierA", out) && out == "NTT DOCOMO");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "gsm.operator.numeric", "46002", out) && out == "44010");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "gsm.operator.iso-country", ",cn", out) && out == ",jp");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "gsm.operator.alpha", "CarrierB", out) && out == "NTT DOCOMO");
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "ro.product.model", "GenericPhone", out));
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "persist.sys.locale", "zh-CN", out) && out == "ja-JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(cfg, "ro.product.locale", "zh-CN", out) && out == "ja-JP");

        auto no_loc = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"locale":"ja-JP","spoof_locale":false})");
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(no_loc, "persist.sys.locale", "zh-CN", out));
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedProperty(no_loc, "ro.product.locale", "zh-CN", out));
    }

    // 5. Zero-allocation pre-baked property buffer fast path
    {
        auto cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"timezone":"Asia/Tokyo","locale":"ja-JP","spoof_carrier":true,"sim_operator":"44010","sim_country_iso":"jp","sim_operator_name":"NTT DOCOMO"})");
        auto baked = stealth::bakeSpoofedProps(cfg);
        char stack_buf[192];
        const char* res = nullptr;

        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "persist.sys.timezone", "Asia/Shanghai", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(std::string(res) == "Asia/Tokyo");
        assert(res == baked.values[0]); // exact zero-copy pointer reuse

        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "gsm.sim.operator.numeric", "46002,46000", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(std::string(res) == "44010,44010");
        assert(res == stack_buf);

        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "gsm.sim.state", "ABSENT", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(std::string(res) == "READY");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "gsm.sim.state", "ABSENT,NOT_READY", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(std::string(res) == "READY,READY");

        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.build.fingerprint", "foo", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
    }

    // 6. Anti-linkage network config & strict zero-alloc IPv4 octet parser
    {
        auto def_cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(R"({"enabled":true})");
        assert(def_cfg.sanitize_network);
        assert(def_cfg.sandbox_link_ipv4 == "10.172.10.2");

        auto custom_cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"sanitize_network":false,"sandbox_link_ipv4":"10.172.88.5"})");
        assert(!custom_cfg.sanitize_network);
        assert(custom_cfg.sandbox_link_ipv4 == "10.172.88.5");

        uint8_t oct[4] = {};
        assert(stealth::parseIPv4Octets("10.172.10.2", oct));
        assert(oct[0] == 10 && oct[1] == 172 && oct[2] == 10 && oct[3] == 2);
        assert(stealth::parseIPv4Octets(" 192.168.0.1 ", oct));
        assert(oct[0] == 192 && oct[1] == 168 && oct[2] == 0 && oct[3] == 1);

        assert(!stealth::parseIPv4Octets("", oct));
        assert(!stealth::parseIPv4Octets("256.0.0.1", oct));
        assert(!stealth::parseIPv4Octets("010.1.1.1", oct));
        assert(!stealth::parseIPv4Octets("1.2.3", oct));
        assert(!stealth::parseIPv4Octets("1.2.3.4.5", oct));
    }

    // 7. Compile-time OEM specialized device region & locale properties
    {
        assert(stealth::kMaxBakedValueBytes == 92);

        auto legacy_alias = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"spoof_device_region":true,"miui_region":"US","boot_hwc":"Global"})");
        assert(legacy_alias.spoof_device_region);
        assert(legacy_alias.device_region == "US");
        assert(legacy_alias.boot_hwc == "Global");

        auto override_cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"spoof_device_region":true,"miui_region":"US","device_region":"DE","locale":"de-DE"})");
        assert(override_cfg.device_region == "DE");

        auto cfg_clean = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"spoof_device_region":true,"locale":"ja-JP","device_region":"JP","boot_hwc":"JP"})");
        auto baked = stealth::bakeSpoofedProps(cfg_clean);
        char stack_buf[92];
        const char* res = nullptr;

        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "persist.sys.country", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "persist.sys.language", "zh", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(std::string(res) == "ja");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.boot.hwcountry", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(std::string(res) == "JP");

#if defined(OEM_HYPEROS)
        assert(std::string(stealth::kOemProfileName) == "hyperos");
        assert(stealth::kBakedPropCount == 17);
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.boot.hwc", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.miui.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.miui.cust_variant", "cn", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "jp");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.miui.build.region", "cn", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "jp");
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.oplus.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.csc.country_code", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
#elif defined(OEM_OPLUS)
        assert(std::string(stealth::kOemProfileName) == "oplus");
        assert(stealth::kBakedPropCount == 17);
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "persist.sys.oplus.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.oplus.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.vendor.oplus.regionmark", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "persist.sys.oppo.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.miui.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.csc.country_code", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
#elif defined(OEM_ONEUI)
        assert(std::string(stealth::kOemProfileName) == "oneui");
        assert(stealth::kBakedPropCount == 18);
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.csc.country_code", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.csc.countryiso_code", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.csc.sales_code", "CHN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.csc.omcnw_code", "CHN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "persist.omc.sales_code", "CHN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res) && std::string(res) == "JP");
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.miui.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.oplus.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
#else
        assert(stealth::kBakedPropCount == 13);
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.miui.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.oplus.region", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "ro.csc.country_code", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
#endif

        auto disabled_region = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":true,"spoof_device_region":false,"device_region":"US","boot_hwc":"Global"})");
        auto baked_off = stealth::bakeSpoofedProps(disabled_region);
        assert(!stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked_off, "ro.boot.hwcountry", "CN", stack_buf, sizeof(stack_buf), &res));
    }

    // 8. Isolated UIDs, string-embedded JSON safety, overflow fallback, and last-wins escape decoding
    {
        const std::string sneaky_json =
            R"({"sandbox_user_id":10,"sim_operator_name":"Carrier\",\"enabled\":false,\"locale\":\"zh-CN\"",)"
            R"("enabled":true,"locale":"ja-JP","device_region":"JP","boot_hwc":"JP","spoof_carrier":true,"sim_operator":"44010"})";
        auto cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(sneaky_json);
        assert(cfg.enabled);
        assert(cfg.locale == "ja-JP");
        assert(cfg.sim_operator_name == R"(Carrier","enabled":false,"locale":"zh-CN")");
        assert(stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 1099001));
        assert(!stealth::shouldSpoofAppUid(cfg, 99001));

        auto baked = stealth::bakeSpoofedProps(cfg);
        char tiny_buf[6];
        const char* ov_res = nullptr;
        assert(stealth::lookupSpoofedPropertyIntoBuf(baked, "gsm.sim.operator.numeric", "46000,46001", tiny_buf, sizeof(tiny_buf), &ov_res));
        assert(ov_res == baked.values[1]);
        assert(std::string(ov_res) == "44010");

        auto dup_cfg = stealth::parseStealthConfig(
            R"({"enabled":false,"sim_operator_name":"NTT\u0020DOCOMO\u0026Co","enabled":true,"nested":{"enabled":false}})");
        assert(dup_cfg.enabled);
        assert(dup_cfg.sim_operator_name == "NTT DOCOMO&Co");
    }

    std::cout << "ALL stealth_logic_test C++ ASSERTIONS PASSED (oem=" << stealth::kOemProfileName << ")\n";
    return 0;
}
```

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Out = "dist",
    [string]$Version = "1.2.0",
    [string[]]$Oems = @("hyperos", "aosp", "oplus", "oneui", "generic"),
    [string]$GoExe = "",
    [string]$JdkHome = "",
    [string]$AndroidSdkRoot = "",
    [string]$AndroidNdkHome = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$RepoRoot = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..")).Path
$Py = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if (-not $Py) { $Py = (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }
if (-not $Py) { throw "python / python3 not found in PATH." }

$argsList = @(
    (Join-Path $RepoRoot "tools\build_matrix.py"),
    "--out", $Out,
    "--version", $Version,
    "--oems"
) + $Oems

if ($GoExe -ne "") { $argsList += @("--go", $GoExe) }
if ($JdkHome -ne "") { $argsList += @("--jdk", $JdkHome) }
if ($AndroidSdkRoot -ne "") { $argsList += @("--sdk", $AndroidSdkRoot) }
if ($AndroidNdkHome -ne "") { $argsList += @("--ndk", $AndroidNdkHome) }

& $Py @argsList
exit $LASTEXITCODE
```

`tools/build_matrix.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Builds the full 30-variant KernBox release matrix into dist/."""

import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

REPO_ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "packaging"))
import pack_variant  # noqa: E402

OEMS = ("hyperos", "aosp", "oplus", "oneui", "generic")
KERNEL_ROOT_PAIRS = [
    ("k510", ("ksu", "magisk", "apatch")),
    ("k419", ("ksu_legacy", "magisk", "apatch")),
]


def resolve_go(explicit: str = "") -> str:
    if explicit:
        return explicit
    goroot = os.environ.get("GOROOT", "").strip()
    if goroot:
        cand = pathlib.Path(goroot) / "bin" / ("go.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "go")
        if cand.is_file():
            return str(cand)
    found = shutil.which("go")
    if not found:
        raise RuntimeError("Go compiler not found: pass --go or set GOROOT / PATH")
    return found


def build_go_guard(go_exe: str, oem: str, kernel: str, version: str, stage_dir: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path:
    tags = f"oem_{oem}" if kernel == "k510" else f"oem_{oem},kernel_compat"
    out_dir = stage_dir / "go" / f"{oem}-{kernel}"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    guard_bin = out_dir / "sandbox_guard"

    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["CGO_ENABLED"] = "0"
    env["GOOS"] = "linux"
    env["GOARCH"] = "arm64"
    env.setdefault("GOTOOLCHAIN", "local")
    ldflags = f"-s -w -X sandbox_guard/internal/buildinfo.Version={version}"

    print(f"[go build] oem={oem} kernel={kernel} version={version} tags={tags}")
    subprocess.run(
        [go_exe, "build", "-trimpath", f"-ldflags={ldflags}", "-tags", tags, "-o", str(guard_bin), "./cmd/guard"],
        cwd=REPO_ROOT / "guard",
        env=env,
        check=True,
    )
    return guard_bin


def build_native_broker(stage_dir: pathlib.Path, args: argparse.Namespace) -> pathlib.Path:
    out_bin = stage_dir / "native" / "sandbox_broker"
    cmd = [
        sys.executable,
        str(REPO_ROOT / "broker" / "build.py"),
        "--out",
        str(out_bin),
    ]
    if args.sdk:
        cmd.extend(["--sdk", args.sdk])
    if args.ndk:
        cmd.extend(["--ndk", args.ndk])
    print("[broker build] static C11 arm64 sandbox_broker")
    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT, check=True)
    return out_bin


def build_zygisk_oem(oem: str, stage_dir: pathlib.Path, args: argparse.Namespace, skip_dex: bool) -> pathlib.Path:
    out_so = stage_dir / "zygisk" / f"zygisk-{oem}-arm64-v8a.so"
    dex_build_dir = stage_dir / "stealth-build"
    cmd = [
        sys.executable,
        str(REPO_ROOT / "stealth" / "build.py"),
        "--oem",
        oem,
        "--build-dir",
        str(dex_build_dir),
        "--out",
        str(out_so),
    ]
    if skip_dex:
        cmd.append("--skip-dex-if-exists")
    if args.jdk:
        cmd.extend(["--jdk", args.jdk])
    if args.sdk:
        cmd.extend(["--sdk", args.sdk])
    if args.ndk:
        cmd.extend(["--ndk", args.ndk])
    print(f"[stealth build] oem={oem}")
    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT, check=True)
    return out_so


def build_verify_apk(out_dir: pathlib.Path, args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
    apk_path = out_dir / "KernBoxVerify.apk"
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(REPO_ROOT / "verify" / "build-probe.py"), "--out", str(apk_path)]
    if args.jdk:
        cmd.extend(["--jdk", args.jdk])
    if args.sdk:
        cmd.extend(["--sdk", args.sdk])
    print("[verify apk build] building KernBoxVerify.apk")
    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT, check=True)
    raw = apk_path.read_bytes()
    return {
        "artifact": apk_path.name,
        "size": len(raw),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().lower(),
    }


def build_controller_apk(out_dir: pathlib.Path, args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
    apk_path = out_dir / "KernBox.apk"
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(REPO_ROOT / "controller" / "build-controller.py"), "--out", str(apk_path)]
    if args.controller_keystore:
        cmd.extend(["--keystore", args.controller_keystore])
    if args.controller_alias:
        cmd.extend(["--alias", args.controller_alias])
    if args.controller_storepass_env:
        cmd.extend(["--storepass-env", args.controller_storepass_env])
    if args.jdk:
        cmd.extend(["--jdk", args.jdk])
    if args.sdk:
        cmd.extend(["--sdk", args.sdk])
    print("[controller apk build] building KernBox.apk")
    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT, check=True)
    raw = apk_path.read_bytes()
    return {
        "artifact": apk_path.name,
        "size": len(raw),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().lower(),
    }


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build 30-variant KernBox release matrix")
    p.add_argument("--out", type=pathlib.Path, default=REPO_ROOT / "dist", help="Output distribution directory")
    p.add_argument("--version", default="1.2.0", help="Release version string")
    p.add_argument("--oems", nargs="+", choices=OEMS, default=list(OEMS), help="Subset of OEMs to build")
    p.add_argument("--controller-keystore", default="", help="Optional release keystore for KernBox.apk")
    p.add_argument("--controller-alias", default="kernbox-controller", help="Optional keystore alias for KernBox.apk")
    p.add_argument("--controller-storepass-env", default="", help="Optional env var holding keystore password")
    p.add_argument("--go", default="", help="Path to go executable")
    p.add_argument("--jdk", default="", help="Optional JDK home")
    p.add_argument("--sdk", default="", help="Optional Android SDK root")
    p.add_argument("--ndk", default="", help="Optional Android NDK home")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)

    go_exe = resolve_go(args.go)
    out_dir = args.out.resolve()
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage_dir = out_dir / ".stage"
    if stage_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(stage_dir)
    stage_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    try:
        ctrl_meta = build_controller_apk(out_dir, args)
        apk_meta = build_verify_apk(out_dir, args)
        broker_bin = build_native_broker(stage_dir, args)

        zygisk_map: dict[str, pathlib.Path] = {}
        for idx, oem in enumerate(args.oems):
            zygisk_map[oem] = build_zygisk_oem(oem, stage_dir, args, skip_dex=(idx > 0))

        variants = []
        for oem in args.oems:
            for kernel, roots in KERNEL_ROOT_PAIRS:
                guard_bin = build_go_guard(go_exe, oem, kernel, args.version, stage_dir)
                for root in roots:
                    zip_name = f"KernBox-{oem}-{kernel}-{root}-arm64.zip"
                    meta = pack_variant.pack_variant(
                        oem=oem,
                        kernel=kernel,
                        root=root,
                        version=args.version,
                        guard_bin=guard_bin,
                        broker_bin=broker_bin,
                        zygisk_so=zygisk_map[oem],
                        out_zip=out_dir / zip_name,
                        quiet=False,
                    )
                    variants.append(meta)

        checksum_lines = [f"{m['sha256']}  {m['artifact']}" for m in variants]
        checksum_lines.append(f"{ctrl_meta['sha256']}  {ctrl_meta['artifact']}")
        checksum_lines.append(f"{apk_meta['sha256']}  {apk_meta['artifact']}")
        (out_dir / "SHA256SUMS.txt").write_text("\n".join(checksum_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

        manifest = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "version": args.version,
            "generated_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
            "total_variants": len(variants),
            "controller_apk": ctrl_meta,
            "verify_apk": apk_meta,
            "variants": variants,
        }
        (out_dir / "variants-manifest.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
        )
        print(f"MATRIX_BUILD_COMPLETE total_variants={len(variants)} out={out_dir}")
        return 0
    finally:
        if stage_dir.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage_dir, ignore_errors=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tools/probe_device.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read-only anonymized ADB device prober for KernBox multi-variant selection.
.DESCRIPTION
  Collects OEM signals, Android SDK, CPU ABI, kernel version, cgroup v2 freezer support,
  TProxy netfilter support, root manager flavor, and Zygisk provider availability.
  Compatible with Windows PowerShell 5.1+ and PowerShell 7+.
  Never collects or outputs hardware serials, IMEI, MAC addresses, or IP addresses.
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Serial = "",
    [string]$Out = "",
    [string]$Adb = "adb"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Invoke-AdbNative {
    param([string[]]$AdbArgs, [string]$StdinText = "")
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    try {
        if ($StdinText -ne "") {
            $res = $StdinText | & $Adb @AdbArgs 2>&1
        } else {
            $res = & $Adb @AdbArgs 2>&1
        }
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $code
        Output   = ($res | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Out-String).Trim()
    }
}

function Invoke-AdbShellScript {
    param([string]$ScriptText)
    $lf = $ScriptText.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "")
    $full = @()
    if ($Serial -ne "") {
        $full += @("-s", $Serial)
    }
    $full += @("shell", "sh")
    $r = Invoke-AdbNative -AdbArgs $full -StdinText $lf
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "adb $($full -join ' ') failed ($($r.ExitCode)): $($r.Output)"
    }
    return $r.Output
}

$adbCmd = Get-Command $Adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $adbCmd -and -not (Test-Path $Adb)) {
    throw "ADB executable '$Adb' not found in PATH."
}

$devRes = Invoke-AdbNative -AdbArgs @("devices")
if ($devRes.ExitCode -ne 0) {
    throw "adb devices failed: $($devRes.Output)"
}
$devicesRaw = $devRes.Output
$online = @()
foreach ($line in ($devicesRaw -split "`r?`n")) {
    if ($line -match '^(\S+)\s+device\b') {
        $online += $Matches[1]
    } elseif ($line -match '^(\S+)\s+(unauthorized|offline)\b') {
        if ($Serial -eq "" -or $Serial -eq $Matches[1]) {
            throw "ADB device is $($Matches[2]). Unlock screen and accept RSA authorization."
        }
    }
}
if ($online.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "No authorized online ADB device found."
}
if ($Serial -eq "" -and $online.Count -gt 1) {
    throw "Multiple ADB devices detected ($($online.Count)); pass -Serial <target> to disambiguate."
}

$shellProbe = @'
getprop_s() { getprop "$1" 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r\n"; }
echo "MFG=$(getprop_s ro.product.manufacturer)"
echo "BRAND=$(getprop_s ro.product.brand)"
echo "SDK=$(getprop_s ro.build.version.sdk)"
echo "REL=$(getprop_s ro.build.version.release)"
echo "ABI=$(getprop_s ro.product.cpu.abi)"
echo "FLAVOR=$(getprop_s ro.build.flavor)"
echo "MIUI_UI=$(getprop_s ro.miui.ui.version.name)"
echo "HYPEROS=$(getprop_s ro.mi.os.version.name)"
echo "OPLUSROM=$(getprop_s ro.build.version.oplusrom)"
echo "ONEUI=$(getprop_s ro.build.version.oneui)"
echo "KREL=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n')"
echo "VBSTATE=$(getprop_s ro.boot.verifiedbootstate)"
echo "FLOCKED=$(getprop_s ro.boot.flash.locked)"
echo "BTAGS=$(getprop_s ro.build.tags)"
echo "ADB_EN=$(settings get global adb_enabled 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n')"
ACC_RAW=$(settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n')
if [ -n "$ACC_RAW" ] && [ "$ACC_RAW" != "null" ]; then echo "ACC_ON=1"; else echo "ACC_ON=0"; fi
echo "USERS_V=$(cmd user list -v 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' '|' | tr -d '\r')"
echo "USERS_PM=$(pm list users 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' '|' | tr -d '\r')"

ROOT_OUT=$(su -c '
  rmgr="none"; rver=""
  if [ -x /data/adb/ksu/bin/ksud ]; then
    rmgr="ksu"
    rver=$(/data/adb/ksu/bin/ksud -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif command -v ksud >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rmgr="ksu"
    rver=$(ksud -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif [ -x /data/adb/ap/bin/apd ]; then
    rmgr="apatch"
    rver=$(/data/adb/ap/bin/apd -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif command -v apd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rmgr="apatch"
    rver=$(apd -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif command -v magisk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rmgr="magisk"
    rver=$(magisk -v 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif [ -d /data/adb/ksu ]; then
    rmgr="ksu"
  elif [ -d /data/adb/ap ]; then
    rmgr="apatch"
  elif [ -d /data/adb/magisk ]; then
    rmgr="magisk"
  fi
  zy=0; ts=0; pif=0; hider=0
  for p in /data/adb/modules/*; do
    [ -d "$p" ] && [ ! -e "$p/disable" ] && [ ! -e "$p/remove" ] || continue
    mod_id=""
    if [ -f "$p/module.prop" ]; then
      mod_id=$(grep -m1 "^id=" "$p/module.prop" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d "\r\n" | tr "A-Z" "a-z" || true)
    fi
    base=${p##*/}
    base_low=$(printf "%s" "$base" | tr "A-Z" "a-z")
    case "$mod_id:$base_low" in
      *zygisksu*|*rezygisk*|*zygisknext*|*zygisk_next*) zy=1 ;;
    esac
    case "$mod_id:$base_low" in
      *tricky_store*|*trickystore*) ts=1 ;;
    esac
    case "$mod_id:$base_low" in
      *playintegrityfix*|*playintegrity*|*pif*|*playcurl*) pif=1 ;;
    esac
    case "$mod_id:$base_low" in
      *shamiko*|*zygisk_assistant*|*susfs*) hider=1 ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ "$zy" = 0 ] && [ "$rmgr" = "magisk" ]; then
    if magisk --sqlite "SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='\''zygisk'\''" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "1"; then
      zy=1
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$rmgr" = "ksu" ] || [ "$rmgr" = "apatch" ]; then
    hider=1
  fi
  cg2=0
  if ls /sys/fs/cgroup/uid_*/cgroup.freeze >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -e /sys/fs/cgroup/uid_0/cgroup.freeze ]; then
    cg2=1
  elif grep -qs "cgroup2" /proc/mounts 2>/dev/null && find /sys/fs/cgroup -maxdepth 2 -name cgroup.freeze 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
    cg2=1
  fi
  tp=0
  if grep -qw TPROXY /proc/net/ip_tables_targets 2>/dev/null; then
    tp=1
  elif iptables -t mangle -j TPROXY --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    tp=1
  elif iptables -t mangle -L PREROUTING -n >/dev/null 2>&1 && zcat /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_TPROXY=[ym]"; then
    tp=1
  elif command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1 && zcat /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "CONFIG_NFT_TPROXY=[ym]"; then
    tp=1
  fi
  inst=0
  [ -d /data/adb/modules/sandbox_guard ] || [ -x /data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ] && inst=1
  printf "ROOT=%s\nROOTVER=%s\nZYGISK=%s\nCG2=%s\nTPROXY=%s\nINSTALLED=%s\nTS=%s\nPIF=%s\nHIDER=%s\nROOT_DENIED=0\n" "$rmgr" "$rver" "$zy" "$cg2" "$tp" "$inst" "$ts" "$pif" "$hider"
' 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$ROOT_OUT" ]; then
  echo "ROOT=none"
  if command -v su >/dev/null 2>&1 || pm list packages 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "me\.weishu\.kernelsu|com\.topjohnwu\.magisk|me\.bmax\.apatch|io\.github\.huskydg\.magisk"; then
    echo "ROOT_DENIED=1"
  else
    echo "ROOT_DENIED=0"
  fi
else
  echo "$ROOT_OUT"
fi
'@

$raw = Invoke-AdbShellScript $shellProbe
$kv = @{}
foreach ($line in ($raw -split "`r?`n")) {
    $idx = $line.IndexOf('=')
    if ($idx -gt 0) {
        $k = $line.Substring(0, $idx).Trim()
        $v = $line.Substring($idx + 1).Trim()
        $kv[$k] = $v
    }
}

$krel = "$($kv['KREL'])"
$kmaj = 0
$kmin = 0
if ($krel -match '^(\d+)\.(\d+)') {
    $kmaj = [int]$Matches[1]
    $kmin = [int]$Matches[2]
}

$sdk = 0
if ("$($kv['SDK'])" -match '^\d+$') { $sdk = [int]$kv['SDK'] }

$excludedCloneUsers = @(95, 150, 999)
$workUserSet = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.SortedSet[int]'
if ($kv['USERS_V']) {
    foreach ($u in ($kv['USERS_V'] -split '\|')) {
        if ($u -match 'id=(\d+).*(MANAGED_PROFILE|profile\.MANAGED)') {
            $uid = [int]$Matches[1]
            if ($uid -gt 0 -and ($excludedCloneUsers -notcontains $uid)) { [void]$workUserSet.Add($uid) }
        }
    }
}
if ($kv['USERS_PM']) {
    foreach ($u in ($kv['USERS_PM'] -split '\|')) {
        if ($u -match 'UserInfo\{(\d+):[^:]*:([0-9a-fA-F]+)\}') {
            $uid = [int]$Matches[1]
            $flags = [Convert]::ToInt32($Matches[2], 16)
            if ($uid -gt 0 -and ($excludedCloneUsers -notcontains $uid) -and (($flags -band 0x20) -ne 0)) {
                [void]$workUserSet.Add($uid)
            }
        }
    }
}
$workUsers = @()
foreach ($uid in $workUserSet) { $workUsers += $uid }

$rootMgr = "none"
if ($kv['ROOT'] -and $kv['ROOT'] -ne "") { $rootMgr = "$($kv['ROOT'])" }

$profile = [ordered]@{
    schema_version = 1
    manufacturer = "$($kv['MFG'])"
    brand = "$($kv['BRAND'])"
    android_sdk = $sdk
    android_release = "$($kv['REL'])"
    cpu_abi = "$($kv['ABI'])"
    kernel_release = $krel
    kernel_major = $kmaj
    kernel_minor = $kmin
    oem_signals = [ordered]@{
        miui_ui_version = "$($kv['MIUI_UI'])"
        hyperos_version = "$($kv['HYPEROS'])"
        oplusrom = "$($kv['OPLUSROM'])"
        oneui = "$($kv['ONEUI'])"
        build_flavor = "$($kv['FLAVOR'])"
    }
    root_manager = $rootMgr
    root_version = "$($kv['ROOTVER'])"
    root_access_denied = ($kv['ROOT_DENIED'] -eq '1')
    zygisk_detected = ($kv['ZYGISK'] -eq '1')
    cgroup_v2_freeze = ($kv['CG2'] -eq '1')
    tproxy_capable = ($kv['TPROXY'] -eq '1')
    work_profile_users = @($workUsers)
    existing_guard_installed = ($kv['INSTALLED'] -eq '1')
    real_device_readiness = [ordered]@{
        bootloader_verified_state = "$($kv['VBSTATE'])"
        bootloader_flash_locked = "$($kv['FLOCKED'])"
        build_tags = "$($kv['BTAGS'])"
        adb_enabled = ($kv['ADB_EN'] -eq '1')
        accessibility_services_active = ($kv['ACC_ON'] -eq '1')
        trickystore_detected = ($kv['TS'] -eq '1')
        pif_detected = ($kv['PIF'] -eq '1')
        root_hider_detected = ($kv['HIDER'] -eq '1')
    }
}

$json = $profile | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
if ($Out -ne "") {
    if ([System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Out)) {
        $resolvedOut = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Out)
    } else {
        $resolvedOut = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Get-Location).Path $Out))
    }
    $outDir = Split-Path -Parent $resolvedOut
    if ($outDir) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
    }
    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($resolvedOut, $json.Replace("`r`n", "`n") + "`n", $utf8NoBom)
    Write-Output "Wrote anonymized device profile to $resolvedOut"
} else {
    Write-Output $json
}
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Read-only anonymized ADB device prober for KernBox variant selection.
# Collects NO hardware serials, IMEIs, MAC addresses, or IP addresses.
set -eu

SERIAL=""
OUT=""
ADB_BIN=${ADB_BIN:-adb}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
        -s|--serial) SERIAL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        -o|--out) OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --adb) ADB_BIN="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        *) echo "Unknown arg: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done

command -v "$ADB_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "adb not found" >&2; exit 1; }

adb_run() {
    if [ -n "$SERIAL" ]; then
        "$ADB_BIN" -s "$SERIAL" "$@"
    else
        "$ADB_BIN" "$@"
    fi
}

if [ -z "$SERIAL" ]; then
    DEV_LINES=$("$ADB_BIN" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')
    CNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$DEV_LINES" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)
    if [ "$CNT" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "No authorized online ADB device found." >&2
        exit 1
    elif [ "$CNT" -gt 1 ]; then
        echo "Multiple ADB devices connected; pass --serial <id>." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

RAW=$(adb_run shell '
getprop_s() { getprop "$1" 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r\n"; }

echo "REL=$(getprop_s ro.build.version.release)"
echo "ABI=$(getprop_s ro.product.cpu.abi)"
echo "FLAVOR=$(getprop_s ro.build.flavor)"
echo "MIUI_UI=$(getprop_s ro.miui.ui.version.name)"
echo "HYPEROS=$(getprop_s ro.mi.os.version.name)"
echo "OPLUSROM=$(getprop_s ro.build.version.oplusrom)"
echo "ONEUI=$(getprop_s ro.build.version.oneui)"
echo "KREL=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r\n")"

echo "BTAGS=$(getprop_s ro.build.tags)"
echo "ADB_EN=$(settings get global adb_enabled 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r\n")"
ACC_RAW=$(settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r\n")
if [ -n "$ACC_RAW" ] && [ "$ACC_RAW" != "null" ]; then echo "ACC_ON=1"; else echo "ACC_ON=0"; fi
echo "USERS_V=$(cmd user list -v 2>/dev/null | tr "\n" "|" | tr -d "\r")"
echo "USERS_PM=$(pm list users 2>/dev/null | tr "\n" "|" | tr -d "\r")"
su -c "
  rmgr=none; rver=
  if [ -x /data/adb/ksu/bin/ksud ]; then
    rmgr=ksu
    rver=\$(/data/adb/ksu/bin/ksud -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif command -v ksud >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rmgr=ksu
    rver=\$(ksud -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif [ -x /data/adb/ap/bin/apd ]; then
    rmgr=apatch
    rver=\$(/data/adb/ap/bin/apd -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif command -v apd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rmgr=apatch
    rver=\$(apd -V 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif command -v magisk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rmgr=magisk
    rver=\$(magisk -v 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  elif [ -d /data/adb/ksu ]; then
    rmgr=ksu
  elif [ -d /data/adb/ap ]; then
    rmgr=apatch
  elif [ -d /data/adb/magisk ]; then
    rmgr=magisk
  fi
  zy=0; ts=0; pif=0; hider=0
  for p in /data/adb/modules/*; do
    [ -d \"\$p\" ] && [ ! -e \"\$p/disable\" ] && [ ! -e \"\$p/remove\" ] || continue
    mod_id=

      *tricky_store*|*trickystore*) ts=1 ;;

    tp=1
  elif iptables -t mangle -L PREROUTING -n >/dev/null 2>&1 && zcat /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq \"CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_TPROXY=[ym]\"; then
    tp=1
  elif command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1 && zcat /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq \"CONFIG_NFT_TPROXY=[ym]\"; then
    tp=1
  fi
  inst=0
  { [ -d /data/adb/modules/sandbox_guard ] || [ -x /data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ]; } && inst=1
  printf \"ROOT=%s\nROOTVER=%s\nZYGISK=%s\nCG2=%s\nTPROXY=%s\nINSTALLED=%s\nTS=%s\nPIF=%s\nHIDER=%s\nROOT_DENIED=0\n\" \"\$rmgr\" \"\$rver\" \"\$zy\" \"\$cg2\" \"\$tp\" \"\$inst\" \"\$ts\" \"\$pif\" \"\$hider\"
" 2>/dev/null || {
  echo "ROOT=none"
  if command -v su >/dev/null 2>&1 || pm list packages 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "me\.weishu\.kernelsu|com\.topjohnwu\.magisk|me\.bmax\.apatch|io\.github\.huskydg\.magisk"; then
    echo "ROOT_DENIED=1"
  else
    echo "ROOT_DENIED=0"
  fi

import json, re, sys
kv = {}
for line in sys.stdin.read().splitlines():
    if "=" in line:
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        kv[k.strip()] = v.strip()
krel = kv.get("KREL", "")
m = re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)", krel)
kmaj, kmin = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))) if m else (0, 0)

    if um:
        uid = int(um.group(1))
        if uid > 0 and uid not in EXCLUDED_CLONE_USERS:
            work.add(uid)

    um = re.search(r"UserInfo\{(\d+):[^:]*:([0-9a-fA-F]+)\}", part)
    if um:
        uid = int(um.group(1))
        flags = int(um.group(2), 16)
        if uid > 0 and uid not in EXCLUDED_CLONE_USERS and (flags & 0x20) != 0:
            work.add(uid)
print(json.dumps({
    "schema_version": 1,
    "manufacturer": kv.get("MFG", ""),
    "brand": kv.get("BRAND", ""),
    "android_sdk": sdk,
    "android_release": kv.get("REL", ""),
    "cpu_abi": kv.get("ABI", ""),
    "kernel_release": krel,
    "kernel_major": kmaj,
    "kernel_minor": kmin,
    "oem_signals": {
        "miui_ui_version": kv.get("MIUI_UI", ""),
        "hyperos_version": kv.get("HYPEROS", ""),
        "oplusrom": kv.get("OPLUSROM", ""),
        "oneui": kv.get("ONEUI", ""),
        "build_flavor": kv.get("FLAVOR", ""),
    },
    "root_manager": kv.get("ROOT") or "none",
    "root_version": kv.get("ROOTVER", ""),
    "root_access_denied": kv.get("ROOT_DENIED") == "1",
    "zygisk_detected": kv.get("ZYGISK") == "1",
    "cgroup_v2_freeze": kv.get("CG2") == "1",
    "tproxy_capable": kv.get("TPROXY") == "1",
    "work_profile_users": sorted(work),
    "existing_guard_installed": kv.get("INSTALLED") == "1",
    "real_device_readiness": {
        "bootloader_verified_state": kv.get("VBSTATE", ""),
        "bootloader_flash_locked": kv.get("FLOCKED", ""),
        "build_tags": kv.get("BTAGS", ""),
        "adb_enabled": kv.get("ADB_EN") == "1",
        "accessibility_services_active": kv.get("ACC_ON") == "1",
        "trickystore_detected": kv.get("TS") == "1",
        "pif_detected": kv.get("PIF") == "1",
        "root_hider_detected": kv.get("HIDER") == "1",
    },
}, indent=2))

    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$OUT")"
    printf '%s\n' "$JSON" > "$OUT"
    echo "Wrote anonymized device profile to $OUT"
```

`tools/select_variant.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic variant selector mapping an anonymized device_profile.json to the optimal build."""

import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple


SUPPORTED_OEMS = ("hyperos", "oplus", "oneui", "aosp", "generic")
SUPPORTED_KERNELS = ("k510", "k419")
SUPPORTED_ROOTS = ("ksu", "ksu_legacy", "magisk", "apatch")
MATRIX_KERNEL_ROOTS = {
    "k510": ("ksu", "magisk", "apatch"),
    "k419": ("ksu_legacy", "magisk", "apatch"),
}
CUSTOM_AOSP_FLAVOR_TOKENS = (
    "lineage",
    "graphene",
    "calyx",
    "crdroid",
    "aosp",
    "evolution",
    "pixelexperience",
    "pixelos",
    "paranoid",
)
PIXEL_FLAVOR_TOKENS = ("pixel", "panther", "cheetah", "husky", "shiba", "oriole", "raven", "komodo", "tokay")


def parse_kernel_tuple(profile: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    maj = profile.get("kernel_major")
    min_v = profile.get("kernel_minor")
    if isinstance(maj, int) and isinstance(min_v, int) and maj > 0:
        return maj, min_v
    krel = str(profile.get("kernel_release") or "")
    m = re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)", krel.strip())
    if m:
        return int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
    return 0, 0


def parse_semver_tuple(ver_str: str) -> Optional[Tuple[int, int, int]]:
    m = re.search(r"v?(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?", str(ver_str or ""))
    if not m:
        return None
    return int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3) or 0)


def determine_oem(profile: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    brand = str(profile.get("brand") or "").strip().lower()
    mfg = str(profile.get("manufacturer") or "").strip().lower()
    sigs = profile.get("oem_signals") or {}
    miui = str(sigs.get("miui_ui_version") or "").strip()
    hyperos = str(sigs.get("hyperos_version") or "").strip()
    oplusrom = str(sigs.get("oplusrom") or "").strip()
    oneui = str(sigs.get("oneui") or "").strip()
    flavor = str(sigs.get("build_flavor") or "").strip().lower()

    has_oem_ui = bool(miui or hyperos or oplusrom or oneui)
    if not has_oem_ui and any(tok in flavor for tok in CUSTOM_AOSP_FLAVOR_TOKENS):
        return "aosp", "Detected custom AOSP-based ROM without proprietary OEM skin; using oem_aosp."

    if miui or hyperos or brand in ("xiaomi", "redmi", "poco") or mfg in ("xiaomi",):
        return "hyperos", "Detected Xiaomi/HyperOS/MIUI ROM signals; using oem_hyperos (MIUI hide-app + Millet + clone exclusions)."
    if oplusrom or brand in ("oneplus", "oppo", "realme") or mfg in ("oneplus", "oppo", "realme"):
        return "oplus", "Detected ColorOS/OxygenOS/RealmeUI signals; using oem_oplus (Hans freezer + multi-app clone 999)."
    if oneui or brand in ("samsung",) or mfg in ("samsung",):
        return "oneui", "Detected Samsung One UI signals; using oem_oneui (Dual Messenger/Secure Folder clone protections)."
    if brand in ("google",) or mfg in ("google",) or any(tok in flavor for tok in PIXEL_FLAVOR_TOKENS):
        return "aosp", "Detected Pixel / pure AOSP-based ROM; using oem_aosp (minimal lean profile)."
    return "generic", "No specialized OEM skin detected; falling back to oem_generic (safe conservative compatibility)."


def determine_kernel(profile: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    maj, min_v = parse_kernel_tuple(profile)
    cg2 = bool(profile.get("cgroup_v2_freeze"))
    if (maj, min_v) >= (5, 10) and cg2:
        return "k510", f"Kernel {maj}.{min_v} >= 5.10 with cgroup v2 freezer active -> fast k510 tier (openat2 + pidfd + cgroup v2 freeze + process_madvise)."
    if (maj, min_v) >= (5, 10) and not cg2:
        return "k419", f"Kernel {maj}.{min_v} >= 5.10 lacks active cgroup v2 freezer -> falling back safely to k419 compat tier."
    if maj > 0:
        return "k419", f"Kernel {maj}.{min_v} < 5.10 -> using k419 compat tier (openat O_NOFOLLOW walk + cgroup v1 freezer fallback)."
    return "k419", "Kernel version undetermined; conservatively selecting k419 compat tier."


def determine_root_and_tier(profile: Dict[str, Any], kernel: str) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str], str, Optional[str]]:
    raw_root = str(profile.get("root_manager") or "").strip().lower()
    raw_ver = str(profile.get("root_version") or "").strip()

    if raw_root in ("", "none", "unknown"):
        if profile.get("root_access_denied"):
            return (
                kernel,
                None,
                "ADB shell su permission was denied by your root manager: grant Shell (com.android.shell) root access in KernelSU / Magisk / APatch Manager and re-run probe_device.",
                None,
            )
        return kernel, None, "No supported root manager (KernelSU / Magisk / APatch) detected via ADB.", None
    if raw_root == "ksu_legacy":
        warn = None
        if kernel != "k419":
            warn = f"Explicit ksu_legacy root requires the k419 compat matrix tier (downgrading {kernel} -> k419)."
            kernel = "k419"
        return kernel, "ksu_legacy", "Explicit ksu_legacy root profile mapped to k419/ksu_legacy.", warn
    if raw_root in ("ksu", "kernelsu"):
        ver = parse_semver_tuple(raw_ver)
        is_legacy_ver = ver is not None and (ver[0], ver[1]) < (0, 9)
        if ver is None:
            cm = re.search(r"\b(\d{4,6})\b", raw_ver)
            if cm and int(cm.group(1)) < 11400:
                is_legacy_ver = True
        if is_legacy_ver:
            warn = None
            if kernel != "k419":
                warn = f"Legacy KernelSU {raw_ver} (< 0.9 / versionCode < 11400) maps to k419/ksu_legacy release artifact."
                kernel = "k419"
            return kernel, "ksu_legacy", f"KernelSU ({raw_ver}) mapped to k419/ksu_legacy.", warn
        if kernel == "k419":
            return kernel, "ksu_legacy", f"KernelSU ({raw_ver or 'compat'}) on k419 mapped to ksu_legacy.", None
        return kernel, "ksu", f"KernelSU ({raw_ver or 'modern'}) on {kernel} mapped to ksu.", None
    if raw_root == "magisk":
        return kernel, "magisk", f"Magisk ({raw_ver or 'detected'}) mapped to {kernel}/magisk.", None
    if raw_root == "apatch":
        return kernel, "apatch", f"APatch ({raw_ver or 'detected'}) mapped to {kernel}/apatch.", None
    return kernel, None, f"Unsupported root manager {raw_root!r}; expected one of ksu, ksu_legacy, magisk, apatch.", None


def install_command_for_root(root: str, artifact: str) -> str:
    remote = f"/data/local/tmp/{artifact}"
    if root in ("ksu", "ksu_legacy"):
        return f'adb push "{artifact}" {remote} && adb shell su -c "ksud module install {remote}"'
    if root == "magisk":
        return f'adb push "{artifact}" {remote} && adb shell su -c "magisk --install-module {remote}"'
    if root == "apatch":
        return f'adb push "{artifact}" {remote} && adb shell su -c "apd module install {remote}"'
    return f"adb push {artifact} {remote}"


def select_variant(profile: Dict[str, Any], version: str = "1.2.0", preset: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    errors: List[str] = []
    warnings: List[str] = []
    reasons: List[str] = []

    abi = str(profile.get("cpu_abi") or "").strip().lower()
    if abi != "arm64-v8a":
        errors.append(f"Unsupported CPU ABI {abi!r}: KernBox only supports arm64-v8a devices.")

    sdk = int(profile.get("android_sdk") or 0)
    if sdk <= 0:
        errors.append("Missing android_sdk in device profile (Android 12 / API 31+ required).")
    elif sdk < 31:
        errors.append(f"Unsupported Android SDK {sdk} (Android {profile.get('android_release') or '?'}): API 31+ (Android 12+) is required.")

    oem, oem_reason = determine_oem(profile)
    reasons.append(oem_reason)

    kernel, kernel_reason = determine_kernel(profile)
    reasons.append(kernel_reason)

    kernel, root, root_reason, tier_warn = determine_root_and_tier(profile, kernel)
    if tier_warn:
        warnings.append(tier_warn)
    if root is None:
        errors.append(root_reason)
    else:
        reasons.append(root_reason)
        allowed_roots = MATRIX_KERNEL_ROOTS.get(kernel, ())
        if root not in allowed_roots:
            errors.append(f"Unsupported combination ({kernel}, {root}); expected root in {allowed_roots}.")

    if not profile.get("zygisk_detected", False):
        if root == "magisk":
            warnings.append("Zygisk is NOT active in Magisk: enable 'Zygisk' in Magisk Settings and reboot so SystemServer/Phone stealth works.")
        else:
            warnings.append(f"Zygisk module (ZygiskNext / ReZygisk) NOT detected alongside {root or 'root'}: install ZygiskNext or ReZygisk before expecting SystemServer/Phone stealth.")

    if "tproxy_capable" in profile and not profile.get("tproxy_capable"):
        warnings.append("TProxy netfilter target not confirmed in /proc/net/ip_tables_targets; verify kernel CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_TPROXY or use a TProxy-capable kernel.")

    work_users = profile.get("work_profile_users") or []
    work_user = int(work_users[0]) if work_users else 10
    if not work_users:
        warnings.append("No active Work Profile user detected yet; provision User 10 via Shelter / TestDPC / your profile controller before activating guard rules.")

    readiness = profile.get("real_device_readiness")
    if not isinstance(readiness, dict):
        readiness = {}
    if not preset:
        warnings.append(
            "Default 'neutral' config leaves spoof_carrier=false and spoof_device_region=false; "
            "pass --preset <name> (e.g. jp-docomo, us-tmobile, uk-ee, sg-singtel, de-telekom) "
            "or run `ctl preset-apply` to align carrier/locale/timezone with your proxy exit country."
        )
    vb_state = str(readiness.get("bootloader_verified_state") or "").strip().lower()
    flash_locked = str(readiness.get("bootloader_flash_locked") or "").strip()
    if ((vb_state and vb_state != "green") or flash_locked == "0") and not readiness.get("trickystore_detected"):
        warnings.append(
            "Unlocked bootloader detected without TrickyStore: hardware KeyMint RootOfTrust attestation "
            "will still reveal unlocked state unless paired with TrickyStore (+ PlayIntegrityFix)."
        )
    if root == "magisk" and readiness.get("root_hider_detected") is False:
        warnings.append(
            "Magisk detected without Shamiko / Zygisk Assistant / SuSFS: enable Enforce DenyList "
            "(or install Shamiko) so /proc/self/mountinfo and su paths stay hidden."
        )
    if readiness.get("adb_enabled") is True:
        warnings.append(
            "USB Debugging (adb_enabled=1) is active: turn off USB Debugging after installation and "
            "verification so apps inspecting Settings.Global.ADB_ENABLED see a retail device."
        )
    if readiness.get("accessibility_services_active") is True:
        warnings.append(
            "Active Android Accessibility Service(s) detected: non-essential accessibility services "
            "can trigger Play Integrity appAccessRiskVerdict; disable them before sensitive use."
        )

    artifact = f"KernBox-{oem}-{kernel}-{root}-arm64.zip" if (not errors and root) else None

    result: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "ok": len(errors) == 0,
        "oem": oem,
        "kernel": kernel,
        "root": root,
        "version": version,
        "artifact": artifact,
        "target_work_user": work_user,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "warnings": warnings,
        "errors": errors,
        "commands": {},
    }
    if artifact:
        cmds = {
            "install": install_command_for_root(root, artifact),
            "reboot": "adb reboot",
            "status_check": 'adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl variant-info && /data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl status && /data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl stealth-status"',
            "verify_install": f'adb install -r --user {work_user} KernBoxVerify.apk && adb shell am instrument --user {work_user} -w com.sandbox.verify/com.sandbox.verify.NetworkProbe',
            "verify_cleanup": f"adb uninstall --user {work_user} com.sandbox.verify",
        }
        if preset:
            preset_name = preset if preset.endswith(".json") else f"{preset}.json"
            cmds["preset_apply"] = (
                f'adb push "presets/{preset_name}" "/data/local/tmp/{preset_name}" && '
                f'adb shell su -c "/data/adb/sandbox_guard/sandbox_guard ctl preset-apply /data/local/tmp/{preset_name}"'
            )
        result["commands"] = cmds
    return result


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Select optimal KernBox variant from device_profile.json")
    p.add_argument("--profile", required=True, help="Path to device_profile.json (or '-' for stdin)")
    p.add_argument("--version", default="1.2.0", help="Release version tag")
    p.add_argument("--preset", help="Optional preset name under presets/ (e.g. jp-docomo, us-tmobile)")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit structured JSON output")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)

    raw = sys.stdin.read() if args.profile == "-" else pathlib.Path(args.profile).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    profile = json.loads(raw)
    res = select_variant(profile, version=args.version, preset=args.preset)

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(res, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        if not res["ok"]:
            print("SELECTION FAILED:", file=sys.stderr)
            for err in res["errors"]:
                print(f"  [ERROR] {err}", file=sys.stderr)
            for warn in res["warnings"]:
                print(f"  [WARN]  {warn}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        print(f"SELECTED VARIANT : {res['artifact']}")
        print(f"PROFILE TUPLE    : oem={res['oem']} kernel={res['kernel']} root={res['root']} work_user={res['target_work_user']}")
        for r in res["reasons"]:
            print(f"  - {r}")
        for w in res["warnings"]:
            print(f"  [WARN] {w}")
        print("\nNEXT COMMANDS:")
        for label, cmd in res["commands"].items():
            print(f"  {label}: {cmd}")

    return 0 if res["ok"] else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```py
import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile

REPO_ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PACKAGING = REPO_ROOT / "packaging"

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(PACKAGING))
import pack_variant  # noqa: E402


class TestPackagingVariants(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ksu_and_legacy_sepolicy_cover_both_ksu_and_su_domains(self):
        for rule_name in ("ksu.rule", "ksu_legacy.rule"):
            text = (PACKAGING / "sepolicy" / rule_name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for required in (
                "allow ksu sandbox_broker process transition",
                "allow su sandbox_broker process transition",
                "type_transition ksu sandbox_broker_exec process sandbox_broker",
                "type_transition su sandbox_broker_exec process sandbox_broker",
                "allow sandbox_broker su fd use",
                "allow sandbox_broker ksu fd use",
            ):
                self.assertIn(required, text, f"{rule_name} missing: {required}")

    def test_version_to_code_monotonic(self):
        c1 = int(pack_variant.version_to_code("1.1.0"))
        c2 = int(pack_variant.version_to_code("1.1.10"))
        c3 = int(pack_variant.version_to_code("1.2.0"))
        self.assertLess(c1, c2)
        self.assertLess(c2, c3)
        self.assertEqual(c3, 10200)

    def test_pack_variant_emits_unix_lf_and_valid_zip(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            tmp = pathlib.Path(td)
            dummy = tmp / "bin"
            dummy.write_bytes(b"\x7fELFdummy")
            out_zip = tmp / "KernBox-test.zip"
            pack_variant.pack_variant(
                oem="hyperos",
                kernel="k510",
                root="ksu",
                version="1.2.0",
                guard_bin=dummy,
                broker_bin=dummy,
                zygisk_so=dummy,
                out_zip=out_zip,
            )
            with zipfile.ZipFile(out_zip) as zf:
                self.assertIsNone(zf.testzip())
                for name in ("service.sh", "post-fs-data.sh", "customize.sh", "action.sh", "uninstall.sh", "sepolicy.rule", "module.prop"):
                    self.assertIn(name, zf.namelist())
                    raw = zf.read(name)
                    self.assertNotIn(b"\r\n", raw, f"CRLF detected in {name}")
                for exec_sh in ("service.sh", "post-fs-data.sh", "customize.sh", "action.sh", "uninstall.sh"):
                    mode = (zf.getinfo(exec_sh).external_attr >> 16) & 0o777
                    self.assertEqual(mode, 0o755, f"{exec_sh} mode={oct(mode)}")
                self.assertIn(b"versionCode=10200\n", zf.read("module.prop"))

                uninstall_sh = zf.read("uninstall.sh").decode("utf-8")
                self.assertIn("ctl start-sandbox", uninstall_sh)
                self.assertNotIn("ctl resume", uninstall_sh)
                self.assertIn("mangle -D POSTROUTING -j SBW_EGRESS", uninstall_sh)
                self.assertIn("mangle:SBW_EGRESS", uninstall_sh)

                action_sh = zf.read("action.sh").decode("utf-8")
                self.assertIn("ctl start-sandbox", action_sh)
                self.assertIn("ctl pause-sandbox", action_sh)
                self.assertNotIn("ctl resume", action_sh)
                self.assertNotIn("ctl pause\n", action_sh)

                customize_sh = zf.read("customize.sh").decode("utf-8")
                for must_exec in ("action.sh", "uninstall.sh", "bin/sandbox_guard", "bin/sandbox_broker"):
                    self.assertIn(must_exec, customize_sh)

                service_sh = zf.read("service.sh").decode("utf-8")
                self.assertIn("9>&- &", service_sh)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import pathlib
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import verify_privacy_leak as vpl


class PrivacyLeakScannerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_clean_repo_passes(self):
        files = vpl.collect_candidate_files(vpl.REPO_ROOT, "git")
        findings = vpl.scan_files(vpl.REPO_ROOT, files)
        self.assertEqual(findings, [], f"Unexpected findings in repo: {findings}")

    def test_detects_sensitive_literals_paths_keys_and_crlf(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = pathlib.Path(td)
            (root / "a.txt").write_text("device=" + "23054" + "RA19C" + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "b.go").write_text('const p = "COM.' + 'LEGEND.work"\n', encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "c.md").write_text("path=" + "C:\\Use" + "rs\\alice\\work\\file\n", encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "d.md").write_text("unix=/ho" + "me/developer/src\n", encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "k.pem").write_text("-----BEGIN RSA " + "PRIVATE KEY-----\nabc\n", encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "cert.crt").write_text("cert\n", encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "module.prop.tmpl").write_bytes(b"id=sandbox_guard\r\n")
            (root / "s.sh").write_bytes(b"#!/bin/sh\r\necho hi\r\n")
            (root / "app.apk").write_bytes(b"PK\x03\x04")
            files = vpl.collect_candidate_files(root, "walk")
            findings = vpl.scan_files(root, files)
            joined = "\n".join(findings)
            self.assertIn("personal_model", joined)
            self.assertIn("legacy_pkg_prefix", joined)
            self.assertIn("win_user_home_path", joined)
            self.assertIn("unix_home_path", joined)
            self.assertIn(".pem", joined)
            self.assertIn(".crt", joined)
            self.assertIn("module.prop.tmpl", joined)
            self.assertIn("s.sh", joined)
            self.assertIn(".apk", joined)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import build_matrix as bm
import select_variant as sv


def base_profile(**overrides):
    p = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "manufacturer": "Google",
        "brand": "google",
        "android_sdk": 35,
        "android_release": "15",
        "cpu_abi": "arm64-v8a",
        "kernel_release": "6.1.75-android14-11",
        "kernel_major": 6,
        "kernel_minor": 1,
        "oem_signals": {
            "miui_ui_version": "",
            "hyperos_version": "",
            "oplusrom": "",
            "oneui": "",
            "build_flavor": "husky-user",
        },
        "root_manager": "ksu",
        "root_version": "0.9.5",
        "zygisk_detected": True,
        "cgroup_v2_freeze": True,
        "tproxy_capable": True,
        "work_profile_users": [10],
        "existing_guard_installed": False,
    }
    for k, v in overrides.items():
        if k == "oem_signals":
            p["oem_signals"].update(v)
        else:
            p[k] = v
    return p

    def test_all_valid_selections_match_build_matrix(self):
        matrix_set = {
            f"KernBox-{oem}-{kernel}-{root}-arm64.zip"
            for oem in bm.OEMS
            for kernel, roots in bm.KERNEL_ROOT_PAIRS
            for root in roots
        }
        self.assertEqual(len(matrix_set), 30)
        for brand, sigs in [
            ("Xiaomi", {"hyperos_version": "OS2"}),
            ("Google", {}),
            ("OnePlus", {"oplusrom": "V14"}),
            ("samsung", {"oneui": "60101"}),
            ("Nothing", {}),
        ]:
            for cg2 in (True, False):
                for rmgr, rver in (("ksu", "1.0.2"), ("ksu", "0.7.6"), ("magisk", "27.0"), ("apatch", "10763")):
                    p = base_profile(
                        brand=brand, manufacturer=brand,
                        oem_signals=sigs, cgroup_v2_freeze=cg2,
                        root_manager=rmgr, root_version=rver,
                    )
                    r = sv.select_variant(p)
                    self.assertTrue(r["ok"], r)
                    self.assertIn(r["artifact"], matrix_set)

    def test_reject_non_arm64(self):
```

`tools/verify_privacy_leak.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Open-source privacy, personal-data, legacy-branding, and LF line-ending gatekeeper."""

import argparse
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from typing import List, Tuple

REPO_ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

# Build literal tokens via concatenation so no raw sensitive string exists anywhere in source.
FORBIDDEN_LITERALS: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("personal_serial", "RWUG" + "XKHUZLHELZGM"),
    ("personal_model", "23054" + "RA19C"),
    ("private_ip_1", "216.23." + "100.6"),
    ("private_ip_2", "217.116." + "174.172"),
    ("local_path_vendor_ws", "Legend" + "SG"),
    ("local_path_user", "Users\\" + "king"),
    ("local_path_user_fwd", "Users/" + "king"),
    ("local_path_cloud", "Android-Cloud-" + "Pixel9Pro"),
    ("legacy_pkg_prefix", "com." + "legend"),
    ("legacy_guard_name", "legend_" + "jp_guard"),
    ("legacy_broker_name", "legend_" + "work_broker"),
    ("legacy_proxy_dir", "legend_" + "proxy"),
    ("legacy_cfg_dir", "legend_" + "work_cfg"),
    ("legacy_sock_dir", "legend_" + "work"),
    ("legacy_chain_lgw", "LGW" + "_"),
    ("legacy_chain_lgp", "LGP" + "_"),
    ("legacy_chain_lgc", "LGC" + "_"),
    ("legacy_stealth_tag", "Legend" + "Stealth"),
    ("legacy_work_tag", "Legend" + "Work"),
    ("legacy_brand_title", "Legend" + " Japan"),
    ("legacy_cn_name", "work-jp-" + "tproxy"),
    ("legacy_pid_field", "legend_" + "pid"),
]

FORBIDDEN_REGEXES: List[Tuple[str, re.Pattern]] = [
    ("private_key_pem", re.compile(r"-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY-----")),
    ("win_user_home_path", re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]:\\Users\\[^\\\s\"']+")),
    ("unix_home_path", re.compile(r"/home/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/")),
    ("xiaomi_personal_model", re.compile(r"\b2\d{4}[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z]\b")),
]

FORBIDDEN_EXTS = {
    ".apk", ".idsig", ".p12", ".jks", ".keystore",
    ".pem", ".crt", ".key", ".der", ".pk8", ".bks",
    ".zip", ".so",
}
LF_REQUIRED_SUFFIXES = (".sh", ".sh.tmpl", ".rule", ".prop.tmpl")


def collect_candidate_files(repo_root: pathlib.Path, mode: str) -> List[pathlib.Path]:
    if mode == "git":
        cmd = ["git", "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"]
        res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=repo_root, capture_output=True, check=True)
        rels = [p.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") for p in res.stdout.split(b"\x00") if p]
        return [repo_root / r for r in rels if (repo_root / r).is_file()]
    return [p for p in repo_root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and ".git" not in p.parts]


def scan_files(repo_root: pathlib.Path, files: List[pathlib.Path]) -> List[str]:
    findings: List[str] = []
    lower_literals = [(label, tok.lower()) for label, tok in FORBIDDEN_LITERALS]
    for fpath in sorted(files):
        rel = fpath.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix()
        low_ext = fpath.suffix.lower()
        if low_ext in FORBIDDEN_EXTS:
            findings.append(f"{rel}: forbidden tracked/non-ignored binary or keystore extension {low_ext}")
            continue
        raw = fpath.read_bytes()
        if any(rel.endswith(suf) for suf in LF_REQUIRED_SUFFIXES):
            if b"\r" in raw:
                findings.append(f"{rel}: contains CR (\\r) byte; UNIX LF line endings required")
        try:
            text = raw.decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
        for lineno, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            line_low = line.lower()
            for label, tok_low in lower_literals:
                if tok_low in line_low:
                    findings.append(f"{rel}:{lineno}: forbidden literal ({label})")
            for label, rx in FORBIDDEN_REGEXES:
                if rx.search(line):
                    findings.append(f"{rel}:{lineno}: forbidden secret/PII pattern ({label})")
    return findings


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Verify oss-main contains zero private data, legacy branding, or CRLF script errors")
    p.add_argument("--root", type=pathlib.Path, default=REPO_ROOT, help="Repository root to scan")
    p.add_argument("--mode", choices=("git", "walk"), default="git", help="File discovery mode")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)

    root = args.root.resolve()
    files = collect_candidate_files(root, args.mode)
    findings = scan_files(root, files)
    if findings:
        for item in findings:
            print(f"[FAIL] {item}", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"PRIVACY_CHECK_FAILED findings={len(findings)} scanned={len(files)}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f"PRIVACY_CHECK_PASSED scanned={len(files)} findings=0")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`verify/IsolatedProbeService.java`:

```java
package com.sandbox.verify;

import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.HandlerThread;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Message;
import android.os.Messenger;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.TimeZone;

/** Isolated sandboxed service (uid = userId*100000 + 99000..99999) for /proc & stealth hygiene audit. */
public final class IsolatedProbeService extends Service {
    static final int MSG_COLLECT_PROC = 1;
    static final int MSG_COLLECT_PROC_REPLY = 2;
    static final String EXTRA_JSON = "json";

    private HandlerThread workerThread;
    private Messenger messenger;

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        super.onCreate();
        workerThread = new HandlerThread("IsolatedProbeWorker");
        workerThread.start();
        messenger = new Messenger(new IncomingHandler(workerThread.getLooper()));
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return messenger.getBinder();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (workerThread != null) {
            workerThread.quitSafely();
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private static final class IncomingHandler extends Handler {
        IncomingHandler(Looper looper) {
            super(looper);
        }

        @Override
        public void handleMessage(Message msg) {
            if (msg.what != MSG_COLLECT_PROC || msg.replyTo == null) {
                super.handleMessage(msg);
                return;
            }
            JSONObject scan = ProcHygieneScanner.scan();
            try {
                scan.put("timezone", TimeZone.getDefault().getID());
                scan.put("locale", Locale.getDefault().toLanguageTag());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
            Bundle bundle = new Bundle();
            bundle.putString(EXTRA_JSON, scan.toString());
            Message reply = Message.obtain(null, MSG_COLLECT_PROC_REPLY);
            reply.setData(bundle);
            try {
                msg.replyTo.send(reply);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Caller disconnected before reply.
            }
        }
    }
}
```
